          root.meta.version=this.SCHEMA_VERSION;

        return root;

        if(typeof meta.lastAppliedOutputHash!=="string")meta.lastAppliedOutputHash="";
        if(typeof meta.debug!=="boolean")meta.debug=false;
        if(!meta.dirty||typeof meta.dirty!=="object"||Array.isArray(meta.dirty)){
          meta.dirty={
          };
        }
        if(typeof meta.dirty.player!=="boolean")meta.dirty.player=false;
        if(!Array.isArray(meta.dirty.abilities))meta.dirty.abilities=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(meta.dirty.items))meta.dirty.items=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(meta.dirty.actors))meta.dirty.actors=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(meta.dirty.entities))meta.dirty.entities=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(meta.dirty.routes))meta.dirty.routes=[];
        if(typeof meta.dirty.reputation!=="boolean")meta.dirty.reputation=false;
        if(typeof meta.dirty.quests!=="boolean")meta.dirty.quests=false;
        if(typeof meta.dirty.time!=="boolean")meta.dirty.time=false;
        if(!Array.isArray(meta.dirty.cards))meta.dirty.cards=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(root.logs.recentEvents))root.logs.recentEvents=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(root.logs.recentParses))root.logs.recentParses=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(root.logs.recentErrors))root.logs.recentErrors=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(root.logs.quarantine))root.logs.quarantine=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(root.logs.migrationHistory))root.logs.migrationHistory=[];
        if(!root.meta.consolidation||typeof root.meta.consolidation!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.meta.consolidation)){
          root.meta.consolidation={
          };
        }
        root.meta.consolidation.targetVersion="1.6.2";
        root.meta.consolidation.buildStage="chunks1-22-plus-regression-hardening-plus-progression-accuracy-plus-ability-growth-combat-rewards";
        root.meta.consolidation.wrapperPolicy="late hook/version wrappers removed; useful patch behavior assigned to core systems";
        root.meta.consolidation.patchInventoryVersion="1.5.1-chunks1-4";
        if(!root.progression.playerLevelState||typeof root.progression.playerLevelState!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.progression.playerLevelState)){
          root.progression.playerLevelState={
          };
        }
        if(root.player&&root.player.levelState&&typeof root.player.levelState==="object"&&!Array.isArray(root.player.levelState)){
          root.progression.playerLevelState=root.player.levelState;
        }
        else if(root.progression.playerLevelState&&typeof root.progression.playerLevelState==="object"){
          root.player.levelState=root.progression.playerLevelState;
        }
        if(!root.stats.player||typeof root.stats.player!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.stats.player)){
          root.stats.player={
          };
        }
        if(root.player&&root.player.stats&&typeof root.player.stats==="object"&&!Array.isArray(root.player.stats)){
          root.stats.player=root.player.stats;
        }
        else if(root.stats.player&&typeof root.stats.player==="object"){
          root.player.stats=root.stats.player;
        }
        if(!root.diagnostics.coreConsolidation||typeof root.diagnostics.coreConsolidation!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.diagnostics.coreConsolidation)){
          root.diagnostics.coreConsolidation={
            installed: true,
            version: "1.5.1-chunks1-4",
            removedLateWrappers: true,
            eventPipelineInstalled: true
          };
        }
      },
      ensureRepairBuckets(root){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object"||Array.isArray(root))return null;
        if(!root.logs||typeof root.logs!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.logs)){
          root.logs={
          };
        }
        if(!Array.isArray(root.logs.recentEvents))root.logs.recentEvents=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(root.logs.recentParses))root.logs.recentParses=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(root.logs.recentErrors))root.logs.recentErrors=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(root.logs.quarantine))root.logs.quarantine=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(root.logs.migrationHistory))root.logs.migrationHistory=[];
        return root.logs;
      },
      snapshotForQuarantine(value){
        try {
          return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
        }
        catch(_error){
          try {
            return String(value);
          }
          catch(_error2){
            return"(unserializable)";
          }
        }
      },
      pushQuarantine(root,
      kind,
      reason,
      payload){
        const logs=this.ensureRepairBuckets(root);
        if(!logs)return 0;
        logs.quarantine.push({
          turn: root&&root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0,
          kind: String(kind||"state"),
          reason: String(reason||"unspecified"),
          payload: this.snapshotForQuarantine(payload)
        });
        while(logs.quarantine.length>12){
          logs.quarantine.shift();
        }
        return 1;
      },
      recordMigration(root,
      entry){
        const logs=this.ensureRepairBuckets(root);
        if(!logs)return 0;
        const cleanEntry=entry&&typeof entry==="object"?entry: {
        };
        logs.migrationHistory.push({
          turn: root&&root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0,
          from: Number.isFinite(Number(cleanEntry.from))?Math.floor(Number(cleanEntry.from)): 0,
          to: Number.isFinite(Number(cleanEntry.to))?Math.floor(Number(cleanEntry.to)): 0,
          step: String(cleanEntry.step||""),
          repaired: Array.isArray(cleanEntry.repaired)?cleanEntry.repaired.slice(0,
          12): []
        });
        while(logs.migrationHistory.length>20){
          logs.migrationHistory.shift();
        }
        return 1;
      },
      validateState(root){
        const issues=[];
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object"||Array.isArray(root)){
          issues.push("invalid_root");
          return {
            ok: false,
            issues: issues
          };
        }
        const containers=["meta",
        "player",
        "build",
        "progression",
        "stats",
        "abilities",
        "items",
        "actors",
        "world",
        "time",
        "reputation",
        "quests",
        "pending",
        "cards",
        "cache",
        "diagnostics",
        "logs"];
        for(let i=0; i<containers.length; i+=1){
          const key=containers[i];
          if(!root[key]||typeof root[key]!=="object"||Array.isArray(root[key])){
            issues.push("bad_container:"+key);
          }
        }
        if(root.meta&&typeof root.meta==="object"&&!Array.isArray(root.meta)){
          if(!Number.isFinite(Number(root.meta.version))){
            issues.push("bad_meta_version");
          }
          if(!root.meta.dirty||typeof root.meta.dirty!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.meta.dirty)){
            issues.push("bad_meta_dirty");
          }
        }
        return {
          ok: issues.length===0,
          issues: issues
        };
      },
      repairStateIfNeeded(root,
      report){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object"||Array.isArray(root))return 0;
        let changes=0;
        const containers=["meta",
        "player",
        "build",
        "progression",
        "stats",
        "abilities",
        "items",
        "actors",
        "world",
        "time",
        "reputation",
        "quests",
        "pending",
        "cards",
        "cache",
        "diagnostics",
        "logs"];
        for(let i=0; i<containers.length; i+=1){
          const key=containers[i];
          if(!root[key]||typeof root[key]!=="object"||Array.isArray(root[key])){
            this.pushQuarantine(root,
            "container",
            key,
            root[key]);
            root[key]={
            };
            changes+=1;
          }
        }
        this.ensureRepairBuckets(root);
        if(!root.meta.dirty||typeof root.meta.dirty!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.meta.dirty)){
          this.pushQuarantine(root,
          "meta.dirty",
          "invalid_dirty_container",
          root.meta.dirty);
          root.meta.dirty={
          };
          changes+=1;
        }
        if(!Number.isFinite(Number(root.meta.version))){
          this.pushQuarantine(root,
          "meta.version",
          "invalid_version",
          root.meta.version);
          root.meta.version=0;
          changes+=1;
        }
        else {
          root.meta.version=Math.max(0,
          Math.floor(Number(root.meta.version)));
        }
        if(report&&Array.isArray(report.issues)&&report.issues.length){
          this.recordMigration(root,
          {
            from: root.meta.version,
            to: root.meta.version,
            step: "repair_state",
            repaired: report.issues
          });
        }
        return changes;
      },
      migrate(root){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object"||Array.isArray(root))return 0;
        this.ensureRepairBuckets(root);
        const startingVersion=Number.isFinite(Number(root.meta&&root.meta.version))?Math.max(0,
        Math.floor(Number(root.meta.version))): 0;
        let workingVersion=startingVersion;
        let changes=0;
        if(workingVersion>this.SCHEMA_VERSION){
          this.pushQuarantine(root,
          "meta.version",
          "future_version_detected",
          workingVersion);
          workingVersion=this.SCHEMA_VERSION;
          changes+=1;
        }
        if(workingVersion<1){
          this.ensureTopLevelShape(root);
          workingVersion=1;
          changes+=1;
          this.recordMigration(root,
          {
            from: startingVersion,
            to: 1,
            step: "baseline_schema_v1",
            repaired: []
          });
        }
        if(root.meta.version!==this.SCHEMA_VERSION){
          root.meta.version=this.SCHEMA_VERSION;
          changes+=1;
        }
        return changes;
      }
    },
    TurnEngine: {
      ensureScratch(root){
        if(!root.pending||typeof root.pending!=="object"){
          root.pending={
          };
        }
        if(!root.pending.turnScratch||typeof root.pending.turnScratch!=="object"){
          root.pending.turnScratch={
          };
        }
        if(!Array.isArray(root.pending.recentHookTrace)){
          root.pending.recentHookTrace=[];
        }
        return root.pending.turnScratch;
      },
      stableHash(value){
        const str=String(value??"");
        let hash=5381;
        for(let i=0; i<str.length; i+=1){
          hash=((hash<<5)+hash)^str.charCodeAt(i);
          hash=hash>>>0;
        }
        return String(hash);
      },
      beginHook(hookName,
      rawText){
        const root=state.aidrpg;
        const meta=root.meta;
        const scratch=this.ensureScratch(root);
        meta.currentHook=hookName;
        if(hookName==="input"){
          meta.currentTurn+=1;
          root.pending.turnScratch={
            turnNumber: meta.currentTurn,
            inputHash: this.stableHash(rawText),
            outputHash: "",
            duplicateOutput: false,
            lastHookStarted: "input"
          };
          if(globalThis.AIDRPG.OperationGuard&&typeof globalThis.AIDRPG.OperationGuard.startTurn==="function"){
            globalThis.AIDRPG.OperationGuard.startTurn(root);
          }
        }
        else {
          scratch.lastHookStarted=hookName;
        }
        scratch.hookName=hookName;
        scratch.startedAtTurn=meta.currentTurn;
        scratch.rawTextHash=this.stableHash(rawText);
        scratch.rawTextLength=String(rawText??"").length;
        root.pending.recentHookTrace.push({
          hook: hookName,
          turn: meta.currentTurn,
          hash: scratch.rawTextHash
        });
        if(root.pending.recentHookTrace.length>12){
          root.pending.recentHookTrace.shift();
        }
        if(hookName==="output"){
          const incomingHash=this.stableHash(rawText);
          scratch.outputHash=incomingHash;
          scratch.duplicateOutput=incomingHash===meta.lastAppliedOutputHash;
        }
      },
      endHook(hookName,
      finalText){
        const root=state.aidrpg;
        const meta=root.meta;
        const scratch=this.ensureScratch(root);
        if(hookName==="output"){
          const finalHash=this.stableHash(finalText);
          scratch.outputHash=finalHash;
          meta.lastAppliedOutputHash=finalHash;
        }
        scratch.lastHookEnded=hookName;
        meta.currentHook="";
      },
      isDuplicateCurrentOutput(){
        const root=state.aidrpg;
        if(!root||!root.pending||!root.pending.turnScratch){
          return false;
        }
        return root.pending.turnScratch.duplicateOutput===true;
      }
    },
    OperationGuard: {
      init(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object"||Array.isArray(root))return null;
        if(!root.pending||typeof root.pending!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.pending)){
          root.pending={
          };
        }
        if(!root.pending.operationGuard||typeof root.pending.operationGuard!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.pending.operationGuard)){
          root.pending.operationGuard={
          };
        }
        const guard=root.pending.operationGuard;
        if(!Array.isArray(guard.recentKeys))guard.recentKeys=[];
        if(typeof guard.currentTurn!=="number"){
          guard.currentTurn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0;
        }
        if(typeof guard.maxKeys!=="number")guard.maxKeys=240;
        if(typeof guard.keepTurns!=="number")guard.keepTurns=6;
        return guard;
      },
      stableSerialize(value){
        const seen=new WeakSet();
        const normalize=(input)=>{
          if(input==null)return null;
          const type=typeof input;
          if(type==="string"||type==="number"||type==="boolean"){
            return input;
          }
          if(Array.isArray(input)){
            return input.map(normalize);
          }
          if(type==="object"){
            if(seen.has(input))return"[circular]";
            seen.add(input);
            const out={
            };
            const keys=Object.keys(input).sort();
            for(let i=0; i<keys.length; i+=1){
              const key=keys[i];
              const value=input[key];
              if(typeof value==="function")continue;
              out[key]=normalize(value);
            }
            return out;
          }
          return String(input);
        };
        try {
          return JSON.stringify(normalize(value));
        }
        catch(_error){
          try {
            return String(value);
          }
          catch(_error2){
            return"";
          }
        }
      },
      makeKey(spec={
      },
      root=state.aidrpg){
        const A=globalThis.AIDRPG;
        const meta=root&&root.meta?root.meta: {
        };
        const hook=String(spec.hook||meta.currentHook||"");
        const turn=typeof meta.currentTurn==="number"?meta.currentTurn: 0;
        const kind=String(spec.kind||"operation");
        const target=String(spec.target||"");
        const fingerprintSource={
          type: String(spec.type||""),
          sourceId: String(spec.sourceId||""),
          payload: spec.payload&&typeof spec.payload==="object"?spec.payload: spec.payload??null
        };
        const serialized=this.stableSerialize(fingerprintSource);
        const fingerprint=A&&A.TurnEngine&&typeof A.TurnEngine.stableHash==="function"?A.TurnEngine.stableHash(serialized): serialized;
        return[hook,
        turn,
        kind,
        target,
        fingerprint].join("|");
      },
      startTurn(root=state.aidrpg){
        const guard=this.init(root);
        if(!guard)return 0;
        const turn=root&&root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0;
        guard.currentTurn=turn;
        return this.prune(root);
      },
      prune(root=state.aidrpg){
        const guard=this.init(root);
        if(!guard)return 0;
        const currentTurn=typeof guard.currentTurn==="number"?guard.currentTurn: 0;
        const keepTurns=typeof guard.keepTurns==="number"?guard.keepTurns: 6;
        const minTurn=currentTurn-keepTurns;
        let removed=0;
        guard.recentKeys=guard.recentKeys.filter((entry)=>{
          const keep=entry&&typeof entry==="object"&&typeof entry.turn==="number"&&entry.turn>=minTurn;
          if(!keep)removed+=1;
          return keep;
        });
        const maxKeys=typeof guard.maxKeys==="number"?guard.maxKeys: 240;
        while(guard.recentKeys.length>maxKeys){
          guard.recentKeys.shift();
          removed+=1;
        }
        return removed;
      },
      wasApplied(key,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        const guard=this.init(root);
        if(!guard||!key)return false;
        for(let i=0; i<guard.recentKeys.length; i+=1){
          const entry=guard.recentKeys[i];
          if(entry&&entry.key===key){
            return true;
          }
        }
        return false;
      },
      recordApplied(key,
      spec={
      },
      root=state.aidrpg){
        const guard=this.init(root);
        if(!guard||!key)return 0;
        if(this.wasApplied(key,
        root)){
          return 0;
        }
        guard.recentKeys.push({
          key: key,
          turn: root&&root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0,
          hook: String(spec.hook||(root&&root.meta?root.meta.currentHook||"": "")),
          kind: String(spec.kind||"operation"),
          target: String(spec.target||"")
        });
        this.prune(root);
        return 1;
      },
      applyOnce(spec={
      },
      fn=null,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(typeof fn!=="function")return 0;
        const key=this.makeKey(spec,
        root);
        if(this.wasApplied(key,
        root)){
          return 0;
        }
        const changes=Number(fn()||0);
        if(changes>0){
          this.recordApplied(key,
          spec,
          root);
        }
        return changes;
      }
    },
    Utils: {
      clamp(value,
      min,
      max){
        const n=Number(value);
        const low=Number(min);
        const high=Number(max);
        if(!Number.isFinite(n))return Number.isFinite(low)?low: 0;
        if(!Number.isFinite(low)&&!Number.isFinite(high))return n;
        if(!Number.isFinite(low))return Math.min(n,
        high);
        if(!Number.isFinite(high))return Math.max(n,
        low);
        return Math.max(low,
        Math.min(high,
        n));
      },
      round(value,
      places=0){
        const n=Number(value);
        const p=Math.max(0,
        Math.floor(Number(places)||0));
        if(!Number.isFinite(n))return 0;
        const factor=Math.pow(10,
        p);
        return Math.round(n*factor)/factor;
      },
      normalizeSpaces(value){
        return String(value??"").replace(/\s+/g,
        " ").trim();
      },
      safeString(value,
      fallback=""){
        if(value==null)return String(fallback);
        return String(value);
      },
      toKey(value){
        return this.safeString(value).normalize("NFKD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,
        "").replace(/[’'`´"]/g,
        "").replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g,
        "$1_$2").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,
        "_").replace(/^_+|_+$/g,
        "").replace(/_+/g,
        "_");
      },
      ensureObject(target,
      key){
        if(!target[key]||typeof target[key]!=="object"||Array.isArray(target[key])){
          target[key]={
          };
        }
        return target[key];
      },
      ensureArray(target,
      key){
        if(!Array.isArray(target[key])){
          target[key]=[];
        }
        return target[key];
      },
      safeGet(root,
      path,
      fallback=undefined){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return fallback;
        const parts=Array.isArray(path)?path: String(path??"").split(".").filter(Boolean);
        let ref=root;
        for(const part of parts){
          if(ref==null||typeof ref!=="object"||!(part in ref)){
            return fallback;
          }
          ref=ref[part];
        }
        return ref;
      },
      safeSet(root,
      path,
      value){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return root;
        const parts=Array.isArray(path)?path: String(path??"").split(".").filter(Boolean);
        if(parts.length===0)return root;
        let ref=root;
        for(let i=0; i<parts.length-1; i+=1){
          const part=parts[i];
          if(!ref[part]||typeof ref[part]!=="object"||Array.isArray(ref[part])){
            ref[part]={
            };
          }
          ref=ref[part];
        }
        ref[parts[parts.length-1]]=value;
        return root;
      },
      pushUnique(arrayRef,
      value){
        if(!Array.isArray(arrayRef))return arrayRef;
        if(!arrayRef.includes(value)){
          arrayRef.push(value);
        }
        return arrayRef;
      },
      removeValue(arrayRef,
      value){
        if(!Array.isArray(arrayRef))return arrayRef;
        const idx=arrayRef.indexOf(value);
        if(idx!==-1){
          arrayRef.splice(idx,
          1);
        }
        return arrayRef;
      },
      makeId(prefix="id"){
        const root=state.aidrpg||{
        };
        const meta=root.meta||{
        };
        const turn=Number(meta.currentTurn||0);
        const seed=Number(meta.seed||0);
        meta.seed=seed+1;
        if(root.meta){
          root.meta.seed=meta.seed;
        }
        const base=`${prefix}_${turn}_${meta.seed}`;
        return this.toKey(base);
      },
      ensureLogBuckets(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return;
        if(!root.logs||typeof root.logs!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.logs)){
          root.logs={
          };
        }
        if(!Array.isArray(root.logs.recentEvents))root.logs.recentEvents=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(root.logs.recentParses))root.logs.recentParses=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(root.logs.recentErrors))root.logs.recentErrors=[];
      },
      log(bucket,
      message,
      maxEntries=30){
        const root=state.aidrpg;
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return;
        this.ensureLogBuckets(root);
        const allowed=new Set(["recentEvents",
        "recentParses",
        "recentErrors"]);
        const bucketName=allowed.has(bucket)?bucket: "recentEvents";
        const list=root.logs[bucketName];
        list.push({
          turn: this.safeGet(root,
          "meta.currentTurn",
          0),
          hook: this.safeGet(root,
          "meta.currentHook",
          ""),
          message: this.safeString(message)
        });
        while(list.length>maxEntries){
          list.shift();
        }
      },
      logEvent(message,
      maxEntries=30){
        this.log("recentEvents",
        message,
        maxEntries);
      },
      logParse(message,
      maxEntries=30){
        this.log("recentParses",
        message,
        maxEntries);
      },
      logError(message,
      maxEntries=30){
        this.log("recentErrors",
        message,
        maxEntries);
      },
      ensureDirtyShape(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return;
        if(!root.meta||typeof root.meta!=="object")root.meta={
        };
        if(!root.meta.dirty||typeof root.meta.dirty!=="object")root.meta.dirty={
        };
        const dirty=root.meta.dirty;
        if(typeof dirty.player!=="boolean")dirty.player=false;
        if(!Array.isArray(dirty.abilities))dirty.abilities=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(dirty.items))dirty.items=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(dirty.actors))dirty.actors=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(dirty.entities))dirty.entities=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(dirty.routes))dirty.routes=[];
        if(typeof dirty.reputation!=="boolean")dirty.reputation=false;
        if(typeof dirty.quests!=="boolean")dirty.quests=false;
        if(typeof dirty.time!=="boolean")dirty.time=false;
        if(!Array.isArray(dirty.cards))dirty.cards=[];
      },
      markDirty(kind,
      value=true,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return;
        this.ensureDirtyShape(root);
        const dirty=root.meta.dirty;
        if(!(kind in dirty))return;
        if(Array.isArray(dirty[kind])){
          if(value!==false&&value!=null){
            this.pushUnique(dirty[kind],
            value);
          }
        }
        else {
          dirty[kind]=Boolean(value);
        }
      },
      clearDirty(kind,
      value=null,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return;
        this.ensureDirtyShape(root);
        const dirty=root.meta.dirty;
        if(!(kind in dirty))return;
        if(Array.isArray(dirty[kind])){
          if(value==null){
            dirty[kind]=[];
          }
          else {
            this.removeValue(dirty[kind],
            value);
          }
        }
        else {
          dirty[kind]=false;
        }
      },
      invalidateSceneCache(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return;
        if(!root.cache||typeof root.cache!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.cache)){
          root.cache={
          };
        }
        root.cache.scenePacket="";
        root.cache.playerPacket="";
        root.cache.actorPacket="";
        root.cache.lastSceneHash="";
        root.cache.parserHints={
        };
        root.cache.localEntityIds=[];
        root.cache.localActorIds=[];
      },
      invalidatePackets(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return;
        if(!root.cache||typeof root.cache!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.cache)){
          root.cache={
          };
        }
        root.cache.scenePacket="";
        root.cache.playerPacket="";
        root.cache.actorPacket="";
        root.cache.lastSceneHash="";
      }
    },
    RuntimeGate: {
      normalizeText(value){
        try {
          return typeof value==="string"?value: String(value??"");
        }
        catch(_error){
          return"";
        }
      },
      ensureBootstrapDiagnostics(){
        if(typeof state!=="object"||state===null||Array.isArray(state)){
          return null;
        }
        if(!state.__aidrpgBootstrap||typeof state.__aidrpgBootstrap!=="object"||Array.isArray(state.__aidrpgBootstrap)){
          state.__aidrpgBootstrap={
          };
        }
        if(!Array.isArray(state.__aidrpgBootstrap.diagnostics)){
          state.__aidrpgBootstrap.diagnostics=[];
        }
        return state.__aidrpgBootstrap.diagnostics;
      },
      logFailure(hookName,
      result){
        const bucket=this.ensureBootstrapDiagnostics();
        if(!bucket)return;
        bucket.push({
          hook: String(hookName||""),
          issues: Array.isArray(result&&result.issues)?result.issues.slice(0,
          6): ["unknown_runtime_failure"],
          turn: state&&state.aidrpg&&state.aidrpg.meta&&typeof state.aidrpg.meta.currentTurn==="number"?state.aidrpg.meta.currentTurn: 0
        });
        while(bucket.length>12){
          bucket.shift();
        }
      },
      validate(hookName,
      rawValue){
        const issues=[];
        const safeText=this.normalizeText(rawValue);
        if(typeof state!=="object"||state===null||Array.isArray(state)){
          issues.push("invalid_state");
        }
        if(typeof safeText!=="string"){
          issues.push("invalid_text");
        }
        if(hookName==="context"){
          if(!globalThis.info||typeof info!=="object"||Array.isArray(info)){
            issues.push("invalid_info");
          }
        }
        return {
          ok: issues.length===0,
          hook: String(hookName||""),
          text: safeText,
          issues: issues
        };
      },
      failSoft(hookName,
      result,
      rawValue){
        const safeText=result&&typeof result.text==="string"?result.text: this.normalizeText(rawValue);
        this.logFailure(hookName,
        result||{
          issues: ["unknown_runtime_failure"]
        });
        return {
          text: safeText
        };
      }
    },
    PatchInventory: {
      VERSION: "1.5.1-chunks1-4",
      entries: [
        {
          oldLayer: "v1.0.4-v1.1.6 beta/cleanpass wrappers",
          issue: "Late wrappers changed hooks and version identity after the core object was already built.",

          status: "removed_from_hook_chain"

        {

          targetSystem: "InventorySystem, QuestLogSystem, ActorProfileSystem, AbilitySystem",

        },
        {

          targetSystem: "TimeTravelSystem, ReputationSystem, SceneStateSystem, CardSyncSystem",
          status: "assigned_for_core_absorption"

        }
      ],
      init(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object"||Array.isArray(root))return null;
        if(!root.diagnostics||typeof root.diagnostics!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.diagnostics)){
          root.diagnostics={
          };

      }

    EventPipeline: {
      VERSION: "1.5.1-chunks1-4",
      init(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object"||Array.isArray(root))return null;
        if(!root.pending||typeof root.pending!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.pending)){
          root.pending={
          };
        }
        if(!root.pending.outputPipeline||typeof root.pending.outputPipeline!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.pending.outputPipeline)){
          root.pending.outputPipeline={
            version: this.VERSION,
            lastOutputHash: "",
            candidates: [],
            validated: [],
            events: [],
            notes: []
          };
        }
        const pipe=root.pending.outputPipeline;
        if(!Array.isArray(pipe.candidates))pipe.candidates=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(pipe.validated))pipe.validated=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(pipe.events))pipe.events=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(pipe.notes))pipe.notes=[];
        pipe.version=this.VERSION;
        return pipe;
      },
      hashText(value){
        if(globalThis.AIDRPG&&globalThis.AIDRPG.TurnEngine&&typeof globalThis.AIDRPG.TurnEngine.stableHash==="function"){
          return globalThis.AIDRPG.TurnEngine.stableHash(value);
        }
        return String(value==null?"": value).length+"";
      },
      snapshot(value){
        try {
          return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
        }
        catch(_error){
          return value==null?null: String(value);
        }
      },
      runOutput(rawText, root=state.aidrpg){
        const pipe=this.init(root);
        if(!pipe)return null;
        const A=globalThis.AIDRPG||{
        };
        const raw=String(rawText==null?"": rawText);
        pipe.lastOutputHash=this.hashText(raw);
        pipe.candidates=[];
        pipe.validated=[];
        pipe.events=[];
        pipe.notes=[];
        const duplicate=A.TurnEngine&&typeof A.TurnEngine.isDuplicateCurrentOutput==="function"&&A.TurnEngine.isDuplicateCurrentOutput();
        if(duplicate){
          pipe.notes.push("duplicate_output_seen_before_system_processing");
        }
        try {
          if(A.ConsequenceParser&&typeof A.ConsequenceParser.init==="function"){
            A.ConsequenceParser.init();
          }
          if(A.ValidationSystem&&typeof A.ValidationSystem.init==="function"){
            A.ValidationSystem.init();
          }
          if(A.ConsequenceParser&&typeof A.ConsequenceParser.processOutput==="function"){
            A.ConsequenceParser.processOutput(raw);
          }
          if(root.pending&&Array.isArray(root.pending.consequenceCandidates)){
            pipe.candidates=this.snapshot(root.pending.consequenceCandidates)||[];
          }
          if(A.ValidationSystem&&typeof A.ValidationSystem.processOutput==="function"){
            A.ValidationSystem.processOutput(raw);
          }
          if(root.pending&&Array.isArray(root.pending.validatedConsequences)){
            pipe.validated=this.snapshot(root.pending.validatedConsequences)||[];
          }
          const validated=Array.isArray(root.pending&&root.pending.validatedConsequences)?root.pending.validatedConsequences: [];
          for(let i=0; i<validated.length; i+=1){
            const candidate=validated[i];
            if(!candidate||typeof candidate!=="object")continue;
            pipe.events.push({
              kind: "validated_consequence",
              category: String(candidate.category||"general"),
              target: String(candidate.targetId||candidate.id||candidate.subject||""),
              payload: this.snapshot(candidate),
              turn: root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0
            });
          }
          if(pipe.events.length===0&&pipe.candidates.length===0){
            pipe.notes.push("no_structured_consequences_detected");
          }
        }
        catch(error){
          pipe.notes.push("pipeline_failsoft:"+String(error&&error.message?error.message: error));
          if(A.Utils&&typeof A.Utils.logError==="function"){
            A.Utils.logError("EventPipeline fail-soft: "+String(error&&error.message?error.message: error));
          }
        }
        return pipe;
      }
    },
    EventReducer: {
      VERSION: "1.5.1-chunks1-4",
      init(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object"||Array.isArray(root))return null;
        if(!root.pending||typeof root.pending!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.pending)){
          root.pending={
          };
        }
        if(!root.pending.eventReducer||typeof root.pending.eventReducer!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.pending.eventReducer)){
          root.pending.eventReducer={
            version: this.VERSION,
            recentCommits: [],
            lastCommitTurn: 0
          };
        }
        const reducer=root.pending.eventReducer;
        if(!Array.isArray(reducer.recentCommits))reducer.recentCommits=[];
        reducer.version=this.VERSION;
        return reducer;
      },
      commitOutputEvents(events=[], root=state.aidrpg){
        const reducer=this.init(root);
        if(!reducer)return 0;
        const list=Array.isArray(events)?events: [];
        const turn=root&&root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0;
        let committed=0;
        if(!root.pending.committedOutputEvents||!Array.isArray(root.pending.committedOutputEvents)){
          root.pending.committedOutputEvents=[];
        }
        for(let i=0; i<list.length; i+=1){
          const event=list[i];
          if(!event||typeof event!=="object")continue;
          root.pending.committedOutputEvents.push({
            turn: turn,
            kind: String(event.kind||"event"),
            category: String(event.category||"general"),
            target: String(event.target||"")
          });
          reducer.recentCommits.push({
            turn: turn,
            kind: String(event.kind||"event"),
            category: String(event.category||"general"),
            target: String(event.target||"")
          });
          committed+=1;
        }
        while(root.pending.committedOutputEvents.length>20)root.pending.committedOutputEvents.shift();
        while(reducer.recentCommits.length>20)reducer.recentCommits.shift();
        reducer.lastCommitTurn=turn;
        reducer.lastCommitCount=committed;
        if(committed>0&&globalThis.AIDRPG&&globalThis.AIDRPG.Utils&&typeof globalThis.AIDRPG.Utils.logEvent==="function"){
          globalThis.AIDRPG.Utils.logEvent("EventReducer committed "+committed+" validated output event(s).");
        }
        return committed;
      }

    AdminDebugSystem: {

        if(C&&typeof C.init==="function")C.init(state.aidrpg);
        const cards=(state.aidrpg&&state.aidrpg.cards)||{};

        const keys=Object.keys(tomb);
        const lines=["[AIDRPG /tombstones]","Generated tombstones: "+keys.length,"Protected cards still restore automatically; generated cards respect deletion until new canon dirties the same target."];

      formatHelp(command){

        const join=(lines)=>lines.join("\n")+"\n";
        if(cmd==="/helpcommands"){

      formatNotice(message){
        return"[AIDRPG]\n"+String(message||"")+"\n";
      },
      fmtValue(value,
      fallback){
        if(fallback==null)fallback="(unset)";
        if(value==null)return fallback;
        const str=String(value).trim();
        return str?str: fallback;
      },
      fmtList(list,
      fallback){
        if(fallback==null)fallback="none";
        if(!Array.isArray(list)||list.length===0)return fallback;
        const cleaned=[];
        for(let i=0; i<list.length; i+=1){
          const v=String(list[i]||"").trim();
          if(v)cleaned.push(v);
        }
        return cleaned.length?cleaned.join(", "): fallback;
      },
      formatSheet(){
        const root=state.aidrpg||{
        };
        const meta=root.meta||{
        };
        const player=root.player||{
        };
        const levelState=player.levelState||{
        };
        const stats=player.stats||{
        };
        const body=player.body||{
        };
        const conditions=player.conditions||{
        };
        const appearance=player.appearance||{
        };
        const scene=root.world&&root.world.currentScene?root.world.currentScene: {
        };
        const locationsById=root.world&&root.world.locationsById?root.world.locationsById: {
        };
        const bench=player.derived&&player.derived.statBenchmark?player.derived.statBenchmark: null;
        const benchExpected=bench&&bench.expectedStats?bench.expectedStats: {
        };
        const benchGap=bench&&bench.gap?bench.gap: {
        };
        const fmtSigned=(value)=>{
          const n=Number(value||0);
          return(n>=0?"+": "")+n;
        };
        let parentLocationName="(none)";
        if(scene.parentLocationRef&&locationsById[scene.parentLocationRef]&&locationsById[scene.parentLocationRef].identity){
          parentLocationName=locationsById[scene.parentLocationRef].identity.displayName||scene.parentLocationRef;
        }
        else if(scene.parentLocationRef){
          parentLocationName=scene.parentLocationRef;
        }
        const lines=["[AIDRPG /sheet]",
        "Build Stage: "+this.fmtValue(globalThis.AIDRPG.BUILD_STAGE,
        "(unknown)"),
        "Current Turn: "+(meta.currentTurn!=null?meta.currentTurn: 0),
        "Debug: "+(meta.debug===true?"on": "off"),
        "",
        "Name: "+this.fmtValue(player.name),
        "Age: "+(player.age&&player.age>0?player.age: "(unknown)"),
        "Species: "+this.fmtValue(player.species),
        "Titles: "+this.fmtList(player.titles),
        "Level: "+(levelState.level!=null?levelState.level: "(pending)"),
        "XP: "+(levelState.xp!=null?levelState.xp: "(pending)")+" / "+(levelState.xpToNext!=null?levelState.xpToNext: "(pending)"),
        "",
        "HP: "+(stats.hp!=null?stats.hp: "(pending)")+" / "+(stats.maxHp!=null?stats.maxHp: "(pending)"),
        "MP: "+(stats.mp!=null?stats.mp: "(pending)")+" / "+(stats.maxMp!=null?stats.maxMp: "(pending)"),
        "EP: "+(stats.ep!=null?stats.ep: "(pending)")+" / "+(stats.maxEp!=null?stats.maxEp: "(pending)"),
        "ATK: "+(stats.atk!=null?stats.atk: "(pending)"),
        "DEF: "+(stats.def!=null?stats.def: "(pending)"),
        "SPD: "+(stats.spd!=null?stats.spd: "(pending)"),
        "INT: "+(stats.intl!=null?stats.intl: "(pending)"),
        "LCK: "+(stats.lck!=null?stats.lck: "(pending)"),
        "",
        "Scale Band: "+(bench&&bench.band?bench.band: "(pending)"),
        "Benchmark Role: "+(bench&&bench.role?bench.role: "dungeon"),
        "Benchmark Avg Stats: ATK "+(benchExpected.atk!=null?benchExpected.atk: "?")+", DEF "+(benchExpected.def!=null?benchExpected.def: "?")+", SPD "+(benchExpected.spd!=null?benchExpected.spd: "?")+", INT "+(benchExpected.intl!=null?benchExpected.intl: "?")+", LCK "+(benchExpected.lck!=null?benchExpected.lck: "?"),
        "Benchmark Gap: ATK "+fmtSigned(benchGap.atk)+", DEF "+fmtSigned(benchGap.def)+", SPD "+fmtSigned(benchGap.spd)+", INT "+fmtSigned(benchGap.intl)+", LCK "+fmtSigned(benchGap.lck),
        "Above Benchmark: "+this.fmtList(bench&&bench.primaryStats?bench.primaryStats: []),
        "Below Benchmark: "+this.fmtList(bench&&bench.weakStats?bench.weakStats: []),
        "",
        "Player Location Ref: "+this.fmtValue(player.locationRef,
        "(none)"),
        "Player Scene Ref: "+this.fmtValue(player.sceneRef,
        "(none)"),
        "Scene Name: "+this.fmtValue(scene.displayName,
        "(none)"),
        "Scene Type: "+this.fmtValue(scene.sceneType,
        "(none)"),
        "Scene Parent Location: "+parentLocationName,
        "Scene Parent Ref: "+this.fmtValue(scene.parentLocationRef,
        "(none)"),
        "Visible Traits: "+this.fmtList(appearance.visibleTraits),
        "Outfit Summary: "+this.fmtValue(appearance.outfitSummary,
        "(none)"),
        "Injuries: "+this.fmtList(body.injuries),
        "Mutations: "+this.fmtList(body.mutations),
        "Active Conditions: "+this.fmtList(conditions.active),
        "Permanent Conditions: "+this.fmtList(conditions.permanent)];
        return lines.join("\n")+"\n";
      },
      formatInventory(){
        const root=state.aidrpg||{
        };
        const items=root.items||{
        };
        const byId=items.byId||{
        };
        const equipment=items.equipment||{
        };
        const ownership=items.ownership||{
        };
        const currency=(items.currency&&items.currency.byType)||{
        };
        const resolveItemName=(itemId)=>{
          if(!itemId)return"(empty)";
          const item=byId[itemId];
          if(!item||typeof item!=="object")return String(itemId);
          return item.displayName||item.baseType||String(itemId);
        };
        const playerOwned=Array.isArray(ownership.player)?ownership.player: [];
        const equippedLines=Object.keys(equipment).length?Object.keys(equipment).map(function(slot){
          return slot+": "+resolveItemName(equipment[slot]);
        }): ["(equipment not initialized yet)"];
        const ownedNames=playerOwned.length?playerOwned.map(resolveItemName).join(", "): "none";
        const lines=["[AIDRPG /inventory]",
        "Owned Item IDs: "+playerOwned.length,
        "Owned Items: "+ownedNames,
        "",
        "Equipped:"];
        for(let i=0; i<equippedLines.length; i+=1){
          lines.push(equippedLines[i]);
        }
        lines.push("");
        lines.push("Currency - copper: "+(currency.copper!=null?currency.copper: 0));
        lines.push("Currency - silver: "+(currency.silver!=null?currency.silver: 0));
        lines.push("Currency - gold: "+(currency.gold!=null?currency.gold: 0));
        return lines.join("\n")+"\n";
      },
      formatTime(){
        const root=state.aidrpg||{
        };
        const time=root.time||{
        };
        const current=time.current||{
        };
        const elapsed=time.elapsed||{
        };
        const routes=time.routes||{
        };
        const contradictions=Array.isArray(time.contradictionFlags)?time.contradictionFlags: [];
        const routeKeys=Object.keys(routes.knownTravelTimes||{
        });
        const routeRows=[];
        const seenRouteRows={
        };
        const T=globalThis.AIDRPG&&globalThis.AIDRPG.TimeTravelSystem?globalThis.AIDRPG.TimeTravelSystem: null;
        for(let i=0; i<routeKeys.length&&routeRows.length<6; i+=1){
          const row=routes.knownTravelTimes[routeKeys[i]];
          if(!row||typeof row.minutes!=="number"||row.minutes<=0)continue;
          const canon=T&&typeof T.makeCanonicalRouteKey==="function"?T.makeCanonicalRouteKey(row.fromRef,
          row.toRef): String(row.fromRef||"")+"|"+String(row.toRef||"");
          if(seenRouteRows[canon])continue;
          seenRouteRows[canon]=true;
          const label=T&&typeof T.formatRouteLabel==="function"?T.formatRouteLabel(row.fromRef,
          row.toRef,
          root): String(row.fromRef||"route").replace(/^location_/,
          "").replace(/_/g,
          " ")+" <-> "+String(row.toRef||"route").replace(/^location_/,
          "").replace(/_/g,
          " ");
          const delay=row.lastDelayReason&&row.lastActualMinutes&&row.lastActualMinutes>row.minutes?" | last actual "+row.lastActualMinutes+"m due to "+row.lastDelayReason: "";
          routeRows.push(label+" = "+row.minutes+"m base"+delay);
        }
        const recentRouteEvents=Array.isArray(routes.recentRouteEvents)?routes.recentRouteEvents.slice(Math.max(0,
        routes.recentRouteEvents.length-3)).map(function(row){
          return row&&row.message?row.message: "";
        }).filter(Boolean): [];
        const lines=["[AIDRPG /time]",
        "Day: "+(current.day!=null?current.day: "(pending)"),
        "Hour: "+(current.hour!=null?current.hour: "(pending)"),
        "Minute: "+(current.minute!=null?current.minute: "(pending)"),
        "Season: "+this.fmtValue(current.season,
        "(unset)"),
        "Weather: "+this.fmtValue(current.weather,
        "(unset)"),
        "",
        "Elapsed Hours: "+(elapsed.totalHours!=null?elapsed.totalHours: 0),
        "Known Route Times: "+routeRows.length,
        "Contradiction Flags: "+(contradictions.length?contradictions.join(", "): "none")];
        if(routeRows.length){
          lines.push("Known Routes: "+routeRows.join(" | "));
        }
        if(recentRouteEvents.length){
          lines.push("Recent Route Notes: "+recentRouteEvents.join(" | "));
        }
        return lines.join("\n")+"\n";
      },
      formatReputation(){
        const root=state.aidrpg||{
        };
        const reputation=root.reputation||{
        };
        const bySubject=reputation.bySubject||{
        };
        const subjects=Object.keys(bySubject).sort();
        const recent=Array.isArray(reputation.recentChanges)?reputation.recentChanges: [];
        const rumors=Array.isArray(reputation.rumors)?reputation.rumors: [];
        const titles=Array.isArray(reputation.titles)?reputation.titles: [];
        const lines=["[AIDRPG /reputation]",
        "Tracked Subjects: "+subjects.length];
        if(subjects.length){
          for(let i=0; i<subjects.length&&i<8; i+=1){
            const subject=bySubject[subjects[i]]||{
            };
            const identity=subject.identity||{
            };
            const mutable=subject.mutable||{
            };
            const name=identity.displayName||subjects[i];
            const score=typeof mutable.score==="number"?mutable.score: 0;
            const standing=mutable.standing||"neutral";
            const tags=Array.isArray(mutable.tags)&&mutable.tags.length?" | tags: "+mutable.tags.join(", "): "";
            lines.push("- "+name+" | "+standing+" | score "+score+tags);
          }
        }
        else {
          lines.push("- none");
        }
        lines.push("");
        lines.push("Titles: "+(titles.length?titles.join(", "): "none"));
        lines.push("Rumors: "+(rumors.length?rumors.slice(-3).map(function(r){
          return r.label||r.text||String(r);
        }).join(" | "): "none"));
        if(recent.length){
          lines.push("");
          lines.push("Recent Changes:");
          for(let i=Math.max(0, recent.length-5); i<recent.length; i+=1){
            const row=recent[i]||{
            };
            lines.push("- "+(row.subject||"unknown")+": "+(row.direction||"change")+" ("+(row.delta||0)+")");
          }
        }
        return lines.join("\n")+"\n";
      },
      formatQuestlog(){
        const root=state.aidrpg||{
        };
        const quests=root.quests||{
        };
        const active=Array.isArray(quests.active)?quests.active: [];
        const archived=Array.isArray(quests.archived)?quests.archived: [];
        const tracking=quests.tracking||{
        };
        const primaryId=tracking.primaryQuestId||null;
        const summarizeQuest=(quest)=>{
          if(!quest||typeof quest!=="object")return"(invalid quest)";
          const id=quest.id?" ["+quest.id+"]": "";
          const title=quest.title||"(untitled quest)";
          const status=quest.status||"unknown";
          const reward=quest.rewardSummary?" | reward: "+quest.rewardSummary: "";
          return"- "+title+id+" | status: "+status+reward;
        };
        const lines=["[AIDRPG /questlog]",
        "Primary Quest ID: "+(primaryId||"(none)"),
        "Active Quests: "+active.length];
        if(active.length){
          for(let i=0; i<active.length; i+=1){
            lines.push(summarizeQuest(active[i]));
          }
        }
        else {
          lines.push("- none");
        }
        lines.push("");
        lines.push("Archived Quests: "+archived.length);
        return lines.join("\n")+"\n";
      },
      formatCombatMatrix(){
        const root=state.aidrpg||{};
        const A=globalThis.AIDRPG||{};
        if(A.PlayerSystem&&typeof A.PlayerSystem.init==="function")A.PlayerSystem.init(root);
        if(A.BuildIdentitySystem&&typeof A.BuildIdentitySystem.init==="function")A.BuildIdentitySystem.init(root);
        if(A.StatBenchmarkSystem&&typeof A.StatBenchmarkSystem.init==="function")A.StatBenchmarkSystem.init(root);
        if(A.CombatMatrixSystem&&typeof A.CombatMatrixSystem.init==="function")A.CombatMatrixSystem.init(root);
        const mech=A.StatBenchmarkSystem&&typeof A.StatBenchmarkSystem.buildMechanicsPacket==="function"?A.StatBenchmarkSystem.buildMechanicsPacket("wide",root):"";
        const matrix=A.CombatMatrixSystem&&typeof A.CombatMatrixSystem.buildCurrentMatchup==="function"?A.CombatMatrixSystem.buildCurrentMatchup("wide",root):"";
        const lines=["[AIDRPG /combat]",mech||"Mechanics unavailable.",matrix||"No active matchup detected. Combat will still use stats, build, resources, equipment, environment, and narrative position when a threat appears."];
        return lines.join("\n")+"\n";
      },
      formatContinuity(){
        const root=state.aidrpg||{};
        const A=globalThis.AIDRPG||{};
        if(A.Step6ContinuitySystem&&typeof A.Step6ContinuitySystem.init==="function")A.Step6ContinuitySystem.init(root);
        const rel=root.cache&&root.cache.step6Relevance?root.cache.step6Relevance:{};
        const actors=root.actors||{};
        const imp=actors.importanceById||{};
        const actorRows=Object.keys(imp).sort((a,b)=>Number((imp[b]||{}).tier||0)-Number((imp[a]||{}).tier||0)).slice(0,8).map((id)=>{
          const rec=actors.byId&&actors.byId[id]?actors.byId[id]:{};
          const ident=rec.identity||{};
          return "- "+(ident.name||ident.displayName||rec.name||id)+" | "+(imp[id].label||"unknown")+" | score "+(imp[id].score||0);
        });
        const world=root.world||{};const cont=world.continuity||{};
        const recent=Array.isArray(cont.recentWorldEvents)?cont.recentWorldEvents.slice(-6):[];
        const time=root.time||{};const stability=time.stability||{};
        const lines=["[AIDRPG /continuity]","Focus: "+(rel.focus||"general"),"Reasons: "+(Array.isArray(rel.reasons)&&rel.reasons.length?rel.reasons.join(", "):"none"),"","Actor Importance:"];
        if(actorRows.length)lines.push.apply(lines,actorRows);else lines.push("- none yet");
        lines.push("","Recent World Continuity:");
        if(recent.length){for(let i=0;i<recent.length;i+=1){lines.push("- "+(recent[i].text||"world update"));}}else lines.push("- none yet");
        lines.push("","Time Stability:");

    PlayerSystem: {

      processContext(rawText,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        return 0;
      },
      processOutput(rawText,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const text=String(rawText||"");
        let changes=0;
        changes+=this.applyValidatedConsequences(root);
        if(text){
          const hints=this.extractIdentityHints(text);
          changes+=this.applyIdentityHints(hints,
          root);
          changes+=this.applyBoundaryEvents(text,
          root);
          changes+=this.applyTransformationCanon(text,
          root);
        }
        return changes;
      },
      applyBoundaryEvents(rawText,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const A=globalThis.AIDRPG||{
        };
        const U=A.Utils||null;
        const raw=String(rawText||"");
        const lower=raw.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,
        " ").trim();
        if(!lower)return 0;
        const player=root.player||{
        };
        const stats=player.stats||{
        };
        const conditions=player.conditions||{
        };
        if(!Array.isArray(conditions.active))conditions.active=[];
        const pushCondition=(label)=>{
          const value=String(label||"").trim();
          if(!value)return 0;
          if(conditions.active.indexOf(value)!==-1)return 0;
          conditions.active.push(value);
          return 1;
        };
        const applyCanonicalCondition=(label,
        severity="severe")=>{
          if(A.PersistentTraitSystem&&typeof A.PersistentTraitSystem.applyConditionCandidate==="function"){
            return A.PersistentTraitSystem.applyConditionCandidate({
              name: String(label||""),
              mode: "active",
              severity: String(severity||"moderate")
            },
            raw,
            root)||0;
          }
          return pushCondition(label);
        };
        const logEvent=(message)=>{
          if(U&&typeof U.logEvent==="function")U.logEvent(message);
        };
        let changes=0;
        const deathMention=/\b(?:dead|die|dies|died|death)\b/.test(lower);
        const nonActualDeath=deathMention&&(/\b(?:rumou?r|rumou?red|heard|says?|said|claims?|claimed|reports?|reported)\b[^.!?]{0,80}\b(?:dead|die|died|death)\b/.test(lower)||/\b(?:could have|might have|would have|almost|nearly)\b[^.!?]{0,40}\b(?:died|die|dead)\b/.test(lower)||/\b(?:but|yet)\b[^.!?]{0,60}\b(?:you are standing|you stand|you are alive|not dead)\b/.test(lower));
        if(nonActualDeath){
          const standingAlive=/\b(?:you are standing|you stand|standing right there|you are alive|not dead)\b/.test(lower);
          logEvent(standingAlive?"Death rumor rejected: player is standing/alive.": "Death rumor rejected: player remains alive.");
        }
        else if(/\byou\s+(?:die|died|are dead)\b/.test(lower)||/\b(?:blade|spear|arrow|claw)\b[^.!?]{0,40}\bpierces?\s+your\s+heart\b/.test(lower)||/\bfatal\s+(?:blow|wound|strike)\b[^.!?]{0,60}\byou\b/.test(lower)){
          changes+=applyCanonicalCondition("dead",
          "terminal");
          if(typeof stats.hp==="number"&&stats.hp!==0){
            stats.hp=0;
            changes+=1;
          }
          logEvent("Boundary: player death confirmed.");
        }
        if(/\b(?:knocks?|knocked)\s+you\s+unconscious\b|\byou\s+(?:fall|fell|go|went)\s+unconscious\b|\byou\s+are\s+unconscious\b/.test(lower)){
          changes+=applyCanonicalCondition("unconscious",
          "severe");
          logEvent("Boundary: player unconscious.");
        }
        const failedEscapeMatch=raw.match(/\b(?:your\s+attack\s+misses|you\s+miss|you\s+fail|the\s+attempt\s+fails)\b[^.!?]{0,100}?\b(?:the\s+)?([a-z][a-z' -]{1,40}?)\s+(?:escapes?|gets\s+away|flees|runs\s+off)(?:\s+with\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.!?;,]+))?/i);
        if(failedEscapeMatch||/\b(?:your\s+attack\s+misses|you\s+miss|you\s+fail|the\s+attempt\s+fails)\b[^.!?]{0,100}\b(?:escapes?|gets\s+away|flees|runs\s+off)\b/.test(lower)){
          const target=failedEscapeMatch&&failedEscapeMatch[1]?String(failedEscapeMatch[1]).replace(/^(?:and\s+)?(?:the|an|a)\s+/i,
          "").replace(/\s+/g,
          " ").trim(): "target";
          const carried=failedEscapeMatch&&failedEscapeMatch[2]?String(failedEscapeMatch[2]).replace(/^(?:the|an|a)\s+/i,
          "").replace(/[.,;:!?]+$/g,
          "").replace(/\s+/g,
          " ").trim(): "";
          logEvent("Failed action: attack misses/missed; "+target+" escaped"+(carried?" with "+carried: "")+"; no benefit granted.");
        }
        if(changes>0){
          this.recomputeDerived(player);
          if(U&&typeof U.markDirty==="function")U.markDirty("player",
          true,
          root);
          if(U&&typeof U.invalidatePackets==="function")U.invalidatePackets(root);
        }
        return changes;
      },
      applyTransformationCanon(rawText,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const A=globalThis.AIDRPG||{
        };
        const U=A.Utils||null;

        const lower=raw.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,

        };

        });

        });

        });

        if(!Array.isArray(body.speciesTraits))body.speciesTraits=[];

        if(!Array.isArray(appearance.visibleTraits))appearance.visibleTraits=[];

          const text=String(value||"").replace(/\s+/g,
          " ").trim();
          if(!Array.isArray(list)||!text)return 0;
          if(list.indexOf(text)!==-1)return 0;
          list.push(text);

        const wordYears={
          one: 1,
          two: 2,
          three: 3,
          four: 4,

          eight: 8,
          nine: 9,
          ten: 10,

              years: years,

        if(!temporary){
          const speciesPatterns=[/\b(?:god|goddess|divine\s+force|curse|ritual|magic|blessing|corruption)[^.!?]{0,80}\b(?:changes|changed|transforms|transformed|turns|turned|makes|made)\s+you\s+(?:into|to)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+)?([a-z][a-z' -]{2,40})/i,

            changes+=pushUnique(appearance.visibleTraits,
            row.label);
            changes+=pushUnique(body.bodyTags,
            row.label.replace(/\s+/g,
            "_"));
            if(permanentBodyWording){
              changes+=pushUnique(body.mutations,
              row.label);
              changes+=pushUnique(conditions.permanent,
              row.label);
            }
            if(row.limb&&/\bright\s+arm\b/i.test(raw)&&body.limbs)body.limbs.rightArm=row.label;
            if(row.limb&&/\bleft\s+arm\b/i.test(raw)&&body.limbs)body.limbs.leftArm=row.label;
          }
        }
        const titlePatterns=[/\byou\s+(?:are\s+)?(?:now\s+)?(?:known\s+as|called)\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30})\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{2,40})\b/,
        /\b([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30})\s+(?:earns|earned|takes|took|receives|received)\s+the\s+title\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{2,40})\b/i,
        /\byou\s+(?:earn|earned|take|took|receive|received)\s+the\s+title\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{2,40})\b/i];
        for(let i=0; i<titlePatterns.length; i+=1){
          const match=raw.match(titlePatterns[i]);
          if(!match)continue;
          if(i===0&&match[1]&&match[2]){
            if(!player.name||player.name.toLowerCase()===String(match[1]).toLowerCase()){
              if(player.name!==match[1]){
                player.name=match[1];
                changes+=1;
              }
            }
            changes+=pushUnique(player.titles,
            match[2]);
          }
          else if(match[1]){
            changes+=pushUnique(player.titles,
            match[1]);
          }
          break;
        }
        if(changes>0){
          if(player.history.majorEvents.length>20)player.history.majorEvents=player.history.majorEvents.slice(-20);
          this.recomputeDerived(player);
          if(U&&typeof U.markDirty==="function")U.markDirty("player",
          true,
          root);
          if(U&&typeof U.invalidatePackets==="function")U.invalidatePackets(root);
          if(U&&typeof U.logEvent==="function")U.logEvent("Player canon updated: transformation/body/title/time-skip.");
        }
        return changes;
      },
      applyValidatedConsequences(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const A=globalThis.AIDRPG;
        const U=A.Utils;
        const Guard=A.OperationGuard;
        const player=root.player||{
        };
        const stats=player.stats||{
        };
        const body=player.body||{
        };
        const pending=root.pending||{
        };
        const validated=Array.isArray(pending.validatedConsequences)?pending.validatedConsequences: [];
        let changes=0;
        const pushUniqueLocal=(list,
        value)=>{
          const text=String(value||"").trim();
          if(!Array.isArray(list)||!text)return 0;
          if(list.indexOf(text)!==-1)return 0;
          list.push(text);
          return 1;
        };
        for(let i=0; i<validated.length; i+=1){
          const candidate=validated[i];
          if(!candidate||candidate.category!=="player"||candidate._playerApplied===true){
            continue;
          }
          const payload=candidate.payload||{
          };
          const target=candidate.type==="resource_state"?String(payload.resource||"player"): candidate.type==="body_injury"?String(payload.bodyPart||payload.injuryTag||"body"): String(payload.status||candidate.type||"player");
          const commit=()=>{
            let localChanges=0;
            if(candidate.type==="resource_state"){
              const resource=String(payload.resource||"");
              const stateName=String(payload.state||"");
              const maxKey=resource==="hp"?"maxHp": resource==="mp"?"maxMp": resource==="ep"?"maxEp": "";
              const currentValue=Number(stats[resource]);
              const maxValue=Number(stats[maxKey]);
              if(maxKey&&Number.isFinite(currentValue)&&Number.isFinite(maxValue)){
                let nextValue=currentValue;
                if(stateName==="empty"){
                  nextValue=0;
                }
                else if(stateName==="low"){
                  const ratio=resource==="hp"?0.30: 0.25;
                  nextValue=Math.min(currentValue,
                  Math.max(0,
                  Math.ceil(maxValue*ratio)));
                }
                nextValue=U.clamp(nextValue,
                0,
                maxValue);
                if(stats[resource]!==nextValue){
                  stats[resource]=nextValue;
                  localChanges+=1;
                }
              }
            }
            else if(candidate.type==="body_injury"){
              const bodyPart=String(payload.bodyPart||"").trim();
              const injuryTag=String(payload.injuryTag||"").trim();
              const label=bodyPart&&injuryTag?bodyPart+" "+injuryTag: injuryTag;
              if(label){
                localChanges+=pushUniqueLocal(body.injuries,
                label);
              }
            }
            return localChanges;
          };
          const localChanges=Guard&&typeof Guard.applyOnce==="function"?Guard.applyOnce({
            kind: "player_"+String(candidate.type||"change"),
            target: target,
            payload: payload,
            sourceId: candidate.id||""
          },
          commit,
          root): commit();
          changes+=localChanges;
          candidate._playerApplied=true;
        }
        if(changes>0){
          this.recomputeDerived(player);
          if(U&&typeof U.markDirty==="function"){
            U.markDirty("player",
            true,
            root);
          }
          if(U&&typeof U.invalidatePackets==="function"){
            U.invalidatePackets(root);
          }
          if(U&&typeof U.logEvent==="function"){
            U.logEvent("Player consequences applied.");
          }
        }
        return changes;
      },
      extractIdentityHints(text){
        const raw=String(text||"");
        const hints={
          name: "",
          age: 0,
          species: "",
          titles: [],
          visibleTraits: [],
          bodyTags: []
        };
        let match=raw.match(/\bYou,\s*([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,30}),\s*(?:an?\s+)?\d{1,3}\s+year old\s+([A-Za-z][A-Za-z -]{1,40}?)(?=[,.]| with\b| at\b| from\b| who\b)/i);
        if(match){
          hints.name=String(match[1]||"").trim();
          const ageMatch=raw.match(/\b(\d{1,3})\s+year(?:s)?\s+old\b/i);
          hints.age=ageMatch&&ageMatch[1]?Math.max(0,
          Math.floor(Number(ageMatch[1]))): 0;
          hints.species=String(match[2]||"").trim();
        }
        if(!hints.name){
          match=raw.match(/\bThe player begins as\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,30})\b/i);
          if(match){
            hints.name=String(match[1]||"").trim();
          }
        }
        if(!hints.name){
          match=raw.match(/\bYou are\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,30})\s+now\b/);
          if(match){
            hints.name=String(match[1]||"").trim();
          }
        }
        if(!hints.name){
          match=raw.match(/^\s*Name\s*:\s*([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,30})\s*$/mi);
          if(match){
            hints.name=String(match[1]||"").trim();
          }
        }
        if(!hints.species){
          match=raw.match(/^\s*(?:Race|Species)\s*:\s*([A-Za-z][A-Za-z -]{1,40})\s*$/mi);
          if(match){
            hints.species=String(match[1]||"").trim();
          }
        }
        if(/\bseven feet tall\b/i.test(raw)||/\bhead brushing\b/i.test(raw)||/\byou have to duck\b/i.test(raw)||/\byour head brushing\b/i.test(raw)){
          hints.visibleTraits.push("very tall");
          hints.bodyTags.push("large_frame");
        }
        return hints;
      },
      normalizeSpeciesLabel(value){
        const cleaned=String(value||"").toLowerCase().replace(/[-_]+/g,
        " ").replace(/^(?:an|a|the)\s+/i,
        "").replace(/[.,;:!?]+$/g,
        "").replace(/\s+/g,
        " ").trim();
        if(!cleaned)return"";
        if(/\d/.test(cleaned))return"";
        if(cleaned.split(" ").length>4)return"";
        const banned=new Set(["confused traveler",
        "traveler",
        "stranger",
        "person",
        "someone",
        "someone else",
        "man",
        "woman",
        "boy",
        "girl"]);
        if(banned.has(cleaned))return"";
        return cleaned;
      },
      applyIdentityHints(hints,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        if(!hints||typeof hints!=="object")return 0;
        const U=globalThis.AIDRPG.Utils;
        const player=root.player||{
        };
        let changes=0;
        const pushUniqueLocal=(list,
        value)=>{
          const text=String(value||"").trim();
          if(!Array.isArray(list)||!text)return 0;
          if(list.indexOf(text)===-1){
            list.push(text);
            return 1;
          }
          return 0;
        };
        const currentName=String(player.name||"").trim();
        const currentSpecies=this.normalizeSpeciesLabel(player.species||"");
        const nextName=String(hints.name||"").trim();
        const nextSpecies=this.normalizeSpeciesLabel(hints.species||"");
        if(nextName&&(!currentName||currentName.toLowerCase()===nextName.toLowerCase())){
          if(player.name!==nextName){
            player.name=nextName;
            changes+=1;
          }
        }
        if(nextSpecies&&(!currentSpecies||currentSpecies==="human"||currentSpecies===nextSpecies)){
          if(player.species!==nextSpecies){
            player.species=nextSpecies;
            changes+=1;
          }
        }
        const nextAge=Math.max(0,
        Math.floor(Number(hints.age||0)));
        if(nextAge>0&&(typeof player.age!=="number"||player.age<=0||player.age===nextAge)){
          if(player.age!==nextAge){
            player.age=nextAge;
            changes+=1;
          }
        }
        if(Array.isArray(hints.titles)){
          for(let i=0; i<hints.titles.length; i+=1){
            changes+=pushUniqueLocal(player.titles,
            hints.titles[i]);
          }
        }
        if(Array.isArray(hints.visibleTraits)){
          for(let i=0; i<hints.visibleTraits.length; i+=1){
            changes+=pushUniqueLocal(player.appearance.visibleTraits,
            hints.visibleTraits[i]);
          }
        }
        if(Array.isArray(hints.bodyTags)){
          for(let i=0; i<hints.bodyTags.length; i+=1){
            changes+=pushUniqueLocal(player.body.bodyTags,
            hints.bodyTags[i]);
          }
        }
        if(changes>0){
          this.recomputeDerived(player);
          if(U&&typeof U.markDirty==="function"){
            U.markDirty("player",
            true,
            root);
          }
          if(U&&typeof U.invalidatePackets==="function"){
            U.invalidatePackets(root);
          }
          if(U&&typeof U.logEvent==="function"){
            U.logEvent("Player identity synced.");
          }
        }
        return changes;
      },
      recomputeDerived(player=(state.aidrpg&&state.aidrpg.player)||null){
        if(!player||typeof player!=="object")return null;
        const stats=player.stats||{
        };
        const levelState=player.levelState||{
        };
        const derived=player.derived||(player.derived={
        });
        const level=Number(levelState.level||1);
        const atk=Number(stats.atk||0);
        const def=Number(stats.def||0);
        const spd=Number(stats.spd||0);
        const intl=Number(stats.intl||0);
        const maxHp=Number(stats.maxHp||0);
        const maxEp=Number(stats.maxEp||0);
        derived.combatPressure=Math.max(1,
        Math.round(((atk+def+spd+intl)/4)+level));
        derived.mobility=Math.max(0,
        Math.round(spd+(maxEp/25)));
        derived.threatRating=Math.max(1,
        Math.round((level*5)+derived.combatPressure+(maxHp/10)));
        const A=globalThis.AIDRPG||{
        };
        if(A.StatBenchmarkSystem&&typeof A.StatBenchmarkSystem.profilePlayer==="function"){
          derived.statBenchmark=A.StatBenchmarkSystem.profilePlayer(player);
        }
        return derived;
      },
      getCompactSummary(player=(state.aidrpg&&state.aidrpg.player)||null){
        if(!player||typeof player!=="object"){
          return"Player summary unavailable.";
        }
        const stats=player.stats||{
        };
        const levelState=player.levelState||{
        };
        const conditions=player.conditions||{
        };
        const body=player.body||{
        };
        const appearance=player.appearance||{
        };
        const active=Array.isArray(conditions.active)&&conditions.active.length?conditions.active.join(", "): "none";
        const injuries=Array.isArray(body.injuries)&&body.injuries.length?body.injuries.slice(Math.max(0,
        body.injuries.length-3)).join(", "): "none";
        const outfit=appearance.outfitSummary&&appearance.outfitSummary.trim()?appearance.outfitSummary.trim(): "unspecified";
        const species=player.species&&String(player.species).trim()?String(player.species).trim(): "unknown";
        const agePart=typeof player.age==="number"&&player.age>0?`Age ${player.age}`: "Age unknown";
        const titles=Array.isArray(player.titles)&&player.titles.length?`Titles: ${player.titles.slice(-2).join(", ")}`: "Titles: none";
        return[`Lvl ${levelState.level ?? 1}`,
        agePart,
        species,
        titles,
        `HP ${stats.hp ?? 0}/${stats.maxHp ?? 0}`,
        `MP ${stats.mp ?? 0}/${stats.maxMp ?? 0}`,
        `EP ${stats.ep ?? 0}/${stats.maxEp ?? 0}`,
        `Cond: ${active}`,
        `Injuries: ${injuries}`,
        `Outfit: ${outfit}`].join(" | ");
      }
    },
    BuildIdentitySystem: {
      init(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return null;
        const U=globalThis.AIDRPG.Utils;
        const player=root.player||{
        };
        if(!root.build||typeof root.build!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.build)){
          root.build={
          };
        }
        const build=root.build;
        if(!Array.isArray(build.originTags))build.originTags=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(build.combatTags))build.combatTags=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(build.methodTags))build.methodTags=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(build.resourceTags))build.resourceTags=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(build.defenseTags))build.defenseTags=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(build.specializationTags))build.specializationTags=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(build.temperamentTags))build.temperamentTags=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(build.styleTags))build.styleTags=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(build.archetypeSummary))build.archetypeSummary=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(build.masteryNotes))build.masteryNotes=[];
        if(!build.matchupProfile||typeof build.matchupProfile!=="object"||Array.isArray(build.matchupProfile)){
          build.matchupProfile={

        }
        if(!Array.isArray(build.matchupProfile.strongAgainst))build.matchupProfile.strongAgainst=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(build.matchupProfile.weakAgainst))build.matchupProfile.weakAgainst=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(build.matchupProfile.unfamiliarAgainst))build.matchupProfile.unfamiliarAgainst=[];
        this.inferBaselineTags(build,
        player);
        this.rebuildArchetypeSummary(build,

        return build;
      },
      clearTagBuckets(build){
        build.originTags=[];
        build.combatTags=[];
        build.methodTags=[];
        build.resourceTags=[];
        build.defenseTags=[];
        build.specializationTags=[];
        build.temperamentTags=[];
        build.styleTags=[];
      },
      addTag(bucket,
      value){
        if(!Array.isArray(bucket))return;
        const tag=String(value||"").trim();
        if(!tag)return;
        if(bucket.indexOf(tag)===-1){
          bucket.push(tag);
        }
      },
      inferBaselineTags(build,
      player){
        this.clearTagBuckets(build);
        const stats=player.stats||{
        };
        const levelState=player.levelState||{
        };
        const derived=player.derived||{
        };
        const body=player.body||{
        };
        const conditions=player.conditions||{
        };
        const appearance=player.appearance||{
        };
        const species=typeof player.species==="string"&&player.species.trim()?player.species.trim().toLowerCase(): "unknown";
        this.addTag(build.originTags,
        "species:"+species);
        if(species==="human"){
          this.addTag(build.originTags,
          "baseline_mortal");
          this.addTag(build.originTags,
          "adaptable");
        }
        else if(species!=="unknown"){
          this.addTag(build.originTags,
          "nonhuman");
        }
        const level=Number(levelState.level||1);
        if(level<=3){
          this.addTag(build.originTags,
          "novice");
        }
        else if(level<=10){
          this.addTag(build.originTags,
          "developing");
        }
        else {
          this.addTag(build.originTags,
          "established");
        }
        const atk=Number(stats.atk||0);
        const def=Number(stats.def||0);
        const spd=Number(stats.spd||0);
        const intl=Number(stats.intl||0);
        const lck=Number(stats.lck||0);
        const maxHp=Number(stats.maxHp||0);
        const maxMp=Number(stats.maxMp||0);
        const maxEp=Number(stats.maxEp||0);
        const mobility=Number(derived.mobility||0);
        const pressure=Number(derived.combatPressure||0);
        const primaryStat=this.getPrimaryStatName({
          atk,
          def,
          spd,
          intl,
          lck
        });
        if(primaryStat==="atk"){
          this.addTag(build.combatTags,
          "direct_force");
          this.addTag(build.styleTags,
          "offensive");
        }
        else if(primaryStat==="def"){
          this.addTag(build.combatTags,
          "anchor");
          this.addTag(build.styleTags,
          "steady");
        }
        else if(primaryStat==="spd"){
          this.addTag(build.combatTags,
          "mobile");
          this.addTag(build.styleTags,
          "agile");
        }
        else if(primaryStat==="intl"){
          this.addTag(build.combatTags,
          "technical");
          this.addTag(build.styleTags,
          "measured");
        }
        else if(primaryStat==="lck"){
          this.addTag(build.combatTags,
          "opportunistic");
          this.addTag(build.styleTags,
          "adaptive");
        }
        if(pressure>=8){
          this.addTag(build.combatTags,
          "combat_capable");
        }
        else {
          this.addTag(build.combatTags,
          "unproven");
        }
        if(atk>=def+2){
          this.addTag(build.methodTags,
          "pressure_first");
        }
        else if(def>=atk+2){
          this.addTag(build.methodTags,
          "durability_first");
        }
        else if(spd>=atk&&spd>=def){
          this.addTag(build.methodTags,
          "positioning_first");
        }
        else {
          this.addTag(build.methodTags,
          "balanced_method");
        }
        if(maxMp>maxEp){
          this.addTag(build.resourceTags,
          "mana_leaning");
        }
        else if(maxEp>maxMp){
          this.addTag(build.resourceTags,
          "stamina_leaning");
        }
        else {
          this.addTag(build.resourceTags,
          "mixed_resource");
        }
        if(intl>=7){
          this.addTag(build.resourceTags,
          "control_sensitive");
        }
        if(def>=7||maxHp>=120){
          this.addTag(build.defenseTags,
          "durable");
        }
        if(mobility>=7||spd>=7){
          this.addTag(build.defenseTags,
          "evasive");
        }
        if(maxHp<90&&def<5){
          this.addTag(build.defenseTags,
          "fragile");
        }
        if(atk>=7){
          this.addTag(build.specializationTags,
          "power_bias");
        }
        if(def>=7){
          this.addTag(build.specializationTags,
          "resilience_bias");
        }
        if(spd>=7){
          this.addTag(build.specializationTags,
          "speed_bias");
        }
        if(intl>=7){
          this.addTag(build.specializationTags,
          "technical_bias");
        }
        if(lck>=7){
          this.addTag(build.specializationTags,
          "fortune_bias");
        }
        if(!build.specializationTags.length){
          this.addTag(build.specializationTags,
          "generalist_bias");
        }
        if(Array.isArray(conditions.active)&&conditions.active.length){
          this.addTag(build.temperamentTags,
          "under_strain");
        }
        else {
          this.addTag(build.temperamentTags,
          "stable");
        }
        if(Array.isArray(body.injuries)&&body.injuries.length){
          this.addTag(build.temperamentTags,
          "pain_tested");
        }
        if(Array.isArray(body.mutations)&&body.mutations.length){
          this.addTag(build.originTags,
          "altered_body");
        }
        if(Array.isArray(appearance.visibleTraits)&&appearance.visibleTraits.length){
          this.addTag(build.styleTags,
          "visibly_distinct");
        }
        if(!build.styleTags.length){
          this.addTag(build.styleTags,
          "unformed");
        }
      },
      getPrimaryStatName(statMap){
        let bestName="atk";
        let bestValue=-Infinity;
        const names=["atk",
        "def",
        "spd",
        "intl",
        "lck"];
        for(let i=0; i<names.length; i+=1){
          const name=names[i];
          const value=Number(statMap[name]||0);
          if(value>bestValue){
            bestValue=value;
            bestName=name;
          }
        }
        return bestName;
      },
      rebuildArchetypeSummary(build,
      player){
        const summary=[];
        const pushUnique=(value)=>{
          const text=String(value||"").trim();
          if(!text)return;
          if(summary.indexOf(text)===-1){
            summary.push(text);
          }
        };
        if(build.combatTags.indexOf("direct_force")!==-1)pushUnique("force-leaning");
        if(build.combatTags.indexOf("anchor")!==-1)pushUnique("durability-leaning");
