        if(build.combatTags.indexOf("mobile")!==-1)pushUnique("mobility-leaning");
        if(build.combatTags.indexOf("technical")!==-1)pushUnique("technical-leaning");
        if(build.combatTags.indexOf("opportunistic")!==-1)pushUnique("opportunistic");
        if(build.resourceTags.indexOf("mana_leaning")!==-1)pushUnique("mana-leaning");
        if(build.resourceTags.indexOf("stamina_leaning")!==-1)pushUnique("stamina-leaning");
        if(build.resourceTags.indexOf("mixed_resource")!==-1)pushUnique("mixed-resource");
        if(build.specializationTags.indexOf("generalist_bias")!==-1)pushUnique("generalist");
        if(build.specializationTags.indexOf("power_bias")!==-1)pushUnique("power-biased");
        if(build.specializationTags.indexOf("resilience_bias")!==-1)pushUnique("resilience-biased");
        if(build.specializationTags.indexOf("speed_bias")!==-1)pushUnique("speed-biased");
        if(build.specializationTags.indexOf("technical_bias")!==-1)pushUnique("technical-biased");
        if(!summary.length){
          pushUnique("unformed");
        }
        build.archetypeSummary=summary;
        if(!build.matchupProfile||typeof build.matchupProfile!=="object"){
          build.matchupProfile={
          };
        }
        if(!Array.isArray(build.matchupProfile.strongAgainst))build.matchupProfile.strongAgainst=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(build.matchupProfile.weakAgainst))build.matchupProfile.weakAgainst=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(build.matchupProfile.unfamiliarAgainst))build.matchupProfile.unfamiliarAgainst=[];
        if(!build.matchupProfile.unfamiliarAgainst.length){
          build.matchupProfile.unfamiliarAgainst.push("unknown_styles");
        }
        return build.archetypeSummary;
      },
      getCompactSummary(build=(state.aidrpg&&state.aidrpg.build)||null){
        if(!build||typeof build!=="object"){
          return"Build summary unavailable.";
        }
        const summary=Array.isArray(build.archetypeSummary)?build.archetypeSummary: [];
        const styles=Array.isArray(build.styleTags)?build.styleTags: [];
        const methods=Array.isArray(build.methodTags)?build.methodTags: [];
        const parts=[];
        if(summary.length){
          parts.push("Archetype: "+summary.join(", "));
        }
        if(styles.length){
          parts.push("Style: "+styles.join(", "));
        }
        if(methods.length){
          parts.push("Method: "+methods.join(", "));
        }
        if(!parts.length){
          return"Build summary unavailable.";
        }
        return parts.join(" | ");
      }
    },
    StatBenchmarkSystem: {
      init(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object"||Array.isArray(root))return null;
        if(!root.player||typeof root.player!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.player))return null;
        const player=root.player;
        if(!player.derived||typeof player.derived!=="object"||Array.isArray(player.derived)){
          player.derived={};
        }
        player.derived.statBenchmark=this.profilePlayer(player,root);
        return player.derived.statBenchmark;
      },
      cleanLevel(level){
        const n=Math.floor(Number(level||1));
        if(!Number.isFinite(n)||n<1)return 1;
        return Math.min(1000,n);
      },
      levelBand(level){
        const lvl=this.cleanLevel(level);
        if(lvl>=1000)return"god-walking-earth";
        if(lvl>=750)return"mythic";
        if(lvl>=500)return"legendary";
        if(lvl>=300)return"world-class";
        if(lvl>=200)return"master";
        if(lvl>=100)return"major-milestone";
        if(lvl>=90)return"elite";
        if(lvl>=70)return"veteran-elite";
        if(lvl>=50)return"city-professional";
        if(lvl>=25)return"village-professional";
        if(lvl>=20)return"trained";
        if(lvl>=10)return"developing";
        if(lvl>=2)return"novice";
        return"baseline";
      },
      bandMeaning(band){
        const table={
          "baseline":"ordinary baseline; weak stats should create real limits",
          "novice":"newly developing; training and caution matter",
          "developing":"capable but not safely above trained opposition",
          "trained":"trained; ordinary civilians should usually be outclassed",
          "village-professional":"professional at village/small-town scale",
          "city-professional":"professional at large-city scale",
          "veteran-elite":"strong veteran; average NPCs should not casually dominate",
          "elite":"elite; normal threats need numbers, surprise, or advantages",
          "major-milestone":"well above average; random NPCs should not talk down as if helpless",
          "master":"master scale; only serious specialists or unusual threats compare cleanly",
          "world-class":"world-class; most local opposition is beneath direct contest",
          "legendary":"legendary; reputation and awe should matter when known",
          "mythic":"mythic; normal scale is usually inadequate",
          "god-walking-earth":"godlike scale; only extreme, divine, or cosmic counters should casually contest"
        };
        return table[String(band||"")]||"benchmark unavailable";
      },
      currentFormulaResources(level){
        const lvl=this.cleanLevel(level);
        const gained=Math.max(0,lvl-1);
        return {maxHp:100+(gained*10),maxMp:20+(gained*2),maxEp:50+(gained*4)};
      },
      weightsForRole(role){
        const key=String(role||"dungeon").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,"_");
        const table={
          average:{atk:20,def:20,spd:20,intl:20,lck:20},
          dungeon:{atk:26,def:24,spd:20,intl:15,lck:15},
          farmer:{atk:20,def:26,spd:18,intl:12,lck:24},
          mage:{atk:8,def:12,spd:12,intl:50,lck:18},
          guard:{atk:25,def:30,spd:17,intl:12,lck:16},
          rogue:{atk:18,def:12,spd:36,intl:16,lck:18},
          scholar:{atk:7,def:10,spd:10,intl:55,lck:18},
          laborer:{atk:22,def:28,spd:16,intl:10,lck:24},
          beast:{atk:30,def:18,spd:30,intl:5,lck:17},
          monster:{atk:32,def:28,spd:16,intl:8,lck:16},
          undead:{atk:24,def:34,spd:10,intl:12,lck:20},
          draconic:{atk:28,def:26,spd:16,intl:20,lck:10}
        };
        return table[key]||table.dungeon;
      },
      normalizeRole(role){
        const key=String(role||"").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,"_").replace(/^_+|_+$/g,"");
        if(!key)return"dungeon";
        if(key.indexOf("mage")!==-1||key.indexOf("wizard")!==-1||key.indexOf("caster")!==-1||key.indexOf("arcane")!==-1)return"mage";
        if(key.indexOf("farm")!==-1||key.indexOf("peasant")!==-1||key.indexOf("villager")!==-1)return"farmer";
        if(key.indexOf("guard")!==-1||key.indexOf("soldier")!==-1||key.indexOf("knight")!==-1)return"guard";
        if(key.indexOf("rogue")!==-1||key.indexOf("thief")!==-1||key.indexOf("scout")!==-1||key.indexOf("assassin")!==-1)return"rogue";
        if(key.indexOf("scholar")!==-1||key.indexOf("scribe")!==-1||key.indexOf("study")!==-1)return"scholar";
        if(key.indexOf("labor")!==-1||key.indexOf("worker")!==-1||key.indexOf("miner")!==-1)return"laborer";
        if(key.indexOf("beast")!==-1||key.indexOf("animal")!==-1)return"beast";
        if(key.indexOf("undead")!==-1)return"undead";
        if(key.indexOf("dragon")!==-1||key.indexOf("drake")!==-1||key.indexOf("draconic")!==-1)return"draconic";
        if(key.indexOf("monster")!==-1)return"monster";
        if(key.indexOf("average")!==-1||key.indexOf("common")!==-1)return"average";
        return key;
      },
      inferPlayerRole(player={},root=state.aidrpg){
        const build=root&&root.build&&typeof root.build==="object"?root.build:{};
        const stats=player&&player.stats?player.stats:{};
        const resourceTags=Array.isArray(build.resourceTags)?build.resourceTags:[];
        const combatTags=Array.isArray(build.combatTags)?build.combatTags:[];
        const styleTags=Array.isArray(build.styleTags)?build.styleTags:[];
        const methodTags=Array.isArray(build.methodTags)?build.methodTags:[];
        const intl=Number(stats.intl||0), atk=Number(stats.atk||0), def=Number(stats.def||0), spd=Number(stats.spd||0);
        const maxMp=Number(stats.maxMp||0), maxEp=Number(stats.maxEp||0);
        if(resourceTags.indexOf("mana_leaning")!==-1||combatTags.indexOf("technical")!==-1||intl>=Math.max(atk,def,spd)+2||maxMp>maxEp)return"mage";
        if(combatTags.indexOf("mobile")!==-1||styleTags.indexOf("agile")!==-1||methodTags.indexOf("positioning_first")!==-1)return"rogue";
        if(combatTags.indexOf("anchor")!==-1||combatTags.indexOf("direct_force")!==-1||combatTags.indexOf("combat_capable")!==-1)return"dungeon";
        return"dungeon";
      },
      expectedStats(level,role){
        const lvl=this.cleanLevel(level);
        const points=Math.max(0,lvl-1);
        const weights=this.weightsForRole(this.normalizeRole(role));
        const out={atk:5,def:5,spd:5,intl:5,lck:5};
        const names=["atk","def","spd","intl","lck"];
        let used=0;
        const fractions=[];
        for(let i=0;i<names.length;i+=1){
          const key=names[i];
          const raw=(points*Number(weights[key]||0))/100;
          const whole=Math.floor(raw);
          out[key]+=whole;
          used+=whole;
          fractions.push({key:key,rest:raw-whole});
        }
        fractions.sort(function(a,b){if(b.rest!==a.rest)return b.rest-a.rest;return names.indexOf(a.key)-names.indexOf(b.key);});
        let remaining=points-used;
        let index=0;
        while(remaining>0){out[fractions[index%fractions.length].key]+=1;remaining-=1;index+=1;}
        return out;
      },
      topStats(stats,count,reverse){
        const names=["atk","def","spd","intl","lck"];
        const rows=[];
        for(let i=0;i<names.length;i+=1)rows.push({key:names[i],value:Number(stats&&stats[names[i]]||0)});
        rows.sort(function(a,b){return reverse?(a.value-b.value):(b.value-a.value);});
        const out=[];
        const max=Math.max(1,Math.min(rows.length,Math.floor(Number(count||2))));
        for(let i=0;i<rows.length&&out.length<max;i+=1)out.push(rows[i].key);
        return out;
      },
      compareStats(actual,expected){
        const names=["atk","def","spd","intl","lck"];
        const gap={}, grade={}, primary=[], weak=[], severeWeak=[], dominant=[];
        for(let i=0;i<names.length;i+=1){
          const key=names[i];
          const a=Number(actual&&actual[key]||0), e=Number(expected&&expected[key]||0);
          const delta=a-e;
          gap[key]=delta;
          if(delta>=8){grade[key]="dominant";dominant.push(key);primary.push(key);}
          else if(delta>=3){grade[key]="above";primary.push(key);}
          else if(delta<=-8){grade[key]="severely_below";severeWeak.push(key);weak.push(key);}
          else if(delta<=-3){grade[key]="below";weak.push(key);}
          else grade[key]="near";
        }
        return {gap:gap,grade:grade,primary:primary,weak:weak,severeWeak:severeWeak,dominant:dominant};
      },
      getStatTier(value){
        const n=Number(value||0);
        if(n>=90)return"mythic";
        if(n>=70)return"legendary";
        if(n>=50)return"elite";
        if(n>=30)return"expert";
        if(n>=15)return"trained";
        if(n>=8)return"capable";
        if(n>=5)return"ordinary";
        if(n>=3)return"weak";
        return"cripplingly low";
      },
      resourceState(current,max,label){
        const cur=Number(current||0), mx=Math.max(1,Number(max||1));
        const pct=cur/mx;
        if(pct<=0)return label+" empty";
        if(pct<=0.18)return label+" critical";
        if(pct<=0.35)return label+" low";
        if(pct>=0.9)return label+" full";
        return label+" stable";
      },
      intentPressure(intent,stats){
        if(!intent||typeof intent!=="object")return"";
        const type=String(intent.primaryType||"");
        const notes=[];
        const atk=Number(stats.atk||0), def=Number(stats.def||0), spd=Number(stats.spd||0), intl=Number(stats.intl||0), lck=Number(stats.lck||0);
        const hp=Number(stats.hp||0), maxHp=Math.max(1,Number(stats.maxHp||1));
        const mp=Number(stats.mp||0), maxMp=Math.max(1,Number(stats.maxMp||1));
        const ep=Number(stats.ep||0), maxEp=Math.max(1,Number(stats.maxEp||1));
        if((type==="attack"||type==="defend"||type==="move"||type==="travel"||type==="train")&&ep/maxEp<=0.25)notes.push("low EP should make physical effort tiring, sloppy, or risky");
        if(type==="use_ability"&&mp/maxMp<=0.25)notes.push("low MP should make magical/mental techniques unstable or limited");
        if(hp/maxHp<=0.30)notes.push("low HP/injuries should limit bold actions even if stats are high");
        if(type==="attack"){
          if(atk>=Math.max(def,spd,intl)+3)notes.push("ATK favors direct pressure");
          if(spd>=atk+3)notes.push("SPD favors positioning, pursuit, retreat, and evasion over trading blows");
          if(atk<=3)notes.push("low ATK should not overpower sturdy foes without leverage, tools, surprise, or weak points");
        }
        if(type==="defend"){
          if(def>=7)notes.push("DEF supports blocking/withstanding ordinary force");
          if(def<=3)notes.push("low DEF makes direct tanking unsafe");
        }
        if(type==="use_ability"||type==="train"){
          if(intl>=7)notes.push("INT supports controlled technique learning and complex ability shaping");
          if(intl<=3)notes.push("low INT makes complex ability control inconsistent without practice");
        }
        if(type==="inspect"||type==="talk"||type==="barter"){
          if(intl>=7)notes.push("INT supports analysis and careful reading of details");
          if(lck>=7)notes.push("LCK can create openings but should not replace skill or evidence");
        }
        return notes.slice(0,3).join("; ");
      },
      profilePlayer(player={},root=state.aidrpg){
        const levelState=player&&player.levelState?player.levelState:{};
        const stats=player&&player.stats?player.stats:{};
        const level=this.cleanLevel(levelState.level||1);
        const role=this.inferPlayerRole(player,root);
        const expected=this.expectedStats(level,role);
        const resources=this.currentFormulaResources(level);
        const comparison=this.compareStats(stats,expected);
        const band=this.levelBand(level);
        return {
          level:level,
          role:role,
          band:band,
          bandMeaning:this.bandMeaning(band),
          expectedStats:expected,
          expectedResources:resources,
          gap:comparison.gap,
          statGrades:comparison.grade,
          primaryStats:comparison.primary.slice(0,3),
          weakStats:comparison.weak.slice(0,3),
          severeWeakStats:comparison.severeWeak.slice(0,3),
          dominantStats:comparison.dominant.slice(0,3),
          statTiers:{
            atk:this.getStatTier(stats.atk),
            def:this.getStatTier(stats.def),
            spd:this.getStatTier(stats.spd),
            intl:this.getStatTier(stats.intl),
            lck:this.getStatTier(stats.lck)
          },
          resourceStates:{
            hp:this.resourceState(stats.hp,stats.maxHp,"HP"),
            mp:this.resourceState(stats.mp,stats.maxMp,"MP"),
            ep:this.resourceState(stats.ep,stats.maxEp,"EP")
          },
          note:"Benchmarks guide plausibility. Victory depends on stats, build, resources, injuries, equipment, environment, preparation, and style matchup."
        };
      },
      profileFor(level,role){
        const lvl=this.cleanLevel(level);
        const normalized=this.normalizeRole(role);
        const band=this.levelBand(lvl);
        return {
          level:lvl,
          role:normalized,
          band:band,
          bandMeaning:this.bandMeaning(band),
          expectedStats:this.expectedStats(lvl,normalized),
          expectedResources:this.currentFormulaResources(lvl)
        };
      },
      compactProfileLine(profile){
        if(!profile||typeof profile!=="object")return"Benchmark unavailable.";
        const s=profile.expectedStats||{};
        return"Benchmark "+String(profile.role||"dungeon")+" L"+String(profile.level||1)+" "+String(profile.band||"baseline")+" avg: ATK "+String(s.atk||0)+", DEF "+String(s.def||0)+", SPD "+String(s.spd||0)+", INT "+String(s.intl||0)+", LCK "+String(s.lck||0)+".";
      },
      buildMechanicsPacket(mode,root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object"||!root.player)return"";
        const player=root.player||{};
        const stats=player.stats||{};
        const levelState=player.levelState||{};
        const profile=this.profilePlayer(player,root);
        const intent=root.pending&&root.pending.inputIntent?root.pending.inputIntent:null;
        const build=root.build||{};
        const parts=[];
        parts.push("L"+String(profile.level||levelState.level||1)+" "+String(profile.band||"baseline"));
        parts.push("Stats ATK "+String(stats.atk||0)+"/DEF "+String(stats.def||0)+"/SPD "+String(stats.spd||0)+"/INT "+String(stats.intl||0)+"/LCK "+String(stats.lck||0));
        parts.push("Resources "+profile.resourceStates.hp+", "+profile.resourceStates.mp+", "+profile.resourceStates.ep);
        if(profile.dominantStats&&profile.dominantStats.length)parts.push("Dominant "+profile.dominantStats.join(", "));
        else if(profile.primaryStats&&profile.primaryStats.length)parts.push("Strong "+profile.primaryStats.join(", "));
        if(profile.severeWeakStats&&profile.severeWeakStats.length)parts.push("Severely weak "+profile.severeWeakStats.join(", "));
        else if(profile.weakStats&&profile.weakStats.length)parts.push("Weak "+profile.weakStats.join(", "));
        const summary=Array.isArray(build.archetypeSummary)&&build.archetypeSummary.length?build.archetypeSummary.slice(0,3).join(", "):"unformed";
        parts.push("Build "+summary);
        const pressure=this.intentPressure(intent,stats);
        if(pressure)parts.push("Constraint "+pressure);
        if(mode==="wide")parts.push("Rule: stats constrain plausibility directly; level is scale, not automatic victory.");
        return "Mechanics: "+parts.join(" | ");
      }
    },
    ActorThreatProfileSystem: {
      init(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object"||Array.isArray(root))return null;
        if(!root.actors||typeof root.actors!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.actors))root.actors={
        };
        if(!root.actors.threatSettings||typeof root.actors.threatSettings!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.actors.threatSettings)){
          root.actors.threatSettings={
            version: 1
          };
        }
        return root.actors.threatSettings;
      },
      hasTag(list,
      tag){
        if(!Array.isArray(list))return false;
        return list.indexOf(String(tag||""))!==-1;
      },
      normRole(roleTags,
      category){
        const tags=Array.isArray(roleTags)?roleTags: [];
        const cat=String(category||"humanoid").toLowerCase();
        const has=(tag)=>tags.indexOf(tag)!==-1;
        if(has("archmage")||has("mage")||has("wizard")||has("priest")||has("oracle"))return"mage";
        if(has("guard")||has("city_guard")||has("village_guard")||has("soldier")||has("knight")||has("captain")||has("commander")||has("sergeant"))return"guard";
        if(has("hunter")||has("archer")||has("scout")||has("bandit"))return"rogue";
        if(has("blacksmith")||has("smith")||has("laborer")||has("miner"))return"laborer";
        if(has("scholar")||has("scribe")||has("elder"))return"scholar";
        if(has("farmer")||has("villager")||has("peasant"))return"farmer";
        if(cat==="beast"||cat==="monster"||cat==="undead"||cat==="draconic")return"dungeon";
        return"average";
      },
      sceneScale(root=state.aidrpg){
        const world=root&&root.world?root.world: {
        };
        const scene=world.currentScene||{
        };
        const locations=world.locationsById||{
        };
        let text=String(scene.displayName||"")+" "+String(scene.sceneType||"")+" "+String(scene.parentLocationRef||"");
        const parent=scene.parentLocationRef&&locations[scene.parentLocationRef]?locations[scene.parentLocationRef]: null;
        if(parent&&parent.identity)text+=" "+String(parent.identity.displayName||"");
        text=text.toLowerCase();
        if(/\b(?:capital|metropolis|large city|great city|city|district|fortress|citadel|castle)\b/.test(text))return"city";
        if(/\b(?:village|hamlet|farm|rural|outskirts)\b/.test(text))return"village";
        if(/\b(?:dungeon|crypt|ruin|cavern|lair|wilds|wilderness|forest)\b/.test(text))return"danger";
        return"unknown";
      },
      baseLevel(roleTags,
      rankTags,
      category,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        const tags=Array.isArray(roleTags)?roleTags: [];
        const ranks=Array.isArray(rankTags)?rankTags: [];
        const cat=String(category||"humanoid").toLowerCase();
        const has=(tag)=>tags.indexOf(tag)!==-1;
        const rank=(tag)=>ranks.indexOf(tag)!==-1;
        const scene=this.sceneScale(root);
        let lvl=5;
        if(rank("child"))lvl=1;
        else if(has("farmer")||has("villager")||has("peasant"))lvl=5;
        else if(has("merchant")||has("barkeep")||has("innkeeper"))lvl=6;
        else if(has("blacksmith")||has("smith")||has("laborer"))lvl=12;
        else if(has("hunter")||has("scout")||has("archer"))lvl=28;
        else if(has("bandit"))lvl=18;
        else if(has("guard")||has("soldier")||has("city_guard")||has("village_guard")){
          if(has("city_guard"))lvl=50;
          else if(has("village_guard"))lvl=25;
          else lvl=scene==="village"?25: scene==="city"?50: 35;
        }
        else if(has("knight"))lvl=70;
        else if(has("captain")||has("sergeant"))lvl=75;
        else if(has("commander")||has("general"))lvl=110;
        else if(has("mage")||has("wizard")||has("priest"))lvl=45;
        else if(has("archmage")||has("oracle"))lvl=150;
        else if(has("adventurer"))lvl=30;
        else if(cat==="beast")lvl=has("wolf")?12: has("boar")?8: has("bear")?28: 18;
        else if(cat==="undead")lvl=has("skeleton")?10: has("zombie")?8: 25;
        else if(cat==="monster")lvl=has("goblin")?10: has("ogre")?45: has("troll")?70: 35;
        else if(cat==="draconic")lvl=has("drake")||has("wyvern")?250: 500;
        if(rank("novice"))lvl=Math.max(1,
        Math.floor(lvl*0.45));
        if(rank("veteran"))lvl=Math.max(lvl+20,
        70);
        if(rank("leader"))lvl=Math.max(lvl+25,
        70);
        if(rank("elite"))lvl=Math.max(lvl+40,
        90);
        if(rank("ancient"))lvl=Math.max(lvl+250,
        500);
        if(rank("legendary"))lvl=Math.max(lvl,
        500);
        if(rank("mythic"))lvl=Math.max(lvl,
        750);
        if(rank("divine"))lvl=Math.max(lvl,
        1000);
        if(scene==="danger"&&lvl<15&&(cat==="monster"||cat==="undead"||cat==="beast"))lvl+=5;
        return Math.max(1,
        Math.min(1000,
        Math.floor(lvl)));
      },
      resolveLevelBand(roleTags,
      rankTags,
      category,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        const lvl=this.baseLevel(roleTags,
        rankTags,
        category,
        root);
        let spread=3;
        if(lvl>=750)spread=100;
        else if(lvl>=500)spread=75;
        else if(lvl>=300)spread=50;
        else if(lvl>=100)spread=25;
        else if(lvl>=50)spread=15;
        else if(lvl>=25)spread=8;
        return {
          bandMin: Math.max(1,
          lvl-spread),
          bandMax: Math.min(1000,
          lvl+spread),
          resolvedLevel: lvl
        };
      },
      threatTier(level,
      roleTags,
      rankTags,
      category){
        const lvl=Math.max(1,
        Math.floor(Number(level||1)));
        const tags=Array.isArray(roleTags)?roleTags: [];
        const cat=String(category||"humanoid").toLowerCase();
        const socialOnly=tags.indexOf("merchant")!==-1||tags.indexOf("barkeep")!==-1||tags.indexOf("innkeeper")!==-1;
        if(lvl>=1000)return"near_divine";
        if(lvl>=750)return"mythic";
        if(lvl>=500)return"legendary";
        if(lvl>=300)return"world_class";
        if(lvl>=200)return"master";
        if(lvl>=100)return"major_milestone";
        if(lvl>=90)return"elite";
        if(lvl>=70)return"veteran_elite";
        if(lvl>=50)return"professional_city_scale";
        if(lvl>=25)return"professional_village_scale";
        if(socialOnly&&cat==="humanoid")return"low_combat_social_risk";
        if(lvl>=10)return"trained_or_dangerous";
        return"ordinary_or_unproven";
      },
      notesFor(role,
      roleTags,
      category,
      level){
        const out=[];
        const tags=Array.isArray(roleTags)?roleTags: [];
        const cat=String(category||"humanoid").toLowerCase();
        const has=(tag)=>tags.indexOf(tag)!==-1;
        if(role==="guard")out.push("trained around ATK/DEF/EP; baseline depends on settlement scale");
        if(role==="mage")out.push("high INT/MP pressure; not automatically durable");
        if(role==="rogue")out.push("danger comes from mobility, range, stealth, or opportunism");
        if(role==="farmer"||role==="laborer")out.push("work-hardened body, not a dedicated combat build");
        if(has("merchant")||has("barkeep")||has("innkeeper"))out.push("social/economic danger may exceed combat danger");
        if(cat==="beast")out.push("body, instincts, senses, and natural weapons modify the stat profile");
        if(cat==="monster"||cat==="undead")out.push("nonhuman body/state can matter more than clean technique");
        if(cat==="draconic")out.push("dragon-scale body/aura/domain makes baseline threat exceptional");
        if(Number(level||0)>=100)out.push("major milestone: average NPCs should not casually talk down to them");
        if(!out.length)out.push("average stat profile by level/role; level alone does not decide outcomes");
        return out.slice(0,
        3);
      },
      profileFromCandidate(candidate,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!candidate||typeof candidate!=="object")return null;
        const roleTags=Array.isArray(candidate.roleTags)?candidate.roleTags.slice(0,
        8): [];
        const rankTags=Array.isArray(candidate.rankTags)?candidate.rankTags.slice(0,
        8): [];
        const category=String(candidate.category||"humanoid");
        const levelProfile=this.resolveLevelBand(roleTags,
        rankTags,
        category,
        root);
        const level=levelProfile.resolvedLevel;
        const role=this.normRole(roleTags,
        category);
        const bench=globalThis.AIDRPG.StatBenchmarkSystem&&typeof globalThis.AIDRPG.StatBenchmarkSystem.profileFor==="function"?globalThis.AIDRPG.StatBenchmarkSystem.profileFor(level,
        role): null;
        const expectedStats=bench&&bench.expectedStats?bench.expectedStats: {
          atk: 5,
          def: 5,
          spd: 5,
          intl: 5,
          lck: 5
        };
        const expectedResources=bench&&bench.expectedResources?bench.expectedResources: {
          maxHp: 100,
          maxMp: 20,
          maxEp: 50
        };
        return {
          level: level,
          levelProfile: levelProfile,
          levelBand: bench&&bench.band?bench.band: "baseline",
          role: role,
          category: category,
          roleTags: roleTags,
          rankTags: rankTags,
          speciesTags: category==="humanoid"?[]: [category],
          bodyTags: category==="humanoid"?[]: [category+"_body"],
          expectedStats: expectedStats,
          expectedResources: expectedResources,
          primaryStats: globalThis.AIDRPG.StatBenchmarkSystem&&typeof globalThis.AIDRPG.StatBenchmarkSystem.topStats==="function"?globalThis.AIDRPG.StatBenchmarkSystem.topStats(expectedStats,
          2,
          false): [],
          weakStats: globalThis.AIDRPG.StatBenchmarkSystem&&typeof globalThis.AIDRPG.StatBenchmarkSystem.topStats==="function"?globalThis.AIDRPG.StatBenchmarkSystem.topStats(expectedStats,
          2,
          true): [],
          threatTier: this.threatTier(level,
          roleTags,
          rankTags,
          category),
          dangerNotes: this.notesFor(role,
          roleTags,
          category,
          level)
        };
      },
      profileFromRecord(record,
      candidate,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(candidate)return this.profileFromCandidate(candidate,
        root);
        if(!record||typeof record!=="object")return null;
        return this.profileFromCandidate({
          roleTags: Array.isArray(record.roleTags)?record.roleTags: [],
          rankTags: Array.isArray(record.rankTags)?record.rankTags: [],
          category: record.identity&&record.identity.category?record.identity.category: "humanoid"
        },
        root);
      },
      statsFromThreatProfile(profile){
        if(!profile||typeof profile!=="object")return {
        };
        const s=profile.expectedStats||{
        };
        const r=profile.expectedResources||{
        };
        const cat=String(profile.category||"humanoid").toLowerCase();
        const lvl=Math.max(1,
        Math.floor(Number(profile.level||1)));
        let hpMul=1;
        let epMul=1;
        let atkBonus=0;
        let defBonus=0;
        let spdBonus=0;
        let intBonus=0;
        if(cat==="beast"){
          hpMul=1.1;
          epMul=1.15;
          spdBonus=2;
        }
        if(cat==="monster"){
          hpMul=1.35;
          atkBonus=2;
          defBonus=1;
        }
        if(cat==="undead"){
          hpMul=1.2;
          defBonus=2;
        }
        if(cat==="draconic"){
          hpMul=2.25;
          epMul=1.5;
          atkBonus=Math.ceil(lvl/25);
          defBonus=Math.ceil(lvl/30);
          intBonus=Math.ceil(lvl/40);
        }
        return {
          hp: Math.max(1,
          Math.round(Number(r.maxHp||100)*hpMul)),
          maxHp: Math.max(1,
          Math.round(Number(r.maxHp||100)*hpMul)),
          mp: Math.max(0,
          Math.round(Number(r.maxMp||20))),
          maxMp: Math.max(0,
          Math.round(Number(r.maxMp||20))),
          ep: Math.max(1,
          Math.round(Number(r.maxEp||50)*epMul)),
          maxEp: Math.max(1,
          Math.round(Number(r.maxEp||50)*epMul)),
          atk: Math.max(1,
          Math.round(Number(s.atk||5)+atkBonus)),
          def: Math.max(1,
          Math.round(Number(s.def||5)+defBonus)),
          spd: Math.max(1,
          Math.round(Number(s.spd||5)+spdBonus)),
          intl: Math.max(1,
          Math.round(Number(s.intl||5)+intBonus)),
          lck: Math.max(1,
          Math.round(Number(s.lck||5)))
        };
      },
      applyThreatProfile(record,
      profile){
        if(!record||typeof record!=="object"||!profile||typeof profile!=="object")return 0;
        let changes=0;
        const snapshot=JSON.stringify(record.threatProfile||{
        });
        record.threatProfile={
          level: profile.level,
          levelBand: profile.levelBand,
          role: profile.role,
          category: profile.category,
          roleTags: profile.roleTags,
          rankTags: profile.rankTags,
          speciesTags: profile.speciesTags,
          bodyTags: profile.bodyTags,
          expectedStats: profile.expectedStats,
          expectedResources: profile.expectedResources,
          primaryStats: profile.primaryStats,
          weakStats: profile.weakStats,
          threatTier: profile.threatTier,
          dangerNotes: profile.dangerNotes
        };
        if(snapshot!==JSON.stringify(record.threatProfile||{
        }))changes+=1;
        return changes;
      }
    },
    CombatMatrixSystem: {
      init(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object"||Array.isArray(root))return null;
        if(!root.cache||typeof root.cache!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.cache))root.cache={};
        if(!root.cache.combatMatrix||typeof root.cache.combatMatrix!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.cache.combatMatrix)){
          root.cache.combatMatrix={lastPacket:"",lastTurn:0,targets:[]};
        }
        if(!Array.isArray(root.cache.combatMatrix.targets))root.cache.combatMatrix.targets=[];
        return root.cache.combatMatrix;
      },
      statNames(){return["atk","def","spd","intl","lck"];},
      cleanNumber(value,fallback=0){const n=Number(value);return Number.isFinite(n)?n:fallback;},
      getPlayerStats(root=state.aidrpg){
        const p=root&&root.player?root.player:{};
        const s=p.stats||{};
        return {hp:this.cleanNumber(s.hp),maxHp:this.cleanNumber(s.maxHp,1),mp:this.cleanNumber(s.mp),maxMp:this.cleanNumber(s.maxMp,1),ep:this.cleanNumber(s.ep),maxEp:this.cleanNumber(s.maxEp,1),atk:this.cleanNumber(s.atk),def:this.cleanNumber(s.def),spd:this.cleanNumber(s.spd),intl:this.cleanNumber(s.intl),lck:this.cleanNumber(s.lck)};
      },
      getActorIds(root=state.aidrpg){
        const actors=root&&root.actors?root.actors:{};
        const party=root&&root.party&&root.party.rosterById?root.party.rosterById:{};
        const partyActorIds={};
        Object.keys(party).forEach(function(id){const row=party[id];if(row&&row.actorId)partyActorIds[row.actorId]=true;});
        const filterParty=(list)=>list.filter(function(id){return !partyActorIds[id];});
        const local=filterParty(Array.isArray(actors.localIds)?actors.localIds.slice():[]);
        if(local.length)return local.slice(0,4);
        const all=filterParty(Array.isArray(actors.allIds)?actors.allIds.slice(-8):[]);
        return all.slice(-4);
      },
      ensureThreat(record,root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!record||typeof record!=="object")return null;
        const A=globalThis.AIDRPG||{};
        if((!record.threatProfile||!record.threatProfile.expectedStats)&&A.ActorThreatProfileSystem&&typeof A.ActorThreatProfileSystem.profileFromRecord==="function"){
          const profile=A.ActorThreatProfileSystem.profileFromRecord(record,null,root);
          if(profile&&typeof profile==="object"&&typeof A.ActorThreatProfileSystem.applyThreatProfile==="function"){
            A.ActorThreatProfileSystem.applyThreatProfile(record,profile);
            if(typeof A.ActorThreatProfileSystem.statsFromThreatProfile==="function")record.stats=A.ActorThreatProfileSystem.statsFromThreatProfile(profile);
          }
        }
        return record.threatProfile||null;
      },
      getActorName(record,id){
        const identity=record&&record.identity?record.identity:{};
        return identity.name||identity.displayName||record.name||String(id||"actor");
      },
      getActorStats(record,profile){
        const s=record&&record.stats?record.stats:{};
        const p=profile&&profile.expectedStats?profile.expectedStats:{};
        const r=profile&&profile.expectedResources?profile.expectedResources:{};
        return {hp:this.cleanNumber(s.hp,r.maxHp||100),maxHp:this.cleanNumber(s.maxHp,r.maxHp||100),mp:this.cleanNumber(s.mp,r.maxMp||20),maxMp:this.cleanNumber(s.maxMp,r.maxMp||20),ep:this.cleanNumber(s.ep,r.maxEp||50),maxEp:this.cleanNumber(s.maxEp,r.maxEp||50),atk:this.cleanNumber(s.atk,p.atk||5),def:this.cleanNumber(s.def,p.def||5),spd:this.cleanNumber(s.spd,p.spd||5),intl:this.cleanNumber(s.intl,p.intl||5),lck:this.cleanNumber(s.lck,p.lck||5)};
      },
      compareStats(playerStats,actorStats){
        const names=this.statNames();
        const strong=[], weak=[], near=[];
        let score=0;
        for(let i=0;i<names.length;i+=1){
          const k=names[i];
          const delta=this.cleanNumber(playerStats[k])-this.cleanNumber(actorStats[k]);
          if(delta>=5){strong.push(k+"+"+delta);score+=2;}
          else if(delta>=2){strong.push(k+"+"+delta);score+=1;}
          else if(delta<=-5){weak.push(k+delta);score-=2;}
          else if(delta<=-2){weak.push(k+delta);score-=1;}
          else near.push(k);
        }
        let verdict="even";
        if(score>=5)verdict="strong advantage";
        else if(score>=2)verdict="advantage";
        else if(score<=-5)verdict="severe disadvantage";
        else if(score<=-2)verdict="disadvantage";
        return {score:score,strong:strong,weak:weak,near:near,verdict:verdict};
      },
      inferPlayerStyle(root=state.aidrpg){
        const build=root&&root.build?root.build:{};
        const stats=this.getPlayerStats(root);
        const tags=[];
        const add=(x)=>{x=String(x||"");if(x&&tags.indexOf(x)===-1)tags.push(x);};
        ["styleTags","methodTags","combatTags","resourceTags","specializationTags"].forEach((key)=>{const arr=Array.isArray(build[key])?build[key]:[];for(let i=0;i<arr.length;i+=1)add(arr[i]);});
        if(stats.atk>=Math.max(stats.def,stats.spd,stats.intl)+3)add("power_attacker");
        if(stats.def>=Math.max(stats.atk,stats.spd)+3)add("durable_defender");
        if(stats.spd>=Math.max(stats.atk,stats.def)+3)add("mobile_evasive");
        if(stats.intl>=Math.max(stats.atk,stats.def,stats.spd)+3)add("technical_caster");
        return tags;
      },
      inferActorStyle(record,profile){
        const tags=[];
        const add=(x)=>{x=String(x||"");if(x&&tags.indexOf(x)===-1)tags.push(x);};
        const roleTags=Array.isArray(record&&record.roleTags)?record.roleTags:[];
        const rankTags=Array.isArray(record&&record.rankTags)?record.rankTags:[];
        for(let i=0;i<roleTags.length;i+=1)add(roleTags[i]);
        for(let i=0;i<rankTags.length;i+=1)add(rankTags[i]);
        if(profile&&profile.category)add(profile.category);
        if(profile&&profile.role)add(profile.role);
        const primary=Array.isArray(profile&&profile.primaryStats)?profile.primaryStats:[];
        for(let i=0;i<primary.length;i+=1)add("primary_"+primary[i]);
        return tags;
      },
      styleMatchup(playerStyle,actorStyle,compare){
        const p=(tag)=>Array.isArray(playerStyle)&&playerStyle.indexOf(tag)!==-1;
        const a=(tag)=>Array.isArray(actorStyle)&&actorStyle.indexOf(tag)!==-1;
        const notes=[];
        if((p("mobile")||p("agile")||p("mobile_evasive")||p("positioning_first"))&&(a("primary_def")||a("guard")||a("durable")))notes.push("mobility can avoid a durable foe but may need weak points to finish");
        if((p("direct_force")||p("power_attacker")||p("pressure_first"))&&(a("monster")||a("draconic")||a("primary_def")))notes.push("direct trading risks being blunted by body/DEF unless ATK gap is real");
        if((p("technical")||p("technical_caster")||p("mana_leaning"))&&(a("beast")||a("monster")))notes.push("control, terrain, and targeting matter more than raw exchange");
        if((p("durable_defender")||p("anchor")||p("durability_first"))&&(a("rogue")||a("scout")||a("assassin")||a("primary_spd")))notes.push("durability helps survive but speed/ambush can bypass simple blocking");
        if(compare&&compare.verdict==="severe disadvantage")notes.push("do not frame easy victory without a major advantage, tactic, tool, ally, or escape option");
        if(compare&&compare.verdict==="strong advantage")notes.push("weak opposition should not casually overpower the player unless numbers/surprise/hazards justify it");
        return notes.slice(0,3);
      },
      resourceConditionNotes(root=state.aidrpg){
        const stats=this.getPlayerStats(root);
        const player=root&&root.player?root.player:{};
        const body=player.body||{};
        const conditions=player.conditions||{};
        const notes=[];
        if(stats.hp/stats.maxHp<=0.30)notes.push("player is badly hurt");
        if(stats.ep/stats.maxEp<=0.25)notes.push("physical stamina is low");
        if(stats.mp/stats.maxMp<=0.25)notes.push("magic/focus reserve is low");
        const injuries=Array.isArray(body.injuries)?body.injuries:[];
        if(injuries.length)notes.push("injuries: "+injuries.slice(-2).join(", "));
        const active=Array.isArray(conditions.active)?conditions.active:[];
        if(active.length)notes.push("conditions: "+active.slice(-2).join(", "));
        return notes.slice(0,3);
      },
      buildCurrentMatchup(mode="normal",root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return"";
        this.init(root);
        const intent=root.pending&&root.pending.inputIntent?root.pending.inputIntent:null;
        const intentType=intent&&intent.primaryType?String(intent.primaryType):"";
        const combatIntent=/^(attack|defend|use_ability|move|travel)$/.test(intentType);
        const actors=root.actors&&root.actors.byId?root.actors.byId:{};
        const ids=this.getActorIds(root);
        if(!combatIntent&&!ids.length)return"";
        const playerStats=this.getPlayerStats(root);
        const playerStyle=this.inferPlayerStyle(root);
        const targets=[];
        for(let i=0;i<ids.length&&targets.length<(mode==="wide"?3:1);i+=1){
          const id=ids[i];
          const record=actors[id];
          if(!record||typeof record!=="object")continue;
          const profile=this.ensureThreat(record,root)||{};
          const actorStats=this.getActorStats(record,profile);
          const cmp=this.compareStats(playerStats,actorStats);
          const actorStyle=this.inferActorStyle(record,profile);
          const notes=this.styleMatchup(playerStyle,actorStyle,cmp);
          const levelText=profile.level?"L"+profile.level+" ":"";
          const name=this.getActorName(record,id);
          const statText="vs "+name+" "+levelText+String(profile.threatTier||profile.levelBand||"unknown")+": "+cmp.verdict;
          const edge=[];
          if(cmp.strong.length)edge.push("player edges "+cmp.strong.slice(0,3).join(","));
          if(cmp.weak.length)edge.push("enemy edges "+cmp.weak.slice(0,3).join(","));
          if(mode==="wide"&&notes.length)edge.push(notes.join("; "));
          else if(cmp.verdict==="severe disadvantage")edge.push("needs tactics/tools/escape; no easy win");
          else if(cmp.verdict==="strong advantage")edge.push("weak foe should not casually overpower player");
          targets.push(statText+(edge.length?" ("+edge.join(" | ")+")":""));
        }
        const condition=this.resourceConditionNotes(root);
        const out=[];
        if(targets.length)out.push(targets.join(" || "));
        else if(combatIntent)out.push("no clear opponent profile; resolve by player stats, resources, equipment, environment, and stated tactic");
        if(condition.length)out.push("Player limits: "+condition.join("; "));
        if(out.length){
          const packet="Combat matrix: "+out.join(" | ");
          root.cache.combatMatrix.lastPacket=packet;
          root.cache.combatMatrix.lastTurn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0;
          return packet;
        }
        return"";
      }
    },
    IntentParser: {
      parseInput(rawText,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return null;
        const U=globalThis.AIDRPG.Utils;
        const trimmed=U.normalizeSpaces(String(rawText||""));
        if(!root.pending||typeof root.pending!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.pending)){
          root.pending={
          };
        }
        if(!trimmed){
          root.pending.inputIntent=null;
          return null;
        }
        const lower=trimmed.toLowerCase();
        const scores=this.scoreActionFamilies(lower,
        trimmed);
        const primaryType=this.pickPrimaryType(scores);
        const alternates=this.buildAlternates(scores,
        primaryType);
        const intent={
          primaryType: primaryType,
          confidence: this.scoreToConfidence(scores[primaryType]||0),
          alternates: alternates,
          targetHint: this.extractTarget(trimmed,
          primaryType),
          weaponHint: this.extractWeapon(trimmed,
          primaryType),
          styleHint: this.extractStyle(trimmed,
          primaryType),
          abilityHint: this.extractAbility(trimmed,
          primaryType),
          itemHint: this.extractItem(trimmed,
          primaryType),
          destinationHint: this.extractDestination(trimmed,
          primaryType),
          trainingHint: this.extractTrainingFocus(trimmed,
          primaryType),
          environmentHint: "",
          tags: this.buildTags(primaryType,
          scores,
          trimmed),
          rawText: trimmed
        };
        root.pending.inputIntent=intent;
        if(root.meta&&root.meta.debug===true&&U&&typeof U.logParse==="function"){
          U.logParse("Input intent: "+primaryType+" ("+intent.confidence+")");
        }
        return intent;
      },
      scoreActionFamilies(lower,
      rawText){
        const scores={
          attack: 0,
          defend: 0,
          move: 0,
          travel: 0,
          inspect: 0,
          talk: 0,
          barter: 0,
          loot: 0,
          equip: 0,
          unequip: 0,
          rest: 0,
          train: 0,
          use_ability: 0,
          consume_item: 0,
          interact: 0
        };
        const addIf=(type,
        regex,
        amount)=>{
          if(regex.test(lower)){
            scores[type]+=amount;
          }
        };
        addIf("attack",
        /\b(attack|strike|slash|stab|shoot|fire at|swing at|kick|punch|smash|hit|lunge|charge at|kill)\b/,
        5);
        addIf("defend",
        /\b(defend|block|parry|guard|brace|protect|shield|take cover|hold position)\b/,
        5);
        addIf("move",
        /\b(go|walk|run|step|move|enter|leave|approach|advance|retreat|back away|climb|crawl)\b/,
        3);
        addIf("move",
        /\b(north|south|east|west|upstairs|downstairs|inside|outside)\b/,
        2);
        addIf("travel",
        /\b(travel|journey|set out|head to|make for|ride to|sail to|return to)\b/,
        5);
        addIf("inspect",
        /\b(look|look at|inspect|examine|search|study|check|observe|scan|peek|read)\b/,
        5);
        addIf("talk",
        /\b(say|ask|tell|reply|speak|talk|whisper|shout|yell|greet|persuade|convince)\b/,
        5);
        addIf("barter",
        /\b(buy|sell|trade|barter|haggle|purchase|pay|negotiate)\b/,
        5);
        addIf("loot",
        /\b(loot|take|grab|pick up|collect|gather|steal)\b/,
        5);
        addIf("equip",
        /\b(equip|wear|put on|draw|wield|ready|don)\b/,
        5);
        addIf("unequip",
        /\b(unequip|remove|take off|sheath|stow|holster)\b/,
        5);
        addIf("rest",
        /\b(rest|sleep|nap|wait|pause|camp|recover|breathe)\b/,
        5);
        addIf("train",
        /\b(train|practice|drill|exercise|meditate|spar|work on)\b/,
        5);
        addIf("use_ability",
        /\b(cast|channel|invoke|activate|unleash|focus)\b/,
        5);
        addIf("consume_item",
        /\b(drink|eat|consume|swallow|sip)\b/,
        5);
        addIf("interact",
        /\b(open|close|push|pull|touch|press|turn|unlock|lock|use|lift|drag)\b/,
        4);
        if(/["“][^"”]+["”]/.test(rawText)){
          scores.talk+=3;
        }
        if(/\bgo to\b/.test(lower)||/\bhead to\b/.test(lower)||/\breturn to\b/.test(lower)||/\breturn from\b/.test(lower)||/\bfrom\s+[^.!?]{2,50}\s+to\s+[^.!?]{2,50}/.test(lower)){
          scores.travel+=2;
          scores.move+=1;
        }
        if(/^\s*(?:i\s+)?return\b/i.test(String(rawText||""))){
          scores.travel+=4;
        }
        if(/\blook around\b/.test(lower)){
          scores.inspect+=3;
        }
        if(/\buse\b/.test(lower)&&!/\bconsume\b/.test(lower)){
          scores.interact+=1;
          scores.use_ability+=1;
        }
        if(/^\s*(?:i\s+)?(?:train|practice|drill|exercise|meditate on|spar with|work on)\s+/i.test(String(rawText||""))){
          scores.train+=7;
        }
        if(/\btake\s+(?:a\s+breath|a\s+deep\s+breath|a\s+step|a\s+moment|a\s+seat|cover|a\s+look|my\s+time|in\s+the\s+view)\b/i.test(String(rawText||""))){
          scores.loot=0;
          scores.logistics=0;
          if(/\btake\s+(?:a\s+breath|a\s+deep\s+breath|a\s+moment|my\s+time)\b/i.test(String(rawText||"")))scores.rest=Math.max(scores.rest,2);
          if(/\btake\s+a\s+look\b/i.test(String(rawText||"")))scores.inspect=Math.max(scores.inspect,3);
        }
        return scores;
      },
      pickPrimaryType(scores){
        let bestType="interact";
        let bestScore=-1;
        const order=["attack",
        "defend",
        "travel",
        "inspect",
        "talk",
        "barter",
        "loot",
        "equip",
        "unequip",
        "rest",
        "train",
        "use_ability",
        "consume_item",
        "move",
        "interact"];
        for(let i=0; i<order.length; i+=1){
          const type=order[i];
          const value=Number(scores[type]||0);
          if(value>bestScore){
            bestScore=value;
            bestType=type;
          }
        }
        if(bestScore<=0){
          return"interact";
        }
        return bestType;
      },
      buildAlternates(scores,
      primaryType){
        const entries=[];
        for(const key in scores){
          if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(scores,
          key))continue;
          if(key===primaryType)continue;
          const value=Number(scores[key]||0);
          if(value>0){
            entries.push({
              type: key,
              score: value
            });
          }
        }
        entries.sort(function(a,
        b){
          return b.score-a.score;
        });
        const out=[];
        for(let i=0; i<entries.length&&i<3; i+=1){
          out.push({
            type: entries[i].type,
            confidence: this.scoreToConfidence(entries[i].score)
          });
        }
        return out;
      },
      scoreToConfidence(score){
        const raw=0.2+(Number(score||0)*0.11);
        if(raw<0.2)return 0.2;
        if(raw>0.95)return 0.95;
        return Math.round(raw*100)/100;
      },
      buildTags(primaryType,
      scores,
      rawText){
        const tags=[];
        const addTag=(value)=>{
          const text=String(value||"").trim();
          if(!text)return;
          if(tags.indexOf(text)===-1){
            tags.push(text);
          }
        };
        addTag("intent:"+primaryType);
        if((scores.attack||0)>0)addTag("aggressive");
        if((scores.defend||0)>0)addTag("protective");
        if((scores.inspect||0)>0)addTag("observational");
        if((scores.talk||0)>0)addTag("social");
        if((scores.travel||0)>0||(scores.move||0)>0)addTag("movement");
        if((scores.train||0)>0)addTag("improvement");
        if((scores.loot||0)>0||(scores.barter||0)>0)addTag("acquisition");
        if((scores.use_ability||0)>0)addTag("specialized");
        if((scores.consume_item||0)>0)addTag("consumable_use");
        if(/["“][^"”]+["”]/.test(rawText)){
          addTag("quoted_speech");
        }
        return tags;
      },
      extractTarget(rawText,
      primaryType){
        const patterns=[/\b(?:attack|strike|slash|stab|shoot|hit|kick|punch|smash|lunge at|charge at)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.,;!?]+)/i,
        /\b(?:talk|speak|say|ask|tell|reply|greet)\s+(?:to\s+)?(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.,;!?]+)/i,
        /\b(?:inspect|examine|check|search|study|open|close|push|pull|touch|unlock|lock)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.,;!?]+)/i,
        /\b(?:at|toward|towards|against|into)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.,;!?]+)/i];
        for(let i=0; i<patterns.length; i+=1){
          const match=rawText.match(patterns[i]);
          if(match&&match[1]){
            return this.cleanHint(match[1]);
          }
        }
        if(primaryType==="inspect"&&/\blook around\b/i.test(rawText)){
          return"surroundings";
        }
        return"";
      },
      extractWeapon(rawText,
      primaryType){
        if(primaryType!=="attack"&&primaryType!=="defend"&&primaryType!=="interact"){
          return"";
        }
        const match=rawText.match(/\bwith\s+(?:my\s+|the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.,;!?]+)/i);
        if(match&&match[1]){
          return this.cleanHint(match[1]);
        }
        return"";
      },
      extractStyle(rawText,
      primaryType){
        const lower=String(rawText||"").toLowerCase();
        if(primaryType==="attack"){
          if(/\bcareful\b|\bprecise\b|\bmeasured\b/.test(lower))return"measured";
          if(/\bfierce\b|\bbrutal\b|\bhard\b|\bfull force\b/.test(lower))return"forceful";
          if(/\bquick\b|\bfast\b|\bsudden\b/.test(lower))return"fast";
        }
        if(primaryType==="talk"){
          if(/\bcalmly\b|\bpolitely\b/.test(lower))return"calm";
          if(/\bangrily\b|\bthreaten\b/.test(lower))return"aggressive";
        }
        if(primaryType==="train"){
          return"practice";
        }
        return"";
      },
      extractAbility(rawText,
      primaryType){
        if(primaryType!=="use_ability"&&primaryType!=="train"){
          return"";
        }
        const patterns=[/\b(?:cast|channel|invoke|activate|unleash|focus on|practice|train)\s+(?:my\s+|the\s+)?([^.,;!?]+)/i,
        /\buse\s+(?:my\s+|the\s+)?([^.,;!?]+)\s+(?:on|at|against)\b/i];
        for(let i=0; i<patterns.length; i+=1){
          const match=rawText.match(patterns[i]);
          if(match&&match[1]){
            return this.cleanHint(match[1]);
          }
        }
        return"";
      },
      extractItem(rawText,
      primaryType){
        if(primaryType!=="loot"&&primaryType!=="equip"&&primaryType!=="unequip"&&primaryType!=="consume_item"&&primaryType!=="barter"&&primaryType!=="interact"){
          return"";
        }
        const patterns=[/\b(?:pick up|grab|take|loot|collect|steal|equip|wear|put on|draw|wield|remove|take off|drink|eat|consume|buy|sell|trade|use)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|my\s+)?([^.,;!?]+)/i];
        for(let i=0; i<patterns.length; i+=1){
          const match=rawText.match(patterns[i]);
          if(match&&match[1]){
            return this.cleanHint(match[1]);
          }
        }
        return"";
      },
      extractDestination(rawText,
      primaryType){
        if(primaryType!=="travel"&&primaryType!=="move"){
          return"";
        }
        const patterns=[/\b(?:go|walk|run|move|travel|journey|head|return|enter|leave|climb|crawl)\s+(?:to|toward|towards|into|inside|outside|back to)?\s*(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.,;!?]+)/i];
        for(let i=0; i<patterns.length; i+=1){
          const match=rawText.match(patterns[i]);
          if(match&&match[1]){
            return this.cleanHint(match[1]);
          }
        }
        return"";
      },
      extractTrainingFocus(rawText,
      primaryType){
        if(primaryType!=="train"){
          return"";
        }
        const patterns=[/\b(?:train|practice|drill|exercise|meditate|spar|work on)\s+(?:my\s+|the\s+)?([^.,;!?]+)/i];
        for(let i=0; i<patterns.length; i+=1){
          const match=rawText.match(patterns[i]);
          if(match&&match[1]){
            return this.cleanHint(match[1]);
          }
        }
        return"";
      },
      cleanHint(value){
        return String(value||"").replace(/\s+/g,
        " ").replace(/\b(?:using|with|at|against|toward|towards|into|to)\b\s*$/i,
        "").trim();
      }
    },
    ProgressionEventRouter: {
      VERSION: "1.6.2-progression-accuracy-plus-growth-matrix",
      init(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object"||Array.isArray(root))return null;
        if(!root.progression||typeof root.progression!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.progression))root.progression={};
        if(!root.progression.router||typeof root.progression.router!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.progression.router)){
          root.progression.router={version:this.VERSION,recentRoutes:[],blocked:[]};
        }
        const r=root.progression.router;
        r.version=this.VERSION;
        if(!Array.isArray(r.recentRoutes))r.recentRoutes=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(r.blocked))r.blocked=[];
        return r;
      },
      norm(value){return String(value||"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();},
      lower(value){return this.norm(value).toLowerCase();},
      push(list,row,max){
        if(!Array.isArray(list))return 0;
        list.push(row);
        while(list.length>Math.max(1,Number(max||20)))list.shift();
        return 1;
      },
      hasNoOpInput(input){
        const s=this.lower(input);
        return /^(?:i\s+)?(?:wait|do nothing|stand still|stay still|pause|breathe|take a breath|take a deep breath|take a moment|look around|look|sit|rest)\.?$/.test(s)||
          /\b(?:take a breath|take a deep breath|do nothing|stand still|wait quietly)\b/.test(s);
      },
      hasMeaningfulOutput(output){
        const s=this.lower(output);
        return /\b(?:discover|find|found|notice|learn|realize|understand|map|clue|evidence|recover|heal|rested|ambush|danger|attack|injury|pain|progress|improve|practice|train|study|read|research|complete|success|fail|cost|exhausted|fatigued|wounded|defeat|kill|slay|survive|resist|endure|craft|repair|persuade|convince|trust|agrees?|confesses?)\b/.test(s);
      },
      isNoOpFiller(input,output){
        if(!this.hasNoOpInput(input))return false;
        return !this.hasMeaningfulOutput(output);
      },
      confirmsStudy(input,output){
        const s=this.lower(input+" "+output);
        const inputStudy=/\b(?:study|read|research|learn|examine|analyze|review|meditate on)\b/.test(this.lower(input));
        if(!inputStudy)return false;
        return /\b(?:book|grimoire|tome|scroll|library|teacher|mentor|lesson|hours?|minutes?|all day|night|notes?|experiment|theory|pattern|runes?|text|manual|practice notes?|insight|understand|learn|study|research|read)\b/.test(s);
      },
      confirmsTraining(input,output){
        const s=this.lower(input+" "+output);
        if(!/\b(?:train|practice|drill|exercise|spar|meditate|work on|hone|refine)\b/.test(this.lower(input)))return false;
        return /\b(?:practice|train|drill|spar|repeat|sweat|fatigue|tired|exhausted|hours?|minutes?|all day|improve|better|control|focus|mentor|teacher|lesson|strain|effort)\b/.test(s);
      },
      confirmsSkillUse(input,output){
        const s=this.lower(input+" "+output);
        return /\b(?:cast|channel|invoke|activate|unleash|perform|use)\b/.test(this.lower(input))&&
          /\b(?:cast|channel|invoke|activate|unleash|hits?|strikes?|works|succeeds?|flares?|manifests?|forms?|lands?|misses?|fails?|costs?|drains?)\b/.test(s);
      },
      confirmsKill(output){
        const s=this.lower(output);
        return /\b(?:you\s+)?(?:kill|kills|killed|slay|slays|slew|slain|defeat|defeats|defeated|finish off|finishes off|destroy|destroys|destroyed)\b/.test(s)||
          /\b(?:collapses?|falls?|dies|dead)\b/.test(s)&&/\b(?:enemy|foe|goblin|bandit|monster|beast|wolf|skeleton|zombie|orc|troll|knight|guard|mage|dragon|target)\b/.test(s);
      },
      confirmsSuccess(output){
        const s=this.lower(output);
        return /\b(?:succeed|successfully|manage to|works|hits?|lands?|connects?|opens?|unlocks?|convince|persuade|agrees?|accepts?|trusts?|learn|understand|improve|complete|crafted|repaired|discover|find|found)\b/.test(s);
      },
      confirmsPassiveExposure(input,output){
        const s=this.lower(input+" "+output);
        return /\b(?:endure|survive|resist|withstand|suffer|exposed|poison|venom|toxin|burn|fire|flame|heat|cold|frost|ice|freeze|acid|pain|fear|pressure|exhaustion|fatigue|hunger|disease|curse)\b/.test(s)&&
          /\b(?:survive|resist|endure|withstand|suffer|burn|poison|freeze|chill|pain|strain|adapt|tolerate)\b/.test(s);
      },
      inferDomain(text){
        const s=this.lower(text);
        const domains=[];
        const add=(d)=>{if(d&&domains.indexOf(d)===-1)domains.push(d);};
        if(/\b(?:magic|mana|spell|arcane|ritual|rune|sorcery|magecraft)\b/.test(s))add("magic");
        if(/\b(?:fire|flame|heat|burn|ember|pyro)\b/.test(s))add("fire");
        if(/\b(?:lightning|storm|thunder|shock|electric|volt)\b/.test(s))add("lightning");
        if(/\b(?:ice|frost|cold|snow|freeze)\b/.test(s))add("ice");
        if(/\b(?:heal|healing|medicine|first aid|mend|restore)\b/.test(s))add("healing");
        if(/\b(?:sword|blade|slash|fencing|saber|katana)\b/.test(s))add("swordsmanship");
        if(/\b(?:bow|arrow|archery|shoot)\b/.test(s))add("archery");
        if(/\b(?:stealth|sneak|silent|hide|shadow)\b/.test(s))add("stealth");
        if(/\b(?:tracking|track|trail|footprints|scout)\b/.test(s))add("tracking");
        if(/\b(?:craft|forge|repair|smith|alchemy|brew|cook|sew|build)\b/.test(s))add(/\balchemy|brew|potion\b/.test(s)?"alchemy":"crafting");
        if(/\b(?:clue|evidence|investigate|suspect|witness|case)\b/.test(s))add("investigation");
        if(/\b(?:persuade|convince|negotiate|comfort|inspire|intimidate|talk|social)\b/.test(s))add("social");
        if(/\b(?:beast|animal|familiar|pet|mount|tame)\b/.test(s))add("beast handling");
        if(/\b(?:domain|kingdom|village|workers|guards|project|taxes|holding)\b/.test(s))add("domain management");
        if(!domains.length)add("general");
        return domains;
      },
      findAbility(input,output,root=state.aidrpg){
        const ab=root&&root.abilities?root.abilities:{};
        const by=ab.byId||{};
        const ids=Array.isArray(ab.allIds)?ab.allIds:Object.keys(by);
        const combined=this.lower(input+" "+output);
        let best=null;
        for(let i=0;i<ids.length;i+=1){
          const id=ids[i],rec=by[id];
          if(!rec||!rec.identity)continue;
          const name=String(rec.identity.name||"").trim();
          if(!name)continue;
          const lowerName=name.toLowerCase();
          const key=lowerName.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,"\\$&");
          const nameHit=new RegExp("\\b"+key+"\\b","i").test(combined);
          const keys=rec.keys&&Array.isArray(rec.keys.keyPhrases)?rec.keys.keyPhrases:[];
          let keyHit=false;
          for(let k=0;k<keys.length&&!keyHit;k+=1){
            const phrase=String(keys[k]||"").trim().toLowerCase();
            if(phrase&&combined.indexOf(phrase)!==-1)keyHit=true;
          }
          if(nameHit||keyHit){
            best={id:id,rec:rec,name:name,type:rec.identity.type||"ability"};
            if(nameHit)return best;
          }
        }
        return best;
      },
      abilityNameHint(input,root=state.aidrpg){
        const intent=root&&root.pending?root.pending.inputIntent:null;
        if(intent&&intent.abilityHint)return this.norm(intent.abilityHint);
        const m=String(input||"").match(/\b(?:cast|channel|invoke|activate|unleash|perform|practice|train|study|use)\s+(?:my\s+|the\s+)?([^.!?;,]+)/i);
        return m&&m[1]?this.norm(m[1]).slice(0,80):"";
      },
      event(lane,amount,source,note,extra){
        const e=extra&&typeof extra==="object"?extra:{};
        e.lane=lane;
        e.amount=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(amount)||0));
        e.source=String(source||lane||"progression");
        e.note=String(note||source||lane||"");
        return e;
      },
      routeOutput(rawText,root=state.aidrpg){
        const r=this.init(root);
        const intent=root&&root.pending?root.pending.inputIntent:null;
        const input=intent&&intent.rawText?String(intent.rawText):"";
        const output=String(rawText||"");
        const events=[];
        const turn=root&&root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0;
        if(!output.trim())return events;
        if(this.isNoOpFiller(input,output)){
          const blocked=this.event("blocked",0,"no_progress","No meaningful XP: filler/no-op turn.");
          blocked.reason="no_meaningful_result";
          events.push(blocked);
          this.push(r.blocked,{turn:turn,reason:blocked.reason,input:this.norm(input).slice(0,120),output:this.norm(output).slice(0,120)},20);
          return events;
        }
        const combined=input+" "+output;
        const ability=this.findAbility(input,output,root);
        const abilityHint=ability?ability.name:this.abilityNameHint(input,root);
        const abilityType=ability?String(ability.type||"ability").toLowerCase():"";
        const domains=this.inferDomain(combined);
        const killed=this.confirmsKill(output);
        const success=this.confirmsSuccess(output);
        const study=this.confirmsStudy(input,output);
        const training=this.confirmsTraining(input,output);
        const skillUse=this.confirmsSkillUse(input,output);
        const passiveExposure=this.confirmsPassiveExposure(input,output);
        const primary=intent&&intent.primaryType?String(intent.primaryType):"";
        const addDomains=(amount,source,note)=>{
          for(let i=0;i<domains.length&&i<3;i+=1)events.push(this.event("domain",amount,source,note,{domain:domains[i]}));
        };
        if(study){
          const strong=/\b(?:hours?|all day|night|mentor|teacher|grimoire|tome|library|experiment|rare|ancient|dragon|pattern|insight|breakthrough)\b/i.test(combined);
          addDomains(strong?3:1,"study","Study confirmed: theory/domain progress.");
          if(strong)events.push(this.event("level",1,"study_breakthrough","Meaningful study produced broad growth."));
        }
        if(training){
          let lane="ability";
          if(abilityType==="skill")lane="skill";
          else if(abilityType==="talent")lane="talent";
          else if(abilityType==="passive")lane="passive";
          const amount=/\b(?:hours?|all day|mentor|spar|danger|exhausted|fatigued|breakthrough|improve|better|refine)\b/i.test(combined)?3:2;
          events.push(this.event(lane,amount,"training","Training confirmed"+(abilityHint?": "+abilityHint:"."),{abilityId:ability&&ability.id,abilityName:abilityHint,abilityType:abilityType||lane}));
          addDomains(1,"training_domain","Training supports related domain progress.");
          if(/\b(?:danger|spar|exhausted|fatigued|breakthrough|all day|hours?)\b/i.test(combined))events.push(this.event("level",1,"training_effort","Hard training produced broad growth."));
        }
        if(skillUse){
          let amount=2;
          if(success)amount=4;
          if(killed)amount=6;
          let lane=abilityType==="talent"?"talent":abilityType==="passive"?"passive":abilityType==="ability"?"ability":"skill";
          events.push(this.event(lane,amount,killed?"kill_with_skill":success?"successful_skill_use":"cast_skill",(abilityHint||"Skill")+" use confirmed.",{abilityId:ability&&ability.id,abilityName:abilityHint,abilityType:abilityType||lane}));
          addDomains(killed?2:1,killed?"combat_domain":"ability_domain","Ability use supports related domain progress.");
          if(killed)events.push(this.event("level",3,"kill_with_skill","Confirmed kill/victory with ability; bounded level XP."));
        }
        if(killed&&!skillUse&&(primary==="attack"||/\b(?:attack|strike|slash|stab|shoot|hit|fight|battle)\b/i.test(input))){
          events.push(this.event("level",3,"combat_victory","Confirmed combat victory; bounded level XP."));
          addDomains(1,"combat_domain","Combat supports related domain progress.");
        }
        if(passiveExposure){
          const severe=/\b(?:poison|venom|burn|fire|freeze|frozen|acid|curse|disease|survive|near death|severe|agony)\b/i.test(combined);
          events.push(this.event("passive",severe?3:1,"passive_exposure","Exposure/adaptation pressure confirmed.",{abilityId:ability&&abilityType==="passive"?ability.id:"",abilityName:ability&&abilityType==="passive"?ability.name:""}));
          addDomains(1,"exposure_domain","Exposure supports related domain progress.");
          if(severe)events.push(this.event("level",1,"survive_hazard","Surviving serious strain produced broad growth."));
        }
        if((primary==="inspect"||primary==="travel"||primary==="move")&&/\b(?:discover|find|found|notice|learn|reveal|map|clue|evidence|hidden|secret|landmark|route)\b/i.test(output)){
          events.push(this.event("level",1,"discovery","Meaningful discovery/exploration confirmed."));
          addDomains(1,"discovery_domain","Discovery supports related domain progress.");
        }
        if((primary==="talk"||primary==="barter")&&/\b(?:persuade|convince|agrees?|accepts?|trusts?|ally|confesses?|reveals?|negotiat|comforts?|calms?)\b/i.test(output)){
          events.push(this.event("level",1,"social_breakthrough","Meaningful social progress confirmed."));
          events.push(this.event("domain",1,"social_domain","Social progress confirmed.",{domain:"social"}));
        }
        if(/\b(?:crafted|crafts|forged|repaired|created|built|brewed|finished)\b/i.test(output)&&/\b(?:using|with|materials?|ore|wood|herb|cloth|leather|tool|workbench|forge|anvil)\b/i.test(combined)){
          events.push(this.event("domain",2,"craft_item","Confirmed crafting progress.",{domain:"crafting"}));
          events.push(this.event("level",1,"craft_item","Meaningful crafting produced broad growth."));
        }
        if(/\b(?:quest\s+complete|completed\s+the\s+quest|job\s+is\s+done|rewarded\s+for|mission\s+complete)\b/i.test(output)){
          events.push(this.event("level",3,"complete_quest","Quest/job completion confirmed."));
        }
        if(!events.length&&this.hasMeaningfulOutput(output)&&!this.hasNoOpInput(input)){
          const source=primary==="rest"?"recovery":primary||"general";
          if(source!=="rest"&&source!=="recovery")events.push(this.event("domain",1,source,"Minor meaningful progress.",{domain:domains[0]||"general"}));
        }
        const filtered=[];
        const seen={};
        for(let i=0;i<events.length;i+=1){
          const e=events[i];
          const key=[e.lane,e.source,e.domain||"",e.abilityId||"",e.amount].join("|");
          if(seen[key])continue;
          seen[key]=true;
          filtered.push(e);
        }
        this.push(r.recentRoutes,{turn:turn,input:this.norm(input).slice(0,100),output:this.norm(output).slice(0,100),events:filtered.map(e=>({lane:e.lane,amount:e.amount,source:e.source,note:e.note,domain:e.domain||"",ability:e.abilityName||""}))},16);
        return filtered;
      }
    },

    AbilityGrowthMatrixSystem: {
      VERSION: "1.6.2-ability-growth-matrix",
      init(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object"||Array.isArray(root))return null;
        if(!root.progression||typeof root.progression!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.progression))root.progression={};
        if(!root.progression.abilityGrowthMatrix||typeof root.progression.abilityGrowthMatrix!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.progression.abilityGrowthMatrix)){
          root.progression.abilityGrowthMatrix={version:this.VERSION,recent:[],blocked:[]};
        }
        const d=root.progression.abilityGrowthMatrix;
        d.version=this.VERSION;
        if(!Array.isArray(d.recent))d.recent=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(d.blocked))d.blocked=[];
        return d;
      },
      norm(value){return String(value||"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();},
      lower(value){return this.norm(value).toLowerCase();},
      toKey(value){const U=globalThis.AIDRPG&&globalThis.AIDRPG.Utils;return U&&typeof U.toKey==="function"?U.toKey(value):String(value||"").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,"_").replace(/^_+|_+$/g,"");},
      push(list,row,max){if(!Array.isArray(list))return 0;list.push(row);while(list.length>Math.max(1,Number(max||20)))list.shift();return 1;},
      abilityKindFromRecord(rec){
        const raw=this.lower(rec&&rec.identity?rec.identity.type:"ability");
        const text=raw+" "+this.lower(rec&&rec.meaning?(rec.meaning.intendedFunction||rec.meaning.effect||""):"");
        if(/passive|resistance|tolerance|adaptation|always/.test(text))return"passive";
        if(/talent|style|stance|form|method|art/.test(text))return"talent";
        if(/skill|spell|cast|technique|active|invoke|channel/.test(text))return"skill";
        return"ability";
      },
      eventKind(e){
        const source=this.lower(e&&e.source);
        if(source.indexOf("study")!==-1)return"study";
        if(source.indexOf("training")!==-1||source.indexOf("train")!==-1)return"training";
        if(source.indexOf("kill")!==-1)return"kill";
        if(source.indexOf("successful")!==-1||source.indexOf("success")!==-1)return"success";
        if(source.indexOf("cast")!==-1||source.indexOf("ability")!==-1)return"use";
        if(source.indexOf("exposure")!==-1||source.indexOf("hazard")!==-1)return"exposure";
        return source||"progress";
      },
      matrixAmount(kind,eventKind,severity){
        const hard=severity==="hard",major=severity==="major";
        const table={
          ability:{study:1,training:3,use:3,success:5,kill:6,exposure:1,progress:1},
          skill:{study:1,training:3,use:3,success:5,kill:8,exposure:0,progress:1},
          talent:{study:1,training:4,use:3,success:6,kill:6,exposure:1,progress:1},
          passive:{study:0,training:2,use:0,success:0,kill:0,exposure:hard||major?4:2,progress:0}
        };
        const base=Number((table[kind]||table.ability)[eventKind]||0);
        if(base<=0)return 0;
        return Math.max(1,base+(major?2:hard?1:0));
      },
      severity(input,output){
        const s=this.lower(input+" "+output);
        if(/\b(?:boss|dragon|demon|ancient|legendary|near death|life or death|breakthrough|all day|weeks?|months?|deadly|impossible|overwhelming)\b/.test(s))return"major";
        if(/\b(?:hours?|danger|under pressure|wounded|exhausted|fatigued|mentor|teacher|rare|grimoire|tome|successful|kills?|defeats?|survive|severe)\b/.test(s))return"hard";
        return"normal";
      },
      normalizeEvents(events,rawText,root=state.aidrpg){
        const d=this.init(root);
        const list=Array.isArray(events)?events:[];
        if(!list.length)return list;
        const intent=root&&root.pending?root.pending.inputIntent:null;
        const input=intent&&intent.rawText?String(intent.rawText):"";
        const output=String(rawText||"");
        const sev=this.severity(input,output);
        const ab=root&&root.abilities?root.abilities:{};
        const by=ab.byId||{};
        const out=[];
        for(let i=0;i<list.length;i+=1){
          const e=Object.assign({},list[i]);
          const lane=this.lower(e.lane);
          if(lane==="blocked"){out.push(e);continue;}
          if(lane==="skill"||lane==="talent"||lane==="ability"||lane==="basic"||lane==="passive"){
            const rec=e.abilityId&&by[e.abilityId]?by[e.abilityId]:null;
            let kind=rec?this.abilityKindFromRecord(rec):(lane==="basic"?"ability":lane);
            if(kind==="basic")kind="ability";
            const ek=this.eventKind(e);
            if(kind==="passive"&&ek!=="exposure"&&ek!=="training"){
              e.lane="blocked";e.amount=0;e.reason="passive_activation_blocked";e.note="No passive XP: passives grow from exposure, strain, adaptation, or relevant conditioning, not activation spam.";
              this.push(d.blocked,{turn:root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0,reason:e.reason,note:e.note},18);
              out.push(e);continue;
            }
            const nextAmount=this.matrixAmount(kind,ek,sev);
            e.lane=kind==="ability"?"ability":kind;
            e.amount=Math.max(Number(e.amount||0),nextAmount);
            e.growthFamily=kind;
            e.growthRule=ek;
            e.note=(e.note?e.note+" ":"")+"Growth matrix: "+(kind==="ability"?"Basic Ability":kind.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+kind.slice(1))+" / "+ek+" / "+sev+".";
            this.push(d.recent,{turn:root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0,ability:e.abilityName||e.abilityId||"",family:e.growthFamily,rule:e.growthRule,amount:e.amount,note:e.note.slice(0,180)},24);
          }
          out.push(e);
        }
        return out;
      },
      formatGrowthMatrix(root=state.aidrpg){
        const d=this.init(root);
        const lines=["[AIDRPG /growthmatrix]","v1.6.2 Ability Growth Matrix","Basic Abilities: study small, practice moderate, real use moderate, difficult success high, new application high.","Skills: study mostly domain/theory, casting gives skill XP, successful use gives more, confirmed kill/victory gives the most skill XP and bounded level XP.","Talents: styles/stances/forms grow from practice, maintained use, pressure-tested application, and style-defining behavior.","Passives: no activation XP and no activation cost; they grow through exposure, survival, adaptation, conditioning, or strain.","Recent matrix routes: "+d.recent.length];
        for(let i=Math.max(0,d.recent.length-8);i<d.recent.length;i++){const r=d.recent[i];lines.push("- "+(r.ability||"ability")+" | "+r.family+"/"+r.rule+" | +"+r.amount);}
        if(d.blocked.length){lines.push("Blocked passive/dirty growth:");for(let i=Math.max(0,d.blocked.length-5);i<d.blocked.length;i++){const b=d.blocked[i];lines.push("- "+b.reason+": "+b.note);}}
        return lines.join("\n")+"\n";
      }
    },

      wordNumber(value){const s=this.lower(value);const map={one:1,two:2,three:3,four:4,five:5,six:6,seven:7,eight:8,nine:9,ten:10,eleven:11,twelve:12,thirteen:13,fourteen:14,fifteen:15,sixteen:16,seventeen:17,eighteen:18,nineteen:19,twenty:20,thirty:30,forty:40,fifty:50,hundred:100};if(/^\d+$/.test(s))return Math.floor(Number(s));return map[s]||0;},
      enemyKey(text){

      threatScore(input,output,root=state.aidrpg){
        const s=this.lower(input+" "+output);
        let score=1;
        if(/\b(?:rat|rats|slime|slimes|training dummy|dummy)\b/.test(s))score=0.35;
        if(/\b(?:goblin|goblins|wolf|wolves|skeleton|skeletons|bandit|bandits|zombie|zombies)\b/.test(s))score=Math.max(score,0.9);
        if(/\b(?:orc|orcs|guard|guards|knight|knights|mage|mages|ogre|ogres)\b/.test(s))score=Math.max(score,1.6);
        if(/\b(?:troll|trolls|boss|champion|warden|guardian|demon|demons)\b/.test(s))score=Math.max(score,2.4);
        if(/\b(?:dragon|dragons|ancient|legendary|mythic|god|divine)\b/.test(s))score=Math.max(score,4.0);
        const playerLevel=root&&root.player&&root.player.levelState?Number(root.player.levelState.level||1):1;
        const actors=root&&root.actors&&root.actors.byId?root.actors.byId:{};
        const local=Array.isArray(root&&root.actors&&root.actors.localIds)?root.actors.localIds:[];
        for(let i=0;i<local.length&&i<3;i++){const rec=actors[local[i]];const lvl=Number(rec&&rec.threatProfile&&rec.threatProfile.level||0);if(lvl>0){const ratio=lvl/Math.max(1,playerLevel);if(ratio>=5)score=Math.max(score,4);else if(ratio>=2)score=Math.max(score,2.5);else if(ratio>=0.75)score=Math.max(score,1.2);else if(ratio<0.35)score=Math.min(score,0.5);}}
        return score;
      },
      setupEvidence(input,output,root=state.aidrpg){
        const s=this.lower(input+" "+output);

        if(/\b(?:prepared|preparation|planned|ambush|trap|terrain|weak point|strategy|tactic|advantage|helped|party|companion|familiar|summon|mentor|crafted|poisoned|studied|scouted)\b/.test(s))score+=1;
        if(/\b(?:rare|artifact|blessing|ritual|cost|sacrifice|exhausted|wounded|risk|dangerous)\b/.test(s))score+=1;
        return score;

      repeatedMultiplier(enemy,root=state.aidrpg){
        const d=this.init(root);const key=String(enemy||"foe");const row=d.antiFarm[key]||(d.antiFarm[key]={count:0,lastTurn:0});const turn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0;
