      },
      scaleLevelAmount(base,input,output,root=state.aidrpg){
        if(this.impossibleVictory(input,output,root))return {amount:0,reason:"unsupported impossible victory",threat:"impossible"};
        const threat=this.threatScore(input,output,root);
        const setup=this.setupEvidence(input,output,root);
        const enemy=this.enemyKey(input+" "+output);
        const repeat=this.repeatedMultiplier(enemy,root);
        let amount=Number(base||0);
        if(threat<0.55)amount=1;
        else if(threat<1.15)amount=Math.max(amount,2);
        else if(threat<2.0)amount=Math.max(amount,4);
        else if(threat<3.5)amount=Math.max(amount,6);
        else amount=Math.max(amount,8);
        if(setup>=2)amount+=2;else if(setup>=1)amount+=1;
        amount=Math.floor(amount*repeat);
        amount=Math.max(0,Math.min(14,amount));
        return {amount:amount,reason:"threat "+threat.toFixed(2)+", setup "+setup+", repeat x"+repeat.toFixed(2),threat:threat,enemy:enemy};
      },
      extractPartialGroupOutcome(input,output,root=state.aidrpg){
        const text=this.norm(input+" "+output);
        const d=this.init(root);
        const groupMatch=text.match(/\b(\d+|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|eleven|twelve|thirteen|fourteen|fifteen|sixteen|seventeen|eighteen|nineteen|twenty|thirty|forty|fifty)\s+([a-z]+s?)\b[^.!?]{0,180}\b(?:attack|attacks|surround|charge|appear|ambush)/i);

        if(groupMatch&&killMatch){
          const total=this.wordNumber(groupMatch[1]);const killed=this.wordNumber(killMatch[1]);
          if(total>1&&killed>0&&killed<total){
            const remaining=total-killed;
            const row={turn:root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0,group:this.norm(groupMatch[2]),total:total,killed:killed,remaining:remaining,note:remaining+" "+this.norm(groupMatch[2])+" remain; partial kill is not total victory."};

            if(root.cache&&typeof root.cache==="object")root.cache.lastPartialGroupOutcome=row.note;
            return row;
          }
        }
        return null;
      },
      enhanceEvents(events,rawText,root=state.aidrpg){

          }
          out.push(e);
        }
        return out;
      },

        const failedPurchaseItem=(()=>{
          const patterns=[/\b(?:cannot|can't)\s+afford\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|this\s+|that\s+)?([^.!?;,]+)/i,
          /\b(?:do\s+not|don't|does\s+not|doesn't|did\s+not|didn't)\s+have\s+enough\s+(?:money|silver|gold|copper|coins?|funds)\s+for\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|this\s+|that\s+)?([^.!?;,]+)/i,
          /\bnot\s+enough\s+(?:money|silver|gold|copper|coins?|funds)\s+for\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|this\s+|that\s+)?([^.!?;,]+)/i,
          /\binsufficient\s+(?:funds|money|silver|gold|copper|coins?)\s+for\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|this\s+|that\s+)?([^.!?;,]+)/i,
          /\b(?:lack|lacks|lacked|lacking)\s+enough\s+(?:money|silver|gold|copper|coins?|funds)\s+for\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|this\s+|that\s+)?([^.!?;,]+)/i];
          for(let i=0; i<patterns.length; i+=1){
            const match=String(rawText||"").match(patterns[i]);
            if(match&&match[1]){
              return String(match[1]||"").replace(/\s+(?:right\s+now|today|here|from\s+the\s+shop).*$/i,
              "").replace(/^(?:the|a|an|this|that)\s+/i,
              "").replace(/[.,;:!?]+$/g,
              "").replace(/\s+/g,
              " ").trim().slice(0,
              60);
            }
          }
          return"";
        })();
        const hasFailedPurchaseMoney=/\b(?:cannot|can't)\s+afford\b/.test(lower)||/\b(?:do\s+not|don't|does\s+not|doesn't|did\s+not|didn't)\s+have\s+enough\s+(?:money|silver|gold|copper|coins?|funds)\b/.test(lower)||/\bnot\s+enough\s+(?:money|silver|gold|copper|coins?|funds)\b/.test(lower)||/\binsufficient\s+(?:funds|money|silver|gold|copper|coins?)\b/.test(lower)||/\b(?:lack|lacks|lacked|lacking)\s+enough\s+(?:money|silver|gold|copper|coins?|funds)\b/.test(lower);
        const hasPurchaseContext=/\b(?:merchant|shopkeeper|vendor|seller|trader|shop|sale|sell|sells|buy|purchase|payment|price|costs?)\b/.test(lower)||/\b(?:healing\s+kit|shield|armor|weapon|potion|item|goods?)\b/.test(lower);
        if(hasFailedPurchaseMoney&&hasPurchaseContext){
          const reason=/\b(?:cannot|can't)\s+afford\b/.test(lower)?"cannot afford": /\binsufficient\s+(?:funds|money|silver|gold|copper|coins?)\b/.test(lower)?"insufficient funds": "not enough money";
          const itemText=failedPurchaseItem?" for "+failedPurchaseItem: "";
          const keyText=failedPurchaseItem?failedPurchaseItem.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,
          "_"): "money";
          changes+=logOnce("Purchase failed: "+reason+itemText+".",
          "failed_purchase_"+keyText);
        }
        const bossMatch=String(rawText||"").match(/\b(?:the\s+)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z' -]{1,40}?(?:warden|boss|champion|chief|lord|beast|monster|golem|knight|guardian))\s+(?:collapses?|falls?|dies|is\s+defeated|is\s+slain)\b/i);
        if(bossMatch||/\bdungeon\s+cleared\b/i.test(rawText)||/\b(?:meaningful|major|combat)\s+(?:but\s+not\s+massive\s+)?experience\b/i.test(rawText)){
          const target=bossMatch&&bossMatch[1]?bossMatch[1].replace(/^the\s+/i,
          "").trim(): "major foe";
          const dungeon=/\bdungeon\s+cleared\b/i.test(rawText)?"; dungeon cleared": "";
          const xp=/\bexperience\b/i.test(rawText)?"; experience gained": "";
          changes+=logOnce("Combat result: "+target+" defeated"+dungeon+xp+".",
          "combat_result_"+target.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,
          "_"));
        }
        const rawString=String(rawText||"");
        const bareActorMatch=rawString.match(/\b([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30})\b[^.!?]{0,90}\b(?:is\s+wounded|is\s+injured|is\s+hurt|bleeds?|is\s+bleeding|is\s+poisoned|stays\s+with\s+the\s+party|stays\s+with\s+you|joins\s+the\s+party|follows\s+you|guards\s+you|protects\s+you)\b[^.!?]{0,90}/i);
        if(bareActorMatch&&bareActorMatch[1]){
          const actorName=String(bareActorMatch[1]||"").trim();
          if(!/^(?:You|The|A|An|Your|His|Her|Their|This|That)$/i.test(actorName)){
            const note=String(bareActorMatch[0]||"").replace(/\s+/g,
            " ").replace(/[.!?]+$/g,
            "").trim().slice(0,
            120);
            changes+=logOnce("Actor note: "+note+".",
            "actor_note_"+actorName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,
            "_"));
          }
        }
        const bareAbilityMatch=rawString.match(/\b([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}(?:\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}){0,3})\s+(?:becomes|became|forms?|formed|turns?\s+into|turned\s+into|expands?\s+into|expanded\s+into|shifts?\s+into|shifted\s+into|surges?\s+into|surged\s+into)\s+([^.!?;]{3,120})/i);
        if(bareAbilityMatch&&bareAbilityMatch[1]&&bareAbilityMatch[2]){
          const abilityName=String(bareAbilityMatch[1]||"").trim();
          const adaptation=String(bareAbilityMatch[2]||"").replace(/\s+/g,
          " ").replace(/[.,;:!?]+$/g,
          "").trim().slice(0,
          90);
          const singleToken=abilityName.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length===1;
          const safeSingleAbility=/(?:ward|guard|blade|step|flame|frost|stone|shield|strike|sight|song|chain|veil|brand|aegis|barrier|bolt|spark)$/i.test(abilityName);
          if(!/\b(?:Captain|Commander|General|Sergeant|Queen|King|Lord|Lady|High\s+Priestess|Archmage|Archdruid|Master)\b/.test(abilityName)){
            if(!singleToken||safeSingleAbility){
              changes+=logOnce("Ability note: "+abilityName+" becomes "+adaptation+".",
              "ability_note_"+abilityName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,
              "_"));
            }
          }
        }
        return changes;
      },
      classifyIntent(intent){
        const type=String(intent.primaryType||"");
        if(type==="attack"||type==="defend"||type==="use_ability"){
          return"combat";
        }
        if(type==="train"){
          return"training";
        }
        if(type==="travel"||type==="move"||type==="inspect"){
          return"exploration";
        }
        if(type==="talk"||type==="barter"){
          return"social";
        }
        if(type==="loot"||type==="equip"||type==="unequip"||type==="consume_item"||type==="interact"){
          return"logistics";
        }
        if(type==="rest"){
          return"recovery";
        }
        return"general";
      },
      baseXpForSource(source,
      intent,
      rawText){
        const type=String(intent.primaryType||"");
        const lower=String(rawText||"").toLowerCase();
        if(source==="combat"){
          let xp=3;
          if(/\b(hit|strike|wound|block|parry|fight|battle|bleed|stagger)\b/.test(lower)){
            xp+=1;
          }
          return xp;
        }
        if(source==="training"){
          let xp=3;
          if(/\b(practice|repeat|drill|exercise|meditate|focus|spar)\b/.test(lower)){
            xp+=1;
          }
          return xp;
        }
        if(source==="exploration"){
          if(type==="inspect")return 2;
          if(type==="travel")return 2;
          return 1;
        }
        if(source==="social"){
          return 1;
        }
        if(source==="logistics"){
          if(type==="loot"||type==="consume_item")return 2;
          return 1;
        }
        if(source==="recovery"){
          return 1;
        }
        return 1;
      },
      antiFarmMultiplier(levelState,
      source){
        const antiFarm=levelState.antiFarm||{
        };
        if(antiFarm.lastSource!==source){
          antiFarm.lastSource=source;
          antiFarm.repeatCount=0;
          levelState.antiFarm=antiFarm;
          return 1;
        }
        antiFarm.repeatCount+=1;
        levelState.antiFarm=antiFarm;
        if(antiFarm.repeatCount===1)return 0.67;
        if(antiFarm.repeatCount===2)return 0.5;
        return 0.34;
      },
      awardXp(amount,
      source,
      note,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const A=globalThis.AIDRPG;
        const U=A.Utils;
        const player=root.player||{
        };
        const levelState=player.levelState||{
        };
        const turn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0;
        if(A.XPBudgetGuardSystem&&typeof A.XPBudgetGuardSystem.adjustAward==="function"){
          amount=A.XPBudgetGuardSystem.adjustAward(amount,source,note,root);
          if(amount<=0)return 0;
        }
        levelState.xp+=amount;
        levelState.totalXp+=amount;
        levelState.lastGainTurn=turn;
        if(!Array.isArray(levelState.history.recentGains)){
          levelState.history.recentGains=[];
        }
        levelState.history.recentGains.push({
          turn: turn,
          amount: amount,
          source: String(source||"general"),
          note: String(note||"")
        });
        while(levelState.history.recentGains.length>12){
          levelState.history.recentGains.shift();
        }
        let leveled=0;
        while(levelState.xp>=levelState.xpToNext){
          levelState.xp-=levelState.xpToNext;
          levelState.level+=1;
          leveled+=1;
          this.applyLevelUpBenefits(root);
          levelState.xpToNext=this.xpNeededForLevel(levelState.level,
          levelState.growthClass);
        }
        if(U&&typeof U.markDirty==="function"){
          U.markDirty("player",
          true,
          root);
        }
        if(U&&typeof U.logEvent==="function"){
          U.logEvent("XP +"+amount+" from "+source+(leveled?" | level up +"+leveled: ""));
        }
        return amount;
      },
      applyLevelUpBenefits(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return;
        const player=root.player||{
        };
        const stats=player.stats||{
        };
        const build=root.build||{
        };
        if(typeof stats.maxHp==="number"){
          stats.maxHp+=10;
          stats.hp=stats.maxHp;
        }
        if(typeof stats.maxEp==="number"){
          stats.maxEp+=4;
          stats.ep=stats.maxEp;
        }
        if(typeof stats.maxMp==="number"){
          stats.maxMp+=2;
          stats.mp=stats.maxMp;
        }
        const specs=Array.isArray(build.specializationTags)?build.specializationTags: [];
        if(specs.indexOf("power_bias")!==-1&&typeof stats.atk==="number"){
          stats.atk+=1;
        }
        else if(specs.indexOf("resilience_bias")!==-1&&typeof stats.def==="number"){
          stats.def+=1;
        }
        else if(specs.indexOf("speed_bias")!==-1&&typeof stats.spd==="number"){
          stats.spd+=1;
        }
        else if(specs.indexOf("technical_bias")!==-1&&typeof stats.intl==="number"){
          stats.intl+=1;
        }
        else if(specs.indexOf("fortune_bias")!==-1&&typeof stats.lck==="number"){
          stats.lck+=1;
        }
        else if(typeof stats.atk==="number"){
          stats.atk+=1;
        }
        if(globalThis.AIDRPG.PlayerSystem&&typeof globalThis.AIDRPG.PlayerSystem.recomputeDerived==="function"){
          globalThis.AIDRPG.PlayerSystem.recomputeDerived(player);
        }
      },
      ensureLaneState(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return null;
        if(!root.progression||typeof root.progression!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.progression))root.progression={};
        const p=root.progression;
        if(!p.lanes||typeof p.lanes!=="object"||Array.isArray(p.lanes))p.lanes={};
        const laneNames=["ability","skill","talent","passive","domain","build","quest","reputation"];
        for(let i=0;i<laneNames.length;i+=1){
          const k=laneNames[i];
          if(!p.lanes[k]||typeof p.lanes[k]!=="object"||Array.isArray(p.lanes[k]))p.lanes[k]={xp:0,totalXp:0,recent:[]};
          if(typeof p.lanes[k].xp!=="number")p.lanes[k].xp=0;
          if(typeof p.lanes[k].totalXp!=="number")p.lanes[k].totalXp=0;
          if(!Array.isArray(p.lanes[k].recent))p.lanes[k].recent=[];
        }
        if(!p.domainsByKey||typeof p.domainsByKey!=="object"||Array.isArray(p.domainsByKey))p.domainsByKey={};
        if(!Array.isArray(p.recentXp))p.recentXp=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(p.blockedXp))p.blockedXp=[];
        return p;
      },
      toKey(value){
        const U=globalThis.AIDRPG&&globalThis.AIDRPG.Utils;
        return U&&typeof U.toKey==="function"?U.toKey(value):String(value||"").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,"_").replace(/^_+|_+$/g,"");
      },
      cleanLabel(value,max=120){
        return String(value==null?"":value).replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f<>]+/g," ").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim().slice(0,Math.max(12,Number(max)||120));
      },
      pushRecentXp(root,row){
        const p=this.ensureLaneState(root);
        const turn=root&&root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0;
        const clean={turn:turn,lane:String(row.lane||""),amount:Math.floor(Number(row.amount)||0),source:String(row.source||""),note:this.cleanLabel(row.note||"",180),domain:String(row.domain||""),ability:String(row.abilityName||row.ability||"")};
        p.recentXp.push(clean);
        while(p.recentXp.length>30)p.recentXp.shift();
        return 1;
      },
      pushBlockedXp(root,reason,note){
        const p=this.ensureLaneState(root);
        const turn=root&&root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0;
        p.blockedXp.push({turn:turn,reason:String(reason||"blocked"),note:this.cleanLabel(note||"",160)});
        while(p.blockedXp.length>24)p.blockedXp.shift();
        this.pushRecentXp(root,{lane:"blocked",amount:0,source:reason||"blocked",note:note||reason});
        return 1;
      },
      applyProgressionEvents(events,root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const list=Array.isArray(events)?events:[];
        if(!list.length)return 0;
        let changes=0;
        for(let i=0;i<list.length;i+=1){
          const e=list[i];
          if(!e||typeof e!=="object")continue;
          const lane=String(e.lane||"").toLowerCase();
          const amount=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(e.amount)||0));
          if(lane==="blocked"||amount<=0){
            changes+=this.pushBlockedXp(root,e.reason||e.source||"blocked",e.note||"No XP awarded.");
            continue;
          }
          if(lane==="level"){
            const before=root.player&&root.player.levelState?Number(root.player.levelState.totalXp||0):0;
            const gained=this.awardXp(amount,e.source||"level",e.note||"",root);
            const after=root.player&&root.player.levelState?Number(root.player.levelState.totalXp||0):before;
            if(gained>0||after>before){this.pushRecentXp(root,{lane:"level",amount:Math.max(0,after-before),source:e.source,note:e.note});changes+=1;}
            continue;
          }
          if(lane==="domain"){
            changes+=this.awardDomainXp(e.domain||"general",amount,e.source,e.note,root);
            continue;
          }
          if(lane==="skill"||lane==="talent"||lane==="passive"||lane==="ability"||lane==="basic"){
            if(e.abilityId){
              changes+=this.awardAbilityXp(e.abilityId,amount,lane,e.source,e.note,root);
            } else {
              changes+=this.awardLaneXp(lane==="basic"?"ability":lane,amount,e.source,e.note,root);
            }
            continue;
          }
          changes+=this.awardLaneXp(lane,amount,e.source,e.note,root);
        }
        if(changes>0){
          const U=globalThis.AIDRPG&&globalThis.AIDRPG.Utils;
          if(U&&typeof U.markDirty==="function")U.markDirty("player",true,root);
          if(U&&typeof U.invalidatePackets==="function")U.invalidatePackets(root);
        }
        return changes;
      },
      awardLaneXp(lane,amount,source,note,root=state.aidrpg){
        const p=this.ensureLaneState(root);
        const key=this.toKey(lane||"general")||"general";
        if(!p.lanes[key])p.lanes[key]={xp:0,totalXp:0,recent:[]};
        const row=p.lanes[key];
        const gained=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(amount)||0));
        if(gained<=0)return 0;
        row.xp+=gained;row.totalXp+=gained;
        const turn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0;
        row.recent.push({turn:turn,amount:gained,source:String(source||key),note:this.cleanLabel(note||"",160)});
        while(row.recent.length>12)row.recent.shift();
        this.pushRecentXp(root,{lane:key,amount:gained,source:source||key,note:note||"",});
        return 1;
      },
      awardDomainXp(domain,amount,source,note,root=state.aidrpg){
        const p=this.ensureLaneState(root);
        const name=this.cleanLabel(domain||"general",80)||"general";
        const key=this.toKey(name)||"general";
        if(!p.domainsByKey[key])p.domainsByKey[key]={key:key,name:name,xp:0,totalXp:0,level:1,recent:[]};
        const d=p.domainsByKey[key];
        const gained=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(amount)||0));
        if(gained<=0)return 0;
        d.xp+=gained;d.totalXp+=gained;
        d.level=Math.max(1,Math.min(100,Math.floor(d.totalXp/12)+1));
        const turn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0;
        d.recent.push({turn:turn,amount:gained,source:String(source||"domain"),note:this.cleanLabel(note||"",160)});
        while(d.recent.length>12)d.recent.shift();
        this.awardLaneXp("domain",gained,source||"domain",note||("Domain progress: "+name),root);
        const latest=root.progression&&Array.isArray(root.progression.recentXp)?root.progression.recentXp[root.progression.recentXp.length-1]:null;
        if(latest)latest.domain=name;
        return 1;
      },
      awardAbilityXp(abilityId,amount,lane,source,note,root=state.aidrpg){
        const ab=root.abilities||{},rec=ab.byId?ab.byId[abilityId]:null;
        if(!rec||typeof rec!=="object")return this.awardLaneXp(lane||"ability",amount,source,note,root);
        const A=globalThis.AIDRPG||{},Ability=A.AbilitySystem;
        if(Ability&&typeof Ability.ensureRecordShape==="function")Ability.ensureRecordShape(rec,abilityId,"",root);
        const prog=rec.progression||(rec.progression={});
        if(typeof prog.xp!=="number")prog.xp=0;
        const gained=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(amount)||0));
        if(gained<=0)return 0;
        const turn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0;
        if(prog.lastProgressionRouterTurn===turn&&prog.lastProgressionRouterSource===String(source||""))return 0;
        prog.xp+=gained;
        prog.laneXp=(prog.laneXp&&typeof prog.laneXp==="object")?prog.laneXp:{};
        const kind=String(lane||rec.identity&&rec.identity.type||"ability").toLowerCase();
        prog.laneXp[kind]=Number(prog.laneXp[kind]||0)+gained;
        if(Ability&&typeof Ability.abilityLevelFromXp==="function"){
          const next=Ability.abilityLevelFromXp(prog.xp);
          if(prog.level!==next)prog.level=next;
          if(typeof Ability.tierFromXp==="function")prog.tier=Ability.tierFromXp(prog.xp);
          if(typeof Ability.masteryLabelForTier==="function")prog.masteryState=Ability.masteryLabelForTier(prog.tier||1);
          if(typeof Ability.refreshCostProfile==="function")Ability.refreshCostProfile(rec,root);
        }
        if(!Array.isArray(prog.recentXp))prog.recentXp=[];
        prog.recentXp.push({turn:turn,amount:gained,lane:kind,source:String(source||kind),note:this.cleanLabel(note||"",160)});
        while(prog.recentXp.length>12)prog.recentXp.shift();
        prog.lastProgressionRouterTurn=turn;
        prog.lastProgressionRouterSource=String(source||"");
        if(Ability&&typeof Ability.markAbilityDirty==="function")Ability.markAbilityDirty(abilityId,root);
        this.awardLaneXp(kind==="basic"?"ability":kind,gained,source||kind,note||"",root);
        const latest=root.progression&&Array.isArray(root.progression.recentXp)?root.progression.recentXp[root.progression.recentXp.length-1]:null;
        if(latest){latest.ability=rec.identity&&rec.identity.name?rec.identity.name:abilityId;latest.lane=kind==="basic"?"ability":kind;}
        return 1;
      },
      formatRecentXp(root=state.aidrpg){
        this.init(root);
        const p=this.ensureLaneState(root);
        const lines=["[AIDRPG /xp]","Recent XP and progression events:"];
        const list=Array.isArray(p.recentXp)?p.recentXp.slice(-12):[];
        if(!list.length)lines.push("- None yet.");
        for(let i=0;i<list.length;i+=1){
          const r=list[i]||{};
          const amt=Number(r.amount||0);
          const target=r.ability?(" | "+r.ability):(r.domain?(" | "+r.domain):"");
          lines.push("- "+(amt>0?("+"+amt):"+0")+" "+(r.lane||"xp")+target+" — "+(r.note||r.source||"progress"));
        }
        return lines.join("\n")+"\n";
      },
      formatProgressionStatus(root=state.aidrpg){
        this.init(root);
        const p=this.ensureLaneState(root),ls=root.player&&root.player.levelState?root.player.levelState:{};
        const lines=["[AIDRPG /progression]","Level: "+(ls.level||1)+" | XP: "+(ls.xp||0)+"/"+(ls.xpToNext||this.xpNeededForLevel(ls.level||1,ls.growthClass))+" | Total Level XP: "+(ls.totalXp||0),"","Lane totals:"];
        const names=Object.keys(p.lanes||{}).sort();
        for(let i=0;i<names.length;i++){const row=p.lanes[names[i]]||{};if(Number(row.totalXp||0)>0)lines.push("- "+names[i]+": "+row.totalXp+" XP");}
        if(lines[lines.length-1]==="Lane totals:")lines.push("- None yet.");
        lines.push("");lines.push("Use /xp for recent awards, /abilityxp for named abilities, and /domains for broad domains.");
        return lines.join("\n")+"\n";
      },
      formatAbilityXp(root=state.aidrpg){
        this.init(root);
        const ab=root.abilities||{},by=ab.byId||{},ids=Array.isArray(ab.allIds)?ab.allIds:Object.keys(by);
        const rows=[];
        for(let i=0;i<ids.length;i++){const rec=by[ids[i]];if(!rec||!rec.identity)continue;const p=rec.progression||{};const total=Number(p.xp||0);if(total>0||Array.isArray(p.recentXp)&&p.recentXp.length)rows.push({name:rec.identity.name||ids[i],type:rec.identity.type||"ability",xp:total,level:p.level||1,rec:rec});}
        rows.sort((a,b)=>b.xp-a.xp);
        const lines=["[AIDRPG /abilityxp]","Tracked ability progression:"];
        if(!rows.length)lines.push("- No ability XP yet.");
        for(let i=0;i<rows.length&&i<12;i++)lines.push("- "+rows[i].name+" ["+rows[i].type+"] L"+rows[i].level+" | XP "+rows[i].xp);
        return lines.join("\n")+"\n";
      },
      formatDomainXp(root=state.aidrpg){
        this.init(root);
        const p=this.ensureLaneState(root),by=p.domainsByKey||{};
        const rows=Object.keys(by).map(k=>by[k]).filter(Boolean).sort((a,b)=>Number(b.totalXp||0)-Number(a.totalXp||0));
        const lines=["[AIDRPG /domains]","Broad domain progression:"];
        if(!rows.length)lines.push("- No domain XP yet.");
        for(let i=0;i<rows.length&&i<14;i++)lines.push("- "+(rows[i].name||rows[i].key)+" L"+(rows[i].level||1)+" | XP "+(rows[i].totalXp||0));
        return lines.join("\n")+"\n";
      },
      formatProgressionSelfTest(root=state.aidrpg){
        const R=globalThis.AIDRPG&&globalThis.AIDRPG.ProgressionEventRouter;
        const lines=["[AIDRPG progression selftest]"];
        const tests=[
          {name:"wait filler blocks",pass:R&&R.isNoOpFiller("I wait.","Nothing happens.")},
          {name:"take a breath blocks",pass:R&&R.isNoOpFiller("I take a breath.","You breathe.")},
          {name:"study source confirms",pass:R&&R.confirmsStudy("I study fire magic from a grimoire for two hours.","You learn a useful fire theory insight.")},
          {name:"skill use confirms",pass:R&&R.confirmsSkillUse("I cast Fireball.","The spell hits the goblin.")},
          {name:"kill confirms",pass:R&&R.confirmsKill("The goblin is killed by the spell and falls dead.")},
          {name:"passive exposure confirms",pass:R&&R.confirmsPassiveExposure("I endure the freezing rain.","You survive the cold and resist the worst of it.")},
          {name:"growth matrix installed",pass:!!(globalThis.AIDRPG&&globalThis.AIDRPG.AbilityGrowthMatrixSystem&&typeof globalThis.AIDRPG.AbilityGrowthMatrixSystem.normalizeEvents==="function")},
          {name:"combat reward resolver installed",pass:!!(globalThis.AIDRPG&&globalThis.AIDRPG.CombatRewardResolver&&typeof globalThis.AIDRPG.CombatRewardResolver.enhanceEvents==="function")},
          {name:"earned acceleration model installed",pass:!!(globalThis.AIDRPG&&globalThis.AIDRPG.EarnedAccelerationModel&&typeof globalThis.AIDRPG.EarnedAccelerationModel.enhanceEvents==="function")}
        ];
        let ok=0;
        for(let i=0;i<tests.length;i++){if(tests[i].pass)ok++;lines.push((tests[i].pass?"PASS ":"FAIL ")+tests[i].name);}
        lines.push("Result: "+ok+" / "+tests.length+" passed.");
        return lines.join("\n")+"\n";
      },
      getCompactSummary(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object"||!root.player||!root.player.levelState){
          return"Progression summary unavailable.";
        }
        const levelState=root.player.levelState;
        return"Level "+levelState.level+" | XP "+levelState.xp+"/"+levelState.xpToNext+" | Total XP "+levelState.totalXp;
      }
    },
    InventorySystem: {
      VERSION: "1.5.1-chunks12-14-inventory-cleanup",
      init(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return null;
        if(!root.items||typeof root.items!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.items))root.items={};
        const items=root.items;
        if(!items.byId||typeof items.byId!=="object"||Array.isArray(items.byId))items.byId={};
        if(!items.ownership||typeof items.ownership!=="object"||Array.isArray(items.ownership))items.ownership={};
        if(!Array.isArray(items.ownership.player))items.ownership.player=[];
        if(!items.ownership.storage||typeof items.ownership.storage!=="object"||Array.isArray(items.ownership.storage))items.ownership.storage={};
        if(!items.ownership.actors||typeof items.ownership.actors!=="object"||Array.isArray(items.ownership.actors))items.ownership.actors={};
        if(!items.equipment||typeof items.equipment!=="object"||Array.isArray(items.equipment))items.equipment={};
        const eq=items.equipment;
        const slots=["mainHand","offHand","head","body","hands","legs","feet","accessory1","accessory2"];
        for(let i=0;i<slots.length;i+=1){if(!(slots[i] in eq))eq[slots[i]]=null;}
        if(!items.currency||typeof items.currency!=="object"||Array.isArray(items.currency))items.currency={};
        if(!items.currency.byType||typeof items.currency.byType!=="object"||Array.isArray(items.currency.byType))items.currency.byType={};
        const cur=items.currency.byType;
        cur.copper=this.cleanNonNegativeInt(cur.copper);
        cur.silver=this.cleanNonNegativeInt(cur.silver);
        cur.gold=this.cleanNonNegativeInt(cur.gold);
        if(!Array.isArray(items.recentEvents))items.recentEvents=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(items.blockedCaptures))items.blockedCaptures=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(items.pendingNormalization))items.pendingNormalization=[];
        const owned=[];
        const seen={};
        for(let i=0;i<items.ownership.player.length;i+=1){
          const id=String(items.ownership.player[i]||"");
          if(!id||seen[id]||!items.byId[id])continue;
          seen[id]=true;
          owned.push(id);
          this.ensureItemShape(items.byId[id],id,root);
        }
        items.ownership.player=owned;
        this.ensureEquipmentIntegrity(items,root);
        this.refreshVisibleCarrySummary(root);
        return items;
      },
      cleanNonNegativeInt(value){const n=Math.floor(Number(value||0));return Number.isFinite(n)&&n>0?n:0;},
      note(root,message){
        if(!root||!root.items)return 0;
        const list=root.items.recentEvents||(root.items.recentEvents=[]);
        list.push({turn:root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0,text:String(message||"")});
        while(list.length>16)list.shift();
        return 1;
      },
      blocked(root,message,phrase){
        if(!root||!root.items)return 0;
        const list=root.items.blockedCaptures||(root.items.blockedCaptures=[]);
        list.push({turn:root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0,reason:String(message||"blocked"),phrase:String(phrase||"").slice(0,80)});
        while(list.length>20)list.shift();
        return 1;
      },
      processOutput(rawText,root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const A=globalThis.AIDRPG||{};
        if(A.TurnEngine&&typeof A.TurnEngine.isDuplicateCurrentOutput==="function"&&A.TurnEngine.isDuplicateCurrentOutput())return 0;
        const text=this.norm(String(rawText||""));
        if(!text)return 0;
        let changes=0;
        changes+=this.applyCurrencyChanges(text,root);
        changes+=this.applyConfirmedAcquisitions(text,root);
        changes+=this.applySpendAndLosses(text,root);
        changes+=this.applyEquipAndUse(text,root);
        changes+=this.applyItemDamage(text,root);
        this.ensureEquipmentIntegrity(root.items,root);
        if(changes>0){
          this.refreshVisibleCarrySummary(root);
          if(A.Utils&&typeof A.Utils.markDirty==="function")A.Utils.markDirty("items","summary",root);
          if(A.Utils&&typeof A.Utils.invalidatePackets==="function")A.Utils.invalidatePackets(root);
          if(A.Utils&&typeof A.Utils.logEvent==="function")A.Utils.logEvent("Inventory cleanup applied "+changes+" change(s).");
        }
        return changes;
      },
      norm(value){return String(value||"").replace(/[\r\n]+/g," ").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();},
      lower(value){return this.norm(value).toLowerCase();},
      key(value){
        const A=globalThis.AIDRPG||{};
        if(A.Utils&&typeof A.Utils.toKey==="function")return A.Utils.toKey(value);
        return String(value||"").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,"_").replace(/^_+|_+$/g,"");
      },
      splitCapture(value){
        let text=this.norm(value).replace(/^[,:;\-\s]+/g,"").replace(/[.!?]+$/g,"");
        text=text.replace(/\s+(?:then|afterward|afterwards|before|because|while|as|when|where|which|that|who)\b[\s\S]*$/i,"");
        text=text.replace(/\s+(?:into|onto|in|inside|on|at|from|toward|towards|against|with|using|by|for)\b[\s\S]*$/i,"");
        text=text.replace(/\s*,[\s\S]*$/,"");
        const parts=text.split(/\s+(?:and|plus)\s+|\s*,\s*/i).map(v=>this.cleanItemPhrase(v)).filter(Boolean);
        const out=[];
        for(let i=0;i<parts.length&&out.length<5;i+=1){if(out.indexOf(parts[i])===-1)out.push(parts[i]);}
        return out;
      },
      cleanItemPhrase(value){
        let text=this.norm(value).replace(/[“”"']+/g,"").replace(/^(?:the|a|an|some|my|your|his|her|their|this|that)\s+/i,"");
        text=text.replace(/\b(?:away|in your inventory|into your inventory|into your bag|into your pack|into your pouch)\b.*$/i,"").trim();
        text=text.replace(/[.,;:!?]+$/g,"").trim();
        if(!text)return"";
        const words=text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
        if(words.length>7)text=words.slice(0,7).join(" ");
        const lower=text.toLowerCase();
        if(/^(?:it|them|that|this|something|anything|nothing|everything|here|there|inside|outside)$/.test(lower))return"";
        if(/\b(?:it|them)\b/i.test(lower))return"";
        if(/^(?:strap|put|place|slip|tuck|stow|sheathe|holster|attach)\b/i.test(lower))return"";
        if(this.isCurrencyPhrase(lower))return"";
        if(/\b(?:quest|task|job|mission|objective|reward|payment|price|cost|promise|offer)\b/.test(lower))return"";
        if(/\b(?:look|glance|breath|moment|chance|rest|seat|hold|care|notice|cover)\b/.test(lower))return"";
        if(/[{}<>]/.test(text))return"";
        return text;
      },
      isCurrencyPhrase(value){return /\b\d+\s*(?:gold|silver|copper)\b|\b(?:gold|silver|copper)\s+coins?\b|\bcoins?\b/i.test(String(value||""));},
      isConcreteItem(value){
        const text=this.cleanItemPhrase(value);
        if(!text)return false;
        const lower=text.toLowerCase();
        if(/\b(?:want|wanted|wish|wished|hope|hoped|remember|remembered|see|saw|notice|noticed|look|looked|hear|heard|mention|mentioned|refuse|decline|reject|almost|nearly)\b/.test(lower))return false;
        if(/\b(?:would|could|should|might|may)\b/.test(lower))return false;
        if(lower.length>70)return false;
        return true;
      },
      hasGlobalAcquisitionBlock(text,root=state.aidrpg){
        const out=this.lower(text);
        const input=root&&root.pending&&root.pending.inputIntent?this.lower(root.pending.inputIntent.rawText||""):"";
        const combined=(input+" "+out).trim();
        if(!combined)return false;
        const blockers=[
          /\b(?:almost|nearly)\s+(?:take|took|grab|grabbed|pick(?:ed)?\s+up|collect|collected|accept|accepted|receive|received|buy|bought|purchase|purchased)\b/,
          /\b(?:do not|don't|does not|doesn't|did not|didn't|decide not to|decides not to|decided not to)\s+(?:take|grab|pick\s+up|collect|accept|receive|buy|purchase|keep)\b/,
          /\b(?:refuse|refuses|refused|reject|rejects|rejected|decline|declines|declined)\b[^.!?]{0,80}\b(?:item|gift|offer|payment|reward|coin|coins|gold|silver|copper|it|them)\b/,
          /\b(?:wish|wishes|wanted|want|desire|desired|hope|hoped)\s+(?:for|to have|to get|to buy|to take)\b/,
          /\b(?:see|saw|notice|noticed|spot|spotted|look at|looked at|examine|examined)\b[^.!?]{0,90}\b(?:on|in|inside|behind|with)\b/,
          /\b(?:quest|job|task|mission)\b[^.!?]{0,80}\b(?:retrieve|bring|deliver|find)\b/,
          /\b(?:promises?|promised|will pay|would pay|reward(?:s|ed)? you with|reward is|reward:|payment will be)\b/
        ];
        for(let i=0;i<blockers.length;i+=1){if(blockers[i].test(combined))return true;}
        return false;
      },
      extractAcquisitionPhrases(text,root=state.aidrpg){
        const raw=this.norm(text);
        const out=[];
        if(this.hasGlobalAcquisitionBlock(raw,root))return out;
        const patterns=[
          /\byou\s+(?:pick(?:ed)?\s+up|grab(?:bed)?|take|takes|took|collect(?:ed)?|gather(?:ed)?|loot(?:ed)?|pocket(?:ed)?|stash(?:ed)?|buy|buys|bought|purchase(?:d)?|receive(?:d)?|accept(?:ed)?|are\s+given|are\s+handed|are\s+awarded)\s+([^.!?;]+)/gi,
          /\b(?:he|she|they|someone|somebody|the\s+[a-z][a-z' -]{1,32}|[A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,40})\s+(?:gives|gave|hands|handed|passes|passed)\s+you\s+([^.!?;]+)/g,
          /\b([^.!?;]{1,80}?)\s+(?:is|are)\s+(?:placed|dropped|slipped|tucked)\s+(?:into|in|onto)\s+your\s+(?:hand|hands|pack|bag|pouch|inventory|pocket)\b/gi
        ];
        for(let p=0;p<patterns.length;p+=1){
          let m;
          while((m=patterns[p].exec(raw))){
            const pieces=this.splitCapture(m[1]||"");
            for(let i=0;i<pieces.length;i+=1){
              const phrase=pieces[i];
              if(!this.isConcreteItem(phrase)){this.blocked(root,"not_concrete_item",phrase);continue;}
              if(out.indexOf(phrase)===-1)out.push(phrase);
            }
          }
        }
        return out;
      },
      applyConfirmedAcquisitions(text,root=state.aidrpg){
        const phrases=this.extractAcquisitionPhrases(text,root);
        let changes=0;
        for(let i=0;i<phrases.length;i+=1){
          const item=this.ensurePlayerItemFromPhrase(phrases[i],"carried","confirmed_acquisition",root);
          if(item)changes+=1;
        }
        return changes;
      },
      parseCurrencyMentions(text){
        const raw=this.norm(text);
        const out=[];
        const re=/\b(\d{1,6})\s*(gold|silver|copper)(?:\s+coins?)?\b/gi;
        let m;
        while((m=re.exec(raw))){out.push({amount:this.cleanNonNegativeInt(m[1]),type:String(m[2]||"").toLowerCase(),index:m.index});}
        return out;
      },
      isPromisedCurrencyContext(text){return /\b(?:promises?|promised|will pay|would pay|could earn|reward is|reward:|payment will be|offers?\s+to\s+pay|agrees?\s+to\s+pay|price|costs?|worth)\b/i.test(String(text||""));},
      applyCurrencyChanges(text,root=state.aidrpg){
        const raw=this.norm(text);
        const lower=raw.toLowerCase();
        const mentions=this.parseCurrencyMentions(raw);
        if(!mentions.length)return 0;
        const cur=root.items.currency.byType;
        let changes=0;
        const gainContext=/\b(?:you\s+(?:receive|received|accept|accepted|take|took|collect|collected|loot|looted|earn|earned|are\s+paid|were\s+paid|are\s+given|were\s+given|pocket|pocketed)|(?:pays|paid|hands|handed|gives|gave)\s+you|rewarded\s+with)\b/i.test(raw);
        const lossContext=/\b(?:you\s+(?:pay|paid|spend|spent|hand\s+over|handed\s+over|give|gave)|(?:coins?|gold|silver|copper)\s+(?:leave|left)\s+your\s+(?:hand|pouch|purse))\b/i.test(raw);
        const promised=this.isPromisedCurrencyContext(raw);
        for(let i=0;i<mentions.length;i+=1){
          const row=mentions[i];
          if(!row.amount||!(row.type in cur))continue;
          if(gainContext&&!promised){cur[row.type]=this.cleanNonNegativeInt(cur[row.type])+row.amount;changes+=1;this.note(root,"Currency gained: "+row.amount+" "+row.type+".");}
          else if(lossContext){cur[row.type]=Math.max(0,this.cleanNonNegativeInt(cur[row.type])-row.amount);changes+=1;this.note(root,"Currency spent/lost: "+row.amount+" "+row.type+".");}
        }
        return changes;
      },
      applySpendAndLosses(text,root=state.aidrpg){
        const raw=this.norm(text);
        if(!/\byou\s+(?:drop|dropped|lose|lost|discard|discarded|throw away|threw away|sell|sold|give|gave|hand over|handed over)\b/i.test(raw))return 0;
        let changes=0;
        const re=/\byou\s+(?:drop|dropped|lose|lost|discard|discarded|throw away|threw away|sell|sold|give|gave|hand over|handed over)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|your\s+)?([^.!?;]+)/gi;
        let m;
        while((m=re.exec(raw))){
          const phrase=this.cleanItemPhrase(m[1]||"");
          if(!phrase)continue;
          const item=this.findMatchingPlayerItem(phrase,root);
          if(item&&this.removePlayerItem(item.id,root)){changes+=1;this.note(root,"Item removed: "+(item.displayName||phrase)+".");}
        }
        return changes;
      },
      applyEquipAndUse(text,root=state.aidrpg){
        const raw=this.norm(text);
        let changes=0;
        const equipRe=/\byou\s+(?:equip|wear|put\s+on|draw|wield|ready|don)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|your\s+)?([^.!?;]+)/gi;
        let m;
        while((m=equipRe.exec(raw))){
          const phrase=this.cleanItemPhrase(m[1]||"");
          if(!phrase)continue;
          const item=this.ensurePlayerItemFromPhrase(phrase,"carried","equip_confirmed",root);
          if(item){const slot=this.inferSlotFromItem(item);if(slot&&this.equipItem(slot,item.id,root))changes+=1;}
        }
        const unequipRe=/\byou\s+(?:unequip|remove|take\s+off|sheath|stow|holster)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|your\s+)?([^.!?;]+)/gi;
        while((m=unequipRe.exec(raw))){const phrase=this.cleanItemPhrase(m[1]||"");const slot=this.inferSlotFromPhrase(phrase);if(slot&&this.unequipSlot(slot,root))changes+=1;}
        const consumeRe=/\byou\s+(?:drink|eat|consume|swallow|sip)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|your\s+)?([^.!?;]+)/gi;
        while((m=consumeRe.exec(raw))){const phrase=this.cleanItemPhrase(m[1]||"");const item=this.findMatchingPlayerItem(phrase,root);if(item&&this.removePlayerItem(item.id,root)){changes+=1;this.note(root,"Item consumed: "+(item.displayName||phrase)+".");}}
        return changes;
      },
      applyItemDamage(text,root=state.aidrpg){
        const raw=this.norm(text);
        const patterns=[{re:/\b(?:your|the)\s+([^.!?;]{1,70}?)\s+(?:breaks|shatters|snaps|is\s+destroyed|is\s+ruined)\b/gi,tag:"broken"},{re:/\b(?:your|the)\s+([^.!?;]{1,70}?)\s+(?:is\s+torn|tears|rips|is\s+cut)\b/gi,tag:"torn"},{re:/\b(?:your|the)\s+([^.!?;]{1,70}?)\s+(?:is\s+damaged|dents|is\s+dented|cracks|is\s+cracked)\b/gi,tag:"damaged"},{re:/\b(?:your|the)\s+([^.!?;]{1,70}?)\s+(?:burns|is\s+burned|scorches|is\s+scorched)\b/gi,tag:"burned"}];
        let changes=0;
        for(let p=0;p<patterns.length;p+=1){let m;while((m=patterns[p].re.exec(raw))){const phrase=this.cleanItemPhrase(m[1]||"");const item=this.findMatchingPlayerItem(phrase,root);if(item&&this.addItemTag(item.id,patterns[p].tag,root))changes+=1;}}
        return changes;
      },
      ensureItemShape(item,id,root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!item||typeof item!=="object")return null;
        if(typeof item.id!=="string"||!item.id)item.id=id||this.key(item.displayName||item.baseType||"item");
        if(typeof item.displayName!=="string"||!item.displayName)item.displayName=String(item.baseType||item.id||"item").replace(/_/g," ");
        if(typeof item.baseType!=="string"||!item.baseType)item.baseType=item.displayName;
        if(typeof item.normalizedKey!=="string"||!item.normalizedKey)item.normalizedKey=this.key(item.displayName||item.baseType);
        if(typeof item.quantity!=="number"||item.quantity<1)item.quantity=1;
        if(typeof item.condition!=="string")item.condition="intact";
        if(!Array.isArray(item.stateTags))item.stateTags=[];
        if(!item.notes||typeof item.notes!=="object"||Array.isArray(item.notes))item.notes={};
        if(typeof item.source!=="string")item.source="unknown";
        if(typeof item.visibility!=="string")item.visibility="known";
        return item;
      },
      ensurePlayerItemFromPhrase(phrase,carryState="carried",source="confirmed",root=state.aidrpg){
        this.init(root);
        const name=this.cleanItemPhrase(phrase);
        if(!this.isConcreteItem(name))return null;
        const existing=this.findMatchingPlayerItem(name,root);
        if(existing){
          existing.quantity=this.cleanNonNegativeInt(existing.quantity)||1;
          if(this.isStackable(existing))existing.quantity+=1;
          this.ensureItemShape(existing,existing.id,root);
          return existing;
        }
        const id=this.makeItemId(name,root);
        const item={id:id,displayName:name,baseType:name,normalizedKey:this.key(name),quantity:1,condition:"intact",stateTags:[],source:String(source||"confirmed"),carryState:String(carryState||"carried"),visibility:"known",acquiredTurn:root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0,notes:{confirmedBy:"story"}};
        root.items.byId[id]=item;
        root.items.ownership.player.push(id);
        this.note(root,"Item gained: "+name+".");
        return item;
      },
      makeItemId(name,root=state.aidrpg){
        const base="item_"+this.key(name||"item");
        let id=base;
        let i=2;
        while(root.items&&root.items.byId&&root.items.byId[id]){id=base+"_"+i;i+=1;}
        return id;
      },
      isStackable(item){const key=this.key((item&&item.baseType)||"");return /(?:arrow|bolt|dart|coin|ration|apple|fish|mushroom|gem|scrap|nail|torch|potion)s?$/.test(key);},
      findMatchingPlayerItem(phrase,root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||!root.items)return null;
        const key=this.key(phrase);
        const owned=root.items.ownership&&Array.isArray(root.items.ownership.player)?root.items.ownership.player:[];
        for(let i=owned.length-1;i>=0;i-=1){
          const item=root.items.byId[owned[i]];
          if(!item)continue;
          this.ensureItemShape(item,owned[i],root);
          const itemKey=this.key(item.displayName||item.baseType||owned[i]);
          const baseKey=this.key(item.baseType||"");
          if(itemKey===key||baseKey===key||itemKey.indexOf(key)!==-1||key.indexOf(itemKey)!==-1||baseKey.indexOf(key)!==-1)return item;
        }
        return null;
      },
      removePlayerItem(id,root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!id||!root||!root.items)return 0;
        const owned=root.items.ownership&&Array.isArray(root.items.ownership.player)?root.items.ownership.player:[];
        const idx=owned.indexOf(id);
        if(idx===-1)return 0;
        owned.splice(idx,1);
        for(const slot of Object.keys(root.items.equipment||{})){if(root.items.equipment[slot]===id)root.items.equipment[slot]=null;}
        return 1;
      },
      addItemTag(id,tag,root=state.aidrpg){const item=root&&root.items&&root.items.byId?root.items.byId[id]:null;if(!item)return 0;this.ensureItemShape(item,id,root);if(item.stateTags.indexOf(tag)===-1)item.stateTags.push(tag);item.condition=tag;this.note(root,"Item state: "+(item.displayName||id)+" is "+tag+".");return 1;},
      inferSlotFromPhrase(phrase){const lower=this.lower(phrase);if(/\b(?:sword|dagger|knife|axe|mace|hammer|wand|staff|bow|spear|blade|club)\b/.test(lower))return"mainHand";if(/\bshield\b/.test(lower))return"offHand";if(/\b(?:helm|helmet|hat|hood|crown)\b/.test(lower))return"head";if(/\b(?:armor|robe|cloak|coat|shirt|tunic|chestplate)\b/.test(lower))return"body";if(/\b(?:glove|gauntlet)\b/.test(lower))return"hands";if(/\b(?:pants|leggings|greaves)\b/.test(lower))return"legs";if(/\b(?:boots|shoes|sandals)\b/.test(lower))return"feet";if(/\b(?:ring|amulet|necklace|bracelet|charm|pendant)\b/.test(lower))return"accessory1";return"";},
      inferSlotFromItem(item){return this.inferSlotFromPhrase((item&&item.displayName)||"");},
      equipItem(slot,itemId,root=state.aidrpg){if(!slot||!itemId||!root||!root.items)return 0;if(!(slot in root.items.equipment))return 0;if(root.items.equipment[slot]===itemId)return 0;root.items.equipment[slot]=itemId;const item=root.items.byId[itemId];if(item){this.ensureItemShape(item,itemId,root);item.equippedSlot=slot;}this.note(root,"Equipped "+itemId+" in "+slot+".");return 1;},
      unequipSlot(slot,root=state.aidrpg){if(!root||!root.items||!root.items.equipment||!(slot in root.items.equipment))return 0;const old=root.items.equipment[slot];if(!old)return 0;root.items.equipment[slot]=null;if(root.items.byId&&root.items.byId[old])root.items.byId[old].equippedSlot="";this.note(root,"Unequipped "+old+" from "+slot+".");return 1;},
      ensureEquipmentIntegrity(items,root=state.aidrpg){if(!items||!items.equipment)return 0;let changes=0;for(const slot of Object.keys(items.equipment)){const id=items.equipment[slot];if(id&&!items.byId[id]){items.equipment[slot]=null;changes+=1;}}return changes;},
      refreshVisibleCarrySummary(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||!root.items)return"";
        const owned=root.items.ownership&&Array.isArray(root.items.ownership.player)?root.items.ownership.player:[];
        const names=[];
        for(let i=0;i<owned.length&&names.length<12;i+=1){const item=root.items.byId[owned[i]];if(item){this.ensureItemShape(item,owned[i],root);names.push(item.displayName+(item.quantity>1?" x"+item.quantity:""));}}
        const cur=root.items.currency&&root.items.currency.byType?root.items.currency.byType:{copper:0,silver:0,gold:0};
        const text="Items: "+(names.length?names.join(", "):"none")+" | Coins: "+(cur.gold||0)+"g "+(cur.silver||0)+"s "+(cur.copper||0)+"c";
        if(!root.cache||typeof root.cache!=="object")root.cache={};
        root.cache.visibleCarrySummary=text;
        return text;
      },
      getVisibleCarrySummary(root=state.aidrpg){this.init(root);return root.cache&&root.cache.visibleCarrySummary?root.cache.visibleCarrySummary:this.refreshVisibleCarrySummary(root);},
      getContextInventorySummary(root=state.aidrpg){return this.getVisibleCarrySummary(root);},
      getCompactSummary(root=state.aidrpg){return this.getVisibleCarrySummary(root);}
    },
    SceneStateSystem: {
      init(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return null;
        if(!root.world||typeof root.world!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.world)){
          root.world={
          };
        }
        if(!root.world.currentScene||typeof root.world.currentScene!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.world.currentScene)){
          root.world.currentScene={
          };
        }
        const scene=root.world.currentScene;
        if(typeof scene.sceneRef!=="string")scene.sceneRef="";
        if(typeof scene.displayName!=="string")scene.displayName="";
        if(typeof scene.sceneType!=="string")scene.sceneType="unknown";
        if(typeof scene.entityRef!=="string")scene.entityRef="";
        if(typeof scene.parentLocationRef!=="string")scene.parentLocationRef="";
        if(typeof scene.lastChangedTurn!=="number")scene.lastChangedTurn=0;
        if(!Array.isArray(scene.localEntityIds))scene.localEntityIds=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(scene.localActorIds))scene.localActorIds=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(scene.localHazards))scene.localHazards=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(scene.localExits))scene.localExits=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(scene.conditionTags))scene.conditionTags=[];
        if(!scene.localEntitiesById||typeof scene.localEntitiesById!=="object"||Array.isArray(scene.localEntitiesById)){
          scene.localEntitiesById={
          };
        }
        if(!scene.localActorsById||typeof scene.localActorsById!=="object"||Array.isArray(scene.localActorsById)){
          scene.localActorsById={
          };
        }
        if(typeof scene.sceneHintLabel!=="string")scene.sceneHintLabel="";
        if(typeof scene.sceneHintStrength!=="number")scene.sceneHintStrength=0;
        if(typeof scene.sceneHintTurn!=="number")scene.sceneHintTurn=0;
        if(typeof scene.pendingSceneLabel!=="string")scene.pendingSceneLabel="";
        if(typeof scene.pendingSceneStrength!=="number")scene.pendingSceneStrength=0;
        if(typeof scene.pendingSceneCount!=="number")scene.pendingSceneCount=0;
        if(typeof scene.pendingSceneTurn!=="number")scene.pendingSceneTurn=0;
        if(typeof scene.sceneConfidence!=="number")scene.sceneConfidence=0;
        if(!root.cache||typeof root.cache!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.cache)){
          root.cache={
          };
        }
        if(typeof root.cache.sceneSummary!=="string")root.cache.sceneSummary="";
        if(!Array.isArray(root.cache.localEntityIds))root.cache.localEntityIds=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(root.cache.localActorIds))root.cache.localActorIds=[];
        if(typeof root.cache.lastSceneHash!=="string")root.cache.lastSceneHash="";
        if(root.player&&typeof root.player==="object"){
          if(typeof root.player.sceneRef!=="string")root.player.sceneRef="";
          if(typeof root.player.locationRef!=="string")root.player.locationRef="";
          if(!scene.sceneRef&&root.player.sceneRef){
            scene.sceneRef=root.player.sceneRef;
          }
        }
        return scene;
      },
      processOutput(rawText,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const A=globalThis.AIDRPG;
        const U=A.Utils;
        const text=U&&typeof U.normalizeSpaces==="function"?U.normalizeSpaces(String(rawText||"")): String(rawText||"").trim();
        if(!text)return 0;
        if(A.TurnEngine&&typeof A.TurnEngine.isDuplicateCurrentOutput==="function"){
          if(A.TurnEngine.isDuplicateCurrentOutput()){
            return 0;
          }
        }
        const scene=root.world.currentScene;
        let changes=0;
        let sceneChanged=0;
        const sceneCandidate=this.extractSceneCandidate(text);
        if(sceneCandidate){
          sceneChanged=this.applySceneCandidate(sceneCandidate,
          root);
          changes+=sceneChanged;
        }
        const exits=this.extractLocalExits(text);
        if(sceneChanged||exits.length){
          changes+=this.replaceSimpleArray(scene.localExits,
          exits,
          6);
        }
        const hazards=this.extractLocalHazards(text);
        if(sceneChanged||hazards.length){
          changes+=this.replaceSimpleArray(scene.localHazards,
          hazards,
          6);
        }
        const conditionTags=this.extractConditionTags(text);
        if(sceneChanged||conditionTags.length){
          changes+=this.replaceSimpleArray(scene.conditionTags,
          conditionTags,
          6);
        }
        const actorLabels=this.extractLocalActors(text);
        if(sceneChanged||actorLabels.length){
          changes+=this.syncLabeledRefs(scene.localActorsById,
          scene.localActorIds,
          actorLabels,
          "local_actor");
        }
        const entityLabels=this.extractLocalEntities(text);
        if(sceneChanged||entityLabels.length){
          changes+=this.syncLabeledRefs(scene.localEntitiesById,
          scene.localEntityIds,
          entityLabels,
          "local_entity");
        }
        if(changes>0){
          this.refreshCache(root);
          if(U&&typeof U.logEvent==="function"){
            U.logEvent("Scene updated: "+this.getCompactSummary(root));
          }
        }
        return changes;
      },
      setCurrentSceneFromPhrase(phrase,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const cleaned=this.cleanSceneCandidate(phrase);
        if(!cleaned)return 0;
        return this.confirmSceneCandidate({
          label: cleaned,
          inferredType: this.inferSceneType(cleaned),
          strength: 3,
          sourceType: "forced_phrase"
        },
        root);
      },
      extractScenePhrase(text){
        const candidate=this.extractSceneCandidate(text);
        if(!candidate||candidate.strength<2){
          return"";
        }
        return candidate.label;
      },
      pickSceneLabel(value){
        const src=String(value||"").trim();
        if(!src)return"";
        const dungeonMatches=[{
          re: /\bbarrow\s+sanctum\b/i,
          label: "barrow sanctum"
        },
        {
          re: /\bsealed\s+sanctum\b/i,
          label: "sanctum"
        },
        {
          re: /\b(?:inner\s+)?sanctum\b/i,
          label: "sanctum"
        },
        {
          re: /\b(?:burial\s+)?chamber\b/i,
          label: "chamber"
        },
        {
          re: /\b(?:old\s+|sealed\s+|chapel\s+)?crypt\b/i,
          label: "crypt"
        },
        {
          re: /\b(?:old\s+|stone\s+)?shrine\b/i,
          label: "shrine"
        },
        {
          re: /\b(?:ancient\s+)?tomb\b/i,
          label: "tomb"
        },
        {
          re: /\bcatacombs?\b/i,
          label: "catacomb"
        }];
        for(let i=0; i<dungeonMatches.length; i+=1){
          if(dungeonMatches[i].re.test(src)){
            const cleaned=this.cleanSceneCandidate(dungeonMatches[i].label);
            if(cleaned)return cleaned;
          }
        }
        const canonicalMatches=[{
          re: /\b(?:tavern|inn)\s+(?:common room|barroom|taproom)\b/i,
          label: "tavern common room"
        },
        {
          re: /\b(?:common room|barroom|taproom)\b/i,
          label: "common room"
        },
        {
          re: /\b(?:tavern\s+)?cellar\b/i,
          label: "cellar"
        },
        {
          re: /\bbarrel room\b/i,
          label: "cellar"
        },
        {
          re: /\bsmithy\s+forge\s+room\b|\bforge\s+room\b/i,
          label: "smithy forge room"
        },
        {
          re: /\b(?:smithy interior|smithy|forge|workshop)\b/i,
          label: "smithy"
        },
        {
          re: /\b(?:ruined\s+)?chapel\b/i,
          label: "chapel"
        },
        {
          re: /\bchapel\s+nave\b|\bnave\b/i,
          label: "chapel nave"
        },
        {
          re: /\bsanctuary\b/i,
          label: "chapel"
        },
        {
          re: /\bguild hall\b/i,
          label: "guild hall"
        },
        {
          re: /\bmain hall\b/i,
          label: "guild hall"
        },
        {
          re: /\bapothecary shop\b/i,
          label: "apothecary shop"
        },
        {
          re: /\bshop interior\b/i,
          label: "shop interior"
        },
        {
          re: /\bmarket lane\b/i,
          label: "market lane"
        },
        {
          re: /\bmarket square\b/i,
          label: "market square"
        }];
        for(let i=0; i<canonicalMatches.length; i+=1){
          if(canonicalMatches[i].re.test(src)){
            const cleaned=this.cleanSceneCandidate(canonicalMatches[i].label);
            if(cleaned)return cleaned;
          }
        }
        const simplePatterns=[/\b(tavern|inn|cellar|smithy|chapel|guild hall|apothecary shop|shop interior|market lane|market square|square|lane|street|road|path|trail|courtyard|yard|bridge|gatehouse|gate|dock|pier|shore|beach|riverbank|river bank|boat|ship deck|deck|camp|forest|woods|swamp|marsh|jungle|cave|cavern|ruins|warehouse|granary|library|house|temple)\b/i];
        for(let i=0; i<simplePatterns.length; i+=1){
          const match=src.match(simplePatterns[i]);
          if(match&&match[1]){
            const cleaned=this.cleanSceneCandidate(match[1]);
            if(cleaned&&!this.isWeakSceneCandidate(cleaned)){
              return cleaned;
            }
          }
        }
        const cleaned=this.cleanSceneCandidate(src);
        if(!cleaned||this.isWeakSceneCandidate(cleaned)){
          return"";
        }
        if(!/\b(tavern|inn|common room|barroom|taproom|cellar|barrel room|smithy|forge|workshop|chapel|nave|sanctuary|guild hall|main hall|apothecary|shop interior|market lane|market square|square|lane|street|road|path|trail|courtyard|yard|bridge|gatehouse|gate|dock|pier|shore|beach|riverbank|river bank|boat|ship deck|deck|camp|forest|woods|swamp|marsh|jungle|cave|cavern|ruins|warehouse|granary|library|house|temple)\b/i.test(cleaned)){
          return"";
        }
        return cleaned;
      },
      sceneFamilyKey(label){
        const lower=this.cleanSceneCandidate(label||"").toLowerCase();
        if(!lower)return"";
        if(/\bbarrow\s+sanctum\b/.test(lower))return"barrow_sanctum";
        if(/\bsanctum\b/.test(lower))return"sanctum";
        if(/\bchamber\b/.test(lower))return"chamber";
        if(/\bcrypt\b/.test(lower))return"crypt";
        if(/\bshrine\b/.test(lower))return"shrine";
        if(/\btomb\b/.test(lower))return"tomb";
        if(/\bcatacombs?\b/.test(lower))return"catacomb";
        if((/\b(tavern|inn)\b/.test(lower)&&/\b(common room|barroom|taproom)\b/.test(lower))||/\b(common room|barroom|taproom)\b/.test(lower)){
          return"tavern_common_room";
        }
        if(/\b(cellar|barrel room)\b/.test(lower)){
          return"cellar";
        }
        if(/\b(smithy|forge|workshop)\b/.test(lower)){
          return"smithy";
        }
        if(/\b(chapel|nave|sanctuary)\b/.test(lower)){
          return"chapel";
        }
        if(/\b(guild hall|main hall)\b/.test(lower)){
          return"guild_hall";
        }
        if(/\b(apothecary|shop interior)\b/.test(lower)){
          return"shop_interior";
        }
        if(/\bmarket lane\b/.test(lower)||/^lane$/.test(lower)){
          return"market_lane";
        }
        if(/\bmarket square\b/.test(lower)){
          return"market_square";
        }
        return"";
      },
      isGenericSceneLabel(label){
        const lower=this.cleanSceneCandidate(label||"").toLowerCase();
        if(!lower)return true;
        return new Set(["lane",
        "room",
        "hall",
        "interior",
        "exterior",
        "outside",
        "inside",
        "place",
        "unknown",
        "unknown place"]).has(lower);
      },
      labelsCompatible(a,
      b){
        const left=this.cleanSceneCandidate(a||"").toLowerCase();
        const right=this.cleanSceneCandidate(b||"").toLowerCase();
        if(!left||!right)return false;
        if(left===right)return true;
        const leftFamily=this.sceneFamilyKey(left);
        const rightFamily=this.sceneFamilyKey(right);
        if(leftFamily&&rightFamily&&leftFamily===rightFamily){
          return true;
        }
        if(left.indexOf(right)!==-1||right.indexOf(left)!==-1){
          if(!this.isGenericSceneLabel(left)||!this.isGenericSceneLabel(right)){
            return true;
          }
        }
        return false;
      },
      preferSceneLabel(currentLabel,
      candidateLabel){
        const current=this.cleanSceneCandidate(currentLabel||"");
        const candidate=this.cleanSceneCandidate(candidateLabel||"");
        if(!current)return candidate;
        if(!candidate)return current;
        if(!this.labelsCompatible(current,
        candidate))return candidate;
        const family=this.sceneFamilyKey(current)||this.sceneFamilyKey(candidate);
        if(family==="tavern_common_room"){
          if(/\b(tavern|inn)\b/i.test(candidate))return candidate;
          if(/\b(tavern|inn)\b/i.test(current))return current;
        }
        if(family==="guild_hall"){
          if(/\bguild hall\b/i.test(candidate))return candidate;
          if(/\bguild hall\b/i.test(current))return current;
        }
        if(family==="chapel"){
          if(/\bchapel\b/i.test(candidate))return candidate;
          if(/\bchapel\b/i.test(current))return current;
        }
        if(family==="smithy"){
          if(/\bsmithy\b/i.test(candidate))return candidate;
          if(/\bsmithy\b/i.test(current))return current;
        }
        if(family==="shop_interior"){
          if(/\bapothecary\b/i.test(candidate))return candidate;
          if(/\bapothecary\b/i.test(current))return current;
        }
        if(family==="market_lane"){
          if(/\bmarket lane\b/i.test(candidate))return candidate;
          if(/\bmarket lane\b/i.test(current))return current;
        }
        if(this.isGenericSceneLabel(candidate)&&!this.isGenericSceneLabel(current)){
          return current;
        }
        if(this.isGenericSceneLabel(current)&&!this.isGenericSceneLabel(candidate)){
          return candidate;
        }
        return candidate.split(/\s+/).length>current.split(/\s+/).length?candidate: current;
      },
      extractSceneCandidate(text){
        const raw=String(text||"");
        const candidates=[];
        const hasWeakReferenceLanguage=/\b(?:visible from|can see|could see|seen from|nearby|down the street|down the road|beyond|in the distance|somewhere|only consider|consider heading|consider going|think about heading|talks about|talk about|mentions|mention|remembering|remembered|recalling|thinking about|visited before|notable locations? include)\b/i.test(raw);
        const hasExplicitArrivalLanguage=/\byou\s+(?:enter|step into|walk into|move into|head into|cross into|make your way into|arrive in|arrive at|return to|descend into|climb into|duck into|go inside|step inside|walk inside)\b/i.test(raw)||/\byou\s+(?:push through|push open|slip through)\b/i.test(raw);
        const weakReferenceOnly=hasWeakReferenceLanguage&&!hasExplicitArrivalLanguage;
        const pushCandidate=(value,
        strength,
        sourceType)=>{
          let candidateValue=String(value||"");
          if(String(sourceType||"")==="explicit_current_presence"){
            candidateValue=candidateValue.replace(/\s+while\s+(?:remembering|thinking\s+about|recalling|considering|mentioning)\b[\s\S]*$/i,
            "").replace(/\s+(?:remembering|thinking\s+about|recalling|visited\s+before|notable\s+locations?\s+include)\b[\s\S]*$/i,
            "").trim();
          }
          const picked=this.pickSceneLabel(candidateValue);
          if(!picked)return;
          candidates.push({
            label: picked,
            inferredType: this.inferSceneType(picked),
            strength: Math.max(1,
            Math.floor(Number(strength)||1)),
            sourceType: String(sourceType||"hint")
          });
        };
        const currentPresencePatterns=[/\byou\s+(?:remain|stay|wait|stand)\s+(?:inside|within|in|at|on)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.!?;,]+)/i,
        /\byou\s+are\s+still\s+(?:inside|within|in|at|on)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.!?;,]+)/i,
        /\bwhile\s+(?:staying|remaining)\s+(?:inside|within|in|at|on)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.!?;,]+)/i,
        /\bbut\s+you\s+(?:remain|stay)\s+(?:inside|within|in|at|on)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.!?;,]+)/i];
        for(let i=0; i<currentPresencePatterns.length; i+=1){
          const match=raw.match(currentPresencePatterns[i]);
          if(match&&match[1]){
            pushCandidate(match[1],
            3,
            "explicit_current_presence");
          }
        }
        const arrivalPatterns=[/\byou\s+(?:enter|step into|walk into|move into|head into|cross into|make your way into|arrive in|arrive at|return to|descend into|climb into|duck into|go inside|step inside|walk inside)\b/i,
        /\byou\s+(?:push through|push open|slip through)\b/i];
        for(let i=0; i<arrivalPatterns.length; i+=1){
          if(arrivalPatterns[i].test(raw)){
            pushCandidate(raw,
            3,
            "explicit_arrival");
          }
        }
        const mediumPatterns=[/\b(?:inside|within|beneath|under|along|on|at)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.!?;]+)/i,
        /\bthe\s+(tavern common room|inn common room|tavern barroom|inn barroom|tavern taproom|inn taproom|common room|barroom|taproom|storeroom|kitchen|workshop|smithy forge room|forge room|smithy|forge|loft|sleeping quarters|cellar|barrel room|guild hall|main hall|apothecary shop|shop interior|market lane|market square|square|lane|street|road|path|trail|courtyard|yard|bridge|gatehouse|gate|dock|pier|shore|beach|riverbank|river bank|tavern|inn|shop|temple|chapel|nave|camp|forest|woods|swamp|marsh|jungle|cave|cavern|ruins)\s+(?:is|lies|stretches|opens|remains|waits|stands|buzzes)\b/i,
        /\b(?:visible from|seen from|can be seen from)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.!?;]+)/i];
        for(let i=0; i<mediumPatterns.length; i+=1){
          const match=raw.match(mediumPatterns[i]);
          if(match&&match[1]){
            pushCandidate(match[1],
            2,
            "contextual_presence");
          }
        }
        if(!candidates.length&&!weakReferenceOnly&&/\b(tavern|inn|common room|cellar|smithy|forge|chapel|nave|guild hall|main hall|apothecary shop|shop interior|market lane|market square|bridge|gatehouse|dock|pier|forest|woods|swamp|marsh|jungle|cave|cavern|ruins)\b/i.test(raw)){
          pushCandidate(raw,
          1,
          "mention_only");
        }
        if(!candidates.length&&!weakReferenceOnly&&/\b(barrow\s+sanctum|sealed\s+sanctum|sanctum|chamber|crypt|shrine|tomb|catacombs?)\b/i.test(raw)){
          pushCandidate(raw,
          hasExplicitArrivalLanguage?3: 2,
          "dungeon_presence");
        }
        if(!candidates.length){
          return null;
        }
        candidates.sort((a,
        b)=>{
          if(b.strength!==a.strength)return b.strength-a.strength;
          return b.label.split(/\s+/).length-a.label.split(/\s+/).length;
        });
        return candidates[0];
      },
      applySceneCandidate(candidate,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        if(!candidate||typeof candidate!=="object"||!candidate.label){
          return 0;
        }
        const scene=root.world.currentScene;
        const turn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0;
        let changes=0;
        if(scene.sceneHintLabel!==candidate.label){
          scene.sceneHintLabel=candidate.label;
          changes+=1;
        }
        if(scene.sceneHintStrength!==candidate.strength){
          scene.sceneHintStrength=candidate.strength;
          changes+=1;
        }
        if(scene.sceneHintTurn!==turn){
          scene.sceneHintTurn=turn;
          changes+=1;
        }
        const currentLabel=this.cleanSceneCandidate(scene.displayName||"");
        const currentStable=currentLabel&&!this.isWeakSceneCandidate(currentLabel);
        const noConfirmedScene=!scene.sceneRef||!currentStable||Number(scene.sceneConfidence||0)<2;
        const sameAsCurrent=currentStable&&this.labelsCompatible(currentLabel,
        candidate.label);
        if(sameAsCurrent){
          const preferred=this.preferSceneLabel(currentLabel,
          candidate.label);
          if(preferred&&scene.displayName!==preferred){
            scene.displayName=preferred;
            changes+=1;
          }
          const nextConfidence=Math.max(Number(scene.sceneConfidence||0),
          candidate.strength);
          if(scene.sceneConfidence!==nextConfidence){
            scene.sceneConfidence=nextConfidence;
            changes+=1;
          }
          if((!scene.sceneType||scene.sceneType==="unknown")&&candidate.inferredType){
            scene.sceneType=candidate.inferredType;
            changes+=1;
          }
          if(scene.pendingSceneLabel||scene.pendingSceneStrength||scene.pendingSceneCount||scene.pendingSceneTurn){
            scene.pendingSceneLabel="";
            scene.pendingSceneStrength=0;
            scene.pendingSceneCount=0;
            scene.pendingSceneTurn=0;
            changes+=1;
          }
          return changes;
        }
        if(candidate.strength>=3||(candidate.strength>=2&&noConfirmedScene)){
          return changes+this.confirmSceneCandidate(candidate,
          root);
        }
        if(candidate.strength<2){
          return changes;
        }
        if(scene.pendingSceneLabel&&this.labelsCompatible(scene.pendingSceneLabel,
        candidate.label)){
          const preferredPending=this.preferSceneLabel(scene.pendingSceneLabel,
          candidate.label);
          const nextCount=Number(scene.pendingSceneCount||0)+1;
          const nextStrength=Math.max(Number(scene.pendingSceneStrength||0),
          candidate.strength);
          if(scene.pendingSceneLabel!==preferredPending){
            scene.pendingSceneLabel=preferredPending;
            changes+=1;
          }
          if(scene.pendingSceneCount!==nextCount){
            scene.pendingSceneCount=nextCount;
            changes+=1;
          }
          if(scene.pendingSceneStrength!==nextStrength){
            scene.pendingSceneStrength=nextStrength;
            changes+=1;
          }
          if(scene.pendingSceneTurn!==turn){
            scene.pendingSceneTurn=turn;
            changes+=1;
          }
        }
        else {
          scene.pendingSceneLabel=candidate.label;
          scene.pendingSceneStrength=candidate.strength;
          scene.pendingSceneCount=1;
          scene.pendingSceneTurn=turn;
          changes+=1;
        }
        if(scene.pendingSceneCount>=2&&scene.pendingSceneStrength>=2){
          changes+=this.confirmSceneCandidate({
            label: scene.pendingSceneLabel,
            inferredType: this.inferSceneType(scene.pendingSceneLabel),
            strength: scene.pendingSceneStrength,
            sourceType: "reinforced_presence"
          },
          root);
        }
        return changes;
      },
      confirmSceneCandidate(candidate,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const U=globalThis.AIDRPG.Utils;
        let label=this.cleanSceneCandidate(candidate&&candidate.label?candidate.label: "");
        if(!label)return 0;
        const scene=root.world.currentScene;
        const currentLabel=this.cleanSceneCandidate(scene.displayName||"");
        if(currentLabel&&this.labelsCompatible(currentLabel,
        label)){
          label=this.preferSceneLabel(currentLabel,
          label);
        }
        const key=U.toKey(label);
        if(!key)return 0;
        const nextSceneRef="scene_"+key;
        const inferredType=candidate&&candidate.inferredType?candidate.inferredType: this.inferSceneType(label);
        const strength=Math.max(1,
        Math.floor(Number(candidate&&candidate.strength?candidate.strength: 2)));
        const turn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0;
        let changed=0;
        if(scene.sceneRef!==nextSceneRef){
          scene.sceneRef=nextSceneRef;
          scene.displayName=label;
          scene.sceneType=inferredType;
          scene.entityRef="entity_"+key;
          scene.lastChangedTurn=turn;
          scene.sceneConfidence=strength;
          scene.localEntityIds=[];
          scene.localActorIds=[];
          scene.localHazards=[];
          scene.localExits=[];
          scene.conditionTags=[];
          scene.localEntitiesById={
          };
          scene.localActorsById={
          };
          changed=1;
          if(root.player&&typeof root.player==="object"){
            root.player.sceneRef=nextSceneRef;
          }
          if(U&&typeof U.invalidateSceneCache==="function"){
            U.invalidateSceneCache(root);
          }
        }
        else {
          if(scene.displayName!==label){
            scene.displayName=label;
            changed=1;
          }
          if(scene.sceneType!==inferredType){
            scene.sceneType=inferredType;
            changed=1;
          }
          const nextConfidence=Math.max(Number(scene.sceneConfidence||0),
          strength);
          if(scene.sceneConfidence!==nextConfidence){
            scene.sceneConfidence=nextConfidence;
            changed=1;
          }
        }
        if(scene.sceneHintLabel!==label){
          scene.sceneHintLabel=label;
          changed=1;
        }
        if(scene.sceneHintStrength!==strength){
          scene.sceneHintStrength=strength;
          changed=1;
        }
        if(scene.sceneHintTurn!==turn){
          scene.sceneHintTurn=turn;
          changed=1;
        }
        if(scene.pendingSceneLabel||scene.pendingSceneStrength||scene.pendingSceneCount||scene.pendingSceneTurn){
          scene.pendingSceneLabel="";
          scene.pendingSceneStrength=0;
          scene.pendingSceneCount=0;
          scene.pendingSceneTurn=0;
          changed=1;
        }
        return changed;
      },
      extractLocalExits(text){
        const out=[];
        const add=(value)=>{
          const v=String(value||"").trim();
          if(!v)return;
          if(out.indexOf(v)===-1)out.push(v);
        };
        const lower=String(text||"").toLowerCase();
        if(/\bdoor\b/.test(lower))add("door");
        if(/\bstairs?\b/.test(lower))add("stairs");
        if(/\bgate\b/.test(lower))add("gate");
        if(/\bhallway\b|\bcorridor\b/.test(lower))add("hallway");
        if(/\bpath\b|\broad\b|\btrail\b/.test(lower))add("path");
        if(/\bladder\b/.test(lower))add("ladder");
        if(/\bwindow\b/.test(lower))add("window");
        if(/\bbridge\b/.test(lower))add("bridge");
        if(/\btunnel\b/.test(lower))add("tunnel");
        if(/\bnorth\b/.test(lower))add("north");
        if(/\bsouth\b/.test(lower))add("south");
        if(/\beast\b/.test(lower))add("east");
        if(/\bwest\b/.test(lower))add("west");
        if(/\bupstairs\b|\bup\b/.test(lower))add("up");
        if(/\bdownstairs\b|\bdown\b/.test(lower))add("down");
        return out;
      },
