      extractLocalActors(text){
        const out=[];
        const raw=String(text||"");
        const lower=raw.toLowerCase();
        const identitySelf=/\b(?:you\s+are|i\s+am|my\s+name\s+is)\b/i.test(raw);
        const A=globalThis.AIDRPG||{};
        const Guard=A.ActorNameExtractionGuard;
        const add=(label)=>{
          let clean=Guard&&typeof Guard.cleanSceneActorLabel==="function"?Guard.cleanSceneActorLabel(label,state.aidrpg):String(label||"").trim();
          if(!clean)return;
          if(out.map(v=>v.toLowerCase()).indexOf(clean.toLowerCase())===-1)out.push(clean);
        };
        const namedRole=/\b(?:a|an|the)\s+([a-z][a-z' -]{2,30})\s+(?:named|called|known\s+as)\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}(?:\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30})?)\b/g;
        let m;
        const namedRoles=[];
        while((m=namedRole.exec(raw))){
          const role=String(m[1]||"").replace(/^(?:old|young|wounded|scarred|veteran|elite)\s+/i,"").trim().toLowerCase();
          const name=Guard&&typeof Guard.cleanPersonName==="function"?Guard.cleanPersonName(m[2],state.aidrpg,"scene_named_actor"):String(m[2]||"").trim();
          if(name){add(name); if(role)namedRoles.push(role);}
        }
        const titled=/\b(High\s+Priestess|High\s+Priest|Archdruid|Archmage|Master|Queen|King|Sergeant|General|Commander|Chancellor|Baroness|Baron|Duchess|Duke|Elder|Oracle|Captain|Guildmaster|Guild\s+Master|Lord|Lady|Sir|Dame|Priestess|Priest|Mage|Wizard|Hunter|Barkeep|Innkeeper|Blacksmith|Smith)\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30})(?:\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}))?\b/g;
        while((m=titled.exec(raw))){
          const name=Guard&&typeof Guard.cleanPersonName==="function"?Guard.cleanPersonName([m[1],m[2],m[3]].filter(Boolean).join(" "),state.aidrpg,"scene_titled_actor"):"";
          if(name)add(name);
        }
        const actorTerms=["guard","merchant","innkeeper","bartender","barkeep","adventurer","soldier","bandit","goblin","wolf","patron","priest","noble","traveler","mage","knight","child","woman","man","beast","dragon","drake","wyvern"];
        for(let i=0;i<actorTerms.length;i+=1){
          if(identitySelf)break;
          const term=actorTerms[i];
          if(namedRoles.indexOf(term)!==-1)continue;
          const re=new RegExp("\\b(?:a|an|the|some)\\s+(?:[a-z]+\\s+){0,3}"+term+"s?\\b","i");
          if(re.test(lower)&&out.map(v=>v.toLowerCase()).indexOf(term)===-1){add(term);}
        }
        const specialActorRe=/\b(?:a|an|the|some)\s+((?:ancient|elder|primordial|legendary|mythic|divine|city|village|elite|veteran)\s+)?(dragon|drake|wyvern|guard|knight|mage)\b/gi;
        while(!identitySelf&&(m=specialActorRe.exec(raw))){
          const role=String(m[2]||"").toLowerCase();
          if(namedRoles.indexOf(role)!==-1)continue;
          const label=String((m[1]||"")+(m[2]||"")).replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
          if(label)add(label);
        }
        const removeIfSpecific=(generic,specific)=>{const gi=out.indexOf(generic); if(gi!==-1&&out.indexOf(specific)!==-1)out.splice(gi,1);};
        removeIfSpecific("guard","city guard"); removeIfSpecific("guard","village guard"); removeIfSpecific("dragon","ancient dragon"); removeIfSpecific("dragon","mythic dragon"); removeIfSpecific("dragon","legendary dragon"); removeIfSpecific("drake","ancient drake"); removeIfSpecific("wyvern","ancient wyvern"); removeIfSpecific("mage","elite mage"); removeIfSpecific("mage","veteran mage"); removeIfSpecific("mage","mythic mage"); removeIfSpecific("knight","elite knight"); removeIfSpecific("knight","veteran knight");
        return out.slice(0,8);
      },
      extractLocalEntities(text){
        const out=[];

        "table",

      syncLabeledRefs(mapObj,
      idArray,
      labels,
      prefix){
        if(!mapObj||typeof mapObj!=="object"||Array.isArray(mapObj))return 0;
        if(!Array.isArray(idArray))return 0;
        if(!Array.isArray(labels))labels=[];
        const U=globalThis.AIDRPG.Utils;
        const nextMap={
        };
        const nextIds=[];
        for(let i=0; i<labels.length&&i<8; i+=1){
          const label=this.cleanPhrase(labels[i]);
          if(!label)continue;
          const key=U.toKey(label);
          if(!key)continue;
          const ref=String(prefix||"local")+"_"+key;
          nextMap[ref]=label;
          nextIds.push(ref);
        }
        let changed=0;
        if(idArray.length!==nextIds.length){
          changed=1;
        }
        else {
          for(let i=0; i<idArray.length; i+=1){
            if(idArray[i]!==nextIds[i]){
              changed=1;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        if(!changed){
          const oldKeys=Object.keys(mapObj);
          const newKeys=Object.keys(nextMap);
          if(oldKeys.length!==newKeys.length){
            changed=1;
          }
          else {
            for(let i=0; i<newKeys.length; i+=1){
              const key=newKeys[i];
              if(mapObj[key]!==nextMap[key]){
                changed=1;
                break;
              }
            }
          }
        }
        if(!changed)return 0;
        idArray.length=0;
        for(let i=0; i<nextIds.length; i+=1){
          idArray.push(nextIds[i]);
        }
        for(const key in mapObj){
          if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(mapObj,
          key)){
            delete mapObj[key];
          }
        }
        for(const key in nextMap){
          if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(nextMap,
          key)){
            mapObj[key]=nextMap[key];
          }
        }
        return 1;
      },
      replaceSimpleArray(targetArray,
      nextValues,
      maxCount){
        if(!Array.isArray(targetArray))return 0;
        if(!Array.isArray(nextValues))nextValues=[];
        const cleaned=[];
        for(let i=0; i<nextValues.length&&i<(maxCount||8); i+=1){
          const value=String(nextValues[i]||"").trim();
          if(!value)continue;
          if(cleaned.indexOf(value)===-1)cleaned.push(value);
        }
        let changed=0;
        if(targetArray.length!==cleaned.length){
          changed=1;
        }
        else {
          for(let i=0; i<targetArray.length; i+=1){
            if(targetArray[i]!==cleaned[i]){
              changed=1;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        if(!changed)return 0;
        targetArray.length=0;
        for(let i=0; i<cleaned.length; i+=1){
          targetArray.push(cleaned[i]);
        }
        return 1;
      },
      inferSceneType(label){
        const lower=String(label||"").toLowerCase();
        if(/\b(barrow\s+sanctum|sealed\s+sanctum|sanctum|chamber|crypt|shrine|tomb|catacombs?)\b/.test(lower)){
          return"room";
        }
        if(/\b(common room|barroom|taproom|storeroom|kitchen|loft|sleeping quarters|cellar|room|hall|chamber)\b/.test(lower)){
          return"room";
        }
        if(/\b(tavern|inn|shop|temple|guildhall|house|building|library|warehouse|granary|smithy|forge|workshop|bar)\b/.test(lower)){
          return"interior";
        }
        if(/\b(market square|square|lane|street|road|path|trail|forest|field|bridge|gate|gatehouse|courtyard|yard|camp|dock|pier|shore|beach|riverbank|river bank|boat|ship deck|deck)\b/.test(lower)){
          return"outdoor";
        }
        return"scene";
      },
      cleanSceneCandidate(value){
        return String(value||"").replace(/\s+/g,
        " ").replace(/^(?:the|an|a)\s+/i,
        "").replace(/\s*,\s*(?:catching|taking|trying|struggling|still|while|as)\b.*$/i,
        "").replace(/\s+(?:where|when|while|and then|but then)\s+.*$/i,
        "").replace(/[.,;:!?]+$/g,
        "").trim();
      },
      isWeakSceneCandidate(value){
        const lower=String(value||"").trim().toLowerCase();
        if(!lower)return true;
        if(lower.length>48)return true;
        if(/\b(catching your breath|looking around|trying to|beginning to|continuing to|still)\b/.test(lower))return true;
        if(/^(there|here|somewhere|nearby|around you)$/.test(lower))return true;
        return false;
      },
      cleanPhrase(value){
        return String(value||"").replace(/\s+/g,
        " ").replace(/^(?:the|an|a)\s+/i,
        "").replace(/\s+(?:where|when|while|and|but)\s+.*$/i,
        "").replace(/[.,;:!?]+$/g,
        "").trim();
      },
      refreshCache(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return"";

        if(globalThis.AIDRPG&&globalThis.AIDRPG.TurnEngine&&typeof globalThis.AIDRPG.TurnEngine.stableHash==="function"){
          root.cache.lastSceneHash=globalThis.AIDRPG.TurnEngine.stableHash(summary);

      },
      getCompactSummary(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object"||!root.world||!root.world.currentScene){
          return"Scene unknown.";
        }
        const scene=root.world.currentScene;
        const parts=[];
        if(scene.displayName){
          parts.push("Scene: "+scene.displayName);
        }
        else {
          parts.push("Scene: unknown");
        }
        if(scene.sceneType){
          parts.push("Type: "+scene.sceneType);
        }
        if(Array.isArray(scene.conditionTags)&&scene.conditionTags.length){
          parts.push("State: "+scene.conditionTags.join(", "));
        }
        if(Array.isArray(scene.localHazards)&&scene.localHazards.length){
          parts.push("Hazards: "+scene.localHazards.join(", "));
        }
        if(Array.isArray(scene.localExits)&&scene.localExits.length){
          parts.push("Exits: "+scene.localExits.join(", "));
        }
        if(scene.localActorIds&&scene.localActorIds.length&&scene.localActorsById){
          const names=[];
          for(let i=0; i<scene.localActorIds.length; i+=1){
            const ref=scene.localActorIds[i];
            if(scene.localActorsById[ref]){
              names.push(scene.localActorsById[ref]);
            }
          }
          if(names.length){
            parts.push("Actors: "+names.join(", "));
          }
        }
        if(scene.localEntityIds&&scene.localEntityIds.length&&scene.localEntitiesById){
          const names=[];
          for(let i=0; i<scene.localEntityIds.length; i+=1){
            const ref=scene.localEntityIds[i];
            if(scene.localEntitiesById[ref]){
              names.push(scene.localEntitiesById[ref]);
            }
          }
          if(names.length){
            parts.push("Objects: "+names.join(", "));
          }
        }
        return parts.join(" | ");
      }
    },

      processOutput(rawText,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const A=globalThis.AIDRPG;
        const U=A.Utils;
        const text=U&&typeof U.normalizeSpaces==="function"?U.normalizeSpaces(String(rawText||"")): String(rawText||"").trim();
        if(!text)return 0;
        if(A.TurnEngine&&typeof A.TurnEngine.isDuplicateCurrentOutput==="function"){
          if(A.TurnEngine.isDuplicateCurrentOutput()){
            return 0;
          }
        }
        let changes=0;
        changes+=this.syncCurrentSceneToWorld(root);
        const locationPhrase=this.extractLocationPhrase(text);
        if(locationPhrase){
          changes+=this.applyLocationPhrase(locationPhrase,
          root);
        }
        const ownerHints=this.extractOwnerHints(text);
        const materialHints=this.extractMaterialHints(text);
        const districtHints=this.extractDistrictHints(text);
        const factionHints=this.extractFactionHints(text);
        changes+=this.applyHintsToCurrentScene(ownerHints,
        materialHints,
        districtHints,
        factionHints,
        root);
        changes+=this.processMapContinuity(text,
        root);
        changes+=this.applyValidatedConsequences(root);

          root);

            const start=labelSpans[spanPos].start;
            const next=spanPos+1<labelSpans.length?labelSpans[spanPos+1].start: -1;
            segment=raw.slice(start,
            next>start?next: Math.min(raw.length,
            start+190));

            if(isRoomAssignment){
              if(!rec.roomAssignment){
                rec.roomAssignment=fact;
                changes+=1;

                root);
              }
              else if(rec.roomAssignment!==fact&&!this.hasValidatedMapChange(rawText)){
                changes+=this.pushMapEvent("Map contradiction: "+rec.displayName+" room placement preserved as "+rec.roomAssignment+".",
                root);
                continue;
              }
              else if(rec.roomAssignment!==fact){
                rec.roomAssignment=fact;
                changes+=1;
              }
              if(loc&&loc.mutable&&!loc.mutable.roomAssignment)loc.mutable.roomAssignment=rec.roomAssignment;
            }
            else if(rec.layoutFacts.indexOf(fact)===-1){
              rec.layoutFacts.push(fact);
              while(rec.layoutFacts.length>12)rec.layoutFacts.shift();
              changes+=1;
              this.pushMapEvent("Map memory: "+rec.displayName+" has "+fact+".",
              root);

              loc.mutable.layoutFacts.push(fact);

            }
          }

        for(let p=0; p<patterns.length; p+=1){
          let match;
          while((match=patterns[p].exec(raw))){
            const maybeActor=match[1]&&!/^The\s+/i.test(match[1])&&!/^Old\s+Barrow$/i.test(match[1])?this.cleanPhrase(match[1]): "";
            const rawPlace=String(match[2]||match[1]||"").replace(/[.,;:!?]+$/g,
            "").replace(/\s+/g,
            " ").trim();
            const place=/^The\s+[A-Z]/.test(rawPlace)?rawPlace: this.cleanPhrase(rawPlace);
            if(!place)continue;
            const goalLabel=maybeActor?("meet/pay "+maybeActor): this.cleanPhrase(match[0]).slice(0,
            80);
            const id="goal_location_"+this.makeKeyFromLabel(goalLabel+"_"+place);
            if(seen[id])continue;
            seen[id]=true;
            if(!map.goalBindingsById[id]){
              map.goalBindingsById[id]={
                id,
                goal: goalLabel,
                locationName: place,
                locationRef: "location_"+this.makeKeyFromLabel(place),
                firstSeenTurn: root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0
              };
              changes+=1;
              this.pushMapEvent("Goal location: "+goalLabel+" at "+place+".",
              root);
            }
            const loc=/^The\s+/.test(place)?this.ensureNamedLocationRecord(place,
            root): null;
            if(loc&&loc.goalRefs.indexOf(id)===-1)loc.goalRefs.push(id);
          }
        }
        return changes;
      },
      detectMapContradictions(rawText,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        const raw=String(rawText||"");
        const map=this.getMapMemory(root);
        if(!map)return 0;
        let changes=0;
        const layouts=map.dungeonLayoutsById||{
        };
        const dungeonIds=Object.keys(layouts);
        for(let i=0; i<dungeonIds.length; i+=1){
          const layout=layouts[dungeonIds[i]];
          if(!layout||!Array.isArray(layout.rooms)||layout.rooms.length<3)continue;
          if(/\b(?:crystal observatory|flooded chapel|fourth chamber|new chamber|extra chamber|different armory)\b/i.test(raw)&&!this.hasValidatedMapChange(raw)){
            const note="Map contradiction: unvalidated dungeon layout change rejected for "+layout.displayName+".";
            if(layout.contradictionNotes.indexOf(note)===-1)layout.contradictionNotes.push(note);
            changes+=this.pushMapEvent(note,
            root);
          }
        }
        const namedIds=Object.keys(map.namedLocationsById||{
        });
        for(let i=0; i<namedIds.length; i+=1){
          const rec=map.namedLocationsById[namedIds[i]];
          if(!rec||!rec.roomAssignment)continue;
          if(new RegExp("\\b"+this.escapeRegExp(rec.displayName)+"\\b",
          "i").test(raw)||/\byour\s+(?:rented\s+)?room\b/i.test(raw)){
            if(/\b(?:basement|attic|third floor|back hall|different wing)\b/i.test(raw)&&!this.hasValidatedMapChange(raw))changes+=this.pushMapEvent("Map contradiction: "+rec.displayName+" room remains "+rec.roomAssignment+".",
            root);
            if(/\bbar\s+(?:is\s+)?(?:now\s+)?on\s+the\s+west\s+wall\b/i.test(raw)&&rec.layoutFacts.indexOf("east-wall bar")!==-1&&!this.hasValidatedMapChange(raw))changes+=this.pushMapEvent("Map contradiction: "+rec.displayName+" bar remains east-wall.",
            root);
          }
        }
        return changes;
      },
      escapeRegExp(value){
        return String(value||"").replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,
        "\\$&");
      },
      getMapContextSummary(root=state.aidrpg,
      mode="normal"){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return"";
        this.init(root);
        const map=root.world&&root.world.mapMemory?root.world.mapMemory: null;
        if(!map)return"";
        const parts=[];
        const currentDungeon=map.currentDungeonId&&map.dungeonLayoutsById?map.dungeonLayoutsById[map.currentDungeonId]: null;
        if(currentDungeon&&Array.isArray(currentDungeon.path)&&currentDungeon.path.length){
          const path=currentDungeon.path.slice(0,
          mode==="tiny"?3: 6);
          const rev=path.slice().reverse();
          let dungeonText="Dungeon "+currentDungeon.displayName+": "+path.join(" > ");
          if(path.length>1)dungeonText+=" | backtrack "+rev.join(" > ");
          if(currentDungeon.roomDetailsByRoom&&typeof currentDungeon.roomDetailsByRoom==="object"){
            const detailBits=[];
            const rooms=Object.keys(currentDungeon.roomDetailsByRoom);
            for(let i=0; i<rooms.length&&detailBits.length<4; i+=1){
              const list=currentDungeon.roomDetailsByRoom[rooms[i]];
              if(Array.isArray(list)&&list.length)detailBits.push(rooms[i]+" has "+list.slice(-6).join(", "));
            }
            if(detailBits.length)dungeonText+=" | "+detailBits.join("; ");
          }
          parts.push(dungeonText);
        }
        const namedIds=Object.keys(map.namedLocationsById||{
        }).sort((a,
        b)=>Number((map.namedLocationsById[b]||{
        }).lastSeenTurn||0)-Number((map.namedLocationsById[a]||{
        }).lastSeenTurn||0));
        for(let i=0; i<namedIds.length&&parts.length<(mode==="wide"?6: 4); i+=1){
          const rec=map.namedLocationsById[namedIds[i]];
          if(!rec)continue;
          const facts=[];
          if(Array.isArray(rec.layoutFacts)&&rec.layoutFacts.length)facts.push(rec.layoutFacts.slice(-4).join(", "));
          if(rec.roomAssignment)facts.push(rec.roomAssignment);
          if(Array.isArray(rec.goalRefs)&&rec.goalRefs.length)facts.push("goals "+rec.goalRefs.length);
          if(facts.length)parts.push(rec.displayName+": "+facts.join("; "));
        }
        const goalIds=Object.keys(map.goalBindingsById||{
        }).sort((a,
        b)=>Number((map.goalBindingsById[b]||{
        }).firstSeenTurn||0)-Number((map.goalBindingsById[a]||{
        }).firstSeenTurn||0));
        if(goalIds.length){
          const goals=[];
          for(let i=0; i<goalIds.length&&goals.length<(mode==="tiny"?1: 3); i+=1){
            const row=map.goalBindingsById[goalIds[i]]||{
            };
            if(row.goal&&row.locationName)goals.push(row.goal+" at "+row.locationName+(row.locationRef?" ["+row.locationRef+"]": ""));
          }
          if(goals.length)parts.push("Goal places: "+goals.join("; "));
        }
        const enc=root.world&&root.world.activeEncounter?root.world.activeEncounter: null;
        if(enc&&enc.enemyLabel&&Number(enc.remainingCount||0)>0&&enc.resolved!==true){
          parts.push("Encounter: "+enc.totalCount+" "+enc.enemyLabel+" | "+enc.remainingCount+" remain");
        }
        if(Array.isArray(map.recentMapEvents)&&map.recentMapEvents.length){
          const recent=[];
          const turn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0;
          for(let i=map.recentMapEvents.length-1; i>=0&&recent.length<(mode==="wide"?4: 3); i-=1){
            const row=map.recentMapEvents[i]||{
            };
            const rowTurn=typeof row.turn==="number"?row.turn: turn;
            if(turn-rowTurn>16)continue;
            const msg=String(row.message||"").replace(/^Map memory:\s*/i,
            "").replace(/\s+/g,
            " ").trim();
            if(msg)recent.push(msg.slice(0,
            120));
          }
          if(recent.length)parts.push("Map note: "+recent.join(" | "));
        }
        return parts.length?"Map: "+parts.join(" | "): "";
      },
      applyValidatedConsequences(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const U=globalThis.AIDRPG.Utils;
        const pending=root.pending||{
        };
        const validated=Array.isArray(pending.validatedConsequences)?pending.validatedConsequences: [];
        const world=root.world||{
        };
        const scene=world.currentScene||{
        };
        const turn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0;
        let changes=0;
        const dirtyWorldIds=[];
        const dirtyRouteIds=[];
        const markWorldDirty=(id)=>{
          const clean=String(id||"").trim();
          if(!clean)return;
          if(dirtyWorldIds.indexOf(clean)===-1)dirtyWorldIds.push(clean);
        };
        const markRouteDirty=(id)=>{
          const clean=String(id||"").trim();
          if(!clean)return;
          if(dirtyRouteIds.indexOf(clean)===-1)dirtyRouteIds.push(clean);
        };
        const ensureSceneShape=()=>{
          if(!Array.isArray(scene.localHazards))scene.localHazards=[];
          if(!Array.isArray(scene.localEntityIds))scene.localEntityIds=[];
          if(!scene.localEntitiesById||typeof scene.localEntitiesById!=="object"||Array.isArray(scene.localEntitiesById)){
            scene.localEntitiesById={
            };
          }
        };
        const pushSceneHazard=(tag)=>{
          ensureSceneShape();
          const clean=this.cleanPhrase(tag);
          if(!clean)return 0;
          if(scene.localHazards.indexOf(clean)!==-1)return 0;
          scene.localHazards.push(clean);
          return 1;
        };
        const pushSceneLocalEntity=(label)=>{
          ensureSceneShape();
          const clean=this.cleanPhrase(label);
          if(!clean)return 0;
          for(let i=0; i<scene.localEntityIds.length; i+=1){
            const ref=scene.localEntityIds[i];
            if(scene.localEntitiesById[ref]===clean){
              return 0;
            }
          }
          const ref="local_entity_"+this.makeKeyFromLabel(clean);
          scene.localEntitiesById[ref]=clean;
          scene.localEntityIds.push(ref);
          return 1;
        };
        const currentLocationRef=typeof scene.parentLocationRef==="string"&&scene.parentLocationRef?scene.parentLocationRef: (root.player&&typeof root.player.locationRef==="string"?root.player.locationRef: "");
        const currentLocationLabel=this.cleanPhrase(scene.displayName||currentLocationRef||"");
        const ensureCurrentLocation=()=>{
          if(!currentLocationRef)return null;
          const record=this.ensureLocationRecord(currentLocationRef,
          currentLocationLabel||currentLocationRef,
          root);
          markWorldDirty(record.identity&&record.identity.id?record.identity.id: currentLocationRef);
          return record;
        };
        const ensureCurrentEntity=()=>{
          if(!scene.entityRef&&!scene.displayName)return null;
          const record=this.ensureEntityRecord(scene.entityRef||("entity_"+this.makeKeyFromLabel(scene.displayName||"scene")),
          scene.displayName||"scene",
          scene.sceneType||"scene",
          root);
          if(record&&record.identity&&record.identity.id){
            markWorldDirty(record.identity.id);
          }
          return record;
        };
        const ensureTargetEntity=(label)=>{
          const clean=this.cleanPhrase(label);
          if(!clean)return null;
          const currentEntity=ensureCurrentEntity();
          const currentName=currentEntity&&currentEntity.identity?this.cleanPhrase(currentEntity.identity.displayName||""): "";
          if(currentEntity&&currentName&&(clean===currentName||currentName.indexOf(clean)!==-1||clean.indexOf(currentName)!==-1)){
            return currentEntity;
          }
          const record=this.ensureEntityRecord("entity_"+this.makeKeyFromLabel(clean),
          clean,
          "world_object",
          root);
          if(scene.sceneRef&&record.links.sceneRef!==scene.sceneRef){
            record.links.sceneRef=scene.sceneRef;
            changes+=1;
          }
          if(currentLocationRef&&record.links.parentLocationRef!==currentLocationRef){
            record.links.parentLocationRef=currentLocationRef;
            changes+=1;
            const locationRecord=ensureCurrentLocation();
            if(locationRecord&&this.pushUnique(locationRecord.mutable.linkedEntityIds,
            record.identity.id)){
              changes+=1;
            }
          }
          if(record&&record.identity&&record.identity.id){
            markWorldDirty(record.identity.id);
          }
          return record;
        };
        for(let i=0; i<validated.length; i+=1){
          const candidate=validated[i];
          if(!candidate||candidate.category!=="world"||candidate._worldApplied===true){
            continue;
          }
          const payload=candidate.payload||{
          };
          if(candidate.type==="world_change"){
            const targetLabel=this.cleanPhrase(payload.targetLabel||"");
            const changeTag=this.cleanPhrase(payload.changeTag||"general_damage")||"general_damage";
            const targetRecord=ensureTargetEntity(targetLabel||scene.displayName||"scene");
            if(targetRecord&&targetRecord.mutable){
              if(this.pushUnique(targetRecord.mutable.conditionTags,
              changeTag)){
                changes+=1;
              }
              if(/(damage|burn|broken|collapse|blocked|crater)/i.test(changeTag)){
                if(this.pushUnique(targetRecord.mutable.hazardTags,
                changeTag)){
                  changes+=1;
                }
              }
              if(targetRecord.mutable.lastConfirmedTurn!==turn){
                targetRecord.mutable.lastConfirmedTurn=turn;
                changes+=1;
              }
            }
            const currentSceneName=this.cleanPhrase(scene.displayName||"");
            if(!targetLabel||(currentSceneName&&targetLabel===currentSceneName)){
              const locationRecord=ensureCurrentLocation();
              if(locationRecord&&this.pushUnique(locationRecord.mutable.conditionTags,
              changeTag)){
                changes+=1;
              }
            }
            if(targetLabel){
              changes+=pushSceneLocalEntity(targetLabel);
            }
            changes+=pushSceneHazard(changeTag);
          }
          else if(candidate.type==="route_issue"){
            const issue=this.cleanPhrase(payload.issue||"blocked")||"blocked";
            const issueTag="route_"+this.makeKeyFromLabel(issue);
            const locationRecord=ensureCurrentLocation();
            if(locationRecord){
              if(this.pushUnique(locationRecord.mutable.conditionTags,
              issueTag)){
                changes+=1;
              }
              if(locationRecord.mutable.lastConfirmedTurn!==turn){
                locationRecord.mutable.lastConfirmedTurn=turn;
                changes+=1;
              }
            }
            const currentEntity=ensureCurrentEntity();
            const currentName=currentEntity&&currentEntity.identity?String(currentEntity.identity.displayName||scene.displayName||""): String(scene.displayName||"");
            if(currentEntity&&/\b(road|trail|path|bridge|gate|gatehouse|dock|pier)\b/i.test(currentName)){
              if(this.pushUnique(currentEntity.mutable.hazardTags,
              issueTag)){
                changes+=1;
              }
              if(currentEntity.mutable.lastConfirmedTurn!==turn){
                currentEntity.mutable.lastConfirmedTurn=turn;
                changes+=1;
              }
            }
            const routeIds=Object.keys(world.routesById||{
            });
            for(let r=0; r<routeIds.length; r+=1){
              const routeId=routeIds[r];
              const route=world.routesById[routeId];
              if(!route||!route.mutable)continue;
              if(route.mutable.fromRef===currentLocationRef||route.mutable.toRef===currentLocationRef){
                if(!Array.isArray(route.mutable.hazardTags)){
                  route.mutable.hazardTags=[];
                }
                if(this.pushUnique(route.mutable.hazardTags,
                issueTag)){
                  changes+=1;
                }
                if(route.mutable.lastConfirmedTurn!==turn){
                  route.mutable.lastConfirmedTurn=turn;
                  changes+=1;
                }
                markRouteDirty(routeId);
              }
            }
            changes+=pushSceneHazard(issueTag);
          }
          candidate._worldApplied=true;
        }
        if(changes>0){
          if(U&&typeof U.markDirty==="function"){
            for(let i=0; i<dirtyWorldIds.length; i+=1){
              U.markDirty("entities",
              dirtyWorldIds[i],
              root);
            }
            for(let i=0; i<dirtyRouteIds.length; i+=1){
              U.markDirty("routes",
              dirtyRouteIds[i],
              root);
            }
          }
          if(U&&typeof U.invalidatePackets==="function"){
            U.invalidatePackets(root);
          }
          if(U&&typeof U.logEvent==="function"){
            U.logEvent("Validated world consequences applied.");
          }
        }
        return changes;
      },
      syncCurrentSceneToWorld(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const scene=root.world.currentScene||{
        };
        const player=root.player||{
        };
        const world=root.world||{
        };
        const turn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0;
        const sceneConfidence=Math.max(0,
        Math.floor(Number(scene.sceneConfidence||0)));
        const inferBroadLocationLabel=(label)=>{
          const lower=String(label||"").trim().toLowerCase();
          if(!lower)return"";
          const broadTerms=["forest",
          "woods",
          "swamp",
          "marsh",
          "jungle",
          "cave",

          "river",
          "stream",
          "creek",
          "lake",
          "pond",
          "road",
          "path",
          "trail",
          "camp"];
          for(let i=0; i<broadTerms.length; i+=1){
            if(lower===broadTerms[i]){
              return broadTerms[i];
            }
          }
          return"";
        };
        let changes=0;
        let locationRecord=null;
        const playerLocationRef=typeof player.locationRef==="string"?player.locationRef: "";
        const sceneParentRef=typeof scene.parentLocationRef==="string"?scene.parentLocationRef: "";
        const invalidSceneStyleRef=(value)=>{
          return!value||value.indexOf("scene_")===0;
        };

        }
        if(scene.parentLocationRef){

          const displayName=existingLocation&&existingLocation.identity?existingLocation.identity.displayName: (broadSceneLabel||scene.parentLocationRef);

            scene.parentLocationRef=locationRecord.identity.id;
            changes+=1;
          }
        }
        if(locationRecord&&player.locationRef!==locationRecord.identity.id){
          player.locationRef=locationRecord.identity.id;
          changes+=1;
        }
        else if(!locationRecord&&invalidSceneStyleRef(playerLocationRef)&&broadSceneLabel){
          player.locationRef="location_"+this.makeKeyFromLabel(broadSceneLabel);
          changes+=1;
        }

        const entityName=scene.displayName||scene.sceneRef||"";
        if(entityRef||entityName){
          const entityRecord=this.ensureEntityRecord(entityRef||("entity_"+this.makeKeyFromLabel(entityName||"scene")),
          entityName||"scene",
          scene.sceneType||"scene",
          root);
          if(entityRecord.links.sceneRef!==(scene.sceneRef||"")){
            entityRecord.links.sceneRef=scene.sceneRef||"";
            changes+=1;
          }
          if(locationRecord&&entityRecord.links.parentLocationRef!==locationRecord.identity.id){
            entityRecord.links.parentLocationRef=locationRecord.identity.id;
            changes+=1;
          }
          entityRecord.mutable.lastConfirmedTurn=turn;
          changes+=this.replaceSimpleArray(entityRecord.mutable.conditionTags,
          scene.conditionTags||[],
          8);
          changes+=this.replaceSimpleArray(entityRecord.mutable.hazardTags,
          scene.localHazards||[],
          8);
          changes+=this.replaceSimpleArray(entityRecord.mutable.exitHints,

            entityRecord.identity.id)){
              changes+=1;
            }
            locationRecord.mutable.lastConfirmedTurn=turn;
          }
        }
        return changes;
      },
      ensureLocationRecord(locationRef,
      displayName,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        this.init(root);
        const world=root.world;

            }

      },
      ensureEntityRecord(entityRef,
      displayName,
      entityType,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        this.init(root);
        const world=root.world;
        const turn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0;
        const id=String(entityRef||"").trim()||("entity_"+this.makeKeyFromLabel(displayName||"entity"));

              objectHints: [],
              lastConfirmedTurn: turn
            },

            }

        }

          };
        }

        }
        if(typeof record.identity.kind!=="string"||!record.identity.kind){

        }

      ensureFactionRecord(factionName,

      applyLocationPhrase(locationPhrase,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;

        };

        };

        Math.floor(Number(scene.sceneConfidence||0)));

        "woods",
        "swamp",
        "marsh",
        "jungle",

        "coast",
        "shore",

        "road",
        "path",

          scene.displayName||scene.entityRef,

          root);

            entityRecord.links.parentLocationRef=locationRecord.identity.id;
            changes+=1;
          }
          if(this.pushUnique(locationRecord.mutable.linkedEntityIds,
          entityRecord.identity.id)){
            changes+=1;
          }
        }
        return changes;
      },
      applyHintsToCurrentScene(ownerHints,
      materialHints,
      districtHints,
      factionHints,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const scene=root.world.currentScene||{
        };

            4);

            changes+=this.replaceSimpleArray(locationRecord.mutable.materialHints,
            materialHints,

      extractLocationPhrase(text){
        const raw=String(text||"");
        const patterns=[/\b(?:town|village|city|district|region|forest|swamp|marsh|ruins|cavern|cave|kingdom)\s+of\s+([^.!?;,]+)/i,
        /\bin\s+(?:the\s+)?([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{2,40})(?:[.,;!?]|$)/,
        /\bat\s+(?:the\s+)?([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{2,40})(?:[.,;!?]|$)/,
        /\b(?:in|within|inside|through|across|along|near|beside|by)\s+(?:the\s+)?(forest|woods|swamp|marsh|jungle|cavern|cave|ruins|riverlands|coast|shore|mountains|hills|valley|plains|meadow)\b/i];
        for(let i=0; i<patterns.length; i+=1){
          const match=raw.match(patterns[i]);
          if(match&&match[1]){
            const cleaned=this.cleanPhrase(match[1]);
            if(cleaned)return cleaned;
          }
        }
        return"";
      },
      extractOwnerHints(text){
        const out=[];
        const patterns=[/\bowned by\s+([^.!?;,]+)/gi,
        /\brun by\s+([^.!?;,]+)/gi,
        /\bkept by\s+([^.!?;,]+)/gi,
        /\bmaintained by\s+([^.!?;,]+)/gi];
        for(let i=0; i<patterns.length; i+=1){
          let match;
          while((match=patterns[i].exec(String(text||"")))){
            const clean=this.cleanPhrase(match[1]);
            if(clean&&out.indexOf(clean)===-1){
              out.push(clean);
            }
          }
        }
        return out;
      },
      extractMaterialHints(text){
        const lower=String(text||"").toLowerCase();
        const known=["stone",
        "wood",
        "wooden",
        "brick",
        "iron",
        "steel",
        "cloth",
        "leather",
        "crystal",
        "bone"];
        const out=[];
        for(let i=0; i<known.length; i+=1){
          if(lower.indexOf(known[i])!==-1&&out.indexOf(known[i])===-1){
            out.push(known[i]);
          }
        }
        return out;
      },
      extractDistrictHints(text){
        const lower=String(text||"").toLowerCase();
        const out=[];
        if(/\bnorth side\b|\bnorthern district\b/.test(lower))out.push("north");
        if(/\bsouth side\b|\bsouthern district\b/.test(lower))out.push("south");
        if(/\beast side\b|\beastern district\b/.test(lower))out.push("east");
        if(/\bwest side\b|\bwestern district\b/.test(lower))out.push("west");
        if(/\bmarket district\b/.test(lower))out.push("market");
        if(/\bouter district\b/.test(lower))out.push("outer");
        if(/\binner district\b/.test(lower))out.push("inner");
        return out;
      },
      extractFactionHints(text){
        const out=[];
        const pattern=/\b([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,40}\s(?:Guild|Company|Consortium|Clans|Circle|Hand|Synod|Dominion|Ascendancy|Order|Council))\b/g;
        let match;
        while((match=pattern.exec(String(text||"")))){
          const clean=this.cleanPhrase(match[1]);
          if(clean&&out.indexOf(clean)===-1){
            out.push(clean);
          }
        }
        return out;
      },
      labelsFromRefMap(idArray,
      mapObj){
        const out=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(idArray)||!mapObj||typeof mapObj!=="object")return out;
        for(let i=0; i<idArray.length; i+=1){
          const ref=idArray[i];
          if(mapObj[ref]){
            const clean=this.cleanPhrase(mapObj[ref]);
            if(clean&&out.indexOf(clean)===-1){
              out.push(clean);
            }
          }
        }
        return out;
      },
      replaceSimpleArray(targetArray,
      nextValues,
      maxCount){
        if(!Array.isArray(targetArray))return 0;
        if(!Array.isArray(nextValues))nextValues=[];
        const cleaned=[];
        for(let i=0; i<nextValues.length&&i<(maxCount||8); i+=1){
          const value=this.cleanPhrase(nextValues[i]);
          if(!value)continue;
          if(cleaned.indexOf(value)===-1)cleaned.push(value);
        }
        let changed=0;
        if(targetArray.length!==cleaned.length){
          changed=1;
        }
        else {
          for(let i=0; i<targetArray.length; i+=1){
            if(targetArray[i]!==cleaned[i]){
              changed=1;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        if(!changed)return 0;
        targetArray.length=0;
        for(let i=0; i<cleaned.length; i+=1){
          targetArray.push(cleaned[i]);
        }
        return 1;
      },
      pushUnique(arrayRef,
      value){
        if(!Array.isArray(arrayRef))return false;
        const clean=String(value||"").trim();
        if(!clean)return false;
        if(arrayRef.indexOf(clean)!==-1)return false;
        arrayRef.push(clean);
        return true;
      },
      makeKeyFromLabel(label){
        const U=globalThis.AIDRPG.Utils;
        if(U&&typeof U.toKey==="function"){
          return U.toKey(label);
        }
        return String(label||"").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,
        "_").replace(/^_+|_+$/g,
        "");
      },
      cleanPhrase(value){
        return String(value||"").replace(/\s+/g,
        " ").replace(/^(?:the|an|a)\s+/i,
        "").replace(/\s+(?:where|when|while|and|but)\s+.*$/i,
        "").replace(/[.,;:!?]+$/g,
        "").trim();
      }
    },

      processInput(rawText,

      buildPendingAdvance(intent,

      root=state.aidrpg){

      estimateTravelMinutes(intent,
      lowerText,
      root=state.aidrpg){

        if(/\bmeditate\b/.test(lowerText))return 60;

      processOutput(rawText,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);

      applyLongDurationTimeSkip(rawText,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const raw=String(rawText||"");
        const lower=raw.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,
        " ").trim();
        if(!lower)return 0;
        const words={
          one: 1,
          two: 2,
          three: 3,
          four: 4,
          five: 5,
          six: 6,
          seven: 7,
          eight: 8,
          nine: 9,
          ten: 10,
          eleven: 11,
          twelve: 12,
          twenty: 20,
          thirty: 30,
          forty: 40,
          fifty: 50,
          sixty: 60,
          seventy: 70,
          eighty: 80,
          ninety: 90
        };
        const parseNum=(value)=>/^\d+$/.test(String(value||""))?Math.floor(Number(value)): (words[String(value||"").toLowerCase()]||0);
        let match=raw.match(/\b(\d+|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|eleven|twelve|twenty|thirty|forty|fifty|sixty|seventy|eighty|ninety)\s+years?\s+(?:pass|passes|passed|later|go by|elapse|elapsed)\b/i);
        if(!match)match=raw.match(/\bafter\s+(\d+|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|eleven|twelve|twenty|thirty|forty|fifty|sixty|seventy|eighty|ninety)\s+years?\b/i);
        if(!match)return 0;
        const years=parseNum(match[1]);
        if(years<=0)return 0;
        const minutes=years*365*24*60;
        this.advanceMinutes(minutes,
        years+" year time skip",
        root);
        return 1;
      },
      applyValidatedConsequences(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const A=globalThis.AIDRPG;
        const Guard=A.OperationGuard;
        const pending=root.pending||{
        };
        const validated=Array.isArray(pending.validatedConsequences)?pending.validatedConsequences: [];
        let changes=0;
        for(let i=0; i<validated.length; i+=1){
          const candidate=validated[i];
          if(!candidate||candidate.category!=="time"||candidate._timeApplied===true){
            continue;
          }
          const payload=candidate&&candidate.payload?candidate.payload: {
          };
          const target=String(payload.label||payload.unit||candidate.type||"time");
          const commit=()=>{
            const minutes=this.validatedCandidateToMinutes(candidate,
            root);
            if(minutes>0){
              return this.advanceMinutes(minutes,
              "validated time consequence",
              root);
            }
            return 0;
          };
          const localChanges=Guard&&typeof Guard.applyOnce==="function"?Guard.applyOnce({
            kind: "time_"+String(candidate.type||"change"),
            target: target,
            payload: payload,
            sourceId: candidate.id||""
          },
          commit,
          root): commit();
          changes+=localChanges;
          candidate._timeApplied=true;
        }
        return changes;
      },
      validatedCandidateToMinutes(candidate,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        const payload=candidate&&candidate.payload?candidate.payload: {
        };
        const type=String(candidate&&candidate.type||"");
        const amount=Math.max(0,
        Math.floor(Number(payload.amount||0)));
        const unit=String(payload.unit||"");
        const label=String(payload.label||"");
        if(type==="time_advance"){
          if(amount>0&&unit==="minutes")return amount;
          if(amount>0&&unit==="hours")return amount*60;
          if(label==="next_morning")return this.minutesUntilNextMorning(root);
        }
        if(type==="rest_completion"&&label==="overnight"){
          return this.minutesUntilNextMorning(root);
        }
        return 0;
      },
      minutesUntilNextMorning(root=state.aidrpg){
        const current=root&&root.time&&root.time.current?root.time.current: {
        };
        const hour=Math.max(0,
        Math.floor(Number(current.hour||0)));
        const minute=Math.max(0,
        Math.floor(Number(current.minute||0)));
        const total=(hour*60)+minute;
        const target=6*60;
        if(total<target){
          return target-total;
        }
        return(24*60-total)+target;
      },
      applyPendingAdvance(text,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const pending=root.time.pendingAdvance;
        if(!pending||typeof pending!=="object"){
          return 0;
        }
        const routeTiming=this.resolveRouteTiming(pending,
        text,
        root);
        const appliedMinutes=routeTiming&&routeTiming.minutes>0?routeTiming.minutes: this.resolveAppliedMinutes(pending,
        text,
        root);
        root.time.pendingAdvance=null;
        if(appliedMinutes<=0){
          return 0;
        }
        const beforeLocationRef=String(pending.startLocationRef||"");
        const afterLocationRef=root.player&&typeof root.player.locationRef==="string"?root.player.locationRef: "";
        const destinationRef=this.makeLocationRef(pending.destinationHint||"");

        const routeToRef=routeTiming&&routeTiming.toRef?routeTiming.toRef: destinationRef;
        const finalDestinationRef=routeToRef||destinationRef;
        let changes=this.advanceMinutes(appliedMinutes,
        pending.note||pending.kind||"time advance",
        root);
        if(pending.kind==="travel"&&routeFromRef&&(afterLocationRef||finalDestinationRef)){
          const toRef=(finalDestinationRef&&finalDestinationRef!==routeFromRef)?finalDestinationRef: afterLocationRef;

            this.rememberRouteDuration(routeFromRef,
            toRef,

            root,

              actualMinutes: appliedMinutes,
              delayReason: routeTiming&&routeTiming.delayReason?routeTiming.delayReason: "",
              rejectedMinutes: routeTiming&&routeTiming.rejectedMinutes?routeTiming.rejectedMinutes: 0,
              rawText: text
            });
          }
        }
        if(pending.kind==="travel"&&finalDestinationRef&&root.player&&typeof root.player==="object"){
          if(root.player.locationRef!==finalDestinationRef){
            root.player.locationRef=finalDestinationRef;
            changes+=1;
          }
          if(root.world&&root.world.currentScene&&typeof root.world.currentScene==="object"){
            if(root.world.currentScene.parentLocationRef!==finalDestinationRef){
              root.world.currentScene.parentLocationRef=finalDestinationRef;
              changes+=1;
            }
          }
          if(globalThis.AIDRPG&&globalThis.AIDRPG.WorldEntitySystem&&typeof globalThis.AIDRPG.WorldEntitySystem.ensureLocationRecord==="function"){
            const label=routeTiming&&routeTiming.toLabel?routeTiming.toLabel: (String(pending.destinationHint||"").trim()||finalDestinationRef.replace(/^location_/,
            "").replace(/_/g,
            " "));
            globalThis.AIDRPG.WorldEntitySystem.ensureLocationRecord(finalDestinationRef,
            label,
            root);
          }
        }
        return changes;
      },
      resolveRouteTiming(pending,
      text,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!pending||String(pending.kind||"")!=="travel")return null;
        this.init(root);
        const raw=String(text||"");
        const lower=raw.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,
        " ").trim();
        const mention=this.extractRouteMention(raw,
        root);
        const beforeLocationRef=mention&&mention.from?this.makeLocationRef(mention.from): String(pending.startLocationRef||"");
        const destinationRef=mention&&mention.to?this.makeLocationRef(mention.to): this.makeLocationRef(pending.destinationHint||"");
        if(!beforeLocationRef||!destinationRef||beforeLocationRef===destinationRef)return null;
        const known=this.getKnownRouteDuration(beforeLocationRef,
        destinationRef,
        root);
        const explicit=this.extractExplicitDurationMinutes(raw);
        const delayReason=this.extractTravelDelayReason(raw);
        const delayMinutes=this.extractTravelDelayMinutes(raw);
        const estimated=Math.max(0,
        Math.floor(Number(pending.minutes||0)));
        const baseWording=/\b(?:usually|normally|typically|base|without\s+delay|clean\s+route|clean\s+road)\b/.test(lower);
        if(!explicit||explicit<=0){
          if(known&&known.minutes>0){
            const actual=delayReason&&delayMinutes>0?known.minutes+delayMinutes: known.minutes;
            return {
              minutes: actual,
              baseMinutes: known.minutes,
              delayReason: delayReason,
              delayMinutes: delayMinutes,
              fromRef: beforeLocationRef,
              toRef: destinationRef,
              toLabel: mention&&mention.to?mention.to: ""
            };
          }
          return null;
        }
        if(known&&known.minutes>0){
          const diff=Math.abs(explicit-known.minutes);
          if(delayReason&&delayMinutes>0){
            const baseMinutes=baseWording||diff<=15?(diff<=15?known.minutes: explicit): known.minutes;
            const actualMinutes=baseMinutes+delayMinutes;
            this.pushRouteEvent("Route delay: "+this.formatRouteLabel(beforeLocationRef,
            destinationRef,
            root)+" actual "+actualMinutes+" minutes due to "+delayReason+"; base "+baseMinutes+" minutes.",
            root);
            return {
              minutes: actualMinutes,
              baseMinutes: baseMinutes,
              delayReason: delayReason,
              delayMinutes: delayMinutes,
              fromRef: beforeLocationRef,
              toRef: destinationRef,
              toLabel: mention&&mention.to?mention.to: ""
            };
          }
          if(diff>15&&!delayReason){
            this.pushRouteEvent("Route contradiction: "+this.formatRouteLabel(beforeLocationRef,
            destinationRef,
            root)+" remains "+known.minutes+" minutes; rejected "+explicit+" minutes.",
            root);
            this.pushContradictionFlag("route_time_conflict",
            root);
            return {
              minutes: known.minutes,
              baseMinutes: known.minutes,
              rejectedMinutes: explicit,
              delayReason: "",
              fromRef: beforeLocationRef,
              toRef: destinationRef,
              toLabel: mention&&mention.to?mention.to: ""
            };
          }
          if(explicit>known.minutes&&delayReason){
            this.pushRouteEvent("Route delay: "+this.formatRouteLabel(beforeLocationRef,
            destinationRef,
            root)+" took "+explicit+" minutes due to "+delayReason+"; base remains "+known.minutes+" minutes.",
            root);
            return {
              minutes: explicit,
              baseMinutes: known.minutes,
              delayReason: delayReason,
              delayMinutes: Math.max(0,
              explicit-known.minutes),
              fromRef: beforeLocationRef,
              toRef: destinationRef,
              toLabel: mention&&mention.to?mention.to: ""
            };
          }
          return {
            minutes: explicit,
            baseMinutes: known.minutes,
            delayReason: delayReason,
            delayMinutes: delayMinutes,
            fromRef: beforeLocationRef,
            toRef: destinationRef,
            toLabel: mention&&mention.to?mention.to: ""
          };
        }
        if(delayReason&&delayMinutes>0){
          const baseMinutes=explicit;
          return {
            minutes: baseMinutes+delayMinutes,
            baseMinutes: baseMinutes,
            delayReason: delayReason,
            delayMinutes: delayMinutes,
            fromRef: beforeLocationRef,
            toRef: destinationRef,
            toLabel: mention&&mention.to?mention.to: ""
          };
        }
        if(estimated>0&&explicit>estimated+30&&delayReason)return {
          minutes: explicit,
          baseMinutes: estimated,
          delayReason: delayReason,
          delayMinutes: Math.max(0,
          explicit-estimated),
          fromRef: beforeLocationRef,
          toRef: destinationRef,
          toLabel: mention&&mention.to?mention.to: ""
        };
        return {
          minutes: explicit,
          baseMinutes: explicit,
          delayReason: delayReason,
          delayMinutes: delayMinutes,
          fromRef: beforeLocationRef,
          toRef: destinationRef,
          toLabel: mention&&mention.to?mention.to: ""
        };
      },
      captureRouteTimingFromText(text,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);

        root);
        if(!mention||!mention.from||!mention.to)return 0;

      },
      extractRouteMention(text,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        const raw=String(text||"").replace(/\s+/g,
        " ").trim();
        if(!raw)return null;
        const cleanLabel=(value)=>{
          let label=String(value||"").replace(/^(?:the|an|a)\s+/i,

          const key=label.toLowerCase();
          const aliases={
            guild: "Adventurers Guild",
            "adventurer guild": "Adventurers Guild",
            "adventurers guild": "Adventurers Guild",
            "guild hall": "Guild Hall",
            barrow: "Old Barrow",
            "old barrow": "Old Barrow",
            "market lane": "Market Lane",
            "ruined chapel": "Ruined Chapel",
            "drunken huntsman": "The Drunken Huntsman",
            "rusted lantern": "The Rusted Lantern"

          if(/^(?:route|road|path|trail|trip|journey|return|same road|same route|clean road)$/i.test(label))return"";

          if(!clean)return false;
          if(clean.length<3||clean.length>60)return false;

          if(/^The\s+[A-Z]/.test(clean))return true;
          if(/^[A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]+(?:\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]+){1,4}$/.test(clean))return true;

        /\b(?:the\s+)?trip\s+from\s+(?:the\s+)?([a-z][a-z'’-]*(?:\s+[a-z][a-z'’-]*){0,5})\s+to\s+(?:the\s+)?([a-z][a-z'’-]*(?:\s+[a-z][a-z'’-]*){0,5})\s+(?:usually\s+|normally\s+|typically\s+)?takes?\b/i];

          if(!match||!match[1]||!match[2])continue;
          const from=cleanLabel(match[1]);
          const to=cleanLabel(match[2]);
          if(isUsefulLabel(from)&&isUsefulLabel(to)&&from.toLowerCase()!==to.toLowerCase())return {
            from: from,
            to: to
          };
        }
        const broadPlace="([A-Za-z][A-Za-z'’-]*(?:\\s+[A-Za-z][A-Za-z'’-]*){0,5})";

      extractExplicitDurationMinutes(text){
        const raw=String(text||"").toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,
        " ");
        const wordNumbers={

          two: 2,
          three: 3,
          four: 4,
          five: 5,
          six: 6,
          seven: 7,
          eight: 8,
          nine: 9,
          ten: 10,
          eleven: 11,

        return 0;
      },
      extractTravelDelayMinutes(text){
        const raw=String(text||"").toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,

      },
      extractTravelDelayReason(text){
        const lower=String(text||"").toLowerCase();
        if(/\b(?:no|without)\s+(?:delay|slowdown|reason|cause|obstruction|fight|encounter)\b|\bfor\s+no\s+(?:reason|cause)\b|\bsomehow\b|\brandomly\b|\bsame\s+clean\s+(?:road|route|path)\b/.test(lower))return"";

        return"";
      },
      getKnownRouteDuration(fromRef,
      toRef,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||!root.time||!root.time.routes)return null;
        const routes=root.time.routes.knownTravelTimes||{
        };
        const keys=[this.makeRouteKey(fromRef,
        toRef),
        this.makeRouteKey(toRef,
        fromRef),
        this.makeCanonicalRouteKey(fromRef,
        toRef)];
        for(let i=0; i<keys.length; i+=1){
          const row=routes[keys[i]];
          if(row&&typeof row.minutes==="number"&&row.minutes>0)return row;
        }
        return null;
      },
      pushRouteEvent(message,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        this.init(root);
        const msg=String(message||"").replace(/\s+/g,
        " ").trim();
        if(!msg)return 0;
        const turn=root&&root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0;
        const events=root.time.routes.recentRouteEvents;
        const last=events.length?events[events.length-1]: null;
        if(last&&last.turn===turn&&last.message===msg)return 0;
        events.push({
          turn,
          message: msg
        });
        while(events.length>24)events.shift();

        if(U&&typeof U.logEvent==="function")U.logEvent(msg);

      },
      pushContradictionFlag(flag,

        this.init(root);

        return 1;
      },
      formatRouteLabel(fromRef,
      toRef,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        const nameFor=(ref)=>{

          };

      resolveAppliedMinutes(pending,
      text,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        const lower=String(text||"").toLowerCase();
        const kind=String((pending&&pending.kind)||"general");
        if(this.isClearlyFailedAction(lower)){
          if(kind==="travel")return 10;
          if(kind==="rest")return 5;
          return 2;
        }
        let minutes=Math.max(0,
        Math.floor(Number((pending&&pending.minutes)||0)));
        const hardCaps={
          combat: 20,
          movement: 20,
          inspection: 15,
          interaction: 15,
          social: 20,
          general: 20,
          training: 360,
          rest: 720,
          travel: 720
        };
        const cap=hardCaps[kind]!=null?hardCaps[kind]: 20;
        if(/\bmoments? later\b|\bshortly after\b/.test(lower)){
          minutes=Math.max(minutes,
          5);
          minutes=Math.min(minutes,
          15);
        }
        if(/\ban hour later\b|\bafter an hour\b/.test(lower)){
          if(kind==="travel"||kind==="rest"||kind==="training"){
            minutes=Math.max(minutes,
            60);
          }
        }
        if(/\bhours later\b|\bafter hours\b/.test(lower)){
          if(kind==="travel"||kind==="rest"||kind==="training"){
            minutes=Math.max(minutes,
            180);
          }
        }

          if(kind==="rest"||kind==="travel"||kind==="training"||kind==="general"){
            return this.minutesUntilTargetHour(8,
            root);
          }
        }
        if(/\bthat evening\b|\blater that evening\b/.test(lower)){
          if(kind==="rest"||kind==="travel"||kind==="training"||kind==="general"){
            return this.minutesUntilTargetHour(18,
            root);
          }
        }
        if(/\bthe next day\b|\btomorrow\b/.test(lower)){
          if(kind==="rest"||kind==="travel"||kind==="training"){
            return Math.max(minutes,
            this.minutesUntilNextDay(root));
          }
        }
        if(/\bdays later\b|\bseveral days later\b/.test(lower)){
          if(kind==="travel"||kind==="rest"){
            return Math.max(minutes,
            72*60);
          }
        }
        if(minutes>cap){
          minutes=cap;
        }
        return minutes;
      },
      advanceMinutes(minutes,
      note,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const totalMinutes=Math.max(0,
        Math.floor(Number(minutes||0)));

        const remainder=afterAbsoluteMinutes%(24*60);

        current.hour=nextHour;
        current.minute=nextMinute;

          hour: current.hour,

          note: String(note||"time advance"),
          minutesAdvanced: totalMinutes
        },
        root);
        const U=globalThis.AIDRPG.Utils;
        if(U&&typeof U.markDirty==="function"){
          U.markDirty("time",
          true,
          root);
        }
        return 1;
      },
      pushTimelineEvent(eventObj,

        }
      },
      rememberRouteDuration(fromRef,
      toRef,
      minutes,
      root=state.aidrpg,
      options={
      }){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return;
        this.init(root);

        };

        to,
        root);
        if(existing&&typeof existing.minutes==="number"&&existing.minutes>0){
          const diff=Math.abs(existing.minutes-mins);
          if(diff>15&&!delayReason){
            this.pushRouteEvent("Route contradiction: "+this.formatRouteLabel(from,
            to,
            root)+" remains "+existing.minutes+" minutes; rejected "+mins+" minutes.",
            root);
            this.pushContradictionFlag("route_time_conflict",
            root);
            return;
          }
        }
        const baseMinutes=existing&&existing.minutes>0&&delayReason?existing.minutes: (existing&&existing.minutes>0&&Math.abs(existing.minutes-mins)<=15?existing.minutes: mins);

        to)];

          const routeKey=routeKeys[k];
          root.time.routes.knownTravelTimes[routeKey]={
            fromRef: k===1?to: from,
            toRef: k===1?from: to,
            minutes: baseMinutes,
            lastActualMinutes: actualMinutes||baseMinutes,
            lastDelayReason: delayReason,
            lastConfirmedTurn: turn,
            symmetric: true
          };
        }
        root.time.routes.baseTravelTimes[this.makeCanonicalRouteKey(from,
        to)]=baseMinutes;

        to,
        root)+" actual "+actualMinutes+" minutes; base "+baseMinutes+" minutes.",
        root);
        else this.pushRouteEvent("Route memory: "+this.formatRouteLabel(from,
        to,
        root)+" is "+baseMinutes+" minutes.",
        root);
        if(globalThis.AIDRPG&&globalThis.AIDRPG.WorldEntitySystem&&typeof globalThis.AIDRPG.WorldEntitySystem.ensureRouteRecord==="function"){
          const routeRecord=globalThis.AIDRPG.WorldEntitySystem.ensureRouteRecord(this.makeCanonicalRouteKey(from,
          to),

            routeRecord.mutable.lastActualMinutes=actualMinutes||baseMinutes;
            routeRecord.mutable.lastDelayReason=delayReason;
            routeRecord.mutable.lastConfirmedTurn=turn;
            if(!Array.isArray(routeRecord.mutable.travelHints))routeRecord.mutable.travelHints=[];
            const label=baseMinutes+"_minutes_base";
            if(routeRecord.mutable.travelHints.indexOf(label)===-1)routeRecord.mutable.travelHints.push(label);
          }
        }
      },
      detectRouteTimeAbuse(text,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;

      detectContradictions(text,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const nextFlags=[];
        const lower=String(text||"").toLowerCase();
        const hour=root.time.current.hour;
        if(/\bmorning\b/.test(lower)&&!(hour>=4&&hour<=11)){
          nextFlags.push("time_of_day_conflict");
        }
        if(/\bafternoon\b/.test(lower)&&!(hour>=12&&hour<=16)){
          nextFlags.push("time_of_day_conflict");
        }
        if(/\bevening\b/.test(lower)&&!(hour>=17&&hour<=20)){
          nextFlags.push("time_of_day_conflict");
        }
        if(/\bnight\b/.test(lower)&&!(hour>=21||hour<=3)){
          nextFlags.push("time_of_day_conflict");
        }

          nextFlags.push("wake_time_conflict");

          if(!recent||typeof recent.minutesAdvanced!=="number"||recent.minutesAdvanced<(24*60)){
            nextFlags.push("large_narrative_jump");
          }
        }
        if(recent&&typeof recent.minutesAdvanced==="number"){
          const note=String(recent.note||"");
          const mins=recent.minutesAdvanced;
          if((note==="combat"||note==="inspection"||note==="interaction"||note==="movement")&&mins>30){
            nextFlags.push("implausible_action_time_jump");
          }
          if(note==="social"&&mins>60){
            nextFlags.push("implausible_action_time_jump");
          }
        }

        for(let i=0; i<existingFlags.length; i+=1){

        }
        return this.replaceSimpleArray(root.time.contradictionFlags,
        nextFlags,
        8);
      },
      updateWeatherAndSeasonHints(text,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const lower=String(text||"").toLowerCase();

        if(weather&&weather!==current.weather){
          current.weather=weather;
          changes+=1;
        }

      extractSeason(lower){
        if(/\bspring\b/.test(lower))return"spring";
        if(/\bsummer\b/.test(lower))return"summer";
        if(/\bautumn\b|\bfall\b/.test(lower))return"autumn";
        if(/\bwinter\b/.test(lower))return"winter";
        return"";
      },
      extractWeather(lower){
        if(/\bstorm\b|\bthunder\b|\blightning\b/.test(lower))return"storm";
        if(/\brain\b|\brains\b|\bdrizzle\b/.test(lower))return"rain";
        if(/\bsnow\b|\bblizzard\b/.test(lower))return"snow";
        if(/\bfog\b|\bmist\b/.test(lower))return"fog";
        if(/\bclear sky\b|\bsunny\b/.test(lower))return"clear";
        if(/\bcloudy\b|\bovercast\b/.test(lower))return"cloudy";
        if(/\bwindy\b|\bgale\b/.test(lower))return"windy";
        return"";
      },
      minutesUntilTargetHour(targetHour,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        this.init(root);
        const current=root.time.current;
        const currentMinutes=(current.hour*60)+current.minute;
        const target=Math.max(0,
        Math.min(23,
        Math.floor(Number(targetHour||0))))*60;
        if(target>currentMinutes){
          return target-currentMinutes;
        }
        return(24*60)-currentMinutes+target;
      },
      minutesUntilNextDay(root=state.aidrpg){
        this.init(root);

        return(24*60)-currentMinutes+(8*60);
      },
      isClearlyFailedAction(lowerText){
        return/\b(fails?|failed|cannot|can't|unable to|could not|couldn't|refuses?|refused|without managing to)\b/.test(String(lowerText||""));
      },
      makeLocationRef(label){
        const clean=String(label||"").trim();
        if(!clean)return"";
        return"location_"+this.makeKeyFromLabel(clean);
      },
      makeRouteKey(fromRef,
      toRef){
        return"route_"+this.makeKeyFromLabel(String(fromRef||"")+"_to_"+String(toRef||""));
      },
      makeCanonicalRouteKey(fromRef,
      toRef){
        const a=String(fromRef||"");
        const b=String(toRef||"");
        const pair=[a,
        b].sort();
        return"route_"+this.makeKeyFromLabel(pair[0]+"_to_"+pair[1]);
      },
      makeKeyFromLabel(label){
        const U=globalThis.AIDRPG.Utils;
        if(U&&typeof U.toKey==="function"){
          return U.toKey(label);
        }
        return String(label||"").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,
        "_").replace(/^_+|_+$/g,
        "");
      },
      replaceSimpleArray(targetArray,
      nextValues,
      maxCount){
        if(!Array.isArray(targetArray))return 0;
        if(!Array.isArray(nextValues))nextValues=[];
        const cleaned=[];
        for(let i=0; i<nextValues.length&&i<(maxCount||8); i+=1){
          const value=String(nextValues[i]||"").trim();
          if(!value)continue;
          if(cleaned.indexOf(value)===-1)cleaned.push(value);
        }
        let changed=0;
        if(targetArray.length!==cleaned.length){
          changed=1;
        }
        else {
          for(let i=0; i<targetArray.length; i+=1){
            if(targetArray[i]!==cleaned[i]){
              changed=1;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        if(!changed)return 0;
        targetArray.length=0;
        for(let i=0; i<cleaned.length; i+=1){
          targetArray.push(cleaned[i]);
        }
        return 1;
      },
      refreshCache(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return"";
        this.init(root);
        if(!root.cache||typeof root.cache!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.cache)){
          root.cache={
          };
        }

        root.cache.timeSummary=summary;
        return summary;
      },
      getCompactSummary(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object"||!root.time||!root.time.current){
          return"Time unknown.";
        }
        const current=root.time.current;
        const parts=[];
        parts.push("Day "+current.day);
        parts.push(this.pad2(current.hour)+":"+this.pad2(current.minute));
        if(current.season){
          parts.push("Season: "+current.season);
        }
        if(current.weather){
          parts.push("Weather: "+current.weather);
        }
        if(root.time.routes&&root.time.routes.knownTravelTimes){
          const routeRows=[];
          const seen={
          };
          const keys=Object.keys(root.time.routes.knownTravelTimes);
          for(let i=0; i<keys.length&&routeRows.length<4; i+=1){
            const row=root.time.routes.knownTravelTimes[keys[i]];
            if(!row||typeof row.minutes!=="number")continue;
            const canon=this.makeCanonicalRouteKey(row.fromRef,
            row.toRef);
            if(seen[canon])continue;
            seen[canon]=true;
            routeRows.push(this.formatRouteLabel(row.fromRef,
            row.toRef,
            root)+" "+row.minutes+"m base"+(row.lastDelayReason&&row.lastActualMinutes&&row.lastActualMinutes>row.minutes?" (last "+row.lastActualMinutes+"m due to "+row.lastDelayReason+")": ""));
          }
          if(routeRows.length)parts.push("Routes: "+routeRows.join("; "));
        }
        if(root.time.routes&&Array.isArray(root.time.routes.recentRouteEvents)&&root.time.routes.recentRouteEvents.length){
          const recentRoutes=[];
          const turn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0;
          for(let i=root.time.routes.recentRouteEvents.length-1; i>=0&&recentRoutes.length<2; i-=1){
            const row=root.time.routes.recentRouteEvents[i]||{
            };
            const rowTurn=typeof row.turn==="number"?row.turn: turn;
            if(turn-rowTurn>10)continue;
            if(row.message)recentRoutes.push(String(row.message).slice(0,
            120));
          }
          if(recentRoutes.length)parts.push("Route notes: "+recentRoutes.join(" | "));
        }
        if(root.time.contradictionFlags&&root.time.contradictionFlags.length){
          parts.push("Flags: "+root.time.contradictionFlags.join(", "));
        }
        return parts.join(" | ");
      },
      pad2(value){
        const n=Math.max(0,
        Math.floor(Number(value||0)));
        return n<10?"0"+n: String(n);
      }
    },
    AbilitySystem: {
      VERSION: "1.5.3-ability-cost-card-split",
      init(root=state.aidrpg){

      },
      processInput(rawText,root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return null;
        this.init(root);
        const intent=root.pending&&root.pending.inputIntent?root.pending.inputIntent:null;
        const candidate=this.extractInputCandidate(rawText,intent,root);
        root.pending.abilityCandidate=candidate;
        if(candidate){
          const abilities=root.abilities;
          abilities.candidatesByKey[candidate.normalizedKey]=this.snapshotCandidate(candidate);
        }
