      },
      processOutput(rawText,root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const A=globalThis.AIDRPG||{};
        const U=A.Utils||null;
        const raw=String(rawText||"");
        if(!raw.trim())return 0;
        if(A.TurnEngine&&typeof A.TurnEngine.isDuplicateCurrentOutput==="function"&&A.TurnEngine.isDuplicateCurrentOutput())return 0;
        let changes=0;
        const pending=root.pending?root.pending.abilityCandidate:null;
        if(pending){
          changes+=this.applyCandidateOutcome(pending,raw,root);
        }
        const outputCandidates=this.extractOutputCandidates(raw,root);
        for(let i=0;i<outputCandidates.length;i+=1){
          if(this.isOutputCandidateGrounded(outputCandidates[i],root,raw)){
            changes+=this.applyCandidateOutcome(outputCandidates[i],raw,root);
          }
          else {
            changes+=this.recordRejectedOutputCandidate(outputCandidates[i],raw,root);
          }
        }
        const revisionCandidates=this.extractRevisionCandidates(raw,root);
        for(let i=0;i<revisionCandidates.length;i+=1){
          changes+=this.applyRevisionCandidate(revisionCandidates[i],raw,root);
        }
        changes+=this.captureDerivedAbilityVariation(raw,root);
        changes+=this.captureObservedUseSignals(raw,root);
        if(root.pending&&Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(root.pending,"abilityCandidate"))root.pending.abilityCandidate=null;
        if(changes>0){
          this.repairIndexes(root);
          this.markAbilityDirty("summary",root);
          if(U&&typeof U.invalidatePackets==="function")U.invalidatePackets(root);
          if(U&&typeof U.logEvent==="function")U.logEvent("Ability lifecycle updated without wrapper repair.");
        }
        return changes;
      },
      snapshotCandidate(candidate){
        try{return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(candidate));}
        catch(_error){return {rawName:String(candidate&&candidate.rawName||candidate&&candidate.name||""),normalizedKey:String(candidate&&candidate.normalizedKey||"")};}
      },
      extractInputCandidate(rawText,intent,root=state.aidrpg){
        const raw=String(rawText||"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
        if(!raw||raw.charAt(0)==="/")return null;
        const primaryType=intent&&typeof intent==="object"?String(intent.primaryType||""):"";
        const lower=raw.toLowerCase();
        const explicitTraining=/\b(?:train|practice|drill|exercise|meditate on|spar with|work on|study|refine|hone|develop)\b/i.test(raw);
        const explicitUse=/\b(?:cast|channel|invoke|activate|unleash|focus|use|perform|attempt|try|shape|manifest|wield)\b/i.test(raw);
        const explicitFormation=/\b(?:make|made|turn|turned|become|became|form|formed|develop|developed|adapt|adapted|incorporate|internalize|make\s+.+\s+part\s+of\s+(?:myself|yourself|your body|my body))\b/i.test(raw);
        if(primaryType!=="use_ability"&&primaryType!=="train"&&!explicitTraining&&!explicitUse&&!explicitFormation)return null;
        let rawName="";
        const passiveName=this.extractPassiveFormationName(raw);
        if(passiveName)rawName=passiveName;
        else if(primaryType==="train"&&intent)rawName=intent.trainingHint||intent.abilityHint||"";
        else if(intent&&intent.abilityHint)rawName=intent.abilityHint;
        if(!rawName)rawName=this.extractNamedPhrase(raw);
        const cleanName=this.cleanAbilityName(rawName);
        if(!cleanName)return null;
        const normalized=this.normalizeAbilityKey(cleanName);
        const categoryGuess=this.inferAbilityType(cleanName,raw,intent);
        const method=this.inferMethod(raw,categoryGuess);
        const target=this.inferTarget(raw,intent);
        const effect=this.inferEffect(raw,cleanName,target);
        const resourceGuess=this.inferResourceGuess(raw,categoryGuess,method);
        const costGuess=this.inferCostGuess(raw,categoryGuess,resourceGuess);
        const mode=explicitTraining||primaryType==="train"?"practice": explicitFormation?"form":"use";
        return {
          rawName: String(rawName||cleanName),
          name: cleanName,
          normalizedKey: normalized,
          type: categoryGuess,
          categoryGuess: categoryGuess,
          mode: mode,
          lifecycleStage: mode==="practice"?"practiced":"attempted",
          confidence: mode==="practice"?0.72:0.64,
          sourceInput: raw,
          sourceOutput: "",
          sourceIntentType: primaryType||mode,
          sourceTags: intent&&Array.isArray(intent.tags)?intent.tags.slice(0,8):[],
          formationContext: this.cleanFormationContext(raw),
          originContext: this.cleanFormationContext(raw),
          intendedFunction: this.inferIntendedFunction(intent,raw,effect),
          method: method,
          target: target,
          effect: effect,
          resourceGuess: resourceGuess,
          costGuess: costGuess,
          limitations: this.extractLimitations(raw),
          risks: this.extractRisks(raw),
          evidenceCount: 1,
          successfulUseCount: 0,
          failedUseCount: 0,
          keyPhrases: this.buildKeyPhrases(cleanName,intent,raw),
          semanticTags: this.extractSemanticTags(raw)
        };
      },
      extractOutputCandidates(rawText,root=state.aidrpg){
        const raw=String(rawText||"");
        const candidates=[];
        const patterns=[
          /\b(?:you\s+)?(?:learn|learns|learned|develop|develops|developed|gain|gains|gained|acquire|acquires|acquired|unlock|unlocks|unlocked|manifest|manifests|manifested|awaken|awakens|awakened|stabilize|stabilizes|stabilized)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+)?(skill|talent|passive|passive\s+talent|ability|technique)\s+(?:called\s+|known as\s+|named\s+)?["“]?([^"”\n.,;:!?]{2,70})/gi,
          /\bnew\s+(skill|talent|passive|passive\s+talent|ability|technique)\s*:\s*["“]?([^"”\n.,;:!?]{2,70})/gi,
          /\b(?:the|this|your)\s+(skill|talent|passive|passive\s+talent|ability|technique)\s+(?:is|was|becomes|became)\s+(?:called|known as|named)\s+["“]?([^"”\n.,;:!?]{2,70})/gi
        ];
        for(let p=0;p<patterns.length;p+=1){
          let match;
          while((match=patterns[p].exec(raw))){
            const typeWord=String(match[1]||"").toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,"_");
            const cleanName=this.cleanAbilityName(match[2]||"");
            if(!cleanName)continue;
            if(/\b(?:stable|reliable|new|basic|active|passive|confirmed|developed)\s+(?:ability|skill|talent|technique)\b/i.test(cleanName))continue;
            if(/^(?:ability|skill|talent|technique)\s+(?:for|to|that)\b/i.test(cleanName))continue;
            const type=this.normalizeAbilityType(typeWord==="technique"?"skill":typeWord==="passive_talent"?"passive":typeWord);
            const method=this.inferMethod(raw,type);
            const target=this.inferTarget(raw,null);
            const effect=this.inferEffect(raw,cleanName,target);
            candidates.push({
              rawName: String(match[2]||cleanName),
              name: cleanName,
              normalizedKey: this.normalizeAbilityKey(cleanName),
              type: type,
              categoryGuess: type,
              mode: "learn",
              lifecycleStage: "confirmed",
              confidence: 0.82,
              sourceInput: root&&root.pending&&root.pending.abilityCandidate?String(root.pending.abilityCandidate.sourceInput||root.pending.abilityCandidate.originContext||""):"",
              sourceOutput: raw,
              sourceIntentType: "output_discovery",
              sourceTags: this.extractSemanticTags(raw),
              formationContext: this.cleanFormationContext(raw),
              originContext: this.cleanFormationContext(raw),
              intendedFunction: this.inferOutputIntendedFunction(raw,cleanName)||effect||"story-confirmed technique",
              method: method,
              target: target,
              effect: effect,
              resourceGuess: this.inferResourceGuess(raw,type,method),
              costGuess: this.inferCostGuess(raw,type,this.inferResourceGuess(raw,type,method)),
              limitations: this.extractLimitations(raw),
              risks: this.extractRisks(raw),
              evidenceCount: 1,
              successfulUseCount: 1,
              failedUseCount: 0,
              keyPhrases: this.buildKeyPhrases(cleanName,null,raw),
              semanticTags: this.extractSemanticTags(raw)
            });
          }
        }
        return candidates;
      },
      isOutputCandidateGrounded(candidate,root=state.aidrpg,rawText=""){
        if(!candidate||typeof candidate!=="object")return false;
        const abilities=root&&root.abilities?root.abilities:{};
        if(candidate.normalizedKey&&abilities.byKey&&abilities.byKey[candidate.normalizedKey])return true;
        const pending=root&&root.pending?root.pending.abilityCandidate:null;
        if(pending&&pending.normalizedKey&&candidate.normalizedKey===pending.normalizedKey)return true;
        if(pending&&pending.name&&this.cleanAbilityName(pending.name).toLowerCase()===this.cleanAbilityName(candidate.name).toLowerCase())return true;
        const intent=root&&root.pending&&root.pending.inputIntent?root.pending.inputIntent:null;
        if(intent&&(intent.primaryType==="train"||intent.primaryType==="use_ability"))return true;
        const raw=String(rawText||"").toLowerCase();
        if(/\b(?:after|through|from)\s+(?:training|practice|study|repetition|repeated|success|successful|several attempts|many attempts)\b/.test(raw))return true;
        if(/\b(?:you successfully|you manage to|you finally|at last)\b/.test(raw)&&/\b(?:learn|develop|stabilize|refine|unlock)\b/.test(raw))return true;
        return false;
      },
      recordRejectedOutputCandidate(candidate,rawText,root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!candidate||!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const abilities=root.abilities;
        if(!Array.isArray(abilities.rejectedOutputCandidates))abilities.rejectedOutputCandidates=[];
        abilities.rejectedOutputCandidates.push({
          turn: root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0,
          name: String(candidate.name||""),
          reason: "ungrounded_output_learning_blocked",
          evidence: this.makeEvidenceSnippet(rawText)
        });
        while(abilities.rejectedOutputCandidates.length>10)abilities.rejectedOutputCandidates.shift();
        return 1;
      },
      applyCandidateOutcome(candidate,rawText,root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!candidate||typeof candidate!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const failed=this.isClearlyFailedOutput(rawText);
        const record=this.findOrCreateRecord(candidate,root);
        if(!record)return 0;
        let changes=0;
        changes+=this.mergeCandidateIntoRecord(record,candidate,rawText,!failed,root);
        changes+=this.advanceLifecycle(record,candidate,rawText,!failed,root);
        changes+=this.applyAbilityUseCost(record,candidate,rawText,!failed,root);
        if(changes>0){
          this.pushRecentEvent({
            turn: root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0,
            type: record.identity.type,
            name: record.identity.name,
            mode: candidate.mode,
            stage: record.lifecycle.stage
          },root.abilities);
          this.markAbilityDirty(record.identity.id,root);
        }
        return changes;
      },
      mergeCandidateIntoRecord(record,candidate,rawText,success,root=state.aidrpg){
        const turn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0;
        let changes=0;
        if(!record.source.sourceInput&&candidate.sourceInput){record.source.sourceInput=String(candidate.sourceInput);changes+=1;}
        if(candidate.sourceOutput&&!record.source.sourceOutput){record.source.sourceOutput=String(candidate.sourceOutput);changes+=1;}
        if(rawText&&record.source.lastOutput!==this.makeEvidenceSnippet(rawText)){record.source.lastOutput=this.makeEvidenceSnippet(rawText);changes+=1;}
        if(candidate.formationContext&&record.meaning.formationContext!==candidate.formationContext){
          if(!record.meaning.formationContext||record.lifecycle.stage==="candidate"){record.meaning.formationContext=String(candidate.formationContext);changes+=1;}
          else changes+=this.pushUniqueNote(record.meaning.formationHistory,String(candidate.formationContext),6);
        }
        if(!record.meaning.originContext&&candidate.originContext){record.meaning.originContext=String(candidate.originContext);changes+=1;}
        if(!record.meaning.originSignature){record.meaning.originSignature=this.makeOriginSignature(candidate.originContext||candidate.formationContext||record.identity.name);changes+=1;}
        const fields=["intendedFunction","method","target","effect","resourceGuess","costGuess"];
        for(let i=0;i<fields.length;i+=1){
          const key=fields[i];
          const value=String(candidate[key]||"").trim();
          if(value&&(!record.meaning[key]||record.meaning[key]==="general"||record.meaning[key]==="unknown")){
            record.meaning[key]=value;
            changes+=1;
          }
        }
        changes+=this.mergeUnique(record.meaning.limitations,candidate.limitations||[]);
        changes+=this.mergeUnique(record.meaning.risks,candidate.risks||[]);
        changes+=this.mergeUnique(record.meaning.stableMeaningFlags,["origin_preserved","function_preserved","generic_lifecycle"]);
        changes+=this.mergeUnique(record.keys.keyPhrases,candidate.keyPhrases||[]);
        changes+=this.updateCostAndDevelopmentProfile(record,candidate,rawText,success,root);
        changes+=this.mergeUnique(record.source.sourceTags,candidate.sourceTags||[]);
        changes+=this.mergeUnique(record.observation.semanticTags,candidate.semanticTags||[]);
        const observedFunction=this.inferOutputIntendedFunction(rawText||candidate.formationContext||"",record.identity.name);
        if(observedFunction&&observedFunction!=="general"){
          changes+=this.pushUniqueNote(record.observation.observedFunctions,observedFunction,8);
          if(record.meaning.intendedFunction&&record.meaning.intendedFunction!==observedFunction)changes+=this.pushUniqueNote(record.meaning.emergentApplications,observedFunction,8);
        }
        const evidence=this.makeEvidenceSnippet(rawText||candidate.formationContext||candidate.sourceInput||"");
        if(evidence&&record.observation.lastEvidence!==evidence){record.observation.lastEvidence=evidence;changes+=1;}
        changes+=this.pushEvidenceTrail(record,evidence,success,turn,candidate.mode);
        const nextConfidence=Math.max(Number(record.observation.confidence||0),Number(candidate.confidence||0));
        if(record.observation.confidence!==nextConfidence){record.observation.confidence=nextConfidence;changes+=1;}
        if(candidate.categoryGuess||candidate.type){
          changes+=this.reclassifyRecord(record,this.normalizeAbilityType(candidate.categoryGuess||candidate.type),"candidate_evidence",root);
        }
        if(record.lifecycle.lastTouchedTurn!==turn){record.lifecycle.lastTouchedTurn=turn;changes+=1;}
        return changes;
      },
      advanceLifecycle(record,candidate,rawText,success,root=state.aidrpg){
        const turn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0;
        let changes=0;
        record.progression.evidenceCount+=1;
        record.progression.lastConfirmedTurn=turn;
        if(success){record.progression.successfulUseCount+=1;record.progression.xp+=candidate.mode==="practice"?2:candidate.mode==="learn"?3:1;}
        else {record.progression.failedUseCount+=1;record.progression.xp+=candidate.mode==="practice"?1:0;}
        if(candidate.mode==="practice"){record.progression.trainingCount+=1;record.progression.lastTrainedTurn=turn;}
        if(candidate.mode==="use"||candidate.mode==="form"){record.progression.useCount+=1;record.progression.lastUsedTurn=turn;}
        changes+=1;
        const explicitConfirm=this.hasExplicitAbilityConfirmation(rawText);
        let nextStage=record.lifecycle.stage||"candidate";
        if(record.progression.evidenceCount>=1)nextStage="attempted";
        if(record.progression.trainingCount>0||record.progression.useCount>0)nextStage="practiced";
        if(success&&(explicitConfirm||record.progression.successfulUseCount>=1))nextStage="confirmed";
        const enoughEvidence=record.progression.evidenceCount>=2||record.progression.trainingCount>=2||record.progression.successfulUseCount>=2;
        if(success&&(explicitConfirm||enoughEvidence||candidate.mode==="learn"))nextStage="stabilized";
        if(record.lifecycle.stage!==nextStage){record.lifecycle.stage=nextStage;changes+=1;}
        const stabilized=nextStage==="stabilized";
        if(record.lifecycle.isCandidate!==(nextStage==="candidate"||nextStage==="attempted")){record.lifecycle.isCandidate=(nextStage==="candidate"||nextStage==="attempted");changes+=1;}
        if(record.lifecycle.isConfirmed!==(nextStage==="confirmed"||stabilized)){record.lifecycle.isConfirmed=(nextStage==="confirmed"||stabilized);changes+=1;}
        if(record.lifecycle.isStabilized!==stabilized){record.lifecycle.isStabilized=stabilized;changes+=1;}
        if(record.lifecycle.cardEligible!==stabilized){record.lifecycle.cardEligible=stabilized;changes+=1;}
        const nextTier=this.tierFromXp(record.progression.xp);
        if(record.progression.tier!==nextTier){record.progression.tier=nextTier;record.progression.masteryState=this.masteryLabelForTier(nextTier);changes+=1;}
        const nextLevel=this.abilityLevelFromXp(record.progression.xp);
        if(record.progression.level!==nextLevel){record.progression.level=nextLevel;changes+=1;}
        changes+=this.refreshCostProfile(record,root);
        return changes;
      },
      hasExplicitAbilityConfirmation(rawText){
        const lower=String(rawText||"").toLowerCase();
        return /\b(?:learn|learned|develop|developed|gain|gained|unlock|unlocked|stabilize|stabilized|refine|refined|become|becomes|became|form|forms|formed|make it part of yourself|make it part of your body|becomes part of you|part of yourself|part of your body|you successfully|you manage to|you finally)\b/.test(lower);
      },
      pushEvidenceTrail(record,evidence,success,turn,mode){
        if(!record.observation||typeof record.observation!=="object")record.observation={};
        if(!Array.isArray(record.observation.evidenceTrail))record.observation.evidenceTrail=[];
        if(!evidence)return 0;
        const last=record.observation.evidenceTrail.length?record.observation.evidenceTrail[record.observation.evidenceTrail.length-1]:null;
        if(last&&last.text===evidence&&last.success===success)return 0;
        record.observation.evidenceTrail.push({turn:turn,text:evidence,success:success===true,mode:String(mode||"")});
        while(record.observation.evidenceTrail.length>6)record.observation.evidenceTrail.shift();
        return 1;
      },
      findOrCreateRecord(candidate,root=state.aidrpg){
        this.init(root);
        const Guard=globalThis.AIDRPG&&globalThis.AIDRPG.AbilityCandidateSanitizer?globalThis.AIDRPG.AbilityCandidateSanitizer:null;
        if(Guard&&typeof Guard.validateCandidate==="function"&&!Guard.validateCandidate(candidate,root)){Guard.quarantine(candidate,"invalid_candidate",root);return null;}
        const U=globalThis.AIDRPG.Utils;
        const abilities=root.abilities;
        const normalized=candidate.normalizedKey||this.normalizeAbilityKey(candidate.name||candidate.rawName||"");
        if(!normalized)return null;
        let abilityId=abilities.byKey[normalized]||"";
        if(abilityId&&abilities.byId[abilityId]){
          const existing=abilities.byId[abilityId];
          this.ensureRecordShape(existing,abilityId,normalized,root);
          return existing;
        }
        const type=this.normalizeAbilityType(candidate.categoryGuess||candidate.type||"ability");
        abilityId=U&&typeof U.makeId==="function"?U.makeId(type):("ability_"+String(Date.now()));
        const turn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0;
        const record={
          identity:{id:abilityId,name:String(candidate.name||candidate.rawName||"Unnamed Ability"),type:type,category:type},
          classification:{currentType:type,confidence:Number(candidate.confidence||0.55),reason:"initial_candidate",history:[{turn:turn,type:type,reason:"initial_candidate"}]},
          keys:{normalizedName:normalized,aliases:[],keyPhrases:[]},
          lifecycle:{stage:"candidate",isCandidate:true,isConfirmed:false,isStabilized:false,cardEligible:false,createdTurn:turn,lastTouchedTurn:turn},
          meaning:{originContext:"",formationContext:"",formationHistory:[],originSignature:"",intendedFunction:String(candidate.intendedFunction||"general"),method:String(candidate.method||"unknown"),target:String(candidate.target||""),effect:String(candidate.effect||""),resourceGuess:String(candidate.resourceGuess||"contextual"),costGuess:String(candidate.costGuess||"contextual"),limitations:[],risks:[],stableMeaningFlags:[],emergentApplications:[],sourceAbilityRef:"",sourceAbilityName:"",variationReason:""},
          progression:{level:1,tier:1,xp:0,evidenceCount:0,useCount:0,trainingCount:0,successfulUseCount:0,failedUseCount:0,masteryState:"candidate",lastConfirmedTurn:0,lastUsedTurn:0,lastTrainedTurn:0},
          costProfile:this.createCostProfileFromCandidate(candidate,type),
          developmentProfile:{efficiency:0,power:0,control:0,speed:0,range:0,area:0,stability:0,stealth:0,mixed:0},
          observation:{confidence:Number(candidate.confidence||0.55),lastEvidence:"",notes:[],observedFunctions:[],semanticTags:[],evidenceTrail:[]},
          source:{firstSeenTurn:turn,sourceInput:String(candidate.sourceInput||candidate.originContext||""),sourceOutput:String(candidate.sourceOutput||""),lastOutput:"",sourceIntentType:String(candidate.sourceIntentType||""),sourceTags:[]}
        };
        abilities.byId[abilityId]=record;
        abilities.byKey[normalized]=abilityId;
        if(abilities.allIds.indexOf(abilityId)===-1)abilities.allIds.push(abilityId);
        this.addToTypeIndex(abilityId,type,root);
        return record;
      },
      ensureRecordShape(record,recordId,normalized,root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!record||typeof record!=="object")return null;
        const turn=root&&root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0;
        if(!record.identity||typeof record.identity!=="object")record.identity={};
        if(!record.identity.id)record.identity.id=recordId||record.id||"";
        if(!record.identity.name)record.identity.name=record.name||record.identity.id||"Unnamed Ability";
        record.identity.type=this.normalizeAbilityType(record.identity.type||record.identity.kind||record.identity.category||record.type||"ability");
        record.identity.category=record.identity.type;
        if(!record.classification||typeof record.classification!=="object")record.classification={currentType:record.identity.type,confidence:Number(record.observation&&record.observation.confidence||0.5),reason:"migrated_record",history:[]};
        if(!Array.isArray(record.classification.history))record.classification.history=[];
        if(!record.keys||typeof record.keys!=="object")record.keys={};
        if(!record.keys.normalizedName)record.keys.normalizedName=normalized||this.normalizeAbilityKey(record.identity.name);
        if(!Array.isArray(record.keys.aliases))record.keys.aliases=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(record.keys.keyPhrases))record.keys.keyPhrases=[];
        if(!record.lifecycle||typeof record.lifecycle!=="object")record.lifecycle={stage:"stabilized",isCandidate:false,isConfirmed:true,isStabilized:true,cardEligible:true,createdTurn:turn,lastTouchedTurn:turn};
        if(!record.lifecycle.stage)record.lifecycle.stage="stabilized";
        if(typeof record.lifecycle.isCandidate!=="boolean")record.lifecycle.isCandidate=record.lifecycle.stage==="candidate"||record.lifecycle.stage==="attempted";
        if(typeof record.lifecycle.isConfirmed!=="boolean")record.lifecycle.isConfirmed=record.lifecycle.stage==="confirmed"||record.lifecycle.stage==="stabilized";
        if(typeof record.lifecycle.isStabilized!=="boolean")record.lifecycle.isStabilized=record.lifecycle.stage==="stabilized";
        if(typeof record.lifecycle.cardEligible!=="boolean")record.lifecycle.cardEligible=record.lifecycle.isStabilized;
        if(!record.meaning||typeof record.meaning!=="object")record.meaning={};
        if(typeof record.meaning.originContext!=="string")record.meaning.originContext="";
        if(typeof record.meaning.formationContext!=="string")record.meaning.formationContext=record.meaning.originContext||"";
        if(!Array.isArray(record.meaning.formationHistory))record.meaning.formationHistory=[];
        if(typeof record.meaning.originSignature!=="string")record.meaning.originSignature="";
        if(typeof record.meaning.intendedFunction!=="string")record.meaning.intendedFunction="general";
        if(typeof record.meaning.method!=="string")record.meaning.method="unknown";
        if(typeof record.meaning.target!=="string")record.meaning.target="";
        if(typeof record.meaning.effect!=="string")record.meaning.effect="";
        if(typeof record.meaning.resourceGuess!=="string")record.meaning.resourceGuess="contextual";
        if(typeof record.meaning.costGuess!=="string")record.meaning.costGuess="contextual";
        if(!Array.isArray(record.meaning.limitations))record.meaning.limitations=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(record.meaning.risks))record.meaning.risks=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(record.meaning.stableMeaningFlags))record.meaning.stableMeaningFlags=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(record.meaning.emergentApplications))record.meaning.emergentApplications=[];
        if(!record.progression||typeof record.progression!=="object")record.progression={};
        if(typeof record.progression.tier!=="number")record.progression.tier=1;
        if(typeof record.progression.xp!=="number")record.progression.xp=0;
        if(typeof record.progression.evidenceCount!=="number")record.progression.evidenceCount=0;
        if(typeof record.progression.useCount!=="number")record.progression.useCount=0;
        if(typeof record.progression.trainingCount!=="number")record.progression.trainingCount=0;
        if(typeof record.progression.successfulUseCount!=="number")record.progression.successfulUseCount=record.progression.useCount||0;
        if(typeof record.progression.failedUseCount!=="number")record.progression.failedUseCount=0;
        if(typeof record.progression.masteryState!=="string")record.progression.masteryState="novice";
        if(!record.observation||typeof record.observation!=="object")record.observation={};
        if(typeof record.observation.confidence!=="number")record.observation.confidence=0.5;
        if(typeof record.observation.lastEvidence!=="string")record.observation.lastEvidence="";
        if(!Array.isArray(record.observation.notes))record.observation.notes=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(record.observation.observedFunctions))record.observation.observedFunctions=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(record.observation.semanticTags))record.observation.semanticTags=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(record.observation.evidenceTrail))record.observation.evidenceTrail=[];
        if(!record.source||typeof record.source!=="object")record.source={firstSeenTurn:turn,sourceInput:"",sourceOutput:"",lastOutput:"",sourceIntentType:"",sourceTags:[]};
        if(!Array.isArray(record.source.sourceTags))record.source.sourceTags=[];
        this.ensureCostAndDevelopmentShape(record,root);
        return record;
      },
      repairIndexes(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||!root.abilities)return 0;
        const abilities=root.abilities;
        const oldAll=Array.isArray(abilities.allIds)?abilities.allIds.slice():[];
        abilities.allIds=[];abilities.abilityIds=[];abilities.skillIds=[];abilities.talentIds=[];abilities.passiveIds=[];abilities.byKey={};
        const byId=abilities.byId||{};
        const ids=Object.keys(byId);
        for(let i=0;i<ids.length;i+=1){
          const id=ids[i];
          const rec=byId[id];
          if(!rec||typeof rec!=="object")continue;
          this.ensureRecordShape(rec,id,"",root);
          const key=rec.keys&&rec.keys.normalizedName?rec.keys.normalizedName:this.normalizeAbilityKey(rec.identity.name||id);
          rec.keys.normalizedName=key;
          abilities.byKey[key]=id;
          if(abilities.allIds.indexOf(id)===-1)abilities.allIds.push(id);
          this.addToTypeIndex(id,rec.identity.type,root);
        }
        for(let i=0;i<oldAll.length;i+=1){
          if(byId[oldAll[i]]&&abilities.allIds.indexOf(oldAll[i])===-1)abilities.allIds.push(oldAll[i]);
        }
        return 1;
      },
      addToTypeIndex(abilityId,type,root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||!root.abilities||!abilityId)return 0;
        const abilities=root.abilities;
        const clean=this.normalizeAbilityType(type);
        const buckets={ability:"abilityIds",skill:"skillIds",talent:"talentIds",passive:"passiveIds"};
        const key=buckets[clean]||"abilityIds";
        if(!Array.isArray(abilities[key]))abilities[key]=[];
        if(abilities[key].indexOf(abilityId)===-1)abilities[key].push(abilityId);
        return 1;
      },
      reclassifyRecord(record,type,reason,root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!record||!record.identity)return 0;
        const next=this.normalizeAbilityType(type);
        const prev=this.normalizeAbilityType(record.identity.type||"ability");
        if(prev!=="ability"&&next==="ability"&&String(reason||"")==="candidate_evidence")return 0;
        if(next===prev)return 0;
        record.identity.type=next;record.identity.category=next;
        if(!record.classification||typeof record.classification!=="object")record.classification={history:[]};
        record.classification.currentType=next;
        record.classification.reason=String(reason||"reclassified");
        if(!Array.isArray(record.classification.history))record.classification.history=[];
        record.classification.history.push({turn:root&&root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0,from:prev,type:next,reason:String(reason||"reclassified")});
        while(record.classification.history.length>8)record.classification.history.shift();
        return 1;
      },
      normalizeAbilityType(value){
        const lower=String(value||"ability").toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,"_").trim();
        if(lower==="skill"||lower==="spell"||lower==="technique"||lower==="active")return"skill";
        if(lower==="talent"||lower==="style"||lower==="stance"||lower==="form"||lower==="art")return"talent";
        if(lower==="passive"||lower==="passive_talent"||lower==="trait"||lower==="resistance"||lower==="adaptation")return"passive";
        return"ability";
      },
      inferAbilityType(name,rawText,intent){
        const lowerName=String(name||"").toLowerCase();
        const lowerRaw=String(rawText||"").toLowerCase();
        const primary=intent&&intent.primaryType?String(intent.primaryType):"";
        if(/\b(passive|affinity|resistance|adaptation|instinct|attunement|constitution|tolerance|always[- ]on|constant|acclimation|immunity)\b/.test(lowerName)||/\b(passive|always[- ]on|constant|part of (?:myself|yourself|your body|my body)|without activating|costs? nothing to activate)\b/.test(lowerRaw))return"passive";
        if(/\b(talent|style|form|stance|art|kata|school|discipline|fighting style|method|kung fu|karate|boxing|wrestling|judo|taekwondo|muay thai|aikido)\b/.test(lowerName)||/\b(talent|style|form|stance|martial art|fighting style|method|kung fu|karate|boxing|wrestling|judo|taekwondo|muay thai|aikido)\b/.test(lowerRaw))return"talent";
        if(/\b(cast|spell|channel|invoke|mana|magical|arcane|unleash|blast|bolt|summon|ritual)\b/.test(lowerRaw)||/\b(spell|blast|bolt|beam|fireball|ward|aegis|barrier|curse|hex)\b/.test(lowerName))return"skill";
        if(primary==="use_ability"&&/\b(strike|slash|shot|throw|combo|technique)\b/.test(lowerRaw))return"skill";
        return"ability";
      },
      extractPassiveFormationName(raw){
        const text=String(raw||"");
        const lower=text.toLowerCase();
        const domainMatch=text.match(/\b(?:against|to|from)\s+(?:the\s+)?([a-z][a-z -]{2,30})(?:\s|[.,;!?]|$)/i);
        const purposeMatch=text.match(/\b(?:so that|to|in order to|so I can|so you can)\s+([^.!?;,]{4,90})/i);
        if(/\b(?:resist|resistance|immune|immunity|tolerate|withstand|adapt|acclimate)\b/i.test(text)&&domainMatch&&domainMatch[1]){
          return this.cleanAbilityName(domainMatch[1]+" resistance");
        }
        if(/\bpart of (?:myself|yourself|my body|your body)\b/i.test(text)&&purposeMatch&&purposeMatch[1]){
          const purpose=purposeMatch[1].replace(/\b(?:increase|raise|maintain|keep|preserve|control|regulate)\b/ig,"").replace(/\byour\b/ig,"my").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
          if(/\bcold\b/i.test(purpose))return"cold resistance";
          if(/\bheat|warmth|temperature\b/i.test(purpose))return"body heat regulation";
          return this.cleanAbilityName(purpose.split(/\b(?:against|during|while|when|because)\b/i)[0].trim())||"internalized adaptation";
        }
        if(/\b(?:always[- ]on|constant|passive)\b/i.test(text)&&purposeMatch&&purposeMatch[1])return this.cleanAbilityName(purposeMatch[1])||"passive talent";
        return"";
      },
      extractNamedPhrase(rawText){
        const raw=String(rawText||"");
        const patterns=[
          /\b(?:cast|channel|invoke|activate|use|unleash|focus|practice|train|drill|work on|study|refine|hone|perform|attempt|try|shape|manifest|wield)\s+(?:my\s+|the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.,;!?]+)/i,
          /\b(?:develop|learn|create|form|make)\s+(?:my\s+|the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.,;!?]+)/i,
          /["“]([^"”]{2,60})["”]/
        ];
        for(let i=0;i<patterns.length;i+=1){const match=raw.match(patterns[i]);if(match&&match[1])return match[1];}
        return"";
      },
      cleanAbilityName(value){
        const S=globalThis.AIDRPG&&globalThis.AIDRPG.AbilityCandidateSanitizer?globalThis.AIDRPG.AbilityCandidateSanitizer:null;
        let text=String(value||"").replace(/["'`“”]+/g,"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
        if(S&&typeof S.cleanAbilityName==="function")return S.cleanAbilityName(text,state.aidrpg);
        text=text.replace(/^(?:my|the|a|an|your)\s+/i,"").replace(/\s+(?:on|at|against|toward|towards|with|using|for|into|from|to|by|in|inside|during|until|through|across|while|as|all day|today|again)\b.*$/i,"").replace(/[.,;:!?]+$/g,"").trim();
        if(!text||text.length<2||text.length>60||text.split(" ").length>7)return"";
        const lower=text.toLowerCase();
        if(/\b(?:xp|experience|level|levels|gold|silver|copper|infinite|max\s+stats?|one\s+second|instant(?:ly)?|gain|gained|become\s+god|all\s+stats?)\b/.test(lower))return"";
        const banned=new Set(["magic","ability","skill","talent","passive","power","attack","move","technique","training","it","that","this","something","anything","everything","nothing"]);
        if(banned.has(lower))return"";
        return text;
      },
      normalizeAbilityKey(value){const U=globalThis.AIDRPG&&globalThis.AIDRPG.Utils?globalThis.AIDRPG.Utils:null;return U&&typeof U.toKey==="function"?U.toKey(String(value||"")):String(value||"").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,"_").replace(/^_+|_+$/g,"");},
      cleanFormationContext(raw){return String(raw||"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim().slice(0,220);},
      inferMethod(raw,type){
        const lower=String(raw||"").toLowerCase();
        if(/\bcast|spell|mana|arcane|magic|channel|invoke\b/.test(lower))return"magical control";
        if(/\bmeditate|focus|breath|breathing|mind|mental\b/.test(lower))return"mental focus";
        if(/\bstrike|slash|punch|kick|stance|martial|sword|blade|bow|weapon|fist\b/.test(lower))return"physical technique";
        if(/\bpart of (?:myself|yourself|body)|adapt|resist|withstand|tolerate\b/.test(lower))return"bodily adaptation";
        if(type==="passive")return"passive adaptation";
        if(type==="talent")return"trained style";
        return"practical action";
      },
      inferTarget(raw,intent){
        if(intent&&intent.targetHint)return String(intent.targetHint).trim();
        const match=String(raw||"").match(/\b(?:at|against|toward|towards|on|into|for)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.,;!?]{2,60})/i);
        return match&&match[1]?this.cleanAbilityName(match[1])||String(match[1]).trim():"";
      },
      inferEffect(raw,name,target){
        const text=String(raw||"");
        const purpose=text.match(/\b(?:to|so that|in order to|so I can|so you can)\s+([^.!?;,]{4,100})/i);
        if(purpose&&purpose[1])return purpose[1].replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
        const lower=text.toLowerCase();
        if(/\bdefend|guard|protect|block|shield|ward|deflect\b/.test(lower))return target?"protects against "+target:"defensive protection";
        if(/\bmove|dash|step|evade|retreat|advance|blink\b/.test(lower))return"mobility and positioning";
        if(/\bstrike|attack|hit|slash|stab|blast|burn|shock|smash\b/.test(lower))return target?"offensive pressure against "+target:"offensive pressure";
        if(/\bdetect|sense|track|scan|read|inspect\b/.test(lower))return"detection and awareness";
        if(/\bresist|withstand|tolerate|adapt|recover|stabilize\b/.test(lower))return"sustainment and resistance";
        return name?"use of "+name:"general application";
      },
      inferIntendedFunction(intent,raw,effect){
        if(effect&&effect!=="general")return effect;
        if(intent&&intent.primaryType==="train")return"trained practice";
        if(intent&&intent.primaryType==="use_ability")return"active use";
        return"general";
      },
      inferResourceGuess(raw,type,method){
        const lower=String(raw||"").toLowerCase();
        if(type==="passive")return"none to activate; natural use may still cause fatigue";
        const hasMagic=/\b(mp|mana|spell|magic|arcane|channel|cast|invoke)\b/.test(lower)||method==="magical control";
        const hasPhysical=/\b(ep|stamina|sweat|tired|physical|body|strike|run|jump|sword|fist|stance|martial)\b/.test(lower)||method==="physical technique";
        if(hasMagic&&hasPhysical)return"mixed MP and EP";
        if(hasMagic)return"MP";
        if(hasPhysical||type==="ability"||type==="talent")return"EP/time/physical effort";
        return"contextual";
      },
      inferCostGuess(raw,type,resource){
        const lower=String(raw||"").toLowerCase();
        if(type==="passive")return"no activation cost; related actions still cost normal effort";
        if(/\bsmall|minor|little|low\s+cost\b/.test(lower))return"low "+resource;
        if(/\bheavy|large|high|draining|exhausting|costly\b/.test(lower))return"high "+resource;
        if(resource==="MP")return"moderate MP until refined";
        if(resource==="mixed MP and EP")return"mixed MP/EP strain until refined";
        if(resource==="EP/time/physical effort")return"moderate EP or time";
        return"context-dependent cost";
      },
      extractLimitations(raw){
        const lower=String(raw||"").toLowerCase();
        const out=[];
        if(/\brequires?\s+concentration\b/.test(lower))out.push("requires concentration");
        if(/\bclose range|nearby|touch\b/.test(lower))out.push("limited range");
        if(/\bline of sight\b/.test(lower))out.push("requires line of sight");
        if(/\bwhile\s+standing|must\s+stand|stance\b/.test(lower))out.push("stance or positioning dependent");
        if(/\bonly\s+(?:works|functions|triggers)\b[^.!?]{0,60}/.test(lower))out.push(this.makeEvidenceSnippet(raw.match(/\bonly\s+(?:works|functions|triggers)\b[^.!?]{0,60}/i)[0]));
        return out;
      },
      extractRisks(raw){
        const lower=String(raw||"").toLowerCase();
        const out=[];
        if(/\bunstable|misfire|backfire\b/.test(lower))out.push("may misfire or backfire");
        if(/\bexhaust|exhausting|draining|fatigue|tired\b/.test(lower))out.push("can cause fatigue");
        if(/\bpain|burns? you|hurts? you|strain\b/.test(lower))out.push("can strain or harm the user");
        if(/\blose control|out of control\b/.test(lower))out.push("control risk");
        return out;
      },
      buildKeyPhrases(name,intent,raw){
        const values=[];const push=(v)=>{const t=String(v||"").trim();if(t&&values.indexOf(t)===-1)values.push(t);};
        push(name);push(this.normalizeAbilityKey(name));
        if(intent&&intent.abilityHint)push(intent.abilityHint);
        if(intent&&intent.trainingHint)push(intent.trainingHint);
        if(intent&&intent.styleHint)push(intent.styleHint);
        const quoted=String(raw||"").match(/["“]([^"”]{2,60})["”]/);
        if(quoted&&quoted[1])push(quoted[1]);
        return values.slice(0,8);
      },
      extractSemanticTags(rawText){
        const lower=String(rawText||"").toLowerCase();
        const tags=[];const push=(v)=>{if(v&&tags.indexOf(v)===-1)tags.push(v);};
        const checks=[
          ["fire",/\bfire|burn|flame|ember|heat|warmth\b/],["ice",/\bice|frost|cold|freeze|chill\b/],["lightning",/\blightning|storm|shock|thunder\b/],["water",/\bwater|rain|river|tide|wave\b/],["earth",/\bearth|stone|rock|metal|sand\b/],["wind",/\bwind|air|gust|breath\b/],["shadow",/\bshadow|dark|veil|obscure\b/],["light",/\blight|radiant|glow|holy\b/],
          ["defense",/\bguard|block|brace|shield|ward|protect|deflect\b/],["mobility",/\bdash|rush|evade|retreat|advance|blink|step\b/],["detection",/\bscan|detect|sense|track|survey|inspect|read\b/],["recovery",/\bheal|recover|restore|stabilize\b/],["martial",/\bweapon|blade|spear|arrow|bow|hammer|fist|kick|punch|sword\b/],["social",/\bpersuade|convince|intimidate|negotiate|deceive\b/],["craft",/\bcraft|forge|cook|brew|sew|build|repair\b/],["survival",/\bfish|hunt|track|forage|camp|climb|swim\b/],["passive",/\bpassive|always[- ]on|constant|part of (?:myself|yourself|body)\b/],["training",/\btrain|practice|drill|repeat|refine|hone|study\b/]
        ];
        for(let i=0;i<checks.length;i+=1)if(checks[i][1].test(lower))push(checks[i][0]);
        return tags;
      },
      isClearlyFailedOutput(rawText){
        const lower=String(rawText||"").toLowerCase();
        return /\b(fail to|fails to|failed to|cannot|can't|unable to|nothing happens|no effect|fizzles|misfires|does not activate|doesn't activate|loses control|backfires)\b/.test(lower);
      },
      inferOutputIntendedFunction(rawText,abilityName){
        const raw=String(rawText||"");const lower=raw.toLowerCase();const lowerName=String(abilityName||"").toLowerCase();
        if(lowerName&&lower.indexOf(lowerName)===-1&&!/\b(skill|talent|passive|ability|technique|style)\b/.test(lower))return"general";
        return this.inferEffect(raw,abilityName,"")||"general";
      },
      captureDerivedAbilityVariation(rawText,root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const raw=String(rawText||"");
        if(!raw.trim())return 0;
        const patterns=[
          /\b([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}(?:\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}){0,3})\s+(?:becomes|became|forms?|formed|turns?\s+into|turned\s+into|expands?\s+into|expanded\s+into|shifts?\s+into|shifted\s+into|surges?\s+into|surged\s+into|refines?\s+into|refined\s+into)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+)?([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}(?:\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}){0,3})\b[^.!?]{0,160}/i,
          /\b(?:turn|shape|refine|adapt)\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}(?:\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}){0,3})\s+into\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+)?([a-z][a-z'’-]{2,30}(?:\s+[a-z][a-z'’-]{2,30}){0,4})\b[^.!?]{0,160}/i
        ];
        let match=null;
        for(let i=0;i<patterns.length;i+=1){match=raw.match(patterns[i]);if(match)break;}

        const sourceName=this.cleanAbilityName(match[1]);
        const variationName=this.cleanAbilityName(match[2]);
        if(!sourceName||!variationName||variationName.toLowerCase()===sourceName.toLowerCase())return 0;
        if(/\b(?:stable|reliable|new|basic|active|passive|confirmed|developed)\s+(?:ability|skill|talent|technique)\b/i.test(variationName))return 0;

        const effect=this.inferEffect(raw,variationName,target);

          rawName:variationName,name:variationName,normalizedKey:this.normalizeAbilityKey(variationName),type:type,categoryGuess:type,mode:"learn",lifecycleStage:"confirmed",confidence:0.78,

        };
        let changes=this.applyCandidateOutcome(candidate,raw,root);
        const recordId=root.abilities.byKey[this.normalizeAbilityKey(variationName)];
        const record=recordId&&root.abilities.byId?root.abilities.byId[recordId]:null;
        if(record){

          if(record.meaning.sourceAbilityName!==sourceRecord.identity.name){record.meaning.sourceAbilityName=sourceRecord.identity.name;changes+=1;}

        }

      extractRevisionCandidates(rawText,root=state.aidrpg){

      captureObservedUseSignals(rawText,root=state.aidrpg){

        }

      },
      tierFromXp(xp){const value=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(xp||0)));if(value>=40)return 5;if(value>=22)return 4;if(value>=10)return 3;if(value>=4)return 2;return 1;},
      masteryLabelForTier(tier){const value=Math.max(1,Math.floor(Number(tier||1)));if(value>=5)return"mastered";if(value===4)return"expert";if(value===3)return"adept";if(value===2)return"practiced";return"novice";},
      makeEvidenceSnippet(value){return String(value||"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim().slice(0,180);},

      processOutput(rawText,
      root=state.aidrpg){

      applyValidatedConsequences(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const A=globalThis.AIDRPG;
        const Guard=A.OperationGuard;
        const pending=root.pending||{
        };
        const validated=Array.isArray(pending.validatedConsequences)?pending.validatedConsequences: [];
        let changes=0;
        for(let i=0; i<validated.length; i+=1){
          const candidate=validated[i];
          if(!candidate||candidate.category!=="player"||candidate._traitApplied===true){
            continue;
          }
          const payload=candidate.payload||{
          };
          const status=String(payload.status||"").trim();
          const commit=()=>{
            let localChanges=0;
            if(candidate.type==="status_gain"&&status){
              localChanges+=this.applyConditionCandidate({
                name: status,
                mode: "active",
                severity: this.validationSeverityForStatus(status)
              },
              candidate.evidence||status,
              root);
            }
            else if(candidate.type==="status_loss"&&status){
              localChanges+=this.removeConditionByName(status,
              root);
            }
            return localChanges;
          };
          const localChanges=Guard&&typeof Guard.applyOnce==="function"?Guard.applyOnce({
            kind: "trait_"+String(candidate.type||"change"),
            target: status||String(candidate.type||"trait"),
            payload: payload,
            sourceId: candidate.id||""
          },
          commit,
          root): commit();
          changes+=localChanges;
          candidate._traitApplied=true;
        }
        return changes;
      },

        for(let i=0; i<names.length; i+=1){
          const name=names[i];
          const re=new RegExp("\\b(?:no longer|without|free of|recovered from|recovers from|recovers from|cured of|cure[d]? of|ends|ended|fades|faded|stops|stopped|lifts|lifted|clears|cleared)\\b[^.!?]{0,30}\\b"+name+"\\b|\\b"+name+"\\b[^.!?]{0,20}\\b(?:ends|ended|fades|faded|stops|stopped|lifts|lifted|clears|cleared)\\b",
          "i");
          if(re.test(raw)){
            removals.push(name);
          }
        }
        return removals;
      },
      extractTraitCandidates(rawText){
        const raw=String(rawText||"");
        const candidates=[];
        const patterns=[{
          category: "immunity",
          re: /\b(?:immune|immunity)\s+to\s+([a-z][a-z -]{1,30})\b/gi
        },
        {
          category: "resistance",
          re: /\b(?:resistant|resistance)\s+to\s+([a-z][a-z -]{1,30})\b/gi
        },
        {
          category: "vulnerability",
          re: /\b(?:vulnerable|susceptible|weak)\s+to\s+([a-z][a-z -]{1,30})\b/gi
        },
        {
          category: "adaptation",
          re: /\b(?:adapted|acclimated|accustomed|tolerant)\s+to\s+([a-z][a-z -]{1,30})\b/gi
        },
        {
          category: "sensitivity",
          re: /\b(?:sensitive)\s+to\s+([a-z][a-z -]{1,30})\b/gi
        },
        {
          category: "resistance",
          re: /\bresists?\s+([a-z][a-z -]{1,30})\b/gi
        }];
        for(let p=0; p<patterns.length; p+=1){
          let match;
          while((match=patterns[p].re.exec(raw))){
            const domain=this.cleanDomainName(match[1]);
            if(!domain)continue;
            candidates.push({
              category: patterns[p].category,
              domain: domain
            });
          }
        }
        return candidates;
      },
      inferConditionMode(rawText,
      name){
        const raw=String(rawText||"").toLowerCase();
        const lowerName=String(name||"").toLowerCase();
        const permanentRe=new RegExp("\\b(?:permanent|chronic|lingering|lasting|lasting permanently|won't heal|will not heal)\\b[^.!?]{0,24}\\b"+lowerName+"\\b|\\b"+lowerName+"\\b[^.!?]{0,24}\\b(?:permanent|chronic|lingering|lasting)\\b",
        "i");
        if(permanentRe.test(raw))return"permanent";
        return"active";
      },
      inferSeverity(rawText,
      name){
        const raw=String(rawText||"").toLowerCase();
        const lowerName=String(name||"").toLowerCase();
        const severeRe=new RegExp("\\b(?:severe|serious|deep|major|critical|grave)\\b[^.!?]{0,18}\\b"+lowerName+"\\b|\\b"+lowerName+"\\b[^.!?]{0,18}\\b(?:severe|serious|deep|major|critical|grave)\\b",
        "i");
        if(severeRe.test(raw))return"severe";
        const minorRe=new RegExp("\\b(?:light|minor|slight|faint)\\b[^.!?]{0,18}\\b"+lowerName+"\\b|\\b"+lowerName+"\\b[^.!?]{0,18}\\b(?:light|minor|slight|faint)\\b",
        "i");
        if(minorRe.test(raw))return"minor";
        return"moderate";
      },
      cleanDomainName(value){
        const text=String(value||"").toLowerCase().replace(/^(?:the|an|a)\s+/i,
        "").replace(/[.,;:!?]+$/g,
        "").replace(/\s+/g,
        " ").trim();
        if(!text)return"";
        if(text.length>24)return"";
        if(/\d/.test(text))return"";
        if(text.split(" ").length>3)return"";
        const banned=new Set(["it",
        "them",
        "that",
        "this",
        "everything",
        "anything"]);
        if(banned.has(text))return"";
        return text;
      },
      makeRecordName(category,
      domain){
        const cleanDomain=this.cleanDomainName(domain);
        if(!cleanDomain)return"";
        if(category==="adaptation")return cleanDomain+" acclimation";
        if(category==="sensitivity")return cleanDomain+" sensitivity";
        if(category==="immunity")return cleanDomain+" immunity";
        if(category==="vulnerability")return cleanDomain+" vulnerability";
        return cleanDomain+" resistance";
      },
      findOrCreateRecord(name,
      kind,
      category,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        this.init(root);
        const U=globalThis.AIDRPG.Utils;
        const traitState=root.player.traitState;
        const normalized=U.toKey(String(name||""));
        if(!normalized)return null;
        let recordId=traitState.byKey[normalized]||"";
        if(recordId&&traitState.byId[recordId]){
          return traitState.byId[recordId];
        }
        recordId=U.makeId(kind==="trait"?"trait": "condition");
        const turn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0;
        const record={
          identity: {
            id: recordId,
            name: String(name||""),
            kind: kind==="trait"?"trait": "condition",
            category: String(category||(kind==="trait"?"trait": "condition"))
          },
          state: {
            mode: "active",
            severity: "moderate",
            stage: 1,
            startedTurn: turn,
            lastConfirmedTurn: turn,
            lastChangedTurn: turn
          },
          meaning: {
            originContext: "",
            stableFlags: [],
            domain: ""
          },
          progression: {
            exposureCount: 0,
            adaptationScore: 0,
            growthHooks: []
          }
        };
        traitState.byId[recordId]=record;
        traitState.byKey[normalized]=recordId;
        traitState.allIds.push(recordId);
        if(kind==="trait"){
          traitState.traitIds.push(recordId);
        }
        else {
          traitState.conditionIds.push(recordId);
        }
        return record;
      },
      applyConditionCandidate(candidate,
      rawText,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!candidate||typeof candidate!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const record=this.findOrCreateRecord(candidate.name,
        "condition",
        "condition",
        root);
        if(!record)return 0;
        const turn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0;
        let changes=0;
        if(record.state.mode!==String(candidate.mode||"active")){
          record.state.mode=String(candidate.mode||"active");
          changes+=1;
        }
        if(record.state.severity!==String(candidate.severity||"moderate")){
          record.state.severity=String(candidate.severity||"moderate");
          changes+=1;
        }
        if(record.state.lastConfirmedTurn!==turn){
          record.state.lastConfirmedTurn=turn;
          changes+=1;
        }
        if(record.state.lastChangedTurn!==turn){
          record.state.lastChangedTurn=turn;
          changes+=1;
        }
        const evidence=this.makeEvidenceSnippet(rawText);
        if(record.meaning.originContext!==evidence){
          record.meaning.originContext=evidence;
          changes+=1;
        }
        if(record.identity.category!=="condition"){
          record.identity.category="condition";
          changes+=1;
        }
        return changes;
      },
      removeConditionByName(name,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        this.init(root);
        const U=globalThis.AIDRPG.Utils;
        const traitState=root.player.traitState;
        const key=U.toKey(String(name||""));
        if(!key)return 0;
        const recordId=traitState.byKey[key];
        if(!recordId||!traitState.byId[recordId])return 0;
        const record=traitState.byId[recordId];
        if(record.identity.kind!=="condition")return 0;
        delete traitState.byId[recordId];
        delete traitState.byKey[key];
        this.removeValueLocal(traitState.allIds,
        recordId);
        this.removeValueLocal(traitState.conditionIds,
        recordId);
        return 1;
      },
      applyTraitCandidate(candidate,
      rawText,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!candidate||typeof candidate!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const traitState=root.player.traitState;
        const name=this.makeRecordName(candidate.category,
        candidate.domain);
        if(!name)return 0;
        const record=this.findOrCreateRecord(name,
        "trait",
        candidate.category,
        root);
        if(!record)return 0;
        const turn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0;
        let changes=0;
        if(record.identity.category!==candidate.category){
          record.identity.category=candidate.category;
          changes+=1;
        }
        if(record.meaning.domain!==candidate.domain){
          record.meaning.domain=candidate.domain;
          changes+=1;
        }
        if(record.state.mode!=="permanent"){
          record.state.mode="permanent";
          changes+=1;
        }
        if(record.state.lastConfirmedTurn!==turn){
          record.state.lastConfirmedTurn=turn;
          changes+=1;
        }
        if(record.state.lastChangedTurn!==turn){
          record.state.lastChangedTurn=turn;
          changes+=1;
        }
        const evidence=this.makeEvidenceSnippet(rawText);
        if(record.meaning.originContext!==evidence){
          record.meaning.originContext=evidence;
          changes+=1;
        }
        if(candidate.category==="resistance"){
          changes+=this.pushUniqueLocal(traitState.resistanceTags,
          candidate.domain);
        }
        else if(candidate.category==="immunity"){
          changes+=this.pushUniqueLocal(traitState.immunityTags,
          candidate.domain);
        }
        else if(candidate.category==="vulnerability"){
          changes+=this.pushUniqueLocal(traitState.vulnerabilityTags,
          candidate.domain);
        }
        else if(candidate.category==="adaptation"){
          changes+=this.pushUniqueLocal(traitState.adaptationTags,
          candidate.domain);
        }
        else if(candidate.category==="sensitivity"){
          changes+=this.pushUniqueLocal(traitState.sensitivityTags,
          candidate.domain);
        }
        return changes;
      },
      captureExposureSignals(rawText,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        this.init(root);
        const raw=String(rawText||"").toLowerCase();
        const traitState=root.player.traitState;
        const domains=this.extractExposureDomains(raw);
        let changes=0;
        for(let i=0; i<domains.length; i+=1){
          const domain=domains[i];
          if(!traitState.exposureByDomain[domain]||typeof traitState.exposureByDomain[domain]!=="object"){
            traitState.exposureByDomain[domain]={
              count: 0,
              lastTurn: 0
            };
          }
          traitState.exposureByDomain[domain].count+=1;
          traitState.exposureByDomain[domain].lastTurn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0;
          changes+=1;
          if(traitState.exposureByDomain[domain].count>=3){
            changes+=this.pushUniqueLocal(traitState.growthHooks,
            domain+"_adaptation_candidate");
          }
        }
        return changes;
      },
      extractExposureDomains(rawText){
        const lower=String(rawText||"").toLowerCase();
        const found=[];
        const push=function(value){
          if(found.indexOf(value)===-1)found.push(value);
        };
        if(/\bfire|burn|flame|ember|heat\b/.test(lower))push("fire");
        if(/\bcold|freeze|frost|ice|chill\b/.test(lower))push("cold");
        if(/\bpoison|venom|toxic\b/.test(lower))push("poison");
        if(/\blightning|storm|shock|thunder\b/.test(lower))push("lightning");
        if(/\bshadow|dark|gloom|veil\b/.test(lower))push("shadow");
        if(/\blight|radiant|sunlight|holy\b/.test(lower))push("light");
        if(/\bwater|rain|soaked|drowned|flood\b/.test(lower))push("water");
        if(/\bdisease|plague|sick|infect\b/.test(lower))push("disease");
        if(/\brot|decay|wither|blight\b/.test(lower))push("rot");
        if(/\bmagic|mana|arcane|spell\b/.test(lower))push("magic");
        return found;
      },
      syncLegacyPlayerArrays(root=state.aidrpg){
        this.init(root);
        const player=root.player;
        const traitState=player.traitState;
        let changes=0;
        const nextActive=[];
        const nextPermanent=[];
        for(let i=0; i<traitState.conditionIds.length; i+=1){
          const record=traitState.byId[traitState.conditionIds[i]];
          if(!record||!record.identity)continue;
          if(record.state.mode==="permanent"){
            nextPermanent.push(record.identity.name);
          }
          else {
            nextActive.push(record.identity.name);
          }
        }
        changes+=this.replaceSimpleArray(player.conditions.active,
        nextActive);
        changes+=this.replaceSimpleArray(player.conditions.permanent,
        nextPermanent);
        changes+=this.replaceSimpleArray(player.conditions.vulnerabilities,
        traitState.vulnerabilityTags);
        changes+=this.replaceSimpleArray(player.conditions.immunities,
        traitState.immunityTags);
        return changes;
      },
      getCompactSummary(root=state.aidrpg,
      maxCount=2){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return"";
        this.init(root);
        const player=root.player||{
        };
        const traitState=player.traitState||{
        };
        const parts=[];
        const active=Array.isArray(player.conditions.active)?player.conditions.active.slice(0,
        maxCount): [];
        const permanent=Array.isArray(player.conditions.permanent)?player.conditions.permanent.slice(0,
        maxCount): [];
        const resistances=Array.isArray(traitState.resistanceTags)?traitState.resistanceTags.slice(0,
        maxCount): [];
        const adaptations=Array.isArray(traitState.adaptationTags)?traitState.adaptationTags.slice(0,
        maxCount): [];
        const sensitivities=Array.isArray(traitState.sensitivityTags)?traitState.sensitivityTags.slice(0,
        maxCount): [];
        if(active.length)parts.push("Active: "+active.join(", "));
        if(permanent.length)parts.push("Permanent: "+permanent.join(", "));
        if(resistances.length)parts.push("Resist: "+resistances.join(", "));
        if(adaptations.length)parts.push("Adapt: "+adaptations.join(", "));
        if(sensitivities.length)parts.push("Sensitive: "+sensitivities.join(", "));
        return parts.join(" | ");
      },
      makeEvidenceSnippet(value){
        return String(value||"").replace(/\s+/g,
        " ").trim().slice(0,
        140);
      },
      replaceSimpleArray(target,
      nextValues){
        if(!Array.isArray(target))return 0;
        const next=Array.isArray(nextValues)?nextValues.slice(): [];
        let changed=0;
        if(target.length!==next.length){
          changed=1;
        }
        else {
          for(let i=0; i<target.length; i+=1){
            if(target[i]!==next[i]){
              changed=1;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        if(!changed)return 0;
        target.splice(0,
        target.length);
        for(let i=0; i<next.length; i+=1){
          target.push(next[i]);
        }
        return 1;
      },
      pushUniqueLocal(list,
      value){
        if(!Array.isArray(list))return 0;
        const text=String(value||"").trim();
        if(!text)return 0;
        if(list.indexOf(text)!==-1)return 0;
        list.push(text);
        return 1;
      },
      removeValueLocal(list,
      value){
        if(!Array.isArray(list))return 0;
        const idx=list.indexOf(value);
        if(idx===-1)return 0;
        list.splice(idx,
        1);
        return 1;
      }
    },
    ConsequenceParser: {
      init(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return null;
        if(!root.pending||typeof root.pending!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.pending)){
          root.pending={
          };
        }
        const pending=root.pending;
        if(!Array.isArray(pending.outputCandidates))pending.outputCandidates=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(pending.unresolvedConsequences))pending.unresolvedConsequences=[];
        if(!pending.lastConsequenceParse||typeof pending.lastConsequenceParse!=="object"||Array.isArray(pending.lastConsequenceParse)){
          pending.lastConsequenceParse={
          };
        }
        return pending;
      },
      processOutput(rawText,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const A=globalThis.AIDRPG;
        const U=A.Utils;
        const pending=root.pending;
        const raw=String(rawText||"");
        pending.outputCandidates=[];
        pending.unresolvedConsequences=[];
        if(!raw.trim()){
          return 0;
        }
        if(A.TurnEngine&&typeof A.TurnEngine.isDuplicateCurrentOutput==="function"){
          if(A.TurnEngine.isDuplicateCurrentOutput()){
            return 0;
          }
        }
        const candidates=this.dedupeCandidates([].concat(this.extractPlayerCandidates(raw,
        root)).concat(this.extractItemCandidates(raw,
        root)).concat(this.extractWorldCandidates(raw,
        root)).concat(this.extractActorCandidates(raw,
        root)).concat(this.extractTimeCandidates(raw,
        root)).concat(this.extractQuestCandidates(raw,
        root)).concat(this.extractReputationCandidates(raw,
        root)));
        for(let i=0; i<candidates.length; i+=1){
          const candidate=candidates[i];
          if(Number(candidate.confidence||0)>=0.72){
            pending.outputCandidates.push(candidate);
          }
          else {
            pending.unresolvedConsequences.push(candidate);
          }
        }
        pending.lastConsequenceParse={
          turn: root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0,
          candidateCount: candidates.length,
          committedCount: pending.outputCandidates.length,
          unresolvedCount: pending.unresolvedConsequences.length
        };
        if(candidates.length&&U&&typeof U.logParse==="function"){
          U.logParse("ConsequenceParser: "+pending.outputCandidates.length+" high-confidence / "+pending.unresolvedConsequences.length+" tentative");
        }
        return candidates.length;
      },
      extractPlayerCandidates(rawText,
