      processOutput(rawText,root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        this.refreshIndex(root);
        let changes=0;
        changes+=this.ensureProtectedStarterCards(root);
        changes+=this.queueDirtyFromMeta(root);
        changes+=this.processDirtyQueue(root);
        return changes;
      },
      getStoryCardApi(){
        try{if(typeof storyCards!=="undefined"&&storyCards)return storyCards;}catch(_error){}
        try{if(globalThis&&globalThis.storyCards)return globalThis.storyCards;}catch(_error2){}
        try{if(typeof info==="object"&&info&&info.storyCards)return info.storyCards;}catch(_error3){}
        return null;
      },
      getStoryCardArray(){
        const api=this.getStoryCardApi();
        if(Array.isArray(api))return api;
        if(api&&Array.isArray(api.cards))return api.cards;
        try{if(globalThis&&Array.isArray(globalThis.storyCards))return globalThis.storyCards;}catch(_error){}
        return null;
      },
      getAllCards(){
        const arr=this.getStoryCardArray();
        if(Array.isArray(arr))return arr.map(function(card,index){return{raw:card,index:index};});
        const api=this.getStoryCardApi();
        try{
          if(api&&typeof api.getCards==="function"){
            const value=api.getCards();
            return Array.isArray(value)?value.map(function(card,index){return{raw:card,index:index};}):[];
          }
          if(api&&typeof api.getAll==="function"){
            const value=api.getAll();
            return Array.isArray(value)?value.map(function(card,index){return{raw:card,index:index};}):[];
          }
        }catch(_error2){}
        return [];
      },
      stableHash(value){
        if(globalThis.AIDRPG&&globalThis.AIDRPG.TurnEngine&&typeof globalThis.AIDRPG.TurnEngine.stableHash==="function")return globalThis.AIDRPG.TurnEngine.stableHash(value);
        const str=String(value||"");let hash=5381;
        for(let i=0;i<str.length;i+=1){hash=((hash<<5)+hash)^str.charCodeAt(i);hash=hash>>>0;}
        return String(hash);
      },
      cleanCardText(value,maxChars){
        const limit=Math.max(40,Math.floor(Number(maxChars||1600)));
        return String(value==null?"":value).replace(/[\u0000-\u0008\u000b\u000c\u000e-\u001f\u007f]+/g," ").replace(/\r\n/g,"\n").replace(/[ \t]+/g," ").replace(/\n{3,}/g,"\n\n").trim().slice(0,limit);
      },
      cleanInline(value,maxChars){
        const limit=Math.max(20,Math.floor(Number(maxChars||160)));
        return String(value==null?"":value).replace(/\s+/g," ").replace(/[<>]/g,"").trim().slice(0,limit);
      },
      toKey(value){
        const U=globalThis.AIDRPG&&globalThis.AIDRPG.Utils;
        return U&&typeof U.toKey==="function"?U.toKey(value):String(value||"").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,"_").replace(/^_+|_+$/g,"");
      },
      makeNamespace(family,id,root=state.aidrpg){
        const cards=this.init(root)||{};
        const prefix=cards.config&&cards.config.namespacePrefix?cards.config.namespacePrefix:"SYS:AIDRPG";
        const cleanFamily=this.toKey(family||"misc").toUpperCase();
        const cleanId=this.toKey(id||"summary").toUpperCase();
        return cleanFamily&&cleanId?prefix+":"+cleanFamily+":"+cleanId:"";
      },
      makeTitle(namespace,displayName){
        const label=this.cleanInline(displayName||"AIDRPG Card",80);
        return label||String(namespace||"AIDRPG Card");
      },
      normalizeKeys(keys,namespace){
        const out=[];
        const push=(value)=>{const clean=this.cleanInline(value,60);if(clean&&out.indexOf(clean)===-1)out.push(clean);};
        push(namespace);
        if(Array.isArray(keys)){for(let i=0;i<keys.length&&out.length<10;i+=1)push(keys[i]);}
        else if(typeof keys==="string"){keys.split(/[,;\n]/).forEach(push);}
        return out.slice(0,10);
      },
      keysToString(keys){
        const clean=this.normalizeKeys(keys,"");
        return clean.join(", ");
      },
      makeCardSpec(family,id,displayName,body,keys,root=state.aidrpg){
        const cards=this.init(root)||{};
        const namespace=this.makeNamespace(family,id,root);
        const title=this.makeTitle(namespace,displayName||id||family);
        const bodyText=this.cleanCardText(body||"",cards.config?cards.config.maxCardTextChars:1600);
        const cleanKeys=this.normalizeKeys(keys,namespace);
        const entry=bodyText;
        const keysString=this.keysToString(cleanKeys);
        return{namespace:namespace,family:String(family||"misc"),id:String(id||"summary"),title:title,entry:entry,body:bodyText,keys:cleanKeys,keysString:keysString,type:cards.config&&cards.config.cardType?cards.config.cardType:"AIDRPG",hash:this.stableHash(title+"|"+entry+"|"+keysString)};
      },
      extractNamespaceFromText(value,root=state.aidrpg){
        const cards=this.init(root)||{};
        const prefix=cards.config&&cards.config.namespacePrefix?cards.config.namespacePrefix:"SYS:AIDRPG";
        const escaped=prefix.replace(/[-\/\\^$*+?.()|[\]{}]/g,"\\$&");
        const match=String(value||"").match(new RegExp("\\b"+escaped+":[A-Z0-9_]+:[A-Z0-9_]+\\b","i"));
        return match&&match[0]?match[0].toUpperCase():"";
      },
      extractNamespaceFromCard(card,root=state.aidrpg){
        const raw=card&&card.raw?card.raw:card;
        if(!raw||typeof raw!=="object")return"";
        const fields=[raw.namespace,raw.title,raw.name,raw.entry,raw.text,raw.description,Array.isArray(raw.keys)?raw.keys.join(" "):raw.keys,Array.isArray(raw.keywords)?raw.keywords.join(" "):raw.keywords];
        for(let i=0;i<fields.length;i+=1){const ns=this.extractNamespaceFromText(fields[i],root);if(ns)return ns;}
        return"";
      },
      isManagedCard(card,root=state.aidrpg){return !!this.extractNamespaceFromCard(card,root);},
      normalizeCardRecord(cardRef,root=state.aidrpg){
        const raw=cardRef&&cardRef.raw?cardRef.raw:(cardRef&&typeof cardRef==="object"?cardRef:{});
        const index=cardRef&&typeof cardRef.index==="number"?cardRef.index:-1;
        let keys=[];
        const rawKeys=Array.isArray(raw.keys)?raw.keys:(Array.isArray(raw.keywords)?raw.keywords:(typeof raw.keys==="string"?raw.keys.split(/[,;\n]/):(typeof raw.keywords==="string"?raw.keywords.split(/[,;\n]/):[])));
        for(let i=0;i<rawKeys.length;i+=1){const key=this.cleanInline(rawKeys[i],80);if(key)keys.push(key);}
        const entry=String(raw.entry||raw.text||raw.description||"");
        return{id:String(raw.id||raw.cardId||raw.uuid||raw._id||"").trim(),index:index,title:String(raw.title||raw.name||"").trim(),entry:entry,keys:keys,namespace:this.extractNamespaceFromCard(raw,root),raw:raw};
      },
      refreshIndex(root=state.aidrpg){
        const cards=this.init(root);if(!cards)return 0;
        const previous=cards.index&&cards.index.byNamespace&&typeof cards.index.byNamespace==="object"?Object.assign({},cards.index.byNamespace):{};
        const all=this.getAllCards();const byNamespace={};const byCardId={};const duplicateRefs=[];
        for(let i=0;i<all.length;i+=1){const n=this.normalizeCardRecord(all[i],root);if(!n.namespace)continue;const ns=n.namespace;if(!byNamespace[ns])byNamespace[ns]=[];byNamespace[ns].push({id:n.id,index:n.index,title:n.title,keys:n.keys.slice(0,8),hash:this.stableHash(n.title+"|"+n.entry+"|"+n.keys.join(","))});if(n.id)byCardId[n.id]=ns;}
        Object.keys(byNamespace).forEach(function(ns){if(byNamespace[ns].length>1)duplicateRefs.push(ns);});
        cards.index.byNamespace=byNamespace;cards.index.byCardId=byCardId;cards.duplicateRefs=duplicateRefs;cards.index.lastRefreshedTurn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0;
        this.recordGeneratedTombstones(previous,byNamespace,root);
        return Object.keys(byNamespace).length;
      },
      parseNamespace(namespace){const p=String(namespace||"").toUpperCase().split(":");if(p.length<4)return null;return{prefix:p.slice(0,2).join(":"),family:this.toKey(p[2]),id:this.toKey(p.slice(3).join("_"))};},
      isProtectedNamespace(namespace,root=state.aidrpg){const cards=this.init(root)||{};const ns=String(namespace||"").toUpperCase();if(!ns)return false;const protectedList=cards.protected&&Array.isArray(cards.protected.namespaces)?cards.protected.namespaces:[];if(protectedList.indexOf(ns)!==-1)return true;try{const specs=this.getProtectedStarterSpecs(root)||[];for(let i=0;i<specs.length;i++){if(String(specs[i].namespace||"").toUpperCase()===ns)return true;}}catch(_e){}return false;},
      isGeneratedNamespace(namespace,root=state.aidrpg){const p=this.parseNamespace(namespace);if(!p)return false;if(this.isProtectedNamespace(namespace,root))return false;return ["actor","entity","route","item","ability","managed"].indexOf(p.family)!==-1;},
      recordGeneratedTombstones(previous,current,root=state.aidrpg){const cards=this.init(root);if(!cards)return 0;let changes=0;Object.keys(previous||{}).forEach(ns=>{if(current&&current[ns])return;if(!this.isGeneratedNamespace(ns,root))return;if(cards.generatedTombstones[ns])return;const parsed=this.parseNamespace(ns)||{};cards.generatedTombstones[ns]={namespace:ns,family:parsed.family||"generated",id:parsed.id||"",deletedTurn:root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0,lastKnownCanonTurn:this.getLastCanonTurn(parsed.family,parsed.id,root),reason:"missing_from_storyCards_index"};cards.tombstoneHistory.push(cards.generatedTombstones[ns]);while(cards.tombstoneHistory.length>40)cards.tombstoneHistory.shift();changes++;});return changes;},
      getLastCanonTurn(family,id,root=state.aidrpg){let turn=0;const f=String(family||"");const key=this.toKey(id||"");if(f==="actor"&&root.actors&&root.actors.byId&&root.actors.byId[key])turn=Number(root.actors.byId[key].lastSeenTurn||root.actors.byId[key].lastUpdatedTurn||0);if(f==="entity"&&root.world&&root.world.entitiesById&&root.world.entitiesById[key]){const e=root.world.entitiesById[key];turn=Number(e.lastUpdatedTurn||e.updatedTurn||0);}if(f==="ability"&&root.abilities&&root.abilities.byId&&root.abilities.byId[key]){const a=root.abilities.byId[key];turn=Number((a.lifecycle&&a.lifecycle.lastUpdatedTurn)||a.updatedTurn||0);}return turn||0;},
      tombstoneBlocks(spec,root=state.aidrpg){if(!spec||!spec.namespace)return false;const cards=this.init(root);const ns=String(spec.namespace||"").toUpperCase();const t=cards.generatedTombstones[ns];if(!t)return false;if(this.isProtectedNamespace(ns,root))return false;const currentTurn=this.getLastCanonTurn(t.family,t.id,root);if(currentTurn>Number(t.deletedTurn||0)){delete cards.generatedTombstones[ns];this.recordOperation("clearGeneratedTombstone",{namespace:ns,mode:"live",message:"new canon updated this generated card target"},root);return false;}return true;},
      bootstrapImmediate(root=state.aidrpg){const cards=this.init(root);if(!cards||cards.config.immediateStoryCardGeneration!==true)return 0;let changes=0;this.refreshIndex(root);changes+=this.ensureProtectedStarterCards(root);changes+=this.queueDirtyFromMeta(root);changes+=this.processDirtyQueue(root);return changes;},
      isLiveWritesEnabled(root=state.aidrpg){const cards=this.init(root);return !!(cards&&cards.config&&cards.config.liveWrites===true&&cards.config.cardSafeMode===false);},
      setLiveWrites(enabled,root=state.aidrpg){const cards=this.init(root);if(!cards)return 0;cards.config.liveWrites=enabled===true;this.recordOperation("setLiveWrites",{mode:cards.config.liveWrites?"live":"dry_run",message:cards.config.liveWrites?"live Story Card writes enabled":"live Story Card writes disabled"},root);return 1;},
      setCardSafeMode(enabled,root=state.aidrpg){const cards=this.init(root);if(!cards)return 0;cards.config.cardSafeMode=enabled!==false;this.recordOperation("setCardSafeMode",{mode:cards.config.cardSafeMode?"safe":"live",message:cards.config.cardSafeMode?"Card Safe Mode blocks live writes":"Card Safe Mode disabled"},root);return 1;},
      recordOperation(action,detail,root=state.aidrpg){
        const cards=this.init(root);if(!cards)return 0;const row=detail&&typeof detail==="object"?detail:{};
        cards.recentOperations.push({turn:root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0,action:String(action||"operation"),namespace:String(row.namespace||""),cardId:String(row.cardId||row.id||""),mode:String(row.mode||(this.isLiveWritesEnabled(root)?"live":"dry_run")),message:this.cleanInline(row.message||"",180)});
        while(cards.recentOperations.length>30)cards.recentOperations.shift();return 1;
      },
      pushPendingWrite(kind,spec,root=state.aidrpg){
        const cards=this.init(root);if(!cards||!spec||!spec.namespace)return 0;const hash=spec.hash||this.stableHash((spec.entry||"")+"|"+(spec.title||""));
        for(let i=0;i<cards.pendingWrites.length;i+=1){const row=cards.pendingWrites[i];if(row&&row.kind===kind&&row.namespace===spec.namespace&&row.hash===hash)return 0;}
        const row={turn:root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0,kind:String(kind||"write"),namespace:spec.namespace,title:spec.title||"",hash:hash};
        cards.pendingWrites.push(row);cards.dryRunLog.push({turn:row.turn,kind:row.kind,namespace:row.namespace,title:row.title,hash:row.hash,mode:"dry_run"});
        while(cards.pendingWrites.length>90)cards.pendingWrites.shift();while(cards.dryRunLog.length>90)cards.dryRunLog.shift();return 1;
      },
      safeFindCardsByNamespace(namespace,root=state.aidrpg){
        const ns=String(namespace||"").trim().toUpperCase();if(!ns)return[];const all=this.getAllCards();const out=[];
        for(let i=0;i<all.length;i+=1){const n=this.normalizeCardRecord(all[i],root);if(n.namespace===ns)out.push(n);}
        return out;
      },
      safeFindCard(namespace,root=state.aidrpg){const m=this.safeFindCardsByNamespace(namespace,root);return m.length?m[0]:null;},
      buildStoryCardPayload(spec,existingCard){
        const clean=spec&&typeof spec==="object"?spec:{};const existing=existingCard&&typeof existingCard==="object"?existingCard:{};const raw=existing.raw&&typeof existing.raw==="object"?existing.raw:existing;const id=String(existing.id||raw.id||raw.cardId||"").trim();
        const keys=this.normalizeKeys(clean.keys,clean.namespace);const keysString=this.keysToString(keys);const payload={title:String(clean.title||raw.title||clean.namespace||"AIDRPG Card"),name:String(clean.title||raw.name||clean.namespace||"AIDRPG Card"),entry:String(clean.entry||raw.entry||""),text:String(clean.entry||raw.text||""),description:String(clean.entry||raw.description||""),keys:keys,keywords:keys.slice(),keysString:keysString,type:String(clean.type||raw.type||"AIDRPG"),namespace:String(clean.namespace||existing.namespace||""),aidrpgManaged:true};
        if(id){payload.id=id;payload.cardId=id;}return payload;
      },
      tryOfficialAdd(spec,root=state.aidrpg){
        const keys=spec.keysString||this.keysToString(spec.keys);const entry=String(spec.entry||"");const type=String(spec.type||"AIDRPG");
        try{
          if(typeof addStoryCard==="function"){
            const result=addStoryCard(keys,entry,type);
            const arr=this.getStoryCardArray();
            if(Array.isArray(arr)){
              const idx=typeof result==="number"?result:arr.length-1;
              if(arr[idx]&&typeof arr[idx]==="object"){arr[idx].title=spec.title;arr[idx].name=spec.title;arr[idx].keys=keys;arr[idx].entry=entry;arr[idx].description=entry;arr[idx].type=type;arr[idx].namespace=spec.namespace;arr[idx].aidrpgManaged=true;}
            }
            return{ok:true,result:result,method:"addStoryCard(keys,entry,type)",source:"global"};
          }
        }catch(error){return{ok:false,error:error&&error.message?error.message:String(error)};}
        return{ok:false,error:"addStoryCard unavailable"};
      },
      tryOfficialUpdate(card,spec,root=state.aidrpg){
        const n=this.normalizeCardRecord(card,root);const keys=spec.keysString||this.keysToString(spec.keys);const entry=String(spec.entry||"");const type=String(spec.type||"AIDRPG");
        try{
          if(typeof updateStoryCard==="function"&&n.index>=0){
            const result=updateStoryCard(n.index,keys,entry,type);
            const arr=this.getStoryCardArray();
            if(Array.isArray(arr)&&arr[n.index]&&typeof arr[n.index]==="object"){arr[n.index].title=spec.title;arr[n.index].name=spec.title;arr[n.index].keys=keys;arr[n.index].entry=entry;arr[n.index].description=entry;arr[n.index].type=type;arr[n.index].namespace=spec.namespace;arr[n.index].aidrpgManaged=true;}
            return{ok:true,result:result,method:"updateStoryCard(index,keys,entry,type)",source:"global"};
          }
        }catch(error){return{ok:false,error:error&&error.message?error.message:String(error)};}
        if(n.raw&&typeof n.raw==="object"){
          n.raw.title=spec.title;n.raw.name=spec.title;n.raw.keys=keys;n.raw.keywords=spec.keys.slice();n.raw.entry=entry;n.raw.text=entry;n.raw.description=entry;n.raw.type=type;n.raw.namespace=spec.namespace;n.raw.aidrpgManaged=true;
          return{ok:true,result:n.raw,method:"direct card object mutation",source:"storyCards"};
        }
        return{ok:false,error:"updateStoryCard unavailable and no mutable card object"};
      },
      tryOfficialRemove(card,root=state.aidrpg){
        const n=this.normalizeCardRecord(card,root);
        try{if(typeof removeStoryCard==="function"&&n.index>=0){const result=removeStoryCard(n.index);return{ok:true,result:result,method:"removeStoryCard(index)",source:"global"};}}catch(error){return{ok:false,error:error&&error.message?error.message:String(error)};}
        const arr=this.getStoryCardArray();
        if(Array.isArray(arr)&&n.index>=0){arr.splice(n.index,1);return{ok:true,result:true,method:"storyCards.splice(index,1)",source:"storyCards"};}
        return{ok:false,error:"removeStoryCard unavailable"};
      },
      safeAddCard(spec,root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!spec||!spec.namespace)return null;
        if(!this.isLiveWritesEnabled(root)){this.pushPendingWrite("add",spec,root);this.recordOperation("safeAddCard",{namespace:spec.namespace,mode:"dry_run",message:"live writes disabled or safe mode enabled"},root);return null;}
        let result=this.tryOfficialAdd(spec,root);
        if(!result.ok){
          const arr=this.getStoryCardArray();
          if(Array.isArray(arr)){arr.push({title:spec.title,name:spec.title,keys:spec.keysString,keywords:spec.keys.slice(),entry:spec.entry,text:spec.entry,description:spec.entry,type:spec.type||"AIDRPG",namespace:spec.namespace,aidrpgManaged:true});result={ok:true,result:arr.length-1,method:"storyCards.push",source:"storyCards"};}
        }
        if(result.ok){this.recordOperation("safeAddCard",{namespace:spec.namespace,mode:"live",message:"created via "+result.source+"."+result.method},root);this.refreshIndex(root);return result.result;}
        this.pushPendingWrite("add",spec,root);this.recordOperation("safeAddCard",{namespace:spec.namespace,mode:"blocked",message:result.error||"live add failed"},root);return null;
      },
      safeUpdateCard(card,spec,root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!spec||!spec.namespace)return null;
        if(!this.isLiveWritesEnabled(root)){this.pushPendingWrite("update",spec,root);this.recordOperation("safeUpdateCard",{namespace:spec.namespace,mode:"dry_run",message:"live writes disabled or safe mode enabled"},root);return null;}
        const result=this.tryOfficialUpdate(card,spec,root);
        if(result.ok){this.recordOperation("safeUpdateCard",{namespace:spec.namespace,cardId:card&&card.id,mode:"live",message:"updated via "+result.source+"."+result.method},root);this.refreshIndex(root);return result.result||card;}
        this.pushPendingWrite("update",spec,root);this.recordOperation("safeUpdateCard",{namespace:spec.namespace,cardId:card&&card.id,mode:"blocked",message:result.error||"live update failed"},root);return null;
      },
      safeRemoveCard(card,reason,root=state.aidrpg){
        const n=this.normalizeCardRecord(card,root);if(!n.namespace&&!n.id)return 0;
        if(!this.isLiveWritesEnabled(root)){this.pushPendingWrite("remove",{namespace:n.namespace||n.id,title:n.title,hash:this.stableHash(reason||"remove")},root);this.recordOperation("safeRemoveCard",{namespace:n.namespace,cardId:n.id,mode:"dry_run",message:reason||"remove requested"},root);return 0;}
        const result=this.tryOfficialRemove(n,root);
        if(result.ok){this.recordOperation("safeRemoveCard",{namespace:n.namespace,cardId:n.id,mode:"live",message:"removed via "+result.source+"."+result.method},root);this.refreshIndex(root);return 1;}
        this.pushPendingWrite("remove",{namespace:n.namespace||n.id,title:n.title,hash:this.stableHash(reason||"remove")},root);this.recordOperation("safeRemoveCard",{namespace:n.namespace,cardId:n.id,mode:"blocked",message:result.error||"live remove failed"},root);return 0;
      },
      safeRenameDuplicateCard(card,namespace,root=state.aidrpg){
        const n=this.normalizeCardRecord(card,root);const ns=String(namespace||n.namespace||"").toUpperCase();if(!ns)return 0;
        const spec=this.makeCardSpec("duplicate","review","Duplicate Managed Card", "This duplicate managed AIDRPG Story Card was detected for "+ns+". The canonical card should be the first card with that namespace. This duplicate is preserved for manual review instead of being trusted as canon.",["duplicate",ns],root);
        spec.namespace=ns+":DUPLICATE_REVIEW";
        if(n.raw&&typeof n.raw==="object"){n.raw.title="Copy of "+(n.title||ns);n.raw.name=n.raw.title;n.raw.keys="DUPLICATE, "+ns;n.raw.namespace=spec.namespace;}
        this.recordOperation("safeRenameDuplicateCard",{namespace:ns,cardId:n.id,mode:"live",message:"duplicate managed card demoted for review"},root);return 1;
      },
      safeEnsureSingletonCard(spec,root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!spec||!spec.namespace)return null;
        if(this.tombstoneBlocks(spec,root)){this.recordOperation("tombstoneSkip",{namespace:spec.namespace,mode:"skipped",message:"generated card deletion respected until new canon updates target"},root);return null;}
        const matches=this.safeFindCardsByNamespace(spec.namespace,root);
        if(!matches.length){this.safeAddCard(spec,root);return null;}
        const primary=matches[0];
        for(let i=1;i<matches.length;i+=1)this.safeRenameDuplicateCard(matches[i],spec.namespace,root);
        const currentHash=this.stableHash((primary.title||"")+"|"+(primary.entry||"")+"|"+(primary.keys||[]).join(","));
        if(currentHash!==spec.hash)this.safeUpdateCard(primary,spec,root);
        return primary;
      },
      queueDirty(family,id,reason,payload,root=state.aidrpg){
        const cards=this.init(root);if(!cards)return 0;const cleanFamily=this.toKey(family||"misc");const cleanId=this.toKey(id||"summary");if(!cleanFamily||!cleanId)return 0;const key=cleanFamily+":"+cleanId;
        for(let i=0;i<cards.dirtyQueue.length;i+=1){const row=cards.dirtyQueue[i];if(row&&row.key===key){row.reason=String(reason||row.reason||"dirty");row.turn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0;return 0;}}
        cards.dirtyQueue.push({key:key,family:cleanFamily,id:cleanId,namespace:this.makeNamespace(cleanFamily,cleanId,root),reason:String(reason||"dirty"),turn:root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0,payloadHash:this.stableHash(payload==null?"":JSON.stringify(payload))});
        while(cards.dirtyQueue.length>cards.config.maxQueueSize)cards.dirtyQueue.shift();return 1;
      },
      queueDirtyFromMeta(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;this.init(root);const dirty=root.meta&&root.meta.dirty&&typeof root.meta.dirty==="object"?root.meta.dirty:{};let changes=0;
        if(dirty.player===true)changes+=this.queueDirty("player","summary","player_dirty",null,root);
        if(dirty.reputation===true)changes+=this.queueDirty("reputation","summary","reputation_dirty",null,root);
        if(dirty.quests===true)changes+=this.queueDirty("quest","summary","quests_dirty",null,root);
        if(dirty.time===true)changes+=this.queueDirty("time","summary","time_dirty",null,root);
        const maps=[{key:"abilities",family:"ability"},{key:"items",family:"item"},{key:"actors",family:"actor"},{key:"entities",family:"entity"},{key:"routes",family:"route"},{key:"cards",family:"managed"}];
        for(let m=0;m<maps.length;m+=1){const list=Array.isArray(dirty[maps[m].key])?dirty[maps[m].key]:[];for(let i=0;i<list.length&&i<32;i+=1)changes+=this.queueDirty(maps[m].family,list[i],maps[m].key+"_dirty",null,root);}
        return changes;
      },
      clearDirtySourceForRow(row,root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!row||!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;const dirty=root.meta&&root.meta.dirty&&typeof root.meta.dirty==="object"?root.meta.dirty:null;if(!dirty)return 0;const family=String(row.family||"");const id=String(row.id||"");let changes=0;
        const clearBool=(key)=>{if(dirty[key]===true){dirty[key]=false;changes+=1;}};
        const clearArr=(key,value)=>{if(!Array.isArray(dirty[key]))return;const before=dirty[key].length;const clean=this.toKey(value);dirty[key]=dirty[key].filter((entry)=>String(entry)!==String(value)&&this.toKey(entry)!==clean);if(dirty[key].length!==before)changes+=1;};
        if(family==="player")clearBool("player");else if(family==="reputation")clearBool("reputation");else if(family==="quest")clearBool("quests");else if(family==="time")clearBool("time");else if(family==="ability")clearArr("abilities",id);else if(family==="item")clearArr("items",id);else if(family==="actor")clearArr("actors",id);else if(family==="entity")clearArr("entities",id);else if(family==="route")clearArr("routes",id);else if(family==="managed")clearArr("cards",id);
        return changes;
      },
      processDirtyQueue(root=state.aidrpg){
        const cards=this.init(root);if(!cards||!cards.dirtyQueue.length)return 0;const max=Math.max(1,Math.floor(Number(cards.config.maxWritesPerTurn||12)));let processed=0;let scheduled=0;const remaining=[];
        while(cards.dirtyQueue.length){const row=cards.dirtyQueue.shift();if(!row)continue;if(processed>=max){remaining.push(row);continue;}const spec=this.buildCardSpecForDirtyTarget(row,root);processed+=1;if(spec&&spec.namespace){this.safeEnsureSingletonCard(spec,root);this.clearDirtySourceForRow(row,root);scheduled+=1;}else{this.recordOperation("processDirtyQueue",{namespace:String(row.namespace||""),mode:"skipped",message:"no serializable state for "+String(row.family||"unknown")+":"+String(row.id||"unknown")},root);}}
        while(remaining.length)cards.dirtyQueue.unshift(remaining.pop());if(scheduled>0)cards.lastSyncTurn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0;return scheduled;
      },
      ensureProtectedStarterCards(root=state.aidrpg){
        const cards=this.init(root);if(!cards||cards.config.restoreProtectedCards!==true)return 0;const specs=this.getProtectedStarterSpecs(root);cards.protected.namespaces=specs.map(function(spec){return spec.namespace;});let writes=0;const max=Math.max(1,Math.floor(Number(cards.config.maxStarterWritesPerTurn||12)));
        for(let i=0;i<specs.length&&writes<max;i+=1){const spec=specs[i];const matches=this.safeFindCardsByNamespace(spec.namespace,root);if(!matches.length){this.safeAddCard(spec,root);writes+=1;}else{const primary=matches[0];for(let d=1;d<matches.length;d+=1)this.safeRenameDuplicateCard(matches[d],spec.namespace,root);const currentHash=this.stableHash((primary.title||"")+"|"+(primary.entry||"")+"|"+(primary.keys||[]).join(","));if(currentHash!==spec.hash){this.safeUpdateCard(primary,spec,root);writes+=1;}}}
        if(writes>0){cards.protected.lastRestoreTurn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn:0;cards.lastSyncTurn=cards.protected.lastRestoreTurn;}
        return writes;
      },

        if(family==="entity")return this.serializeEntityCard(id,root);

          const specs=this.getProtectedStarterSpecs(root);for(let i=0;i<specs.length;i+=1){if(this.toKey(specs[i].id)===this.toKey(id)||this.toKey(specs[i].family+"_"+specs[i].id)===this.toKey(id))return specs[i];}
        }
        return null;
      },

      getBudget(mode,
      rawText){
        const maxChars=this.getMaxChars();
        const baseLen=String(rawText||"").length;
        const freeSpace=Math.max(120,
        maxChars-baseLen);
        let ratio=0.32;
        let hardMin=360;
        let hardMax=960;
        if(mode==="tiny"){
          ratio=0.22;
          hardMin=240;
          hardMax=520;
        }
        else if(mode==="wide"){
          ratio=0.42;
          hardMin=560;
          hardMax=1500;
        }
        let budget=Math.floor(maxChars*ratio);
        if(budget<hardMin)budget=hardMin;
        if(budget>hardMax)budget=hardMax;
        const freeCap=Math.max(160,
        Math.floor(freeSpace*0.72));
        if(budget>freeCap)budget=freeCap;
        return budget;
      },

          if(!text)continue;
          const nextLen=used+1+text.length;

          }
          lines.push(text);
          used=nextLen;
        }
        if(lines.length===1){
          return"";
        }

              names.push(scene.localEntitiesById[ref]);
            }
          }
          if(names.length){
            parts.push("Objects: "+names.join(", "));
          }
        }
        return parts.join(" | ");
      },
      makePlayerPacket(mode,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        const playerSummary=globalThis.AIDRPG.PlayerSystem&&typeof globalThis.AIDRPG.PlayerSystem.getCompactSummary==="function"?globalThis.AIDRPG.PlayerSystem.getCompactSummary(root.player): "";
        const inventoryContext=globalThis.AIDRPG.InventorySystem&&typeof globalThis.AIDRPG.InventorySystem.getContextInventorySummary==="function"?globalThis.AIDRPG.InventorySystem.getContextInventorySummary(root,

          parts.push(abilitySummary);

          parts.push(buildSummary);

        mode): "";

        if(partySummary)parts.push(partySummary);
        if(actorSummary)parts.push(actorSummary);
        if(memorySummary)parts.push(memorySummary);
        return parts.join(" | ");

      makeReputationPacket(mode,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        const summary=globalThis.AIDRPG.ReputationSystem&&typeof globalThis.AIDRPG.ReputationSystem.getCompactSummary==="function"?globalThis.AIDRPG.ReputationSystem.getCompactSummary(root,
        mode): "";

      makeQuestPacket(mode,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(globalThis.AIDRPG.QuestLogSystem&&typeof globalThis.AIDRPG.QuestLogSystem.getCompactSummary==="function"){
          const summary=globalThis.AIDRPG.QuestLogSystem.getCompactSummary(root,
          mode);

        }

        };

        };

          for(let i=0; i<active.length; i+=1){
            if(active[i]&&active[i].id===tracking.primaryQuestId){
              quest=active[i];

          quest=active[0];

            };

            const recentStatus=String(recentQuest.status||"archived").trim();
            return recentTitle?("Recent quest: "+recentTitle+" | Status: "+recentStatus): "";
          }
          return"";
        }

        const parts=["Quest: "+title];
        if(status){
          parts.push("Status: "+status);
        }
        if(mode!=="tiny"&&objective){
          parts.push("Goal: "+objective);
        }
        return parts.join(" | ");

      makeMapPacket(mode,

      makeWorldPacket(mode,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(mode!=="wide")return"";

        const world=root.world||{
        };

          return"";

        if(entity.mutable&&Array.isArray(entity.mutable.materialHints)&&entity.mutable.materialHints.length){
          parts.push("Materials: "+entity.mutable.materialHints.join(", "));
        }
        if(entity.mutable&&Array.isArray(entity.mutable.ownerHints)&&entity.mutable.ownerHints.length){
          parts.push("Owners: "+entity.mutable.ownerHints.join(", "));
        }
        if(entity.mutable&&Array.isArray(entity.mutable.districtHints)&&entity.mutable.districtHints.length){
          parts.push("District: "+entity.mutable.districtHints.join(", "));
        }
        return parts.length?("Linked detail: "+parts.join(" | ")): "";
      },
      takeDistinct(values,
      maxCount){
        const out=[];
        const list=Array.isArray(values)?values: [];
        for(let i=0; i<list.length&&out.length<(maxCount||4); i+=1){
          const clean=String(list[i]||"").trim();
          if(!clean)continue;
          if(out.indexOf(clean)===-1){
            out.push(clean);
          }
        }
        return out;
      }
    },
    MajorActorMemorySystem: {
      init(root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object"||Array.isArray(root))return null;
        if(!root.actors||typeof root.actors!=="object"||Array.isArray(root.actors)){
          root.actors={
          };
        }
        const actors=root.actors;
        if(!actors.majorMemory||typeof actors.majorMemory!=="object"||Array.isArray(actors.majorMemory)){
          actors.majorMemory={
          };
        }
        const memory=actors.majorMemory;
        if(!memory.byActorId||typeof memory.byActorId!=="object"||Array.isArray(memory.byActorId))memory.byActorId={
        };
        if(!Array.isArray(memory.activeIds))memory.activeIds=[];
        if(!Array.isArray(memory.recentEvents))memory.recentEvents=[];
        if(!memory.config||typeof memory.config!=="object"||Array.isArray(memory.config))memory.config={
        };
        const config=memory.config;
        if(typeof config.maxMajorActors!=="number")config.maxMajorActors=12;
        if(typeof config.maxGoals!=="number")config.maxGoals=6;
        if(typeof config.maxGrudges!=="number")config.maxGrudges=6;
        if(typeof config.maxNotes!=="number")config.maxNotes=8;
        if(typeof config.maxEvents!=="number")config.maxEvents=40;
        if(typeof config.activationSightings!=="number")config.activationSightings=5;
        return memory;
      },
      processOutput(rawText,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!root||typeof root!=="object")return 0;
        this.init(root);
        const A=globalThis.AIDRPG||{
        };
        const U=A.Utils;
        const raw=String(rawText||"");
        if(!raw.trim())return 0;
        if(A.TurnEngine&&typeof A.TurnEngine.isDuplicateCurrentOutput==="function"){
          if(A.TurnEngine.isDuplicateCurrentOutput())return 0;
        }
        let changes=0;
        changes+=this.discoverNamedMajorActors(raw,
        root);
        changes+=this.syncMajorActors(root);
        changes+=this.applyMemoryFromText(raw,
        root);
        changes+=this.rebuildActiveIds(raw,
        root);
        changes+=this.pruneMajorMemory(root);
        if(changes>0){
          if(U&&typeof U.invalidatePackets==="function")U.invalidatePackets(root);
          if(U&&typeof U.logEvent==="function")U.logEvent("Major actor memory updated.");
        }
        return changes;
      },
      discoverNamedMajorActors(rawText,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        const raw=String(rawText||"");
        const A=globalThis.AIDRPG||{
        };
        const ActorSystem=A.ActorProfileSystem;
        if(!ActorSystem||typeof ActorSystem.findOrCreateRecord!=="function")return 0;
        const found=[];
        const addName=(value,
        reason)=>{
          const G=globalThis.AIDRPG&&globalThis.AIDRPG.ActorNameExtractionGuard?globalThis.AIDRPG.ActorNameExtractionGuard:null;
          const P=globalThis.AIDRPG&&globalThis.AIDRPG.PlayerIdentityGuard?globalThis.AIDRPG.PlayerIdentityGuard:null;
          let name=this.cleanShortText(value||"");
          if(G&&typeof G.cleanPersonName==="function")name=G.cleanPersonName(name,root,reason);
          if(!name||this.isBannedActorLabel(name))return;
          if(P&&typeof P.isPlayerName==="function"&&P.isPlayerName(name,root))return;
          if(!/\b[A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}\b/.test(name))return;
          for(let i=0; i<found.length; i+=1){
            if(found[i].name.toLowerCase()===name.toLowerCase())return;
          }
          found.push({
            name: name,
            reason: String(reason||"named_major_actor")
          });
        };
        const titledPatterns=[/\b(High\s+Priestess|High\s+Priest|Archdruid|Archmage|Master|Queen|King|Sergeant|General|Commander|Chancellor|Baroness|Baron|Duchess|Duke|Elder|Oracle|Captain|Guildmaster|Guild\s+Master|Lord|Lady|Sir|Dame|Priestess|Priest|Mage|Wizard|Knight|Hunter|Barkeep|Innkeeper|Blacksmith|Smith)\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30})(?:\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}))?\b/g];
        for(let p=0; p<titledPatterns.length; p+=1){
          let match;
          while((match=titledPatterns[p].exec(raw))){
            addName([match[1],
            match[2],
            match[3]].filter(Boolean).join(" "),
            "titled_major_actor");
          }
        }
        const appositivePatterns=[/\b([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30})\s*,\s+(?:your\s+)?(?:companion|ally|friend|mentor|rival|guide|apothecary|scout|healer|bodyguard|protector|merchant|trader|contact|informant)\b/g,
        /\b([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30})\s+the\s+(?:wounded\s+|old\s+|young\s+|loyal\s+|scarred\s+)?(?:scout|apothecary|companion|ally|guide|oracle|healer|priestess|priest|captain|sergeant|general|mage|archmage|merchant|trader|contact|informant|cultist|acolyte)\b/g,
        /\b([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30})\b[^.!?]{0,50}\b(?:promises?|vows?|remembers?|trusts?|fears?|warns?|offers?\s+you\s+(?:an?\s+)?alliance|offers?\s+fair\s+trade|trades?\s+fairly|warms?\s+to\s+you|betrays?|swears?)\b/g,
        /\b([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30})\b[^.!?]{0,70}\b(?:is\s+wounded|is\s+injured|is\s+hurt|bleeds?|is\s+bleeding|is\s+poisoned|stays\s+with\s+the\s+party|stays\s+with\s+you|joins\s+the\s+party|follows\s+you|guards\s+you|protects\s+you)\b/g,
        /\b([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30})\b[^.!?]{0,80}\b(?:merchant|trader|fair\s+trade|trades?\s+fairly|warms?\s+to\s+you|cult|cultist|betrays?|betrayal|fearful|afraid)\b/g];
        for(let p=0; p<appositivePatterns.length; p+=1){
          let match;
          while((match=appositivePatterns[p].exec(raw))){
            addName(match[1],
            "important_named_actor");
          }
        }
        const namedCreaturePatterns=[/\byou\s+name\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([a-z][a-z' -]{2,30})\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}(?:\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30})?)\b/g,
        /\b(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)([a-z][a-z' -]{2,30})\s+(?:is\s+)?(?:named|called)\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}(?:\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30})?)\b/g];
        for(let p=0; p<namedCreaturePatterns.length; p+=1){
          let match;
          while((match=namedCreaturePatterns[p].exec(raw))){
            const kind=String(match[1]||"creature").replace(/^(?:blue|gray|grey|small|large|young|old|nameless)\s+/i,
            "").trim();
            const G=globalThis.AIDRPG&&globalThis.AIDRPG.ActorNameExtractionGuard?globalThis.AIDRPG.ActorNameExtractionGuard:null;
            const P=globalThis.AIDRPG&&globalThis.AIDRPG.PlayerIdentityGuard?globalThis.AIDRPG.PlayerIdentityGuard:null;
            let name=String(match[2]||"").trim();
            if(G&&typeof G.cleanPersonName==="function")name=G.cleanPersonName(name,root,"named_creature");
            if(!name||this.isBannedActorLabel(name))continue;
            if(P&&typeof P.isPlayerName==="function"&&P.isPlayerName(name,root))continue;
            const humanoidRole=/\b(?:knight|guard|merchant|man|woman|soldier|bandit|priest|mage|wizard|hunter|scout|innkeeper|barkeep|blacksmith|smith|noble|king|queen|captain|commander)\b/i.test(kind);
            found.push({
              name: name,
              reason: humanoidRole?"named_actor":"named_creature",
              creatureKind: humanoidRole?"":(kind||"creature")
            });
          }
        }
        let changes=0;
        for(let i=0; i<found.length; i+=1){
          const name=found[i].name;
          const sceneKey=A.Utils&&typeof A.Utils.toKey==="function"?A.Utils.toKey(name): name.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,
          "_");
          if(!sceneKey)continue;
          const roleTags=typeof ActorSystem.inferRoleTags==="function"?ActorSystem.inferRoleTags(name): [];
          const rankTags=typeof ActorSystem.inferRankTags==="function"?ActorSystem.inferRankTags(name): [];
          const category=found[i].creatureKind?"creature": (typeof ActorSystem.inferCategory==="function"?ActorSystem.inferCategory(name): "humanoid");
          if(found[i].creatureKind&&roleTags.indexOf("companion")===-1)roleTags.push("companion");
          if(found[i].creatureKind&&roleTags.indexOf(found[i].creatureKind)===-1)roleTags.push(found[i].creatureKind);
          const candidate={
            sceneKey: sceneKey,
            displayName: found[i].creatureKind?(name+" the "+found[i].creatureKind): name,
            roleTags: roleTags,
            rankTags: rankTags.length?rankTags: ["leader"],
            category: category,
            importanceScore: 5,
            persistent: true,
            major: true
          };
          const record=ActorSystem.findOrCreateRecord(candidate,
          root);
          if(!record||!record.identity||!record.identity.id)continue;
          if(typeof ActorSystem.applyCandidateToRecord==="function"){
            changes+=ActorSystem.applyCandidateToRecord(candidate,
            record,
            root)||0;
          }
          changes+=this.ensureMemoryForActor(record.identity.id,
          found[i].reason,
          root)?1: 0;
        }
        return changes;
      },
      syncMajorActors(root=state.aidrpg){
        this.init(root);
        const actors=root.actors||{
        };
        const byId=actors.byId||{
        };
        const allIds=Array.isArray(actors.allIds)?actors.allIds: [];
        let changes=0;
        for(let i=0; i<allIds.length; i+=1){
          const actorId=allIds[i];
          const actor=byId[actorId];
          if(!actor||typeof actor!=="object")continue;
          if(this.shouldActorHaveMemory(actor,
          root)){
            changes+=this.ensureMemoryForActor(actorId,
            "profile_major_actor",
            root)?1: 0;
          }
        }
        return changes;
      },
      shouldActorHaveMemory(actor,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        if(!actor||typeof actor!=="object")return false;
        const identity=actor.identity||{
        };
        const name=this.getActorName(actor);
        if(!name||this.isBannedActorLabel(name))return false;
        const importance=actor.importance||{
        };
        const score=Number(importance.score||0);
        const sightings=Number(importance.sightings||0);
        const rankTags=Array.isArray(actor.rankTags)?actor.rankTags: [];
        const roleTags=Array.isArray(actor.roleTags)?actor.roleTags: [];
        if(importance.major===true)return true;
        if(score>=4)return true;
        if(sightings>=this.getConfig(root).activationSightings)return true;
        for(let i=0; i<rankTags.length; i+=1){
          const tag=String(rankTags[i]||"").toLowerCase();
          if(tag==="leader"||tag==="elite"||tag==="veteran"||tag==="royalty")return true;
        }
        const importantRoles=new Set(["captain",
        "commander",
        "guildmaster",
        "general",
        "sergeant",
        "queen",
        "king",
        "chancellor",
        "baron",
        "baroness",
        "duke",
        "duchess",
        "elder",
        "oracle",
        "archmage",
        "priest",
        "priestess",
        "apothecary",
        "scout",
        "merchant",
        "trader",
        "companion",
        "ally"]);
        for(let i=0; i<roleTags.length; i+=1){
          const tag=String(roleTags[i]||"").toLowerCase();
          if(importantRoles.has(tag))return true;
        }
        if(/\b(High Priestess|High Priest|Archmage|Queen|King|Sergeant|General|Commander|Chancellor|Baroness|Baron|Duchess|Duke|Elder|Oracle|Captain|Guildmaster|Lord|Lady|Sir|Dame)\b/.test(String(identity.name||identity.displayName||name||""))){
          return true;
        }
        return false;
      },
      ensureMemoryForActor(actorId,
      reason,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        const memory=this.init(root);
        if(!memory)return false;
        const id=String(actorId||"").trim();
        if(!id)return false;
        const actor=root.actors&&root.actors.byId?root.actors.byId[id]: null;
        const name=actor?this.getActorName(actor): id;
        const turn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0;
        if(!memory.byActorId[id]||typeof memory.byActorId[id]!=="object"){
          memory.byActorId[id]={
            actorId: id,
            name: name,
            createdTurn: turn,
            lastSeenTurn: turn,
            lastUpdatedTurn: turn,
            relationshipStance: "neutral",
            goals: [],
            grudges: [],
            attitudeNotes: [],
            longTermNotes: [],
            recentEvents: [],
            activation: {
              reason: String(reason||"major_actor"),
              activationCount: 0
            }
          };
          this.pushRecentEvent("activated",
          name,
          id,
          String(reason||"major_actor"),
          root);
          this.markActorDirty(id,
          root);
          return true;
        }
        const rec=memory.byActorId[id];
        let changed=false;
        if(rec.name!==name&&name){
          rec.name=name;
          changed=true;
        }
        if(!rec.activation||typeof rec.activation!=="object"){
          rec.activation={
            reason: String(reason||"major_actor"),
            activationCount: 0
          };
          changed=true;
        }
        if(!Array.isArray(rec.goals)){
          rec.goals=[];
          changed=true;
        }
        if(!Array.isArray(rec.grudges)){
          rec.grudges=[];
          changed=true;
        }
        if(!Array.isArray(rec.attitudeNotes)){
          rec.attitudeNotes=[];
          changed=true;
        }
        if(!Array.isArray(rec.longTermNotes)){
          rec.longTermNotes=[];
          changed=true;
        }
        if(!Array.isArray(rec.recentEvents)){
          rec.recentEvents=[];
          changed=true;
        }
        if(typeof rec.relationshipStance!=="string"){
          rec.relationshipStance="neutral";
          changed=true;
        }
        if(changed){
          rec.lastUpdatedTurn=turn;
          this.markActorDirty(id,
          root);
        }
        return changed;
      },
      applyMemoryFromText(rawText,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        const memory=this.init(root);
        if(!memory)return 0;
        const raw=String(rawText||"");
        const actorIds=Object.keys(memory.byActorId||{
        });
        let changes=0;
        for(let i=0; i<actorIds.length; i+=1){

      applyMemoryCandidate(actorId,
      candidate,
      root=state.aidrpg){
        const memory=this.init(root);
        if(!memory||!candidate||typeof candidate!=="object")return 0;
        const rec=memory.byActorId[String(actorId||"")];
        if(!rec)return 0;
        const kind=String(candidate.kind||"note").toLowerCase();
        const text=this.cleanShortText(candidate.text||"");

        let changes=0;
        if(kind==="goal"){
          changes+=this.pushCappedUnique(rec.goals,
          text,
          this.getConfig(root).maxGoals);
        }
        else if(kind==="grudge"){
          changes+=this.pushCappedUnique(rec.grudges,
          text,
          this.getConfig(root).maxGrudges);
          if(rec.relationshipStance!=="hostile"){
            rec.relationshipStance="hostile";
            changes+=1;
          }
        }
        else if(kind==="relationship"){
          const stance=text.indexOf("hostile:")===0?"hostile": text.indexOf("friendly:")===0?"friendly": "mixed";
          if(rec.relationshipStance!==stance){
            rec.relationshipStance=stance;
            changes+=1;
          }
          changes+=this.pushCappedUnique(rec.attitudeNotes,
          text.replace(/^(?:friendly|hostile|mixed):\s*/i,
          ""),
          this.getConfig(root).maxNotes);
        }
        else {
          changes+=this.pushCappedUnique(rec.attitudeNotes,
          text,
          this.getConfig(root).maxNotes);
        }
        if(changes>0){
          const turn=root.meta&&typeof root.meta.currentTurn==="number"?root.meta.currentTurn: 0;
          rec.lastUpdatedTurn=turn;
          this.pushCappedUnique(rec.recentEvents,
          kind+": "+text,
          8);
          this.pushRecentEvent(kind,
          rec.name||actorId,
          actorId,
          text,
          root);
          this.markActorDirty(actorId,
          root);
        }
        return changes;
      },
      rebuildActiveIds(rawText,

        });

      },

          };

        Number(rec.activation.activationCount||0))+1;
        if(changes>0){

          root);
        }
        return changes;

        }

      getContextSummary(root=state.aidrpg,
      mode="normal"){

        };

          root,

          if(summary)parts.push(summary);
        }

      },

      cleanShortText(value){
        return String(value||"").replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]+/g,
        " ").replace(/[<>]/g,
        "").replace(/\s+/g,
        " ").replace(/^[\s:;,.!?-]+|[\s:;,.!?-]+$/g,
        "").trim().slice(0,
        160);
      },
      escapeRegExp(value){
        return String(value||"").replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,
        "\\$&");
      },
      pushCappedUnique(list,
      value,
      maxCount){
        if(!Array.isArray(list))return 0;
        const clean=this.cleanShortText(value);
        if(!clean)return 0;
        for(let i=0; i<list.length; i+=1){
          if(String(list[i]||"").toLowerCase()===clean.toLowerCase())return 0;
        }
        list.push(clean);
        const max=Math.max(1,
        Math.floor(Number(maxCount||8)));
        while(list.length>max)list.shift();
        return 1;
      },
      replaceArray(target,
      next){
        if(!Array.isArray(target)||!Array.isArray(next))return 0;
        let changed=target.length!==next.length;
        if(!changed){
          for(let i=0; i<target.length; i+=1){
            if(target[i]!==next[i]){
              changed=true;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        if(!changed)return 0;
        target.length=0;
        for(let i=0; i<next.length; i+=1)target.push(next[i]);
        return 1;
      },
      dedupeCandidates(list){
        const out=[];
        const seen=new Set();
        const input=Array.isArray(list)?list: [];
        for(let i=0; i<input.length; i+=1){
          const row=input[i];
          if(!row||typeof row!=="object")continue;
          const key=String(row.kind||"")+"|"+this.cleanShortText(row.text||"").toLowerCase();
          if(seen.has(key))continue;
          seen.add(key);
          out.push(row);
        }
        return out;
      }

      ensureGroup(label,count,side,kind,root,detail){const s=this.init(root);let clean=this.clean(label,70).replace(/^(?:the|a|an|some|several)\s+/i,"");if(!clean||/^(?:army|group|force|troops|soldiers)$/i.test(clean)&&!detail)return null;const n=Math.max(1,Math.min(999999,Math.floor(Number(count)||1)));const id="scale_group_"+this.key((side||"unknown")+"_"+clean);let rec=s.groupsById[id];const turn=this.turn(root);if(!rec){rec={id,name:clean,count:n,side:String(side||"unknown"),kind:String(kind||"force"),status:"active",morale:"steady",supplies:"unknown",location:this.currentPlace(root),firstSeenTurn:turn,lastSeenTurn:turn,notes:[]};s.groupsById[id]=rec;this.addUnique(s.groupIds,id);this.recordEvent("Group tracked: "+n+" "+clean+" ("+rec.side+").",root);}else{if(n>0)rec.count=n;rec.lastSeenTurn=turn;rec.location=this.currentPlace(root)||rec.location;}if(detail)this.addUnique(rec.notes,this.clean(detail,120));this.trim(root);return rec;},
      inferSide(fragment){const l=String(fragment||"").toLowerCase();if(/\b(?:your|ally|allied|friendly|our|kingdom's|party's)\b/.test(l))return"ally";if(/\b(?:enemy|hostile|opposing|invading|raider|bandit|goblin|undead|orc)\b/.test(l))return"enemy";return"unknown";},
      kindFromLabel(label){const l=String(label||"").toLowerCase();if(/\b(?:fleet|ships|navy)\b/.test(l))return"fleet";if(/\b(?:cavalry|riders|knights)\b/.test(l))return"cavalry";if(/\b(?:archers|bowmen)\b/.test(l))return"ranged";if(/\b(?:mages|wizards|casters)\b/.test(l))return"caster";if(/\b(?:guards|soldiers|troops|infantry|militia|legion|battalion|regiment|squad|platoon|company)\b/.test(l))return"military";if(/\b(?:horde|swarm|pack)\b/.test(l))return"horde";return"group";},
      detectGroups(raw,root){let changes=0;const patterns=[/\b(\d{1,6}|(?:one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten)\s+hundred|(?:one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten)\s+thousand|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|twenty|thirty|forty|fifty|hundred|thousand)\s+([a-z][a-z' -]{2,50}?\b(?:soldiers|troops|guards|militia|archers|cavalry|knights|goblins|orcs|undead|skeletons|zombies|raiders|bandits|ships|mages|warriors|beasts|wolves))\b/gi,/\b(?:an?\s+)?(army|legion|battalion|regiment|company|platoon|squad|horde|fleet|warband)\s+of\s+([a-z][a-z' -]{2,50})\b/gi];for(let pi=0;pi<patterns.length;pi++){let m;const re=patterns[pi];while((m=re.exec(raw))){let count=1,label="";if(pi===0){count=this.wordNumber(m[1])||1;label=m[2];}else{count=1;label=m[1]+" of "+m[2];}const side=this.inferSide(m[0]);const g=this.ensureGroup(label,count,side,this.kindFromLabel(label),root,m[0]);if(g)changes++;}}return changes;},
      detectConflict(raw,root){const s=this.init(root);const l=String(raw||"").toLowerCase();if(!/\b(?:battle|war|siege|skirmish|battlefield|front line|under siege|assault|invasion)\b/.test(l))return 0;const scene=this.currentPlace(root);let type="battle";if(/\bsiege|under siege\b/.test(l))type="siege";else if(/\bwar|invasion\b/.test(l))type="war";else if(/\bskirmish\b/.test(l))type="skirmish";const scale=/\b(?:army|legion|battalion|regiment|fleet|war)\b/.test(l)?"army":/\b(?:squad|platoon|skirmish)\b/.test(l)?"squad":"battlefield";const id="conflict_"+this.key(type+"_"+scene);let rec=s.conflictsById[id];const turn=this.turn(root);if(!rec){rec={id,title:type.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+type.slice(1)+" at "+scene,type,scale,status:"active",location:scene,objectives:[],groups:[],casualties:[],notes:[],createdTurn:turn,updatedTurn:turn};s.conflictsById[id]=rec;s.conflictIds.push(id);this.recordEvent("Conflict tracked: "+rec.title+" ("+scale+").",root);}rec.updatedTurn=turn;s.activeConflictId=id;s.contextActiveUntil=turn+Number(s.config.contextHoldTurns||4);Object.keys(s.groupsById).forEach(gid=>{if(rec.groups.indexOf(gid)===-1)rec.groups.push(gid);});this.trim(root);return 1;},
      detectMoraleSuppliesCasualties(raw,root){const s=this.init(root);const rec=s.activeConflictId?s.conflictsById[s.activeConflictId]:null;if(!rec)return 0;let changes=0;const l=String(raw||"").toLowerCase();if(/\b(?:morale breaks|morale collapses|panic|rout|routes|flee the battlefield|hold firm|rally)\b/.test(l)){rec.notes.push({turn:this.turn(root),text:this.clean("Morale note: "+raw,160)});changes++;}
        if(/\b(?:supplies run low|out of supplies|short on food|ammunition runs low|reinforcements arrive|supply line)\b/.test(l)){rec.notes.push({turn:this.turn(root),text:this.clean("Supply note: "+raw,160)});changes++;}
        const cm=String(raw||"").match(/\b(\d{1,5}|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|twenty|thirty|forty|fifty|hundred)\s+(soldiers|troops|guards|goblins|orcs|undead|skeletons|raiders|bandits|ships)\s+(?:fall|die|are slain|are killed|burn|drown|break)\b/i);if(cm){rec.casualties.push({turn:this.turn(root),count:this.wordNumber(cm[1])||1,label:cm[2],text:this.clean(cm[0],100)});changes++;}while(rec.notes.length>12)rec.notes.shift();while(rec.casualties.length>12)rec.casualties.shift();if(changes)rec.updatedTurn=this.turn(root);return changes;},
      detectProtagonists(raw,root,fromInput){const s=this.init(root);let changes=0;const text=String(raw||"");const explicit=/\b(?:player characters?|protagonists?|controlled by a player|second player|multiplayer)\b/i.test(text);const listMatch=text.match(/\b(?:players?|protagonists?|player characters?)\s+(?:are|include|are named)\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}(?:\s*,\s*[A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30})*(?:\s+and\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30})?)/i);if(listMatch&&listMatch[1]){const names=listMatch[1].replace(/\s+and\s+/g,",").split(/\s*,\s*/);for(let i=0;i<names.length;i++)changes+=this.ensureProtagonist(names[i],root,"explicit player list")?1:0;}
        const one=text.match(/\b([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30})\s+(?:is|becomes|joins as)\s+(?:a\s+)?(?:player character|protagonist|second player|player-controlled character)\b/i);if(one&&one[1])changes+=this.ensureProtagonist(one[1],root,"explicit protagonist")?1:0;
        if(explicit){const names=[];const re=/\b([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30})\b/g;let m;while((m=re.exec(text))&&names.length<6){const n=m[1];if(!/^(?:The|You|Your|AIDRPG|Player|Character|Protagonist|Second|Multiplayer)$/i.test(n)&&names.indexOf(n)===-1)names.push(n);}if(names.length>=2){for(let i=0;i<Math.min(names.length,4);i++)changes+=this.ensureProtagonist(names[i],root,"explicit multiplayer context")?1:0;}}
        if(Object.keys(s.protagonistsById).length>1){s.narrationMode="third_person";s.contextActiveUntil=Math.max(Number(s.contextActiveUntil||0),this.turn(root)+Number(s.config.contextHoldTurns||4));}
        return changes;},
      ensureProtagonist(name,root,reason){const s=this.init(root);let clean=this.clean(name,40);if(!clean||/^(?:You|The|A|An|Player|Character)$/i.test(clean))return null;const id="protagonist_"+this.key(clean);let rec=s.protagonistsById[id];const turn=this.turn(root);if(!rec){rec={id,name:clean,role:"player-controlled protagonist",status:"active",location:this.currentPlace(root),firstSeenTurn:turn,lastSeenTurn:turn,notes:[]};s.protagonistsById[id]=rec;this.addUnique(s.protagonistIds,id);this.recordEvent("Protagonist tracked: "+clean+".",root);}rec.lastSeenTurn=turn;rec.location=this.currentPlace(root)||rec.location;if(reason)this.addUnique(rec.notes,this.clean(reason,80));this.trim(root);return rec;},
      trim(root){const s=this.init(root);const maxG=Number(s.config.maxGroups||24),maxC=Number(s.config.maxConflicts||8),maxP=Number(s.config.maxProtagonists||6);while(s.groupIds.length>maxG){const old=s.groupIds.shift();if(old)delete s.groupsById[old];}while(s.conflictIds.length>maxC){const old=s.conflictIds.shift();if(old&&old!==s.activeConflictId)delete s.conflictsById[old];}while(s.protagonistIds.length>maxP){const old=s.protagonistIds.shift();if(old)delete s.protagonistsById[old];}return 1;},
      getActiveConflict(root=state.aidrpg){const s=this.init(root);if(s.activeConflictId&&s.conflictsById[s.activeConflictId])return s.conflictsById[s.activeConflictId];for(let i=s.conflictIds.length-1;i>=0;i--){const c=s.conflictsById[s.conflictIds[i]];if(c&&c.status==="active")return c;}return null;},
      getContextSummary(root=state.aidrpg,mode="normal"){const s=this.init(root);const cfg=root&&root.settings&&root.settings.aidrpg?root.settings.aidrpg:{};if(cfg.scaleContext===false&&cfg.multiplayerContext===false)return"";const turn=this.turn(root);const wake=!!(root.pending&&root.pending.scaleWake);const conflict=this.getActiveConflict(root);const protagonists=s.protagonistIds.map(id=>s.protagonistsById[id]).filter(Boolean);if(!wake&&turn>Number(s.contextActiveUntil||0)&&!conflict&&protagonists.length<2)return"";const parts=[];if(conflict&&cfg.scaleContext!==false){parts.push("Scale: "+conflict.title+" | "+conflict.scale+" scale; resolve by objectives, morale, terrain, supplies, commanders, special units, and casualties, not by simulating every soldier");const groups=(conflict.groups||[]).map(id=>s.groupsById[id]).filter(Boolean).slice(-3);if(groups.length)parts.push("Groups "+groups.map(g=>g.count+" "+g.name+"("+g.side+")").join(", "));if(conflict.casualties&&conflict.casualties.length&&mode!=="tiny")parts.push("Casualties tracked; do not resurrect or erase losses without cause");}
        else if(cfg.scaleContext!==false){const groups=s.groupIds.map(id=>s.groupsById[id]).filter(Boolean).slice(-3);if(groups.length)parts.push("Groups: "+groups.map(g=>g.count+" "+g.name+"("+g.side+")").join(", "));}
        if(protagonists.length>1&&cfg.multiplayerContext!==false){parts.push("Protagonists: "+protagonists.slice(0,4).map(p=>p.name+" at "+(p.location||"current scene")).join(", "));parts.push("Narration: multi-protagonist scenes should use third person/name-based narration instead of assuming a single 'you'");}
        return parts.join(" | ");},
      getCardLines(root=state.aidrpg){const s=this.init(root);const lines=["Scale & Protagonists",""];const conflict=this.getActiveConflict(root);if(conflict){lines.push("Active Conflict");lines.push("- "+conflict.title+" — "+conflict.scale+" scale, "+conflict.status);if(conflict.objectives&&conflict.objectives.length)lines.push("Objectives: "+conflict.objectives.slice(-4).join(", "));if(conflict.casualties&&conflict.casualties.length)lines.push("Casualties: "+conflict.casualties.slice(-4).map(c=>c.count+" "+c.label).join(", "));}else lines.push("Active Conflict: none");lines.push("");lines.push("Tracked Groups");const groups=s.groupIds.map(id=>s.groupsById[id]).filter(Boolean).slice(-10);if(groups.length)groups.forEach(g=>lines.push("- "+g.count+" "+g.name+" | side: "+g.side+" | morale: "+g.morale+" | supplies: "+g.supplies));else lines.push("- None");lines.push("");lines.push("Protagonists");const pros=s.protagonistIds.map(id=>s.protagonistsById[id]).filter(Boolean).slice(0,8);if(pros.length)pros.forEach(p=>lines.push("- "+p.name+" — "+p.status+" at "+(p.location||"current scene")));else lines.push("- Single-protagonist mode unless the story explicitly establishes multiple player-controlled protagonists.");lines.push("");lines.push("Notes: Large battles are tracked at group/objective scale. Summoned armies, squads, fleets, and battlefield forces should remain grouped unless an individual becomes important. Multiplayer scenes use third-person/name-based narration when more than one protagonist is active.");return lines;},
      formatScale(root=state.aidrpg){const s=this.init(root);const lines=["[AIDRPG /scale]","Groups: "+s.groupIds.length,"Conflicts: "+s.conflictIds.length,"Protagonists: "+s.protagonistIds.length,"Narration Mode: "+s.narrationMode,""];this.getCardLines(root).forEach(l=>lines.push(l));return lines.join("\n")+"\n";}
    }

  };
})();
